jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

Be part of a team that makes a real difference.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement machine learning models and algorithms to address business problems related to medical claims
  • Conduct exploratory data analysis to identify patterns, trends, and insights
  • Clean, preprocess, and transform large, complex datasets to ensure data quality
  • Create compelling data visualizations and dashboards to communicate findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy models into production environments
  • Monitor model performance and implement improvements as needed
  • Mentor junior data scientists and contribute to best practices documentation
  • Stay current with emerging techniques and technologies in data science and machine learning
  • Present findings and recommendations to leadership and business stakeholders

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, or related quantitative field
  • 3+ years of professional experience in data science, machine learning, or related analytical role
  • Strong programming skills in Python or R, and proficiency with data manipulation libraries (pandas, numpy, dplyr)
  • Experience building and deploying machine learning models using frameworks such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch
  • Solid understanding of statistical methods, experimental design, and hypothesis testing
  • Proficiency with SQL and experience working with relational databases
  • Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts to non-technical audiences

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with cloud computing platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Experience with Snowflake cloud data platform, including:
    • Writing optimized SQL queries for Snowflake's architecture
    • Leveraging Snowflake's unique features like Time Travel, Zero-Copy Cloning, and Secure Data Sharing
    • Working with Snowflake's semi-structured data capabilities (VARIANT, ARRAY, OBJECT types)
    • Using Snowflake's integration with Python via connectors and Snowpark
    • Experience with Snowflake's performance optimization techniques
  • Knowledge of big data technologies (Spark, Hadoop)
  • Experience with version control systems (Git) and collaborative development workflows
  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience with NLP, computer vision, or time series analysis
  • Contributions to open-source projects or research publications

Required Technical Skills

  • Programming: Python, SQL, R (preferred)
  • Cloud Data Warehousing: Snowflake SQL, Snowflake data objects and architecture
  • Machine Learning: Classification, regression, clustering, dimensionality reduction
  • Data Processing: ETL pipelines, data cleaning, feature engineering
  • Statistics: Hypothesis testing, experimental design, A/B testing
  • Tools: Jupyter, Git, Docker (preferred)
  • Visualization: Matplotlib, Seaborn, ggplot2, Tableau, PowerBI

Soft Skills

  • Problem-solving and analytical thinking
  • Excellent written and verbal communication
  • Collaboration and teamwork
  • Attention to detail
  • Time management and prioritization
  • Continuous learning mindset

Benefits

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living.   • Ensure strategic opportunities receive the right level of technical and proposal support.

  • Define intake standards, SLAs, review checkpoints, escalation paths, and quality gates for demos and proposal work.

  • Support hiring, onboarding, development, performance management, and succession planning across the SE and Proposal teams.

  • Have experience managing the end-to-end technical aspects of sales opportunities through to technical closure.

jobs.description:
Agentify — це міжнародна аутсорсингова компанія, яка з 2013 року задає тренди на ринку клієнтського сервісу та продажів. Сьогодні Agentify — це сотні однодумців, які працюють як у наших сучасних технологічних офісах, так і в зручному віддаленому форматі (Remote) з будь-якої точки світу. Наші Core-ніші та експертиза:

  • 🔹 E-commerce & Retail — повний супровід клієнтів інтернет-магазинів: від оформлення замовлень до координації міжнародної логістики та повернень.

  • 🔹 Активні продажі — робота з теплими лідами, телемаркетинг, cross-sell/up-sell та повернення клієнтів до покинутих кошиків.

  • 🔹 Омніканальний Customer Care — клієнтська та технічна підтримка користувачів у режимі 24/7/365.

  • 🔹 Цифрові чати — спілкування з клієнтами без голосу через Live-чати на сайтах, Email та популярні месенджери (Viber, Telegram, WhatsApp).

  • 🔹 Інтелектуальна телефонія — робота з сучасним програмним забезпеченням, професійними CRM-системами та AI-інструментами автоматизації.

В свою команду зараз ми шукаємоОператор call-центра \ sales manager !

🌟Чому кандидати обирають Agentify?

  • Стабільність з 2013 року —прозорі виплати та впевненістьу завтрашньому дні.

  • Власна Академія —безкоштовне навчання з нуля(ділова комунікація, техніки продажів, робота з програмами та сервісами). Ми інвестуємо в розвиток співробітників і підтримуємо їх на всіх етапах адаптації.

  • Дохід без обмежень —погодинна ставка + відсоток від викупуза виконання KPI. У продажах твій заробіток залежить насамперед від твоїх результатів.

  • Реальний кар'єрний ліфт — більшість наших Team Lead, Supervisor та QA-менеджерів виросли всередині компанії.

  • Абсолютна інклюзивність— ми вільні від стереотипів. Для нас важливі лише твої навички, енергія та бажання розвиватися.

Ми пропонуємо:

  • Своєчасна оплата праці,що складається зфіксованої ставки 3,25 євро/год + % від викупу товарів.Середній дохід 400-700 євро на місяць.

  • Повністю віддалена робота.

  • Зручний позмінний графік :8.00−15.00 та з 15.00−22.00. 2 плаваючі вихідні на тиждень.

  • Кар'єрний ріст: можливість вирости до Team Lead, Тренера чи Менеджера QI

  • Постійне навчання за рахунок компанії та підвищення кваліфікації

  • Бонус за успішне проходження навчання

  • Дружній колектив і наставники, які завжди допоможуть.

  • Подарунки на річницю роботи та дітям співробітників на свята.

  • Спеціальні бонуси для менеджерів з найвищими показниками: індивідуальний графік, оплата спортивних абонементів або оплата курсів з іноземної мови, оплата розваг та інші привілеї.

  • Акція «Бонус за новачка» (ти отримуєш приємний бонус за кожного працівника, що прийшов по твоїй рекомендації)

Наші бізнес-цінності:

Відкритість—ми цінуємо вміння говорити прямо, чути інших і шукати нові підходи.

Надійність— для нас важливо, щоб на кожного члена команди можна було покластися, і ми створюємо умови для відповідальної роботи.

Безперервний розвиток—ми не чекаємо досконалості, але очікуємо бажання вчитися та вдосконалюватися.

Націленість на результат— ми працюємо, щоб досягати реальних результатів, а не для виконання формальних планів.

Клієнтоорієнтованість— ми ставимо потреби клієнтів у центр уваги та працюємо над тим, щоб забезпечувати якісний сервіс та пропонувати рішення, які створюють реальну цінність

Твої майбутні обов’язки:

  • Здійснювати дзвінки по теплій базі клієнтів.

  • Виявляти потреби клієнтів, презентувати товари та працювати з запереченнями (активні продажі).

  • Продавати продукцію компанії за скриптами.

  • Фіксувати замовлення в CRM-системі.

Що потрібно, щоб до нас приєднатись:

  • ПК/ноутбук, дротова гарнітура та стабільний інтернет.

  • Базове володіння ПК і офісними програмами.

  • Уміння продавати або бажання навчитися це робити.

Що для нас важливо?

Щоб ви бачили сенс у тому, що робите, були чесними з собою та колегами й не боялися вийти за межі звичного, коли це потрібно.

Якщо ви шукаєте місце, де ваші дії справді впливають на результат, ми будемо раді познайомитися!

jobs.excerpt: SAP TM S/4HANA Rollout Consultant, PortugalContract: 6 months initially, extensible.
jobs.description:
SAP TM S/4HANA Rollout Consultant, Portugal

Contract: 6 months initially, extensible. Long-term programme. Start: 1 November 2026 Location: Remote, for consultants based in Portugal. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.

The programme

A global manufacturing organisation is moving its transportation processes onto SAP Transportation Management (TM) on S/4HANA. The global template is the base, and it is being rolled out to sites in waves. Each wave brings new plants, new carriers and new country requirements into the template.

You will own the TM solution for the waves you are given. You will run fit-to-standard sessions with the business, decide what the template already covers and what is a real local gap, and design the answer without breaking the global standard. You will then carry that design through build, testing, cutover and early support after go-live.

What you will work on

Fit-gap for each rollout wave. Local transport practice, carriers, legal and document needs measured against the global design. TM solution design on S/4HANA. Freight planning, carrier selection and tendering, freight order execution, charge calculation and freight settlement. Integration across the S/4HANA logistics chain. Outbound sales orders and deliveries, inbound purchasing flows, warehouse execution, and freight cost through to finance. Carrier connectivity. EDI or business network onboarding, tracking, and status messages from carriers. Functional specifications for the build team, working closely with integration, development and test leads. Test planning and defect resolution through integration and user acceptance testing. Cutover, hypercare and handover to support for each wave. Feeding what each wave teaches back into the template, so the next wave starts from a better base.

What you bring

8 or more years in SAP logistics, with SAP TM on S/4HANA as a core part of it. At least one TM rollout or global template programme for a manufacturing business, where you did the fit-gap and the solution design yourself, not only the configuration. Working knowledge of how TM connects to SD, MM, EWM and FI/CO, and where those integrations tend to break. Experience running workshops with business users and turning what they say into a design and a specification. Comfort working remotely across countries in a programme team made up of several companies.

Useful but not essential:

jobs.excerpt: We're hiring a Machine Learning Engineer to join the team of one of our clients, a computer vision AI company whose platform turns standard cameras into intelligent systems that raise productivity and reduce operating costs for enterprise customers in healthcare, manufacturing, and retail.
jobs.description:
We're hiring a Machine Learning Engineer to join the team of one of our clients, a computer vision AI company whose platform turns standard cameras into intelligent systems that raise productivity and reduce operating costs for enterprise customers in healthcare, manufacturing, and retail.

You will be responsible for the design, accuracy, and backbone of the client's computer vision applications: preparing data, training and configuring neural networks, deploying models in real customer environments, and refining algorithms. The role involves regular interaction with technical and non-technical stakeholders and close collaboration with the solutions engineering team, with room to grow, lead technical projects, and improve current processes.

The Product

The platform helps hospitals automate supply room monitoring and inventory management. Fixed cameras and AI continuously track supplies in storage areas and update on-hand counts in real time. When inventory falls below defined thresholds, replenishment orders are generated automatically and sent to ERP systems, eliminating manual counts and barcode scanning. Hospitals reduce critical stockouts, optimize inventory levels, and free clinical and supply chain teams to spend more time on patient care.

What You Will Do

  • Design, train, and fine-tune models for object detection, classification, segmentation, tracking, and anomaly detection on real customer video and images.
  • Adapt pretrained and foundation models (YOLO-family detectors, ViTs, CLIP-style and vision-language models) to new use cases with limited labeled data.
  • Own data pipelines end to end: curation, labeling guidelines, augmentation, synthetic data, and dataset versioning.
  • Optimize models for production and edge hardware using quantization, pruning, distillation, ONNX export, and TensorRT, meeting agreed latency and accuracy targets.
  • Build evaluation suites with clear metrics (mAP, precision/recall, false-alarm rates per camera-hour) and catch regressions before release.
  • Deploy and monitor models in production, diagnose drift and failure cases, and close the loop with retraining.
  • Write clean, tested, reviewed code and contribute to shared ML tooling.

Requirements

  • Solid experience building ML systems, with at least 2 years focused on computer vision.
  • Strong Python and hands-on experience with PyTorch (or TensorFlow) for training and debugging deep learning models.
  • At least one computer vision model shipped to production, with the ability to explain the trade-offs made along the way.
  • Solid grasp of CNN and transformer architectures for detection, segmentation, and classification.
  • Experience with OpenCV and image/video processing: decoding streams, preprocessing, and augmentation.
  • Working knowledge of model optimization for inference (ONNX, TensorRT, quantization, or similar).
  • Comfortable with Docker, Git, Linux, and training on GPUs in a cloud environment (AWS or Azure).
  • Sound ML fundamentals: loss functions, overfitting, class imbalance, evaluation metrics, and experiment design.
  • Clear written and verbal communication in English.

Why join us:

  • Remote job from LATAM
  • USD compensation
  • Paid time off
  • Long-term engagements
  • Collaborate with international teams on innovative, real-world AI projects.

We’re looking for a culturally fluent Social Media Manager to lead organic social for our millennial and Gen Z consumer brands. You’ll own strategy and execution across our clients’ channels, build and run UGC programs that turn real customers and creators into a brand’s best content engine, and spot the cultural moments worth jumping on before everyone else does. You’ll know what drives views and engagement on every platform, optimize relentlessly, and report on results in a way clients understand and act on. You’ll be the day-to-day lead for social media client relationships, the person who solves problems before they become problems, and the creative mind who knows exactly when a post can be made in Canva and when it needs a designer’s touch. This is an ideal position for someone who lives at the pulse of culture, brings strategic rigor to every idea, and thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative agency environment.

Responsibilities:

Your role would include, but not be limited to, the following:

Social Strategy & Execution

Develop and lead organic social strategies across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, Pinterest, and emerging platforms that ladder up to client business goals.
Own content calendars from concept to publish, writing platform-native copy and captions in each brand’s voice.
Create on-brand assets in Canva, and write clear, detailed creative briefs for designers on assets that require custom design or motion.
Oversee community management and engagement, ensuring every brand shows up consistently and responsively.

UGC Programs

Plan and run UGC campaigns within social, from concept and creator sourcing to briefing, content review, and publishing.
Write UGC briefs that deliver authentic, platform-ready content aligned with campaign objectives.
Manage usage rights and repurpose UGC across owned channels and paid support.
Build a repeatable UGC content engine that keeps client channels fresh and drives engagement and conversion.

Culture & Trendjacking

Monitor culture, trends, memes, and platform features daily, and identify trendjacking opportunities that fit each brand.
Move quickly from idea to approval to post so clients show up in the conversation while it still matters.
Bring proactive, culturally relevant ideas to clients that resonate with millennial and Gen Z audiences.

Performance, Optimization & Reporting

Optimize content for views and engagement by testing hooks, formats, lengths, captions, audio, and posting times, and apply what works to future content.
Understand how each platform’s algorithm distributes content, and adjust strategy to maximize reach, watch time, and retention.
Track views, reach, engagement rate, watch time, saves, shares, and follower growth across organic social and UGC.
Build and present monthly client reports that connect performance to business goals, with clear insights, wins, and recommended next steps.
Use native analytics and social reporting tools to monitor performance in real time and course-correct quickly.

Client Leadership

Serve as the day-to-day lead for client relationships, building strong rapport and trust.
Anticipate challenges and solve problems with clear, confident recommendations.
Mentor and guide coordinators, and contribute to internal process improvements.

Skills & Qualifications:

4+ years of agency experience in social media management (minimum).
Based in the US or Canada and authorized to work there.
Proven experience planning and running UGC campaigns within social, including briefing creators and managing usage rights.
A proven track record of growing views and engagement, with a strong understanding of platform algorithms, hooks, and retention.
Experience building and presenting client-ready performance reports that turn data into clear recommendations.
Advanced Canva skills, plus experience briefing designers on custom assets.
A track record of trendjacking and moving at the speed of culture for millennial and Gen Z consumer brands.
Excellent client rapport, with strong communication and presentation skills.
Sharp problem-solving skills and the ability to stay calm and decisive under tight timelines.
Organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple clients at once.
Familiarity with CapCut, social scheduling and analytics tools, Notion, and Google Drive is a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Customer Experience
jobs.excerpt: About PERSUITPERSUIT is a legal spend management platform that helps the world's largest organizations bring transparency, efficiency, and control to how they manage outside counsel.
jobs.description:
About PERSUIT

PERSUIT is a legal spend management platform that helps the world's largest organizations bring transparency, efficiency, and control to how they manage outside counsel. Following our merger with Apperio, we cover the full lifecycle of legal spend, from sourcing outside counsel to real-time spend visibility and e-billing. Our Customer Experience team turns complex enterprise implementations into long-term partnerships. We move fast, hold ourselves to a high standard, and care about the outcomes we deliver.

The Role

Our clients increasingly invest in professional services to deliver larger, more complex programs, and we are creating this role to lead them. As Senior Program Manager, you will own the end-to-end delivery of 2–4 concurrent strategic programs for Fortune 100 and Fortune 500 clients, each spanning multiple workstreams and a broad group of client, law firm, and internal stakeholders, often with competing priorities. You will be the single point of accountability for scope, schedule, governance, and risk.

This is a player-coach role. Alongside your own programs, you will raise the standard of program management across the team by coaching Onboarding Managers and building the playbooks that make our delivery consistent and scalable. It suits someone equally comfortable presenting to a steering committee and untangling a messy dependency log.

Key Responsibilities

  • Program Delivery: Lead your strategic programs from Sales handover through go-live and transition to Customer Success, delivering against the Statement of Work on time, on budget, and in scope.
  • Program Governance: Run steering committees and executive reporting, and keep clear decision and change logs so everyone knows what was agreed, when, and why.
  • Risk and Issue Management: Anticipate risks and dependencies before they become issues, keep risk and issue logs current, and escalate to the right people early.
  • Technical Discovery and Integrations: Lead requirements gathering with Solutions Architects and engineers, and oversee configuration, data migration, and integrations with client e-billing and AP systems.
  • Go-Live Readiness: Define go-live criteria and UAT standards, and manage cutover so clients launch with confidence.
  • Scope: Manage change control against the SOW, flag out-of-scope requests early, and support SOW drafting for new work.
  • Adoption and Value: Drive client adoption and change management so programs deliver measurable value, not just a completed project plan.
  • Stakeholder Management: Work across client legal, procurement, finance, and IT teams, their consultants and vendors, and our internal teams, and feed implementation insights to Product and Engineering.
  • Coaching and Process: Develop Onboarding Managers through coaching and program reviews, leading by expertise rather than line management. Build and improve playbooks for governance, change control, risk, and reporting.

Requirements

Experience & Qualifications

  • 8+ years of client-facing program or project management experience in enterprise SaaS implementations, including technical discovery, integrations, and data migration
  • A track record of building or significantly improving program management processes
  • Experience working to Statements of Work and holding a clear scope line with clients
  • Experience running committee-led governance and managing executive stakeholders at Fortune 500 or equivalent organizations
  • Skilled at setting direction for stakeholders who may not yet know what they need, managing expectations, and pushing back when needed
  • Clear communicator who can translate complexity for technical and non-technical audiences
  • Experience managing programs that need significant internal coordination across Product, Engineering, and go-to-market teams
  • Confident using program management software and AI tools to work efficiently and scale delivery

You Might Be a Great Fit If You Have Experience In

  • Legal technology, legal operations, or legal spend management
  • Holding a PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2, or similar certification (a plus, not a requirement)
  • E-billing, AP, or procurement systems (such as Coupa or SAP Ariba), particularly for financial services or other regulated clients
  • A high-growth SaaS company where processes are still being built
  • Building governance playbooks, delivery templates, or enablement resources used across a team

Location, Travel and Work Authorization

This role is remote and open to U.S.-based candidates only, with a strong preference for New York. You will work closely with colleagues in London and across U.S. time zones. Expect up to 20% travel to client sites for discovery, steering committees, and go-live.

Candidates must have current, valid work authorization in the country where the role is based. Unfortunately, we are not able to provide sponsorship for visas or work permits at this time.

Compensation

The base salary for this position is between $142,500 - $150,000.

Benefits

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
  • Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
  • Training & Development
  • Wellness Resources

We're AI-friendly — feel free to use tools like ChatGPT during your prep — but we ask that your interview responses and work samples reflect your own thinking.

Company Overview

Planview has one mission: to close the gap between strategic intent and business outcome, providing the intelligence organizations need to act decisively.

As the global leader in Strategic Portfolio Management, Planview helps organizations of all sizes achieve their business goals, faster and smarter. Our comprehensive platform bring initiatives, investments, and resources into a continuous, connected model of the business: the actionable understanding leaders need to move decisively, keep teams and AI in lockstep, and know how their initiatives are performing.—now powered by Planview Anvi, our next-generation enterprise AI that delivers expert guidance, intelligent recommendations, and actionable insights, turning complex data into decisive action from strategy through execution.

Recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Strategic Portfolio Management for the fifthconsecutive year, we proudly serve more than 3,000 customers globally, including 45%of the Fortune 100—and more than 3 million users worldwide.

Why Join Planview?

At Planview, our people’s connections drive our innovation and success. Our global team of 1,500+ employees work remotely and across offices in Austin, Vancouver, Hod HaSharon, Bangalore, Sydney, and Stockholm. We've built a world-class, connected culture rooted in shared values that empowers our teams to thrive and succeed from anywhere. When you join Planview, you're not just joining a company,you're joining a movement to transform how the world works.

Discover more about our portfolio atplanview.com, and connect with us onLinkedIn,Instagram, andX.


The Opportunity

Planview is hiring an experienced Enterprise Account Executive to own new business and expansion revenue across Germany, reporting to the RVP of Enterprise Sales. You will be responsible for both acquiring new customers and growing strategic relationships with existing Planview customers.
You will manage the full enterprise sales cycle for new-logo and expansion opportunities—from territory and account planning through prospecting, executive discovery, solution alignment, negotiation, and close. You will help large German organizations connect strategy to execution, improve visibility across investments and resources, and make more confident decisions with Planview’s portfolio management and AI-enabled solutions.
This is an opportunity for an ambitious, consultative seller who enjoys complex enterprise sales, can build trusted relationships with senior technology and business leaders, and is motivated by helping organizations create measurable business outcomes.

Who you are

You are a high-energy, driven, and collaborative enterprise SaaS seller. You are comfortable opening doors, creating demand, developing executive relationships, and leading complex buying processes across large organizations.
You bring a track record of selling business-critical, ROI-focused software to senior decision-makers, including CIOs, CTOs, CFOs, transformation leaders, PMO executives, and other enterprise stakeholders. You can work independently in the German market while collaborating effectively with distributed sales, marketing, solution consulting, customer success, and partner teams.
As Planview continues to expand its AI capabilities, you will be at the forefront of bringing these solutions to market—helping customers use connected data and intelligent guidance to improve strategic planning, investment decisions, resource allocation, and execution.

What You'll Do

  • 5+ years of enterprise SaaS sales experience.
  • A consistent record of meeting or exceeding quota in a full-cycle role.
  • Experience selling to C-level business and technology leaders.
  • Knowledge of the German enterprise software market.
  • Professional fluency in German and English.
  • Experience with complex buying groups, long sales cycles, and multi-threaded deals.
  • Strong prospecting, territory planning, negotiation, forecasting, and closing skills.
  • A value- and ROI-based approach to enterprise selling.
  • Experience with Salesforce and modern sales tools such as ZoomInfo and Demandbase.
  • Strong executive communication, presentation, and collaboration skills.
  • Interest in AI’s practical applications in strategic planning, portfolio management, and resource optimization.
  • Experience selling AI-enabled software is a plus.
  • Willingness to travel within Germany

What You'll Bring

  • Own a Germany territory plan that delivers new-logo and expansion revenue.
  • Build account plans, identify whitespace, and create cross-sell opportunities in existing accounts.
  • Partner with Customer Success and Account Management to turn customer value into growth.
  • Lead the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through negotiation and close.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior business and technology executives.
  • Run discovery, value workshops, executive presentations, and product demonstrations.
  • Navigate complex buying groups, long sales cycles, and procurement, legal, security, and finance processes.
  • Develop ROI-based business cases tied to measurable customer outcomes.
  • Position Planview Anvi and AI-enabled capabilities around better decisions, risk visibility, scenario planning, and resource optimization.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline, opportunity plans, and forecasts in Salesforce.
  • Collaborate with SDRs, Marketing, Solution Consulting, Customer Success, Professional Services, Product, and partners.
  • Consistently meet or exceed revenue targets and represent Planview with customers across Germany.

Benefits at Planview

At Planview, you’ll join our global team and culture which reflects the vibrant communities in which our employees live and work. To support you at Planview, you will enjoy:

  • Unplugged Days: 4 company-wide paid days off per year to recharge and relax.
  • Generous PTO offerings (region dependent).
  • Region specific competitive benefit plans to support you at any life stage including parental leave, retirement, medical plans, wellness support, and remote work support.
  • Paid time to volunteer through Planview’s Force for Good Week.
  • Employee Referral bonus program.
  • Weekly office lunches for hybrid team members and social events.
  • Flexible work hours/environment.

Now is a great time to join our team. If you are looking for a place to grow your career, innovate with best-in-class solutions, and build the future of connected work, Planview is the right place for you!


AI Use in Recruitment

Planview may employ AI-based tools to support certain recruiting activities, however all decisions affecting a candidate's application are made by a human recruiter or hiring manager. Planview is committed to complying with applicable AI regulations, including the EU AI Act and other emerging legislation in the jurisdictions in which we operate, and reviews its AI practices as these requirements evolve. jobs.description:
This is an exciting opportunity to own and build an emerging-growth territory, representing established brands including Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology News and Inside Precision Medicine and offering clients a broad portfolio of advertising, sponsored content, and lead generation solutions. With a diverse mix of print, digital, content, and virtual event-based offerings, you’ll have the opportunity to develop new business, grow existing accounts, and create integrated solutions that connect clients and agencies with highly relevant technical professional audiences.

As a Commercial Sales Account Executive, you’ll be responsible for delivering revenue goals within an assigned territory and account portfolio across Sage Professional Media. Taking a consultative and proactive approach, you’ll build strong client and agency relationships, understand their objectives, audiences, budgets, and measures of success, and translate those needs into compelling commercial solutions.

You’ll have the autonomy to develop your territory and account strategy while partnering with Sales Management and colleagues across the business. Success will come through persuasive communication, strong market and product knowledge, disciplined prospecting, and effective collaboration from initial discovery through campaign delivery and renewal.

Your New Role

Sales

  • Own and grow an assigned territory and account portfolio, achieving sales targets through strategic territory planning, consistent prospecting, renewals, cross-selling, and account expansion.

  • Research prospects, identify decision makers, and generate qualified opportunities through tailored outreach, telephone and video conversations, presentations, client meetings, and conferences.

  • Conduct consultative discovery to understand client objectives, target audiences, budgets, timing, success measures, and decision-making processes.

  • Build strong relationships with clients and agencies to uncover new business opportunities and identify ways to expand existing partnerships.

  • Develop and persuasively present integrated solutions across assigned products, including print and digital advertising, newsletters, targeted email, sponsored content, webinars, podcasts, eBooks, and event exhibits or sponsorships, as available.

  • Respond to RFPs, navigate objections, negotiate within approved pricing and terms, and confidently progress opportunities through to close.

  • Use audience insights and campaign measures to demonstrate the value of Sage solutions and align recommendations with client objectives.

  • Plan client outreach, meetings, conference activity, and travel to maximize selling opportunities.

  • Collaborate with Sales Management on territory strategy, pipeline health, performance, and actions needed to achieve sales goals.

  • Use Sage’s approved sales technology and enablement tools to support prospecting, client engagement, opportunity development, and selling effectiveness.

Customer and Client Delivery

  • Partner with sales support and delivery teams to provide smooth handoffs, ensuring specifications, materials, deadlines, and client commitments are clearly communicated.

  • Respond promptly to client needs and proactively help resolve campaign, delivery, or billing concerns.

  • Review campaign performance with clients and internal partners to demonstrate value, identify opportunities for improvement, and support renewals and account growth.

  • Collaborate across teams to provide a consistent, positive client experience throughout the sales and campaign lifecycle.

Product and Market Knowledge

  • Develop a strong understanding of assigned Sage publications, professional audiences, advertising formats, sponsored content, and sponsorship opportunities.

  • Clearly articulate the value of Sage’s audiences, brands, and integrated commercial solutions in relation to client goals and the competitive marketplace.

  • Stay informed about assigned markets, client priorities, industry trends, and competitive offerings to strengthen prospecting and account strategy.

  • Share client feedback, campaign insights, and market intelligence with Sales Management and internal partners to help improve positioning and identify new revenue opportunities.

  • Participate in product training and sales coaching and apply that learning to strengthen discovery conversations, presentations, and recommendations.

Territory Planning and Pipeline Management

  • Build and regularly update strategic territory and account plans in partnership with Sales Management, using CRM data, Power BI, sales trends, and account insights to identify growth opportunities and prioritize activity.

  • Maintain a healthy, qualified pipeline aligned with sales targets and regularly review opportunities, risks, next steps, and forecast expectations with management.

  • Keep CRM records current and accurate, including key contacts, opportunity stages, expected close dates, values, client commitments, and next steps.

  • Maintain realistic rolling 30-, 60-, and 90-day forecasts and proactively adjust prospecting and account-development activity when pipeline or revenue gaps emerge.

  • Complete required sales reporting and expense submissions accurately and on time.

Business Travel and Conference Attendance

  • Travel to client and agency meetings, industry conferences, and relevant events based on territory and business needs, including overnight travel when necessary.

  • Use conferences and in-person meetings to generate qualified leads, deepen client relationships, understand market needs, and progress advertising and sponsorship opportunities.

  • Establish objectives and arrange prospect and client meetings in advance of events, then complete timely follow-up to move opportunities forward.

  • Attend required sales meetings, training, and other company meetings as needed.

Can you be our new Account Executive? Do you have:

Relevant combinations of education, skills, and experience will be considered.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience preferred.

  • At least three years of relevant B2B sales experience, preferably within media, publishing, advertising, sponsorship, or association/exhibit sales, with evidence of both new business development and account growth.

  • Experience selling digital and integrated solutions or programs.

  • Experience using CRM, Microsoft 365, virtual collaboration, and prospect research or sales enablement tools. Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales experience is a plus.

  • The ability to learn new markets and products, work independently, build strong client relationships, and collaborate effectively across teams.

  • A consultative and commercially focused approach, with the ability to understand client needs and translate them into compelling solutions.

  • The ability to apply coaching and feedback and use approved automation and AI-assisted tools accurately and in accordance with company policies.

If you have a disability and you need any support during the application process, please contact All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply.

Sage Publishing is committed to being an inclusive employer where all individuals are treated with fairness and respect. Sage is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer.

Compensation at Sage is influenced by several factors, including but not limited to skill set, nature and level of experience, qualifications, and other relevant considerations. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range and additional aspects of the compensation/benefits package for this position during the hiring process. Unique program benefits that support a healthy life, a company-sponsored anniversary trip every 5 years, a 401(k)-matching program of 100% up to 5% of pay, and other significant meaningful benefits. In alignment with our value for education, Sage offers financial support for bachelor's and graduate-level degree programs as well as learning for personal interest.

Sage offers freedom and autonomy in your day-to-day with hybrid or remote work, depending on the role. Join the nearly 2,000 Sage employees worldwide who deliver products and services that serve to fulfill our noble goal of education and dissemination of knowledge globally. We’d love to meet you!

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Sage Publishing is committed to being an inclusive employer where all individuals are treated with fairness and respect, regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marriage and partnership status, pregnancy and parental responsibilities, race, religion and belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

DocMatter is an ambitious, growth-stage company that is changing the face of collaboration for the medical community and is hiring exceptional individuals that want to contribute to that mission. We are fast becoming a household name among clinicians worldwide who consistently rely on the DocMatter platform to connect with their peers, learn from experts, gain insights, and stay up to date with the latest clinical data, best practices, and therapeutic innovations in medicine. Our goal is to bring our innovative platform to every clinician in the world.

We are looking for a commercially minded, healthcare-experienced operator and strategist who can build account plans from scratch, identify upsell opportunities, and lead senior customer stakeholders with confidence. Success in this role requires ownership, intensity, and the ability to turn DocMatter’s value proposition into measurable customer impact and account growth. As a senior member of our Customer Success Team, you will own account strategy, be accountable for retention and expansion outcomes, and directly influence revenue growth across strategic life sciences customers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Stakeholder Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with important stakeholders across Medical Affairs and Commercial functions at top-tier life science companies.
  • Strategic Account Planning: Develop and execute tailored success plans that align customer business objectives with DocMatter capabilities.
  • Value Realization: Drive usage, satisfaction, and measurable value creation through onboarding, enablement, strategic alignment, and ongoing engagement strategies.
  • Upsell & Growth Strategy: Identify expansion opportunities within accounts, manage your own upsell efforts and partner with Sales for cross-sell motions and help develop long-term growth roadmaps.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Clinical Engagement, Sales and Medical Affairs teams to ensure customer needs are met and exceeded.
  • Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify and manage risks to account retention and client satisfaction.

Within the first 3 months, you will have:

  • Mapped every key stakeholder across your accounts and built custom engagement plans that keep them active, informed, and aligned to the specific challenges DocMatter is helping them solve.
  • Become deeply familiar with the paradigm shift your clients are working to drive in healthcare, including the strategic, clinical, organizational, and commercial forces shaping their priorities.
  • Identified the next expansion opportunities within each account, clarified what must happen to make those opportunities successful, and built a practical path to move them forward.

What this role is not

  • A reactive customer support role
  • A high account volume role. You will be responsible for a small number of clients, each with six-figure ARR and ambitious growth targets, and will be expected to go deep with each account
  • Aligned to a rigid playbook. You will be expected to exercise creativity in relationship building, account strategy, and execution
  • A people management role. You will come in as an individual contributor with account-based milestones, but will need to exercise strong internal collaboration to achieve your goals.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or Strategic Partnerships within pharmaceutical, biotech, medical device, digital health, or healthcare SaaS markets.
  • Deep understanding of life sciences workflows and operating models across Medical Affairs, Commercial, Clinical Operations, or related functions.
  • Proven ability to own strategic enterprise accounts, map complex stakeholder ecosystems, and influence senior customer leaders.
  • Fluent in the enterprise SaaS customer lifecycle, including implementation, onboarding, adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion.
  • Track record of hitting or exceeding delivery, renewal, expansion, upsell, or account-growth goals in a customer success organization.
  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional initiatives, driving change, and turning ambiguity into measurable customer outcomes.
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to engage C-suite executives and senior stakeholders credibly.
  • Experience building or shaping customer success playbooks, account plans, team processes, or scalable operating rhythms — not just executing them.
  • Successful in small, fast-paced teams where initiative, collaboration, intensity, and ownership are non-negotiable.
  • Level of comfort with clinical subject matters and an understanding of physician to physician dialouge.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Worked in management consulting, strategy consulting, business operations, or life sciences transformation and produced client-ready analyses, recommendations, or implementation plans.
  • Built or improved customer-facing processes, playbooks, operating rhythms, or scalable CS motions in a high-growth company where structure was still forming.
  • Navigated regulatory, compliance, privacy, or data governance considerations in healthcare or life sciences environments.
  • Contributed to pricing, packaging, account expansion, or go-to-market strategy for a healthcare, life sciences, or SaaS product.
  • Led strategic working sessions with senior Medical Affairs or Commercial stakeholders.

Benefits

DocMatter provides a peer-to-peer collaboration platform that facilitates knowledge transfer across a global network of highly engaged healthcare professionals to drive life-changing patient outcomes. We are well on our way, but new hires are early enough that you will still be able to play a pivotal role in advancing our mission.

Our employees are passionate about elevating the practice of medicine. Come join some of the smartest minds tackling one of the great opportunities to advance the global medical field!

Benefits

  • Series A equity
  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • PTO and company holidays
  • Wellness stipend

Compensation

  • The salary range for this position is $120,000–$190,000 annually. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as skills, experience, and location. This role may be eligible for other forms of compensation, including a variable bonus, commission, and/or equity awards.

Job Summary:


PARTNERSHIP MARKETING & PROMOTIONS COORDINATOR

Location: New York, NY or remote elsewhere in the US -- please note preference for EST time zone

Division: Ticketmaster

Line Manager: VP, Partnership Marketing

Contract Terms: Temporary, Part-Time, up to 15 hours per week, Flexible schedule

THE TEAM

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide. We’re fans who help fans everywhere get into the live events they love. A proud division of Live Nation Entertainment, Ticketmaster has changed the way the world connects with their favorite artists, teams, and shows, and we continue to shape innovation every day. We’re not just selling tickets (though we do that better than anyone else), we’re enriching lives one amazing experience at a time. And we think that’s pretty amazing.

THE JOB

The Partnership Marketing & Promotions Coordinator provides administrative and operational support for promotional campaigns (e.g., sweepstakes, contests, surprise-and-delight programs, etc.) and for ongoing sponsorship asset tracking for the Ticketmaster Partnership Marketing Team portfolio of sponsorships. In addition, this role assists the Partnership Marketing team by handling day-to-day clerical work, documentation upkeep, the sweepstakes winner-process, and routine monitoring/reporting on sponsorship assets. It's important to note this is intended to be a support role, and therefore, final compliance, legal, and decisions remain with full-time Partnership Marketing staff and Legal departments at Ticketmaster.


Please note this is a temporary part-time position with a set engagement of up to fifteen (15) hours per week for a one (1) year term working on campaign launches, winner processing windows, and reporting deadlines.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

Administrative & Clerical Support

  • Maintain and organize shared files, trackers, and the promotional materials library (microsites/landing pages, partner lists, approved creative assets, affidavits etc.)
  • Schedule and coordinate stakeholder meetings; prepare agendas and distribute notes/action items
  • Data entry and upkeep of campaign trackers, budgets, and timelines in Excel/Word/PowerPoint
  • Format and proofread sponsorship & promotions documents for internal and client distribution
  • Manage routine promotions correspondence as directed by the Partnership Marketing Managers
  • Prepare, organize, and file documentation for audit and record-keeping purposes (affidavits, releases, W-9s, receipts)

Promotions Support

  • Support the Partner Marketing team in developing promotional plans for music & sports, live-event initiatives.
  • Build and maintain promotional campaign timelines, launch plans, channel requirements, and approval paths.
  • Compile all needed details for promotions (prize structure, eligibility, dates, entry mechanics)
  • Convert campaign objectives into clear briefs for creative, CRM, media, and partners
  • Develop copy for entry pages, social and any promotion materials
  • Submit promotional artwork requests as needed to internal creative team for development
  • Build entry pages utilizing in-house system and route
  • Assist with collecting and organizing winner documentation (Affidavits of Eligibility, Liability & Publicity Releases, Guest Releases, W-9 forms etc…)
  • Perform an initial completeness check on W-9s and releases and flag discrepancies— all final verification and legal sign-off remains with Legal and the Promotions Manager
  • Initiate and manager winner communications (notifications, status updates, document follow-ups) and secure winner affidavits and accompanying paperwork under the direction of the Partnership Marketing Manager and agency.
  • Coordinate event requirements: ticket quantities, venue details, winner communications with the Partner Marketing team and agency team
  • Monitor entry periods and help track prize procurement status, shipping logistics, and fulfillment timelines
  • Establish repeatable processes, trackers, templates, and documentation that improve campaign quality and team efficiency.

Sponsorship Monitoring & Reporting

  • Monitor sponsor assets across digital/social placements to confirm delivery against contracted terms
  • Coordinate materials for monthly partnership marketing newsletter and populate templates for deployment.
  • Assist with the audit of asset tracking links and pull and compile recurring reporting on sponsor asset performance for internal reviews
  • Support basic competitive/landscape monitoring related to competitive sponsorship activity as assigned

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (or TECHNICAL SKILLS)

  • Bachelors Degree
  • Prior experience in a marketing support, or coordinator role
  • Basic knowledge of sports marketing and sponsorship principles
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Strong project management skills, including timeline ownership, prioritization, follow-through, and risk management
  • Proficiency with common productivity, presentation, spreadsheet, communication, and project-tracking tools (Google, Microsoft, Canva etc.)
  • Comfortable learning new software/reporting platforms (promotion management tools, tracking dashboards etc.)
  • Clear, concise and professional written and verbal communication
  • Ability to handle sensitive/confidential documentation
  • Desire for a flexible schedule and ability to pivot on competing priorities and projects as needed
  • Familiarity with sponsorship, promotions, or sweepstakes processes a plus
  • Basic design tool familiarity (Canva, Photoshop) a plus

YOU (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS)

  • Passionate and motivated.
  • Driven with and by an entrepreneurial spirit.
  • Resourceful, innovative, forwarding thinking, and committed.

LIFE AT TICKETMASTER

Position Title: Architect – Medical & Commercial Fit-Outs
Work Set-up: Work From Home
Schedule: Monday – Friday, 6:00 am – 2:30 pm PH Time
Salary: Php 55,000 – Php 65,000

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced architect registered or licensed in the Philippines, with strong interior design and construction documentation skills who can support our client in delivering medical and commercial fit-out projects including medical centers, dental clinics, pathology facilities, pharmacies, offices and retail spaces. The successful candidate will work closely with our Client’s Australian project management team to develop practical designs and prepare accurate, coordinated drawing packages for client review, contractor pricing, approval submissions and construction.

This position requires someone who can take a project brief, existing drawings and marked-up instructions, develop the design, and resolve the details needed to build it. The projects to be handled include new fit-outs within empty tenancies and renovations to existing premises.

JOB DESCRIPTION FOR ARCHITECT – MEDICAL & COMMERCIAL FIT-OUTS

Responsibilities as an Architect – Medical & Commercial Fit-Outs:

1. Space Planning and Interior Design
• Develop proposed layouts using client briefs, landlord drawings, existing CAD files, supplied site measurements, photographs and project team instructions.
• Plan functional spaces, including reception and waiting areas, consultation rooms, treatment rooms, dental surgeries, sterilization areas, staffrooms, amenities and storage.
• Consider circulation, furniture, equipment, accessibility and the day-to-day use of each space.
• Develop interior concepts, colour schemes, materials and finishes suited to the client’s brief and project budget.
• Adapt established design concepts across different projects where required.
2. Drafting and Construction Documentation
• Prepare and update drawing packages appropriate to each project, including:
• Existing conditions and demolition plans (where required)
• Proposed floor plans, dimensioned layouts and partition set-out plans.
• Reflected ceiling plans.
• Floor finishes and wall/paint finishes plans.
• Door, hardware, fixtures and finishes schedules.
• Internal elevations, room-specific sections and construction details.
• Electrical, lighting and data location plans showing design intent, coordinated with the relevant consultants.
• Joinery layouts, elevations, sections and detailed design drawings.
• Work within existing project files where available, maintain drawing consistency, and develop additional details where needed.
3. Joinery and Detailed Interior Design
• Design and document reception counters, consultation and treatment room cabinetry, staffroom kitchens, storage units and other built-in joinery.
• Clearly show dimensions, cabinet configurations, materials, finishes, benchtops, splash backs and hardware.
• Coordinate allowances for basins, appliances, medical equipment, cable access, lighting and relevant service connections.
• Prepare project-specific details that allow contractors to understand and price the intended work.
• Review joinery shop drawings against the design brief and highlight discrepancies for the project team.
4. Finishes and Material Selection
• Prepare clear finishes schedules identifying products, colors, finishes, suppliers and application locations.
• Keep finish references consistent across plans, elevations, details and schedules.
• Consider durability, cleaning, maintenance, availability and budget when proposing materials.
• Assist with alternative selections where products are unavailable or exceed the budget.
5. Coordination and Construction Support
• Coordinate drawings with information provided by architectural, hydraulic, mechanical, electrical, fire and structural consultants.
• Identify clashes, missing information and inconsistencies, and raise them promptly with the project team.
• Incorporate client, consultant, landlord and certifier comments into revised drawings.
• Apply project requirements under the direction of the Australian team and relevant consultants, referring specialist design and certification matters to them.
• Assist with drawing queries during construction and update documentation from verified site information and approved changes.
• Maintain organized drawing registers, revision records, title blocks and editable project files.
Qualifications as an Architect – Medical & Commercial Fit-Outs:

Software:
• ArchiCAD experience is preferred to align with the client’s existing drafting workflow.
• Candidates should identify their main drafting software, versions used and level of proficiency.
• Experience with AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, PDF markup tools and rendering software should also be stated.
• The ability to produce 3D views and visualizations for client presentations would be an advantage 
Required Skills and Experience
• Previous work on Australian fit-out projects
• A recognized qualification in architecture. Current registration or a license as an architect in the Philippines.
• Familiarity with the Australian NCC/BCA, Australian Standards and accessibility requirements relevant to fit-out documentation
• Demonstrated experience in medical or commercial fit-out, including interior design and detailed construction documentation.
• Strong understanding of construction detailing, joinery and the coordination of drawings and schedules.
• Ability to interpret existing plans, consultant drawings, sketches and marked-up instructions.
• Good design judgement and the ability to develop and resolve designs from a project brief, supported by hands-on drafting and practical construction detailing.
• Strong attention to dimensions, drawing accuracy, consistency and presentation.
• Clear written and spoken English.
• Ability to manage several drawing packages, meet agreed deadlines and communicate questions or delays early.
• Clear progress updates, organized file sharing and timely responses to project queries.

jobs.description:
About Flosum

Every large company now runs critical parts of its business on Salesforce: sales, service, financial data, patient records, citizen services. When a release breaks something or data goes missing, revenue stops and regulators call. Flosum is the platform these companies trust to ship changes safely, protect their data, and recover fast.
We are in the middle of the most exciting chapter in our history. Our customers have relied on our Salesforce-native platform for years. Now we are bringing them a new cloud-native platform they can run on AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or on-premises. We have also launched sandbox management built for the AI era, so teams can test AI agents such as Agentforce on production-ready environments in minutes instead of days.
Our customers include some of the most demanding enterprises in banking, insurance, healthcare, the public sector, and technology. They don’t buy us casually, and they don’t leave us casually. Your job is to make sure they never want to.

The role
You will own a book of enterprise accounts and one number: retained revenue. You decide which accounts need you most this week, and you go there. This is a commercial role. You will spend your time with executives, not running support tickets.

What you will do

  • Own renewals across your book, from strategic accounts to smaller ones, and protect every dollar of recurring revenue.
  • Build relationships with the executives who decide: CIOs, CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and heads of Salesforce platforms. Reach past your champion when the account needs it.
  • Turn red accounts green. Spot risk early, build a save plan, and run it with urgency.
  • Move customers from our Salesforce-native products to our cloud-native platform, and make the business case for why it matters to them.
  • Defend your accounts against competitors, in-house builds, and new enterprise architectures.
  • Pull the right people in. Hold product, support, engineering, and customer success accountable for what your customers need.
  • Find expansion opportunities and hand them to our sales team with a clear plan.
  • Run your book with discipline: accurate forecasts, clean renewal pipeline in Salesforce, no surprises.

Requirements

What you bring

  • 7+ years in enterprise account management, renewals, or customer-facing sales at a B2B software company.
  • You have carried a significant book of business (ideally $5M+ in annual recurring revenue) with individual accounts above $250K.
  • You have sold or renewed complex IT solutions: DevOps, data protection, security, infrastructure, or developer platforms. Technical buyers trust you.
  • A track record of saving at-risk renewals by going to the executive level, with the numbers to prove it.
  • Commercial intensity. You negotiate well, you push for multi-year terms, and you are comfortable with hard conversations about price and value.
  • You know how NRR and GRR are calculated and how your work moves them.
  • Clear, concise writing and speaking. You can brief a CIO in five minutes.
  • Experience in the Salesforce ecosystem is a strong plus.

Benefits

Why join now

    • You will work with customers at the moment they move to the cloud. Few account managers get to shape a transition this large.
    • Our products sit in the path of AI adoption. Every company deploying AI agents on Salesforce needs to test, release, and protect them safely.
    • You will have real ownership, direct access to leadership, and the room to build how account management works here.
    • Competitive base plus variable compensation tied to retention.

Position Summary
As a Senior Azure Architect, you will lead the design of DataSpring's Azure platform: the landing zones, networking, identity, resilience, and governance that our healthcare data products run on. DataSpring runs several production platforms in Azure that handle protected health information for health plans and providers nationwide, and we are bringing more of their design and operation in-house from vendors. You will help shape our Azure standards, review vendor designs against them, and stay hands-on enough to prove a design before it is adopted. The ideal candidate has designed enterprise Azure environments end to end in a regulated industry, knows where Azure designs break under real load and real outages, and uses AI tools such as Claude Code to work faster.

This is a full-time, remote, exempt position and reports to the Director, Enterprise Architecture & Infrastructure.

Specific Responsibilities

  • Lead architecture design for Azure platforms and initiatives, and contribute to the target-state architecture set by the Director, including landing zones, management group and subscription design, hub-and-spoke networking, and shared services such as API Management, messaging, and identity.
  • Design for resilience: recommend availability, recovery time, and recovery point targets for each platform, and design and regularly test multi-region and disaster recovery patterns that meet them at a reasonable cost.
  • Develop and apply Azure standards through Azure Policy, reference architectures, and reusable infrastructure-as-code modules (Terraform; Helm for Kubernetes workloads; Bicep a plus).
  • Review designs from implementation vendors and partner teams on assigned projects before build, recommend approval, and hold them to the agreed standards through delivery.
  • Lead network architecture, including private, edge, and global traffic management across regions. Responsible for maintaining DNS, hybrid connectivity, and zero-trust network security and segmentation across projects and environments.
  • Partner with Information Security to meet HIPAA, SOC 2, and HITRUST requirements, with strong controls for PHI, identity and access (Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, privileged access), encryption, and logging.
  • Manage cloud costs for assigned projects within approved budgets (FinOps): tagging and showback, right-sizing, reservations and savings plans, and architecture choices that lower run cost.
  • Design the platform foundations for AI workloads, including Azure OpenAI and AI Foundry capacity, gateways, and secure access patterns.
  • Implement and improve observability practices (LGTM, OpenTelemetry, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights) so incidents can be detected, diagnosed, and traced to root cause.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex Azure incidents and lead the design fixes that follow.
  • Mentor engineers on the Architecture and Infrastructure team and raise the team's Azure design skills.
  • Document architecture decisions and maintain current-state and target-state diagrams.
  • Report weekly status on architecture initiatives to designated DataSpring management.
  • Follow all DataSpring Policies and Procedures.

Skills

  • Deep, hands-on expertise in Azure architecture: landing zones, management groups and subscriptions, Azure Policy, and the Cloud Adoption and Well-Architected Frameworks.
  • Strong Azure networking: hub-and-spoke and Virtual WAN, Private Link, Azure DNS, Application Gateway and Front Door, Azure Firewall, and hybrid connectivity.
  • Proven design of multi-region, highly available, and disaster recovery architectures for PaaS and container workloads (App Service, AKS, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Storage).
  • Identity architecture with Microsoft Entra ID across multiple tenants, including managed identities, RBAC, Conditional Access, and privileged access.
  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform required; Bicep a plus) and CI/CD for infrastructure; able to write and review modules, not just specify them.
  • Cloud security in a regulated environment (HIPAA, SOC 2, HITRUST): encryption, key management, logging, and defense in depth.
  • FinOps practice: reading Azure cost data, forecasting spend, and designing for cost.
  • Ability to explain design trade-offs clearly to engineers, vendors, and executives, and to push back on a vendor design with evidence.
  • Demonstrated use of AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) to accelerate design, infrastructure as code, and analysis.
  • Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, or SAFe delivery is a plus.

Experience & Education

  • 8+ years in infrastructure or cloud engineering, with at least 5 years designing Azure environments at enterprise scale as a cloud or solutions architect.
  • Has led an Azure landing zone or platform design in production, including a disaster recovery design that was tested. Healthcare or other regulated-industry experience (HIPAA, SOC 2, HITRUST) strongly preferred; experience directing vendor or managed-service delivery teams is a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) strongly preferred; Azure networking or security specialty certifications are a plus.

Who We Are

DataSpring is the trusted data connector at the core of healthcare. For more than 25 years, we have powered the industry with the largest and most complete healthcare data foundation in the U.S., including more than 4.8 million provider data records sourced directly from providers and member data representing 75% of covered lives supplied by health plans. By improving how essential information flows across the system, DataSpring helps healthcare operate more efficiently, accurately, and with greater confidence.

What You Get

At DataSpring, you will do meaningful work at the intersection of healthcare, data, and technology, helping solve complex problems that make the healthcare system work better. You will collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about accuracy, trust, and meaningful impact in a fully remote environment.

DataSpring offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) with company contributions and matching, paid parental leave, tuition assistance, and generous paid time off. Position Highlights

Position Title: Project Implementation Manager

Department: Programs and Innovation Office – Workforce Acceleration Initiative

FLSA Classification: Exempt

Reports to: Project Manager - Workforce Acceleration Initiative

Location: Remote, must be based in the United States, Up to 10% domestic travel may be required.

Salary Range: $90,000 - $123,000 per year, plus benefits. Individual salary offers will be based on experience and qualifications unique to each candidate.

Position Type: Grant funded, limited-term opportunity

Position End Date: June 30, 2027

Hours of Work: Individual must routinely be available during core department business hours to collaborate with Illinois Department of Public Health staff.

Overview

The Project Implementation Manager will drive the delivery of data modernization projects that improve the use of public health data to inform decision making. This role is aligned to the Workforce Acceleration Initiative (WAI). WAI is a federally funded CDC Foundation program with the goal of helping the nation’s public health agencies by providing them with the technology and data experts they need to accelerate their information system improvements.

Working within the Illinois Department of Public Health the Project Implementation Manager will collaborate across technical and non-technical teams to define project objectives, allocate resources, coordinate with teams, and manage timelines to ensure the successful delivery and implementation of a public health data systems project.

The Project Implementation Manager will be hired by the CDC Foundation and assigned to the Illinois Department of Public Health. This position is eligible for a fully remote work arrangement for U.S. based candidates.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain data modernization workplans, serving as the Project Implementation Manager to develop detailed project plans and timelines, as well as maintain project documentation including project charters, plans, status reports, and post-project evaluations.
  • Drive project deliverables to ensure they are within scope, deadlines, and budget.
  • Develop and execute supporting plans including data communication, data training, and the data modernization initiative (DMI) evaluation plan. Support execution of enterprise-wide data maturity assessment. Develop and conduct surveys and focus groups as needed to assist in assessment. Create an evaluation plan for data modernization impact analysis. Assist with implementation of the data maturity roadmap.
  • Establish measurable metrics to be used to evaluate DMI activities and impact.
  • Schedule and organize regular recurring meetings with internal and external data interest holders to review project progress, address any issues or concerns, identify data needs and gaps.
  • Schedule and organize data modernization advisory committee meetings.
  • Collaborate with DMI core team including (data governance manager, metadata specialist, data training and communication specialist, business process analyst) to execute DMI workplan. Work with business analysts and other stakeholders to implement and adopt change management strategies.
  • Define clear roles and responsibilities and ensure standards and best practices are followed.
  • Work with user community, technical teams and vendors to meet implementation timeline.
  • Document business practices and workflows, identify opportunities for improvement, support process improvement, discover issues and deliver improved value.
  • Effectively communicating insights and plans to cross-functional team members and management. Facilitate communication between project team members, business analysts, and stakeholders. Create dashboards and generate reports.
  • Develop and implement change management strategies and plans to support the successful adoption and implementation of data modernization transformational activities.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in project management, public health, information systems, operations management or related field required. Master’s degree or other related advanced degree in a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 10 years of related experience leading data management projects.
  • Expert knowledge of project management fundamentals, including the ability to develop and implement accurate work plans, schedules, staffing plans, and budgets, in an agile or iterative environment. Proficiency in Smartsheet, Confluence, SharePoint and/or other project management tools and techniques.
  • Experienced in change management and risk management principles and processes.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to describe difficult technical problems and solutions to technical and non-technical teams.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining working relationships with internal and external partners and can effectively promote collaboration among differing viewpoints.
  • Outstanding interpersonal and teamwork skills; and the ability to develop productive working relationships with colleagues and partners.
  • Experience working in a virtual environment with remote partners and teams.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
  • Knowledge of data management, data governance and change management.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification or equivalent is preferred.

Special Notes

This role is involved in a dynamic public health program. As such, roles and responsibilities are subject to change as situations evolve. Roles and responsibilities listed above may be expanded upon or updated to match priorities and needs, once written approval is received by the CDC Foundation in order to best support the public health programming.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status, and all other characteristics protected by law.

We comply with all applicable laws including E.O. 11246 and the Vietnam Era Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974 governing employment practices and do not discriminate on the basis of any unlawful criteria in accordance with 41 C.F.R. §§ 60-300.5(a)(12) and 60-741.5(a)(7). As a federal government contractor, we take affirmative action on behalf of protected veterans.

The CDC Foundation is a smoke-free environment.

Relocation expenses are not included.

About the CDC Foundation

The CDC Foundation is an independent nonprofit authorized by Congress to mobilize philanthropic partners to support the public health system, including the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), in preventing and responding to threats to health. In this role, we are focused on one priority: building catalytic, flexible and impactful partnerships—with corporations, philanthropies, individuals and organizations—to help improve the health and lives of people in all communities, everywhere.
