Job Description

Optimum Energy is looking for a smart, motivated, collaborative business professional to join our accounting team as a Staff Accountant, reporting to the Controller. The Staff Accountant will own the day-to-day accounts payable process, including invoice review and approval support, the weekly check run, and vendor statement reconciliations. This role will also prepare journal entries and reconciliations for accruals, accounts payable, bank accounts, and the balance sheet as part of month-end close, code and enter monthly credit card receipts into NetSuite, and assist with monthly state sales tax filings and financial audit requests. The ideal candidate is comfortable building and maintaining Excel spreadsheets for ad hoc projects and tracking, and is ready to support the Senior Accountant and Controller on special projects as needed. Success attributes critical to this role include initiative, creativity, curiosity, and desire to tackle big challenges.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Accounts Payable: Review invoices for proper support and approval. Assist with weekly check run processes. Reconcile vendor statements to ensure proper balances.
  • Month-End Close: Reconcile accruals and accounts payable and prepare journal entries. Reconcile bank accounts and maintain balance sheet reconciliations.
  • Fixed Assets: Maintain fixed asset registers and calculate monthly depreciation.
  • Credit Card & Expense Reporting: Collect monthly credit card receipts, code them, and enter them into NetSuite. Assist with expense report tracking and coding.
  • Tax & Audit Support: Assist with monthly state sales tax filings and financial audit requests.
  • Special Projects: Assist with special projects and work alongside the Senior Accountant. Create and maintain Excel spreadsheets for various projects and tracking purposes.

Key Competencies and Skills Expectations

  • Integrity: High level of integrity, trust, and the ability to maintain confidentiality is critical.
  • Problem Solving: Effective problem-solving abilities.
  • Customer Service: Professional, yet personal demeanor and strong customer service skills.
  • Communication: Good verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Organization & Time Management: Ability to multi-task, meet deadlines, handle frequent interruptions, and maintain a high level of productivity.
  • Attention to Detail: Accuracy and careful attention to detail required. Produces high-quality work.
  • Results Focus: Focus on results and success, conveying a sense of urgency and seeing issues through to closure.

Requirements

  • Education: 4-year bachelor's degree in Accounting preferred.
  • Experience:
    • 1 to 2 years of accounting and/or accounts payable experience.
    • Knowledge of basic accounting principles including AR, AP, accruals, and general ledger.
    • Working knowledge of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) preferred.
  • Technical Knowledge: Intermediate to advanced Excel skills. Intermediate experience with NetSuite preferred. Knowledge of MS Office (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint) and SharePoint (preferred).

Optimum Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer encouraging diversity in the workplace.

About the Company

Optimum Energy, a Bernhard Capital Partners portfolio company, has spent 20 years helping hospitals, universities, government facilities, and advanced manufacturing operations reduce energy consumption

in heating and cooling systems by up to 50% and turn that infrastructure into a strategic financial and

operational asset. With 300+ plants and institutions served globally, nobody understands energy

infrastructure, efficiency, and financial opportunity quite like Optimum Energy.

Our Energy-as-a-Service model converts aging central utility plants into upfront unrestricted cash, cuts utility operating expenses 25 to 35%, and keeps the transaction entirely off the balance sheet. The structure has been confirmed by Big Four auditors and cited by rating agencies as a driver of improved credit outlooks.

We work with clients from master planning and design through implementation, commissioning, and into long-term operations and maintenance. How we show up depends on what the client needs. That could

mean fully managed plants with Optimum carrying total accountability for performance and uptime. It

could mean supplementing an existing facilities team with engineering support, analytics, training, and escalation resources. Or it could mean a tailored combination of both. In every engagement, we stay for

the life of the agreement.

Proprietary technology, including OptiCx and OptimumLOOP, powers everything we do. It is not what we sell. It is what enables us to deliver the most continuous, precise system-level optimization across chilled water, hot water, and steam plants available in the market today. Machine learning algorithms trained on two decades of operational data adapt to load, weather, and occupancy in real time. AI-driven predictive maintenance and fault detection catch equipment degradation before it becomes a problem. We guarantee the performance. We carry the risk.

Behind the technology is a team built on a simple set of principles: be sharp, be relentless, and be accountable for outcomes. Our people are engineers, operators, and financial structurers who would rather solve the hard problem than talk around it. Every engagement gets that same intensity, whether the scope is a single plant or a 26-site enterprise portfolio. For more information, visit .

About the Industry

Commercial and institutional HVAC infrastructure is aging faster than organizations can replace it. Hospitals are running central plants built in the 1960s and 70s. Universities carry over $112 billion in

collective deferred maintenance nationally. Advanced manufacturing operations face intensifying energy demand from reshoring and facility expansion. Rising energy costs, tightening regulations, sustainability mandates, and a skilled trades labor gap that shows no sign of closing all compound the pressure.

Connected systems are generating more data than most organizations can act on. The capacity to analyze it and translate it into operational decisions requires platforms and people most facilities teams do not have. The industry is not short on ambition or technology. It is short on the capital structures, operational models, and workforce capacity to turn intent into sustained results.

Why Optimum Energy?

With 300+ sites and over 300M square feet of operational data, our machine learning algorithms

continuously optimize in real time. No competitor replicates this at scale.

We do not sell software, and we do not sell equipment. We deliver guaranteed outcomes through the convergence of deep engineering expertise, proprietary optimization technology, and financial structures that align our interests directly with those of our clients. That means tailoring solutions to unique financial and operational realities, not forcing a one-size-fits-all model. It means verifiable success across facility design, ongoing operations, and complex deal structuring. And it means protecting client investments by optimizing the 70% of total costs that occur after day one.

Our EaaS contracts transfer construction, performance, and lifecycle risk entirely. No upfront capital. No balance sheet impact. Capital that would have gone to back-of-house infrastructure stays available for the priorities that matter most, whether that is clinical growth, enrollment expansion, or production capacity.

No other firm brings this combination of engineering, technology, operations, and financial structuring under a single partnership.

The gym runs its lead follow-up, trial bookings, member communication, and retention campaigns through GoHighLevel. This hire owns that platform end to end — building the automations that drive memberships and supporting the owner and front-desk team who use it every day.

Every lead, trial, and member touchpoint at the gym runs through GoHighLevel. The GHL Specialist will design and maintain those systems — from the first ad inquiry to the membership renewal — and provide responsive, first-line support to the gym owner and staff.

Position Highlights

Position Title: Project Implementation Manager

Department: Programs and Innovation Office – Workforce Acceleration Initiative

FLSA Classification: Exempt

Reports to: Project Manager - Workforce Acceleration Initiative

Location: Remote, must be based in the United States, Up to 10% domestic travel may be required.

Salary Range: $90,000 - $123,000 per year, plus benefits. Individual salary offers will be based on experience and qualifications unique to each candidate.

Position Type: Grant funded, limited-term opportunity

Position End Date: June 30, 2027

Hours of Work: Individual must routinely be available during core department business hours to collaborate with Illinois Department of Public Health staff.

Overview

The Project Implementation Manager will drive the delivery of data modernization projects that improve the use of public health data to inform decision making. This role is aligned to the Workforce Acceleration Initiative (WAI). WAI is a federally funded CDC Foundation program with the goal of helping the nation’s public health agencies by providing them with the technology and data experts they need to accelerate their information system improvements.

Working within the Illinois Department of Public Health the Project Implementation Manager will collaborate across technical and non-technical teams to define project objectives, allocate resources, coordinate with teams, and manage timelines to ensure the successful delivery and implementation of a public health data systems project.

The Project Implementation Manager will be hired by the CDC Foundation and assigned to the Illinois Department of Public Health. This position is eligible for a fully remote work arrangement for U.S. based candidates.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain data modernization workplans, serving as the Project Implementation Manager to develop detailed project plans and timelines, as well as maintain project documentation including project charters, plans, status reports, and post-project evaluations.
  • Drive project deliverables to ensure they are within scope, deadlines, and budget.
  • Develop and execute supporting plans including data communication, data training, and the data modernization initiative (DMI) evaluation plan. Support execution of enterprise-wide data maturity assessment. Develop and conduct surveys and focus groups as needed to assist in assessment. Create an evaluation plan for data modernization impact analysis. Assist with implementation of the data maturity roadmap.
  • Establish measurable metrics to be used to evaluate DMI activities and impact.
  • Schedule and organize regular recurring meetings with internal and external data interest holders to review project progress, address any issues or concerns, identify data needs and gaps.
  • Schedule and organize data modernization advisory committee meetings.
  • Collaborate with DMI core team including (data governance manager, metadata specialist, data training and communication specialist, business process analyst) to execute DMI workplan. Work with business analysts and other stakeholders to implement and adopt change management strategies.
  • Define clear roles and responsibilities and ensure standards and best practices are followed.
  • Work with user community, technical teams and vendors to meet implementation timeline.
  • Document business practices and workflows, identify opportunities for improvement, support process improvement, discover issues and deliver improved value.
  • Effectively communicating insights and plans to cross-functional team members and management. Facilitate communication between project team members, business analysts, and stakeholders. Create dashboards and generate reports.
  • Develop and implement change management strategies and plans to support the successful adoption and implementation of data modernization transformational activities.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in project management, public health, information systems, operations management or related field required. Master’s degree or other related advanced degree in a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 10 years of related experience leading data management projects.
  • Expert knowledge of project management fundamentals, including the ability to develop and implement accurate work plans, schedules, staffing plans, and budgets, in an agile or iterative environment. Proficiency in Smartsheet, Confluence, SharePoint and/or other project management tools and techniques.
  • Experienced in change management and risk management principles and processes.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to describe difficult technical problems and solutions to technical and non-technical teams.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining working relationships with internal and external partners and can effectively promote collaboration among differing viewpoints.
  • Outstanding interpersonal and teamwork skills; and the ability to develop productive working relationships with colleagues and partners.
  • Experience working in a virtual environment with remote partners and teams.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
  • Knowledge of data management, data governance and change management.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification or equivalent is preferred.

Special Notes

This role is involved in a dynamic public health program. As such, roles and responsibilities are subject to change as situations evolve. Roles and responsibilities listed above may be expanded upon or updated to match priorities and needs, once written approval is received by the CDC Foundation in order to best support the public health programming.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status, and all other characteristics protected by law.

We comply with all applicable laws including E.O. 11246 and the Vietnam Era Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974 governing employment practices and do not discriminate on the basis of any unlawful criteria in accordance with 41 C.F.R. §§ 60-300.5(a)(12) and 60-741.5(a)(7). As a federal government contractor, we take affirmative action on behalf of protected veterans.

The CDC Foundation is a smoke-free environment.

Relocation expenses are not included.

About the CDC Foundation

The CDC Foundation is an independent nonprofit authorized by Congress to mobilize philanthropic partners to support the public health system, including the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), in preventing and responding to threats to health. In this role, we are focused on one priority: building catalytic, flexible and impactful partnerships—with corporations, philanthropies, individuals and organizations—to help improve the health and lives of people in all communities, everywhere. Job Title: Senior Director, Drug Safety Operations (remote)

Job Location: Indianapolis, Indiana, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


Overview


Centessa Pharmaceuticals, a wholly owned subsidiary of Eli Lilly and Company, is a clinical-stage company developing orexin receptor 2 (OX2R) agonists as a new class of medicines for the treatment of narcolepsy and potentially other sleep-wake disorders. Centessa’s lead investigational candidate – cleminorexton (formerly ORX750) – is being developed for narcolepsy type 1, narcolepsy type 2, and idiopathic hypersomnia. Centessa's OX2R agonist portfolio includes additional clinical and preclinical-stage assets with potential utility across a broader range of neurological, neurodegenerative, and neuropsychiatric conditions. Headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, Centessa was recognized as a Great Place to Work® in 2026.


We are seeking a highly experienced and detail-oriented Senior Director, Drug Safety Operations to lead and optimize the operational aspects of our global safety and pharmacovigilance (PV) function. Reporting to the AVP, Drug Safety & Pharmacovigilance, this role will provide strategic and operational leadership for our global drug safety and pharmacovigilance function. This role is responsible for overseeing end-to-end safety operations, including case processing, individual case safety report (ICSR) management, regulatory reporting, vendor oversight, inspection readiness, and compliance with global pharmacovigilance requirements across the product lifecycle. The Senior Director will lead the development and optimization of scalable processes, systems, and partnerships that ensure high-quality, efficient, and compliant safety reporting while supporting Centessa's growing portfolio. Operating in a dynamic environment, this individual will drive operational excellence, continuous improvement, and innovation to advance patient safety and regulatory compliance globally.


Responsibilities


  • Lead Drug Safety Operations activities and manage assigned team members, ensuring the timely, accurate, and compliant collection, assessment, processing, review, and reporting of safety information across clinical development programs.
  • Partner across the Drug Safety leadership team to implement and enhance operational processes, governance activities, and resourcing plans in support of an evolving development portfolio.
  • Lead execution of the global Drug Safety Operations strategy, operating model, governance framework, objectives, and resourcing plans to support an evolving portfolio and business priorities.
  • Oversee pharmacovigilance operations, including case intake, triage, processing, medical coding, quality review, Individual Case Safety Reports (ICSRs), SUSAR reporting, and submissions to global regulatory authorities.
  • Lead oversight and governance of pharmacovigilance vendors, CROs, safety database providers, and other external partners, ensuring high-quality service delivery, regulatory compliance, performance management, and financial stewardship.
  • Establish, maintain, and continuously improve pharmacovigilance processes, SOPs, work instructions, quality systems, and operational controls to ensure compliance with global regulations and industry standards, including FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, and ICH requirements.
  • Ensure ongoing inspection readiness and lead operational support for regulatory inspections, partner audits, and quality assessments, including CAPA development and implementation as needed.
  • Monitor operational performance through KPIs, quality metrics, dashboards, and trend analyses to drive data-informed decision-making, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Drug Safety physicians, Clinical Development, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Medical Affairs, Biometrics, and external partners to align pharmacovigilance operations with program and corporate objectives.
  • Support the preparation and operational execution of aggregate safety reporting activities, including DSURs, PBRERs, Risk Management Plans, and other regulatory deliverables, ensuring data integrity and inspection-ready documentation.
  • Drive operational excellence through process optimization, system enhancements, automation, and scalable solutions that improve efficiency, quality, compliance, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Build, develop, and mentor a high-performing Drug Safety Operations team while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and patient focus.

Basic Qualifications


  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Nursing, Public Health, or a related scientific discipline.
  • 10+ years of pharmacovigilance and drug safety operations experience within the biotechnology and/or pharmaceutical industry, including increasing levels of responsibility.
  • Experience supporting small molecule development programs and/or neuroscience/CNS products within an emerging biotechnology environment strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience managing global safety operations, including case processing, Individual Case Safety Reports (ICSRs), SUSAR reporting, and regulatory submissions within a GxP-regulated environment.
  • Strong knowledge of global pharmacovigilance regulations and guidance, including FDA, EMA, MHRA, ICH, GVP, and applicable international reporting requirements.
  • Experience overseeing pharmacovigilance vendors, CROs, and external service providers, including performance management, governance, and compliance oversight.
  • Hands-on experience with safety databases and pharmacovigilance technologies (e.g., Argus, ArisG, or comparable systems), including familiarity with MedDRA, WHO Drug dictionaries, and E2B(R3) reporting standards.
  • Experience supporting clinical-stage development programs, with knowledge of aggregate safety reporting activities such as DSURs, PBRERs, Risk Management Plans, and related regulatory deliverables.
  • Proven ability to lead and develop staff, manage competing priorities, and operate effectively in a fast-paced, evolving biotech environment.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across geographies and organizational levels.
  • Experience supporting regulatory inspections, audits, and health authority interactions, with a demonstrated commitment to quality, compliance, and patient safety.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (e.g., PharmD, MSN, MPH, or MS) in a related scientific discipline.

Work Location

The Senior Director, Drug Safety Operations role is a remote position based in the US, with occasional travel.

jobs.excerpt: SAP TM S/4HANA Rollout Consultant, BulgariaContract: 6 months initially, extensible.
jobs.description:
SAP TM S/4HANA Rollout Consultant, Bulgaria

Contract: 6 months initially, extensible. Long-term programme. Start: 1 November 2026 Location: Remote, for consultants based in Bulgaria. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.

The programme

A global manufacturing organisation is moving its transportation processes onto SAP Transportation Management (TM) on S/4HANA. The global template is the base, and it is being rolled out to sites in waves. Each wave brings new plants, new carriers and new country requirements into the template.

You will own the TM solution for the waves you are given. You will run fit-to-standard sessions with the business, decide what the template already covers and what is a real local gap, and design the answer without breaking the global standard. You will then carry that design through build, testing, cutover and early support after go-live.

What you will work on

Fit-gap for each rollout wave. Local transport practice, carriers, legal and document needs measured against the global design. TM solution design on S/4HANA. Freight planning, carrier selection and tendering, freight order execution, charge calculation and freight settlement. Integration across the S/4HANA logistics chain. Outbound sales orders and deliveries, inbound purchasing flows, warehouse execution, and freight cost through to finance. Carrier connectivity. EDI or business network onboarding, tracking, and status messages from carriers. Functional specifications for the build team, working closely with integration, development and test leads. Test planning and defect resolution through integration and user acceptance testing. Cutover, hypercare and handover to support for each wave. Feeding what each wave teaches back into the template, so the next wave starts from a better base.

What you bring

8 or more years in SAP logistics, with SAP TM on S/4HANA as a core part of it. At least one TM rollout or global template programme for a manufacturing business, where you did the fit-gap and the solution design yourself, not only the configuration. Working knowledge of how TM connects to SD, MM, EWM and FI/CO, and where those integrations tend to break. Experience running workshops with business users and turning what they say into a design and a specification. Comfort working remotely across countries in a programme team made up of several companies.

Useful but not essential:

SAP Business Network for Logistics, or a carrier visibility platform. Both embedded and side-by-side TM deployments. Automotive, industrial or process manufacturing. Multimodal, international or dangerous goods transport. SAP TM certification.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent TM rollout: the countries or sites in scope, whether TM was embedded or side-by-side, and what you personally designed.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced SAP TM people in front of a global manufacturing organisation.

About the Client

You'll design and build complex automation systems, integrate AI technologies, develop custom code, and create tailored software solutions when existing platforms aren't sufficient.

Working closely with the founder and delivery team, you'll take ownership of projects from requirements gathering and technical design through development, deployment, and optimization.

This isn't a role for someone who only builds simple automations. We're looking for a software engineer who understands system architecture, can solve complex technical challenges, and knows when to use low-code platforms versus custom development.

Location: Fully Remote

Software Development & AI Systems

  • Develop custom integrations, scripts, and applications using JavaScript/TypeScript and/or Python.

  • Build RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems using LLMs, embeddings, document retrieval, and vector databases.

  • Apply software engineering and cybersecurity best practices to ensure secure, reliable, and maintainable systems.

Project Ownership & Collaboration

  • Take ownership of projects from requirements gathering and solution design through testing, deployment, and optimization.

  • Translate business requirements into practical technical solutions.

  • Collaborate with the founder and delivery team on technical decisions and project execution.

  • Maintain clear documentation and high standards of quality.

  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve systems, workflows, and development processes.

Must-Haves

  • Several years (at least 3+) of professional software development experience, complemented by substantial hands-on automation engineering experience.

  • Advanced proficiency in n8n and Make.com, including complex, multi-step workflows and integrations.

  • Strong hands-on experience with HubSpot CRM, including its data structures, pipelines, properties, and automation capabilities.

  • Practical experience building RAG-based AI systems, including LLM integrations, embeddings, document retrieval, and vector databases.

  • Strong programming skills in JavaScript/TypeScript and/or Python.

  • Experience with Zapier, Close CRM, or other automation and CRM platforms.

  • Experience building custom business applications or replacing/extending SaaS platforms.

  • Background in an AI automation consultancy, agency, or client-facing technical environment.

  • Previous technical leadership experience.

Ideal Candidate Profile

You're a software engineer at heart who understands both traditional development and modern automation platforms. You know when to use n8n or Make.com, when custom code is necessary, and how to design solutions that are secure, scalable, and maintainable.

You're analytical, structured, detail-oriented, and methodical in your approach. You think through technical challenges carefully, make logical and well-reasoned decisions, and value precision and quality over quick fixes.

You're also reliable, accountable, and calm under pressure. You take ownership of projects, communicate proactively, and can be trusted to deliver consistently high-quality work with minimal supervision.

Above all, you're curious about emerging AI technologies and motivated to build practical, innovative solutions that solve real business problems.

Why Join?

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Voice - Milan
jobs.excerpt: If you are here, it is because you know that we are looking for a Software Engineer, Voice for our Product team.
jobs.description:
If you are here, it is because you know that we are looking for a Software Engineer, Voice for our Product team.

indigo.ai is the leading platform in Italy for building next-generation AI Agents that transform the way companies communicate with their customers. Since 2016, we’ve been helping enterprises in industries such as finance, insurance, utilities, retail, and e-commerce to evolve their Customer Experience through conversational AI. We don’t just “sell software”: we enable a shift in how organizations interact with people, automating millions of conversations every year, reducing operational costs, improving conversion rates, and creating more personalized, scalable, and compliant customer journeys.

Backed by a recent €10 million investment from Azimut, we are on a mission to take this technology global. This is a unique opportunity to join a well-funded, highly ambitious team and play a direct role in shaping the future of enterprise AI.

To make this happen, we are looking for a Software Engineer, Voice to support our Chief Product Development Officer in making talking to AI on the phone feel human.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for a Software Engineer, Voice to own the real-time voice layer of our AI Agents. Voice is where conversational AI is being decided right now, and our voice agents already handle production phone traffic for large companies. The bar is moving fast: we want to make the leap from "works reliably" to "feels human on a real phone line", and we want one person to own that leap. This is a specialist role with end-to-end ownership: the architecture, the model and provider choices, the latency budget, the way a conversation feels. You'll join our Product Engineering team, reporting to our Chief Product Development Officer, as our first full-time engineer dedicated to voice. And if voice grows the way we believe it will, you'll shape the team that grows around it.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the real-time voice pipeline end-to-end. From audio ingress on the telephony edge, through streaming STT and turn-taking, to the agent brain and back out through streaming TTS. Every millisecond in between is yours.

  • Engineer how fast the agent feels. Semantic end-of-turn detection, preemptive generation on partial transcripts, eager TTS, filler and backchannel strategies that mask tool calls. All measured on real 8kHz phone audio, not in a browser demo.

  • Make turn-taking human. Barge-in that survives noisy lines. Endpointing policies that know the dialog state, so a caller never gets cut off mid-IBAN. The difference between an IVR and a conversation lives here.

  • Raise voice quality on the channel that actually ships: the phone. Benchmark and A/B STT and TTS providers on real G.711 calls (Italian first: WER, naturalness, numbers and codes read right), exploit wideband/HD voice where the carrier allows it, and experiment with context-aware TTS and conversational speech models as they mature.

  • Build the evaluation harness. Turn "this voice sounds better" into numbers we trust: per-stage latency budgets, turn-taking metrics, regression suites on recorded calls, quality gates before anything reaches a client.

  • Keep production boringly reliable. Per-stage observability, live-call incident debugging (dead air, stuck turns, provider hiccups), graceful degradation when a vendor blinks.

  • Track a weekly-moving ecosystem and turn it into strategy. New STT/TTS/speech-to-speech releases land every month. You decide what we integrate, what we self-host for EU compliance and data residency, and what we skip. And you make provider swaps cheap.

You will need:

The filter is not your degree, and it's not years-of-experience arithmetic. It's having built it. Tell us about a real-time voice or audio system you designed and shipped: the latency budget, where it broke, and what you changed to make it feel right. That tells us more than any title.

  • Real-time audio systems, shipped. You've built voice agents, telephony systems, conferencing or live-streaming products that ran in production. You know what it means to move audio over WebSockets/WebRTC, through codecs (G.711/μ-law, Opus), against a latency budget.

  • The modern voice AI stack, hands-on. Streaming STT and TTS, VAD and turn detection, voice orchestration frameworks (Pipecat, LiveKit Agents or equivalent), speech-to-speech models. You have opinions on the trade-offs, grounded in things you've actually built, not blog posts.

  • Strong software engineering. TypeScript/Node.js and/or Python, and the maturity to own a production service end-to-end: containers, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, observability.

  • A latency obsession. You think in milliseconds per stage, you instrument before you optimize, and you know the difference between measured and perceived latency, and how to exploit it.

  • A product ear. You can hear the difference between a demo and a conversation, and you can translate what you hear into engineering priorities and measurable evals.

  • An AI-native way of working. You use agentic coding tools (e.g. Claude Code) daily and you're good at directing them: setting up the problem, judging the output.

  • Language Skills: Fluent English.

We will really like (but they are not required):

  • Italian: our voice market is Italian-first, and you'll be tuning pronunciation, prosody and evals for it every week.

  • Contact-center / CCaaS ecosystem experience: SIP trunking, SBCs, enterprise telephony platforms.

  • ML audio experience: evaluating or fine-tuning ASR/TTS models, working with speech datasets.

  • Elixir: our agent platform is built on it.

  • Open source: contributions to open-source voice/audio projects.

Our values:

At indigo.ai we prize Vision (curiosity and courage to challenge the status quo), Connection (empathy, candor, and trust), Responsibility (ownership, reliability, and follow-through), and Excellence (the habit of raising the bar and refining until it’s right). If you naturally think ahead, build strong relationships, take accountability, and obsess over the quality of what you deliver, we’re probably a great match.

What do we offer?

  • A key role in one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI scale-ups, backed by a €10M investment from Azimut.

  • A competitive salary in the range of 40-70k RAL, commensurate with experience + a performance-based Bonus.

  • A flexible, remote-friendly work environment.

  • Meal vouchers and Welfare programs to support your everyday life.

  • Access to a dedicated education budget for continued learning and growth.

  • Career Development Plan, ensuring a clear path for both personal and professional growth.

  • Top-grade equipment, which may include a MacBook Air, iPhone, and other top-tier devices.

  • Unlimited coffee.

  • Company retreats in stunning locations throughout the year.

Where is the job?

This position is fully remote, so there's no need to be in a specific location to do your work. That said, we have an amazing office at SPACES, Piazza Gae Aulenti 1/Torre B in Milan, available to anyone who wants to use it. We also love getting together and organize various retreats and meetups throughout the year to stay connected.

Why join us?

At indigo.ai you’ll be part of a fast-growing SaaS company where your ideas and work can turn into products used by millions. Join us and you’ll:

  • Work with the most advanced AI technologies, shaping how enterprises across industries engage with their customers.

  • Be part of a dynamic and passionate team, where everyone has a direct impact on company growth.

  • Grow in a culture that values transparency, continuous learning, and career development, with clear paths for personal and professional progression.

  • Enjoy a flexible, people-first environment, with remote-friendly policies, stunning retreats, and a strong focus on well-being.

  • Contribute to our mission of reshaping how companies and people communicate worldwide.

About Us

At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 250 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data.

For more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy-to-use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data, quickly, dependably, and at scale. And today, the data we extract helps thousands of organizations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. Today, over 3,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.

The Integration Squad helps developers and data teams find, adopt and keep using Zyte for web data. We focus on coding agents and agent-based workflows. We make Zyte API and Scrapy Cloud easy to reach from the tools people already use: coding agents like Claude Code, Codex and Cursor; frameworks like LangChain and LlamaIndex; cloud platforms like AWS and Google Cloud; and later, automation and app-building tools. We measure success by how many customers use Zyte through these integrations, not by how many integrations we publish.

We’re hiring an Integrations Engineer to help build this program from the start. You’ll build and publish integrations, including MCP-based setups, a Zyte command-line tool (CLI), framework packages and data-delivery connectors. You’ll also write the documentation that lets developers and their agents use them without help, and the tracking that shows whether they work.

We employ agile methodologies and work in cross-functional pods, which lets us respond quickly to both community feedback and internal product needs.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Build and publish integrations that bring Zyte into coding-agent environments (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Docker), building on the existing Zyte MCP server.
  • Design, build and release the Zyte CLI as a shared base for integrations, published to both PyPI and npm.
  • Build and maintain packages and tools for developer frameworks and agent SDKs (e.g. LangChain, LlamaIndex) and for browser automation tools.
  • Build recurring data delivery into customers’ cloud and data platforms (e.g. AWS, Google Cloud Storage and BigQuery, Snowflake), reusing existing export routes where possible.
  • Assess app and automation platforms (e.g. Dify, Flowise, Make, Zapier, Lovable, Replit). Prototype integrations or templates where they’ll lead to repeat Zyte use.
  • Give early engineering estimates of feasibility, effort, dependencies and upkeep for each candidate integration, to help decide what we build next.
  • Add tracking so signups and usage can be traced back to each integration, and report gaps where tracking isn’t possible.
  • Write clear setup guides, examples and docs that work for both people and coding agents, on docs.zyte.com and in public repositories.
  • Prepare and manage submissions to partner directories, registries and marketplaces, including responding to partner review feedback.
  • Maintain live integrations: keep up with changes in partner tools, fix issues, and handle releases and versioning.
  • Work with Product, Product Marketing and Developer Relations on launches, positioning and community support.
  • Work with the SaaS and Platform teams to keep the Zyte API and Scrapy Cloud surfaces that integrations rely on stable.
  • Take part in code reviews, planning and squad routines.

Requirements

  • Strong Python skills and solid TypeScript/Node.js. You’ll publish packages in both ecosystems.
  • Experience building SDKs, client libraries, CLIs, plugins or third-party integrations used by outside developers.
  • Hands-on use of coding agents and AI tooling (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex), and familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar tool-calling interfaces.
  • Experience publishing and maintaining packages (PyPI, npm), including versioning, CI/CD, tests and releases.
  • Good working knowledge of REST APIs and authentication, including keeping credentials secure in client and server setups.
  • An outcome-focused mindset: you care whether developers adopt and keep using what you ship, and you use data to decide what to improve.
  • Clear writing in English. Documentation and examples are a core part of the job.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and early-stage scoping in a new squad.
  • Experience in a distributed, remote-first team is a strong plus.
  • Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex or agent SDKs is a plus.
  • Experience with AWS or GCP data services (S3, Cloud Storage, BigQuery) or Snowflake is a plus.
  • Familiarity with web scraping, Scrapy or browser automation (Playwright, Selenium) is a plus, but not required.
  • Open-source maintenance or Developer Relations experience is a plus.

Benefits

As a new Zytan, you will:

Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multi-cultural team.

Have the freedom and flexibility to work from where you do your best work.

Work with cutting-edge open source technologies and tools.

35 days paid holidays

jobs.description:
SAP TM S/4HANA Rollout Consultant, Czechia

Contract: 6 months initially, extensible. Long-term programme. Start: 1 November 2026 Location: Remote, for consultants based in Czechia. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.

The programme

A global manufacturing organisation is moving its transportation processes onto SAP Transportation Management (TM) on S/4HANA. The global template is the base, and it is being rolled out to sites in waves. Each wave brings new plants, new carriers and new country requirements into the template.

You will own the TM solution for the waves you are given. You will run fit-to-standard sessions with the business, decide what the template already covers and what is a real local gap, and design the answer without breaking the global standard. You will then carry that design through build, testing, cutover and early support after go-live.

What you will work on

Fit-gap for each rollout wave. Local transport practice, carriers, legal and document needs measured against the global design. TM solution design on S/4HANA. Freight planning, carrier selection and tendering, freight order execution, charge calculation and freight settlement. Integration across the S/4HANA logistics chain. Outbound sales orders and deliveries, inbound purchasing flows, warehouse execution, and freight cost through to finance. Carrier connectivity. EDI or business network onboarding, tracking, and status messages from carriers. Functional specifications for the build team, working closely with integration, development and test leads. Test planning and defect resolution through integration and user acceptance testing. Cutover, hypercare and handover to support for each wave. Feeding what each wave teaches back into the template, so the next wave starts from a better base.

What you bring

8 or more years in SAP logistics, with SAP TM on S/4HANA as a core part of it. At least one TM rollout or global template programme for a manufacturing business, where you did the fit-gap and the solution design yourself, not only the configuration. Working knowledge of how TM connects to SD, MM, EWM and FI/CO, and where those integrations tend to break. Experience running workshops with business users and turning what they say into a design and a specification. Comfort working remotely across countries in a programme team made up of several companies.

Useful but not essential:

SAP Business Network for Logistics, or a carrier visibility platform. Both embedded and side-by-side TM deployments. Automotive, industrial or process manufacturing. Multimodal, international or dangerous goods transport. SAP TM certification.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent TM rollout: the countries or sites in scope, whether TM was embedded or side-by-side, and what you personally designed.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced SAP TM people in front of a global manufacturing organisation.

Company Overview

We bring solutions to physicians by providing constant enhancement of our products and services including EHR, practice management, marketing, patient coordination and billing.

Voted the #1 EHR by PC Magazine, WRS Health is a physician-owned company delivering a fully integrated, AI-powered cloud EHR and practice management platform to medical practices across 25+ specialties. We support physicians with continuously improving products and services, including EHR, practice management, marketing, patient coordination, and billing.

We are seeking a Marketing Operations Strategist to develop and execute strategic marketing plans that drive brand awareness, customer acquisition, and revenue growth. You will build repeatable, measurable marketing systems that align with company goals, using HubSpot, AI-driven automation, and data science to turn marketing data into smarter decisions. This role is ideal for a results-driven, creative, and collaborative leader with a strong B2B SaaS background who enjoys managing projects, documenting processes, analyzing performance, and optimizing the website for better user experience, conversion rates, and lead generation.

Key Responsibilities

Marketing Strategy & Planning

  • Design and execute a comprehensive marketing strategy aligned with company objectives, target markets, and healthcare IT industry trends.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership to define marketing goals, KPIs, and budgets.

AI-Focused Marketing Workflows

  • Design and implement AI-powered workflows for lead scoring, content generation, audience segmentation, chatbots, and campaign personalization.
  • Evaluate and integrate AI tools (including HubSpot's AI features) into the marketing stack, with clear guidelines for quality, brand voice, and HIPAA-conscious data use.

Data Science & Marketing Analytics

  • Apply statistical analysis, predictive modeling, and attribution modeling to forecast pipeline, identify high-value segments, and measure channel effectiveness.
  • Design and analyze A/B and multivariate tests across emails, landing pages, and website experiences, turning results into actionable recommendations.

HubSpot & Marketing Automation

  • Manage HubSpot (Marketing, Sales, Service, and CMS Hubs), including automation workflows, processes, and data hygiene.
  • Analyze reports and dashboards in HubSpot to track KPIs, campaign performance, and ROI for stakeholders.

Campaign & Website Optimization

  • Build and manage the email marketing program from segmentation to execution.
  • Improve forms, email templates, landing pages, and website experiences to increase conversion rates and lead generation.

Project Management & Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Manage marketing operations projects from initiation to completion, tracking progress, risks, and bottlenecks to stay on schedule and within budget.
  • Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Customer Service teams to integrate processes and document repeatable workflows.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Management, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • At least 5 years of experience in marketing, marketing operations, and project management, preferably in B2B SaaS.
  • Advanced expertise in HubSpot (Marketing, Sales, Service, and CMS Hubs) and strong proficiency in marketing automation technologies.
  • Hands-on experience building AI-assisted marketing workflows (e.g., predictive lead scoring, AI content tools, chatbots, or personalization).
  • Strong analytical and statistical skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
  • Advanced database management and data visualization skills.
  • Solid understanding of customer journey mapping and business processes.
  • Excellent project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple projects at once.
  • Strong communication skills, including knowing how to ask the right questions and turn answers into systems.

Preferred

  • HubSpot certifications (Marketing, Sales, Operations, or related).
  • Experience as a HubSpot trainer or in HubSpot customer support.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, Python, or R for marketing data analysis.
  • Experience with BI tools such as Looker Studio, Tableau, or Power BI.
  • Familiarity with marketing attribution, predictive analytics, or machine learning concepts.
  • Experience marketing to healthcare providers or in health IT, with awareness of HIPAA considerations.

A Day in the Life

Your day blends strategy, systems, and data. You might start by reviewing HubSpot dashboards to check overnight campaign results and pipeline movement, then meet with Sales to refine how AI-driven lead scores route new leads to the right reps. Later, you could be building an automated nurture workflow that personalizes content by specialty, analyzing an A/B test on a demo-request landing page, or running a quick attribution analysis to show leadership which channels are actually driving booked demos. Along the way, you're cleaning up data, documenting processes so they can be repeated, keeping marketing projects on track, and testing new AI tools to see where they can save the team time without compromising quality.

Success Metrics

  • Pipeline and revenue growth: Measurable increases in marketing-qualified leads (MQLs), demo requests, and marketing-sourced revenue.
  • Conversion improvements: Higher conversion rates across the website, landing pages, forms, and email campaigns, validated through A/B testing.
  • AI-driven efficiency: AI and automation workflows in place that reduce manual work, improve lead scoring accuracy, and speed up campaign execution.
  • Data quality and insight: Clean, reliable HubSpot data and accurate dashboards and attribution reporting that leadership uses to make decisions.
  • Operational excellence: Marketing projects delivered on time and within budget, with documented, repeatable processes adopted across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Service.

Make finance transformation happen

We are looking for an experienced Finance Transformation Delivery Lead to turn an ambitious FY27 change agenda into measurable, well-controlled delivery.

This is a high-visibility role at the centre of a multi-entity, highly acquisitive international group. You will connect strategy with execution across a portfolio of finance transformation programmes, ensuring that plans are integrated, dependencies are actively managed and teams are set up to deliver.

A major part of the role will be supporting acquisitions. You will lead the finance integration journey from Day 1 readiness through to a stable handover, working with country finance teams, functional leaders, vendors and an offshore build team. You will also help deliver major change across NetSuite, including chart of accounts and multi-book, O2C and P2P, e-invoicing and Brazil tax reform.

This is an opportunity to shape how Finance Transformation delivers change: creating a consistent way of working, developing project managers and bringing the right level of pace, transparency and accountability to a complex portfolio.

What you'll do

Lead the integrated delivery plan

  • Own the single integrated plan across the FY27 finance transformation programmes.
    - Set sequencing and priorities across each quarter, making dependencies, decision points, delivery gates and build capacity visible.
    - Coordinate delivery across programmes so that teams can plan effectively and issues are addressed early.
    - Work closely with the Senior ERP Manager to align demand with offshore build capacity.

Deliver acquisition integrations

  • Own the finance integration plan for each acquisition from Day 1 readiness through to handover.
    - Coordinate entity onboarding, chart of accounts mapping, close activities and related finance readiness requirements.
    - Work with country finance teams and other stakeholders to resolve issues and maintain momentum.
    - Ensure every integration has a clear knowledge-capture deliverable, with appropriate funding agreed before delivery begins.
    - Hand delivery to the named run-side integration lead once the agreed outcomes and handover requirements are complete.

Provide strong programme control

  • Maintain the portfolio RAID log and ensure risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies have clear owners and actions.
    - Identify slippage early and drive recovery within agreed tolerances.
    - Escalate when thresholds are crossed, including proposing recovery plans or a re-baseline to the Director.
    - Prepare weekly reporting for the Director and the monthly programme board.
    - Provide the evidence required for quarterly outcomes assessments.

Build trusted senior relationships

  • Act as the day-to-day delivery contact for country finance teams, finance function owners and vendors.
    - Be the first point of resolution for delivery disputes involving country finance or stakeholders outside Finance.
    - Build confidence through clear communication, fact-based reporting and consistent follow-through.
    - Balance the needs of global standards with the practical realities of local finance teams and statutory requirements.

Develop the delivery team and approach

  • Lead, coach and develop the project managers across the portfolio.
    - Establish a consistent delivery method, governance rhythm and set of templates.
    - Create an environment where project managers can move between programmes quickly and work to a common standard.
    - Promote practical knowledge sharing and ensure lessons from each migration are captured and reused.

Drive readiness, go-live and handover

  • Coordinate the evidence required for each go/no-go decision.
    - Ensure readiness risks are visible and owned before a programme reaches its critical gates.
    - Produce a complete handover pack for the run owner.
    - Obtain the run owner’s sign-off, marking the formal end of delivery responsibility.

The environment

You will be working in a complex and fast-moving finance transformation landscape, including:

  • A multi-entity, acquisitive international group.

- NetSuite as the core ERP platform.

  • Finance teams across Europe, Brazil and other countries.
    - A significant FY27 M&A integration workload.
    - Chart of accounts and multi-book transformation.
    - O2C and P2P improvements.
    - Regulatory change, including e-invoicing and Brazil tax reform.
    - Distributed delivery, with build capability in the Philippines working EMEA hours.

This role is about making complex change happen. You will bring structure, pace, transparency and effective decision-making across the portfolio. Those responsibilities remain with the Director, Group Finance technical accounting, ERP and build teams, and the relevant function owners.

Why this role matters

You will have a direct influence on how Finance Transformation delivers one of the group’s most important change portfolios. You will work at the intersection of M&A, finance, technology and operations, helping newly acquired businesses integrate quickly while improving the foundations of the wider finance function.

Success in this role will be visible: clearer plans, faster issue resolution, confident country teams, stronger project managers and finance programmes that reach go-live with the right evidence and a clean handover.

What we are looking for

You will bring:

  • Significant experience leading complex finance transformation, ERP or business change programmes.
    - Strong programme planning and dependency management skills across multiple workstreams.
    - Experience managing acquisition or entity integrations, ideally from Day 1 through to operational handover.
    - The confidence to work with senior stakeholders, country finance teams, vendors and delivery teams.

Required

  • Credible partner to senior finance, technology and business leaders
  • Relentless on clarity, pace and delivery discipline
  • Has led finance integration for acquisitions, from Day 1 readiness through entity onboarding and close to handover.

Nice-to-have:

As Brand Director, you'll lead with vision, craft, and strategy, shaping how brands show up across every digital and physical touchpoint. As a director, you'll pair thought leadership with hands-on mentorship. You'll create the conditions for teams to do their best work, and make sure every brand we touch carries clarity, creativity, and craft.

What You'll Do

Lead the work

  • Define the vision for brand design at Parallel and raise our brand practice to a new level of creative excellence.

  • Guide and mentor brand designers at every level, through the whole journey from insight to identity to expression.

  • Partner with clients strategically, helping founders and executives shape, evolve, and scale their brands for a digital-first world.

  • Build and refine brand systems that carry cleanly into product experiences, marketing, and motion.

  • Make sure every engagement, ours or a client's, holds clarity, consistency, and purpose.

Shape creative direction

  • Drive the creative process on major brand initiatives, setting the tone for identity systems, storytelling frameworks, and brand guidelines.

  • Work closely with product design leadership so brand and product feel like one coherent experience.

  • Lead cross-disciplinary critique, lifting the team's fluency in storytelling, systems thinking, and craft.

  • Keep Parallel's own brand at the highest bar of craft and cohesion across everything we put out.

  • Build a team culture rooted in openness, mentorship, and curiosity, where designers grow and thrive.

  • Connect brand, product, and marketing so the experience holds together end to end.

What You Bring

  • Visionary brand leadership. You inspire creative excellence, communicate a clear and compelling brand vision, and earn client trust. You balance creative risk with strategic rigour, so every direction is both aspirational and grounded in business value.

  • Hands-on craft. You don't just direct great design, you do it. As one of the most senior makers in the room, you lead by example with exceptional craft and detail, and bring real design energy to pitches, reviews, and live work.

  • Brand systems expertise. You turn complex ideas into coherent, scalable systems across visual, verbal, and experiential, and you know how an identity holds up across environments, from a screen to motion to a physical moment.

  • Strategic storytelling. You see brand as narrative, where story, identity, and experience meet, and you guide teams and clients to articulate what makes their brand meaningful and distinct.

  • Cross-disciplinary collaboration. You move fluidly across product, strategy, and marketing, bringing a systems mindset that connects every touchpoint.

  • Mentorship and critique. You raise the people around you through coaching, high standards, and a culture of honest, constructive feedback.

Requirements

  • 8+ years in brand design, creative direction, or design leadership, ideally in a digital-first environment.

  • Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and large-scale brand engagements from strategy through execution.

  • A portfolio that shows mastery of visual identity, brand systems, and storytelling across digital touchpoints.

  • Experience presenting to executive stakeholders and turning creative thinking into strategic outcomes.

  • Fluency in modern design tools (Figma, Illustrator, After Effects) and a real grasp of how brands extend through motion, interaction, and content.

  • Comfort with emerging tools, including everyday use of AI in your craft.

  • Strong facilitation and communication skills, guiding workshops and strategic sessions with confidence and empathy.

  • Deep knowledge of design trends and the evolving role of brand in the digital ecosystem.

jobs.excerpt: At Contegris, we're not just focused on building great products — we're equally committed to making sure they work reliably and deliver a seamless experience for the people who use them.
jobs.description:
At Contegris, we're not just focused on building great products — we're equally committed to making sure they work reliably and deliver a seamless experience for the people who use them.

As a System Support Engineer, you'll be part of the team responsible for helping customers resolve technical issues, troubleshoot system-related problems, and ensure a smooth customer experience.

This is an entry-level technical support role suited for someone who enjoys troubleshooting, learning how systems work, communicating with customers, and finding practical solutions to technical problems. You'll work closely with customers to investigate issues, provide timely support, document incidents, and escalate complex problems when required.

If you're technically curious, comfortable communicating with customers, and looking to build your career in IT Support Network Support, this role might be for you.

What This Role Does

  • Handle Customer Support: Respond to customer inquiries and technical issues received through phone, email, chat, and other support channels.
  • Troubleshoot Technical Issues: Analyze reported problems, identify possible causes, and provide appropriate solutions.
  • Drive First Contact Resolution: Resolve customer issues efficiently at the first point of contact whenever possible.
  • Monitor & Escalate: Identify system alerts or complex technical issues and escalate them to the relevant technical team when required.
  • Understand Customer Needs: Ask the right questions, actively listen to customer concerns, and gather the information required to diagnose issues.
  • Provide Clear Communication: Explain technical issues and solutions in a simple and professional manner to customers.
  • Document Incidents: Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, technical issues, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions in the CRM/HelpDesk system.
  • Follow Up: Stay connected with customers on pending issues and ensure they receive timely updates until resolution.
  • Collaborate with Technical Teams: Work with relevant internal teams to investigate and resolve issues that require further technical assistance.
  • Maintain Customer Experience: Ensure every customer interaction is handled professionally, patiently, and with a customer-first mindset.

Who This Is For

  • Bachelor's degree, preferably BS Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 6 months - 1 year of experience in technical support or a high-paced call center environment.
  • Students currently enrolled in a BS CS/IT-related program at VU (Virtual University) are also encouraged to apply.
  • Candidates who have completed CCNA, CCNP, or relevant networking/IT courses from Corvit are encouraged to apply.
  • Basic understanding of Linux, Networking, and Network Security.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Customer-oriented approach with the ability to handle customer concerns professionally.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Good attention to detail and ability to accurately document technical issues.
  • Ability to remain calm and effective under pressure.
  • Good team player with a willingness to learn and grow.
  • Comfortable working in Rotational shifts.

What Won't Work

This role won't be a fit if you:

  • Don't enjoy troubleshooting or investigating technical problems.
  • Prefer to simply forward customer issues instead of trying to understand and resolve them.
  • Struggle to communicate clearly with customers.
  • Find it difficult to remain patient and professional when dealing with frustrated customers.
  • Are uncomfortable working in a fast-paced support environment with rotational shifts.
  • Don't want to learn about Linux, networking, SaaS products, and technical systems.
  • This is primarily a Product Support role where you'll learn our products and technologies and provide technical support to our customers. If your career goal is to move into pure Networking or Network Engineering, this role may not be the right fit.
  • Avoid documenting issues, troubleshooting steps, or customer interactions properly.
  • Struggle to work under pressure or manage multiple support requests.
  • Prefer working independently and are not comfortable collaborating with technical teams.

Location

Business - Real Estate

Brookfield Real Estate Group is one ofBrookfield’s primary operating groups. The Real Estate Group is one of the world's largest investors in real estate, with a global portfolio that includes office, retail, multifamily, logistics, hospitality and alternative real estate assets on five continents. The Group owns and operates approximately $268 billion of assets representing the most iconic properties in the world’s most dynamic markets. We seek to generate value by leveraging our operating expertise and focusing on our core real estate capabilities of leasing, financing, development, design and construction as well as property and facilities management. For more information, visit .

Brookfield Culture

Brookfield has a unique and dynamic culture. We seek team members who have a long-term focus and whose values align with our Attributes of a Brookfield Leader: Entrepreneurial, Collaborative and Disciplined. Brookfield is committed to the development of our people through challenging work assignments and exposure to diverse businesses.

Job Description

Brookfield is seeking a Senior ML/AI Engineer to help build and scale an AI-first platform that amplifies Brookfield's intelligence and enables smarter investment decisions, faster.


This role is for a hands-on engineer who will design, build, and improve the ML and AI application systems that turn Brookfield's proprietary investment context, including deals, documents, research, decisions, and outcomes, into reusable institutional intelligence.


You will work across retrieval, document intelligence, knowledge graphs, and LLM-powered applications, supporting capabilities ranging from natural-language query over structured data to grounded Q&A across large virtual data rooms, cross-corpus search, and agentic workflows.


You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Investment teams to deliver ML/AI capabilities that are accurate, traceable, scalable, and trustworthy enough to support real investment decisions. The ideal candidate combines strong hands-on ML/AI engineering experience with product judgment, curiosity, and a pragmatic approach to solving complex problems.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, build, and maintain ML/AI systems across knowledge graph intelligence, document intelligence, retrieval, and LLM-powered applications.
  • Build retrieval capabilities that combine structured data, unstructured documents, embeddings, metadata, and graph-based relationships.
  • Contribute to the development of knowledge graph capabilities that support natural-language query, entity linking, and context assembly.
  • Build and improve document processing pipelines for large-scale virtual data rooms, including ingestion, OCR, layout-aware parsing, table extraction, structured fact extraction, and citation-grounded Q&A.
  • Develop hybrid retrieval and reranking systems combining lexical, dense, metadata, and graph-based approaches across large datasets.
  • Build LLM applications using RAG, agent and workflow orchestration, prompt and tool design, structured outputs, and grounding techniques.
  • Develop and maintain evaluation frameworks, including golden sets, automated evaluations, human validation workflows, online metrics, and regression testing.
  • Evaluate foundation models, embedding models, vector stores, and document AI services based on quality, latency, cost, and product requirements.
  • Build cost-efficient ML/AI systems using techniques such as caching, model cascading, tiered processing, and appropriate batch versus real-time processing.
  • Implement permissions-aware retrieval and AI pipelines that respect data access controls and audit requirements.
  • Ensure AI-generated outputs are grounded in and traceable to source evidence.
  • Partner with Full Stack, Platform, Product, and other AI Engineers to integrate shared ML/AI capabilities into products and workflows.
  • Contribute to model fine-tuning and adaptation initiatives where off-the-shelf models do not meet product requirements.
  • Support other engineers through code reviews, technical discussions, and shared engineering standards.
  • Improve retrieval, ranking, generation, and recommendation quality using user feedback, validated outputs, and other product signals.
  • Stay current with developments across LLMs, retrieval, document intelligence, agentic systems, and AI engineering, applying new approaches where they meaningfully improve the platform.

QUALIFICATIONS

SERVICE / PERSONAL SKILLS


  • Strong systems thinker with the ability to design practical ML/AI solutions for complex product and data problems.
  • Clear communicator who can explain ML/AI tradeoffs and model behavior to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Highly collaborative and comfortable working across Product, Engineering, Data, and Investment teams.
  • Execution-focused and pragmatic, with good judgment around build-versus-buy decisions.
  • Passionate about AI and interested in applying it to high-stakes, judgment-heavy domains where accuracy and trust are critical.
  • High-agency builder who is comfortable with ambiguity and enjoys getting close to users and their workflows.

EXPERIENCE

  • 5+ years of professional experience in machine learning, applied AI, software engineering with an ML focus, or ML/AI systems engineering, with experience shipping production systems.
  • Strong experience with retrieval systems, including embeddings, vector search, hybrid retrieval, and reranking.
  • Experience developing LLM applications using RAG, agent or workflow orchestration, prompt and tool design, structured outputs, and grounding.
  • Experience with knowledge graphs or relationship-heavy retrieval, including areas such as entity resolution, graph traversal, or graph-aware context assembly.
  • Experience with document intelligence pipelines, including OCR, parsing, table extraction, and citation-preserving chunking.
  • Experience developing and applying evaluation approaches for ML/AI systems, including automated evaluation, golden datasets, human validation, and regression testing.
  • Understanding of permissions-aware AI systems and access control within retrieval and generation pipelines.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and familiarity with modern ML/AI development frameworks and tooling.
  • Experience with cloud-native ML/AI infrastructure; experience with AWS, FastAPI, or TypeScript is an asset.
  • Understanding of the cost, latency, and quality tradeoffs associated with foundation models and AI infrastructure.
  • Experience with model fine-tuning, training, or adaptation is an asset.
  • Experience in data-rich, judgment-heavy domains such as real estate, finance, asset management, or legal is an asset.
  • Comfortable using AI coding tools and agents to improve engineering productivity.
  • Able to assess AI-generated code critically, understanding when outputs can be trusted and when deeper review is required.
  • Interested in improving AI engineering workflows, tooling, guardrails, and feedback loops over time.

EDUCATION / DESIGNATIONS / LICENSES

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related technical field required, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in a quantitative or ML/AI-related field is preferred.
  • Cloud certifications, including AWS, Azure, or GCP architecture or ML/AI certifications, are considered an asset.

Our compensation structure is comprised of a base salary and a short-term incentive program (cash bonus). Cash compensation tends to vary based on geography to account for local market conditions and is set to be market competitive. Compensation decisions are based on a number of factors including relative experience, overall years of experience, industry experience, education and designations.
