About Us:

STACK is a leading provider of cloud-based construction estimating and takeoff software solutions, committed to helping businesses transform through innovative solutions. We pride ourselves on fostering a collaborative, dynamic environment where team members have the opportunity to grow and make a real impact.

About the Role:

The Senior Director of Revenue Operations will lead the strategy, processes, technology, and data behind STACK's revenue teams, with a focus on building a signal-led go-to-market motion that helps us attract prospects, grow accounts, and retain customers. This role turns buying, usage, and partner signals into clear, timely action for our revenue teams. Our Senior Director of Revenue Operations will report to the Chief Growth Officer, lead the Revenue Operations team, and work collaboratively with the Revenue, Product, and Finance teams.

Your Most Important Initiatives:

  • Own the revenue operations strategy and roadmap, aligning sales, account management, marketing, partnerships, product, and customer success around shared KPIs and a signal-led go-to-market motion
  • Build and lead a signal-led revenue engine that captures and unifies buying signals (product usage, website and content engagement, third-party intent, partner and ecosystem overlap, and firmographic or hiring changes) into a single view of account readiness
  • Design signal-based account scoring, routing, and plays so sales and customer success teams engage the right accounts at the right time, and measure the pipeline and revenue impact of each signal
  • Instrument the product-led funnel, including trial starts, activation, paywall hits, self-serve purchases, and product-qualified lead handoffs to sales, and reconcile e-commerce and rep-sold revenue so self-serve results never hide in reporting gaps
  • Track partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, deal registration, and co-sell attribution
  • Own forecasting, pipeline health, and revenue analytics, and run the operating cadence, including weekly pipeline reviews, forecast calls, QBR packs, and the board metrics deck
  • Build dashboards leaders actually use, explain the "why" behind every number, and flag risks early, such as aging pipeline, slipping close rates, renewal risk, and rep activity gaps
  • Support Customer Success with renewal forecasting, health scoring, churn analysis, and expansion pipeline tracking, and make sure customer lifecycle data flows back into GTM planning
  • Own one source of truth for funnel stage definitions (MQL → SAL → SQO → Pipeline → Closed), conversion math, and attribution rules; enforce data hygiene across duplicates, ownership rules, required fields, and lead routing SLAs; and resolve Sales and Marketing lead disputes with clear rules, not opinions
  • Own the revenue technology stack, including Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, and Pendo, so the systems integrate cleanly and report the same numbers; manage tool rationalization, vendor contracts, and renewals to prevent stack sprawl; and own automation for routing, scoring, alerts, and cross-team handoffs
  • Lead the use of AI across revenue operations, including AI-assisted forecasting, signal detection, account research, and workflow automation, with clear guardrails for data quality, security, and responsible use
  • Build the annual and quarterly revenue plan, including bookings, pipeline coverage, capacity models, and quotas, and partner with Finance on forecasting methodology, ARR reporting, and compensation plan design
  • Design territories, account segmentation, and ICP tiering so coverage matches where the revenue is
  • Run systems and process onboarding for revenue teams, document playbooks, and train teams on new processes and signal-driven workflows, making the right way the easy way for reps
  • Serve as the primary strategic partner between Sales, Account Management, Marketing, Finance, Product, and Operations leadership
  • Lead, hire, and develop the Revenue Operations team, setting clear goals and helping each person perform their best

What You Bring:

  • 8+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or go-to-market operations, including 3+ years leading teams (required)
  • Experience building or scaling a signal-led or intent-based go-to-market motion, such as account scoring, intent data, product usage signals, or partner and ecosystem data (required)
  • Experience operating a product-led or self-serve motion, including trial and activation instrumentation, product-qualified lead handoffs, and reconciling e-commerce with rep-sold revenue (strongly preferred)
  • 5+ years working with Salesforce (required) and other systems like HubSpot, Gong, Pendo, Intercom, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and signal or intent platforms such as Crossbeam, 6sense, or Clay (each ideal)
  • Hands-on experience applying AI in go-to-market operations, such as AI agents and copilots in Salesforce, Gong, or Clay, LLM-based workflows, and prompt design (required)
  • Ability to evaluate AI tools, measure their impact on productivity and pipeline, and drive adoption across revenue teams
  • Experience building annual revenue plans, capacity models, forecasts, territories, quotas, and compensation plans in partnership with Finance
  • Track record of defining and governing funnel stages, attribution rules, and lead routing across Sales and Marketing
  • Strong data and analytics skills; SQL or BI tool experience is a plus
  • B2B SaaS experience required; construction technology experience is a plus
  • Project and change management
  • Strong executive communication (verbal and written)
  • Strong organizational skills, time management, and the ability to prioritize and multi-task

Why Join STACK?

  • Opportunity to work in a fast-paced, growth-oriented, remote-first environment.
  • Async-friendly environment with a focus on ownership and deep work.
  • Be part of a dynamic, supportive team where your contributions are valued.

At STACK, our values shape how we work, collaborate, and serve our customers:

  • Radical Honesty: Communicate directly, respectfully, and transparently—even when conversations are difficult. Give and receive feedback with care.
  • Customer Obsession: Put the customer at the center of every decision. Solve real problems, follow through, and measure success by customer outcomes.
  • Move With Purpose: Take thoughtful action, remain accountable, and own both successes and mistakes. Anticipate what’s next and adapt as you learn.
  • Grow Together: Share knowledge, collaborate across teams, and invest in one another’s development. Celebrate collective wins and treat setbacks as opportunities to learn.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas.

We take into account an individual’s qualifications, skillset, and experience in determining final salary. This role is eligible for health insurance (medical, dental & vision), life insurance, 401(k) & paid time off. The compensation range for this role is around $165k- $220k USD. The actual offer will be at the company’s sole discretion and determined by relevant business considerations, including the final candidate’s qualifications, years of experience, skillset, and geographic location.

Job Summary

To handle a portfolio of claimant serious injury claims for Minster Law clients, to generate fee income and contribute to the general success of the department. The caseload is predominantly RTA based and it is anticipated you will deal with cases valued up to £50,000.

Core Responsibilities

  • You will be responsible for delivering excellent client care to our clients who have suffered from a traumatic and life changing event.

  • Regular communication and face to face meetings with your client.

  • Instructions and meetings with a multi-disciplinary team of experts for example, medical experts, case managers, care experts, architects, forensic accountants, counsel.

  • Analysis of evidence and research of legal issues on liability, causation and quantum.

  • Drafting documents including statements, pleadings and schedules of loss.

  • Securing early interim payments and appropriate rehabilitation.

  • Optimising your client’s settlement.

  • Ability to work with a task based case management system to ensure regular contact is maintained with all clients, providing exceptional customer service and managing their expectations.

  • Raising awareness of the department and developing your profile.

  • Perform to a high level in a target orientated environment.

  • To undertake any other tasks as deemed relevant and reasonable by the business

Key Performance Indicators

Your KPIs and Objectives will be discussed and agreed with you on a one-to-one basis. You will have regular one-to-one meetings with your line manager to review your performance against these objectives and identify any areas for development and/or required support.

Person Specification

Essential

  • We welcome applications from experienced legal professionals who can demonstrate the capability and expertise required to justify a Grade C charge-out rate, including Qualified Solicitors and Fellows of CILEx.

  • Commitment to delivering excellent client care for each of our clients.

  • Excellent communication skills to include negotiation and objection handling.

  • Accountable for achieving objectives in a fast paced environment whilst maintaining high standards of work quality and client care.

  • Competent working with a case management system and good knowledge of Excel and Word.

  • Good attention to detail and strong organisational skills.

Desirable

  • Proven track record of dealing with serious injury claims.

  • Desire to develop your professional profile and that of your firm within the personal injury field.

  • Team Player and acts as a role model to your colleagues, working together to achieve business and team objectives.

  • Maintains a positive attitude, self-motivated and uses own initiative.

  • Robust - able to deal with changing circumstances and challenging situations whilst still achieving objectives.

  • Takes opportunities to develop and stretch yourself, and be passionate about developing your career in personal injury.

Personal Development

There is the opportunity for high performing individuals to move into different departments across the business, to expand their knowledge, experience and develop a career within Minster Law.

Travel

Our clients are based throughout England and Wales and there will be a need for occasional travel, for example to undertake meetings with clients and conferences with the multi-disciplinary teams of experts and counsel.

Salary Information

The annual salary range for this role is £35,000 - 42,000

Equal Opportunities

All applicants will be considered for employment regardless of age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, neurodiversity, or disability status. You can read more about our commitment to equality and diversity on the Minster Law website.

We are seeking a Program Delivery Consultant to support complex technology programs for our healthcare clients. You have experience working within cross-functional teams to develop high-quality deliverables, coordinate delivery activities, analyze business and technology challenges, and help move programs from planning through implementation.

As an Accenture Consultant, you will work closely with Managers, Senior Managers, and client stakeholders to support program execution, create client-ready deliverables, address delivery challenges, and contribute to a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing team environment.

  • Create and maintain client-ready deliverables, including program plans, status reports, executive presentations, process documentation, decision materials, and risk and issue summaries.

  • Coordinate activities across Accenture, client, and technology partner teams, including geographically distributed onshore and offshore resources.
  • Track milestones, deliverables, risks, issues, decisions, dependencies, and action items, escalating concerns to program leadership when appropriate.
  • Prepare clear and concise program communications for client stakeholders and Accenture leadership.
  • Facilitate working sessions, document decisions and outcomes, and follow through on assigned actions.
  • Apply knowledge of healthcare payer operations and technology delivery to analyze challenges and support effective program decisions.
  • Support testing, implementation readiness, deployment, go-live, and post-deployment optimization activities.

  • Collaborate effectively with team members while taking ownership of assigned activities and deliverables.
  • Contribute to an inclusive team culture by sharing knowledge, supporting colleagues, and seeking opportunities for continued professional development.

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

jobs.excerpt: Sobre o Grupo QuintoAndarSomos o Grupo QuintoAndar, o maior ecossistema imobiliário da América Latina.
jobs.description:
Sobre o Grupo QuintoAndar

Somos o Grupo QuintoAndar, o maior ecossistema imobiliário da América Latina. Guiados pelo propósito de ajudar pessoas a amar o lugar onde moram, criamos tecnologias e soluções que simplificam toda a jornada da moradia, do aluguel à compra e venda.

Presentes em 6 países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Peru, Equador e Panamá) e com um hub de tecnologia em Portugal, reunimos mais de 3.100 pessoas no desafio de transformar o setor. Com o apoio de investidores globais como SoftBank, General Atlantic e Kaszek, já captamos mais de US$ 755 milhões e somos uma empresa avaliada em US$ 5,1 bilhões.

Lideramos a transformação do mercado sendo pioneiros na aplicação de Inteligência Artificial em larga escala no setor imobiliário. Nossas plataformas somam mais de 50 milhões de acessos mensais, administrando mais de 350 mil contratos de aluguel ativos e movimentando R$ 20 bilhões por ano.

Se você busca resolver problemas complexos com autonomia, tecnologia de ponta e impacto em escala massiva, pode entrar, a casa é sua.

Para saber mais sobre a nossa história, acesse:

Localização e Modelo de Trabalho

  • Atuamos no modelo remote-first, oferecendo total flexibilidade para você trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil. Para quem gosta de encontros presenciais, disponibilizamos nosso escritório em São Paulo e coworkings parceiros. Além disso, contamos com o programa Work From Anywhere (WFA), que permite trabalhar remotamente de qualquer lugar do mundo por até 90 dias no ano.


Sobre o Desafio

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Recrutadora Sênior acostumada a rodar no ritmo de ambientes fast-paced e pronta para assumir desafios de alto impacto.

Se você domina o recrutamento end-to-end — do kick-off à negociação de proposta —, transita com facilidade entre a complexidade do mundo Corporativo e a agilidade das estruturas de Operações, e sabe lidar com alto volume sem perder a qualidade da experiência do candidato nem a parceria estratégica com o negócio, esta oportunidade é para você.

Aqui, você jogará lado a lado com gestores e diretores, utilizando dados, estratégias avançadas de sourcing e uso inteligente de ATS para acelerar nossas contratações e garantir processos seletivos fluidos, inclusivos e eficientes.

Se você gosta de autonomia, dinâmica acelerada e quer transformar a forma como atraímos talentos, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Suas Responsabilidades
  • ​Gestão End-to-End: Conduzir o ciclo completo de recrutamento e seleção (do kick-off da vaga a call de offer) para as estruturas corporativas de People e Legal.
  • ​Gestão de Stakeholders: Atuar como um parceiro estratégico de gestores e diretores, alinhando perfis, ajustando expectativas de prazo e fornecendo consultoria sobre o mercado de trabalho.
  • ​Sourcing Ativo & Pipeline: Desenvolver estratégias avançadas de busca ativa de candidatos (boolean search, mapeamento de mercado, hunting) utilizando LinkedIn Recruiter e outras redes de talentos.
  • ​Volume e Priorização: Gerenciar com eficiência um alto volume de posições simultâneas, mantendo SLA de fechamento competitivo sem comprometer a qualidade da experiência do candidato e do gestor.
  • ​Mentalidade Data-Driven: Acompanhar, analisar e apresentar métricas e KPIs da área, utilizando dados para identificar gargalos e otimizar o fluxo do funil de seleção.
  • ​Gestão de Ferramentas e ATS: Garantir o uso rigoroso e estruturado do Greenhouse (ou similar), mantendo a governança do sistema, feedback contínuo aos candidatos e relatórios atualizados.
  • ​Experiência do Candidato & Diversidade: Promover uma jornada inclusiva, justa e memorável para os candidatos, além de atuar como embaixador de iniciativas de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DE&I) nos processos seletivos
O que buscamos (Requisitos)
  • Experiência comprovada com recrutamento end to end de posições de diferentes senioridades das estruturas comerciais e/ou Corporativo.
  • ​Experiência em ATS e Ferramentas: Domínio prático de Greenhouse (ou ATS de mercado como Lever, Workday) e LinkedIn Recruiter corporativo.
  • ​Idiomas:Inglês Avançado
  • ​Orientação por Dados: Habilidade demonstrada em tomar decisões baseadas em métricas de R&S e facilidade para montar dashboards/relatórios de acompanhamento.
  • ​Comunicação e Influência: Comunicação verbal e escrita impecáveis, com capacidade de negociar com clareza, dar feedbacks construtivos e alinhar expectativas com lideranças sêniores.

Como é nosso processo seletivo?

Desenhamos uma jornada transparente, direta e focada em avaliar seu potencial técnico, comportamental e oferecer a você a oportunidade de conhecer nossos times e trilhas de carreira, sendo estruturadas da seguinte forma:

  • People Interview
  • Hiring Manager Interview
  • Live Case
  • Entrevista com Stakeholder


Importante: Avaliamos todas as candidaturas individualmente e garantimos retorno para todas as pessoas. Toda a comunicação é feita por e-mail, então certifique-se de liberar o domínio @quintoandar.com.br na sua caixa de entrada.


Benefícios

Oferecemos um pacote completo focado na sua saúde, bem-estar, família e desenvolvimento:

  • Remuneração: Salário competitivo, Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR - para funções elegíveis) e Remuneração Variável (para funções elegíveis).
  • Saúde e Bem-Estar: Plano de Saúde, Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, Wellhub (Gympass) e QuintoCare (apoio psicológico, jurídico, social e financeiro gratuito).
  • Qualidade de Vida: Vale Refeição e Alimentação, Day Off de aniversário, Dia das Mães e Dia dos Pais.
  • Flexibilidade: Auxílio Home Office e programa Work From Anywhere (WFA).
  • Família e Cuidado: Auxílio Creche, Auxílio Parentalidade Atípica, Licença Parental Estendida e Kit Leiturinha.
  • Educação e carreira: Parcerias com instituições de ensino;

Diversidade & Inclusão no Grupo QuintoAndar

Valorizamos a diversidade e queremos que todas as pessoas se sintam bem-vindas por aqui — independentemente da sua idade, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, cor, etnia, origem, deficiência, religião ou qualquer outra característica. Todas as nossas vagas são abertas para todas as pessoas! Você verificará que existem algumas perguntas sobre diversidade no formulário de inscrição. Em vagas afirmativas, as informações poderão ser utilizadas para verificar o seu alinhamento com o público-alvo da oportunidade, podendo, nesses casos, ter caráter eliminatório. Para vagas não afirmativas, esses dados serão utilizados de forma anonimizada, exclusivamente para acompanhar e aprimorar nossas práticas de inclusão nos processos seletivos e sem impacto na sua candidatura.

Privacidade e Proteção a Dados

O Grupo QuintoAndar atua em conformidade com as leis de privacidade e proteção de dados, incluindo, mas não se limitando à Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais - LGPD (Lei nº 13.709/2018), e garante a segurança de seus dados pessoais. Para saber mais, acesse o nosso Aviso de Privacidade para Pessoas Candidatas. Se tiver dúvidas ou quiser exercer seus direitos como titular de dados, entre em contato com a gente pelo Canal de Atendimento.

jobs.title: Senior Principal Structural Engineer - Data Center Infrastructure (FE)
jobs.excerpt: At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions.
jobs.description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

How will you make an impact?


The Senior Principal Structural Engineer is a core member of the Facility Enablement team, responsible for the structural integrity of both the data center products we build and the manufacturing facilities used to produce them. This role spans the full product lifecycle, from early stage design through factory integration, deployment, and field installation, with a focus on scalable, repeatable, and manufacturable structural solutions aligned with hyperscale delivery models.


The position requires deep expertise in structural steel and concrete design, seismic analysis, and equipment support systems, combined with a practical understanding of how structural systems integrate with high-density MEP environments and modular construction workflows. The role is customer-facing and works closely with mechanical, electrical, manufacturing, BIM, and product engineering teams to deliver code-compliant, platform-based, and production-ready data center solutions.


Location: Remote* OR Austin, TX

*Requires up to 30% domestic and/or international travel (rare)


What will you do?


Structural Design & Analysis

  • Evaluate structural solutions through the lens of technical risk, cost efficiency, and schedule - ensuring designs are robust, buildable, and aligned to delivery timelines.
  • Lead gravity, wind, seismic, and vibration analysis for modules, frames, racks, and support structures per IBC, ASCE 7, AISC, ACI, and applicable local codes.
  • Analyze and provide structural recommendations for MDCs, equipment skids, enclosures, and factory-built assemblies.
  • Validate structural solutions for HAC systems across overhead, rack-integrated, and floor-supported configurations.
  • Develop seismic bracing and restraint strategies for MEP systems, cable trays, pipe racks, and modular assemblies.
  • Engineer foundations, steel frames, and anchorage solutions for chillers, generators, UPS systems, pumps, heat exchangers, and fluid distribution equipment.
  • Define structural strategies for thermal loads, vibration-sensitive equipment, and deflection-managed assemblies.
  • Develop and maintain DFMEA documentation to identify structural risks and drive mitigation across product families.
  • Optimize recurring product families for weight, manufacturability, cost, and platform scalability.

Manufacturing Facility & Production Space Support

  • Support structural design and coordination for manufacturing and production facilities, including floor loading, equipment pads, overhead crane rails, mezzanines, dock infrastructure, and material handling systems.
  • Evaluate structural implications of factory layout changes, new production equipment installations, and capacity expansions.
  • Ensure production floor structural systems are compatible with the weight, dynamic loading, and footprint of the data center products being manufactured.
  • Collaborate with facility planning and operations teams to define structural requirements for new or modified production spaces.

Factory Integration & DFx Enablement

  • Support factory layout and integration efforts, including load paths, transportation loads, and installation constraints.
  • Collaborate with manufacturing teams to ensure structural designs meet DFMA requirements; develop standard design templates and modularization strategies to enable repeatability across programs.
  • Define structural requirements for transportation, lifting, and placing equipment and skids; validate shipping and logistics requirements including OTR dimensional and load limitations.
  • Ensure structural designs align with factory automation, material-handling capabilities, and assembly workflows.

BIM & Cross-Discipline Coordination

  • Collaborate with the BIM/Revit team to ensure structural models are integrated, clash-free, and current within the master coordination model.
  • Participate in multi-discipline model coordination reviews, resolving structural clearances, anchorage zones, and maintenance envelopes across MEP disciplines.
  • Review and contribute to coordination drawings, ensuring structural elements are accurately represented and conflict-free.
  • Maintain structural model quality and LOD standards in adherence with the project BIM Execution Plan (BEP).

Fabrication & Implementation

  • Collaborate with fabrication shops and factory teams to ensure structural designs are buildable, manufacturable, and installation-ready.
  • Review shop drawings, fabrication details, welds, connections, and material specifications for MDCs, HAC systems, and equipment support structures.
  • Verify lifting, rigging, transportation, and shipping load cases, including temporary bracing for modules and skids.
  • Support factory builds, FATs, and field installations; resolve RFIs, NCRs, and production deviations, feeding lessons learned back into design standards.

Documentation, Compliance & Technical Leadership

  • Produce and review calculations, drawings, specifications, and stamped engineering packages; manage coordination with third-party engineering partners and AHJ approvals where required.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable codes, seismic standards, customer requirements, and product certification pathways (UL, OSHPD/OSP, etc.) where applicable.
  • Contribute to internal design standards, platform templates, best practices, and lessons-learned documentation.
  • Mentor junior engineers, lead design reviews, and serve as a technical escalation point for complex structural issues across the team.

How will you get here?

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Structural Engineering or Civil Engineering (structural emphasis) required

Experience:

  • 15+ years of progressive structural engineering experience, including leadership of complex structural systems in high-availability industrial or mission-critical facilities or an equivalent combination of education, training or experience.

Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. jobs.description:
Comprehensive Prosthetics & Orthotics is seeking an Orthotics and Prosthetics CAD Modifier to prepare and modify digital models used to fabricate custom orthotic and prosthetic devices. Working remotely with clinicians and fabrication staff, you will translate supplied scans, measurements, and clinical instructions into accurate digital models for production.

This position requires practical experience with orthotics and prosthetics computer-aided design software and patient-specific model modification. You will apply clinician-directed changes, check model accuracy, and prepare files for fabrication while maintaining organized case records.

What You Will Do

·Review incoming scans, measurements, work orders, and clinician instructions for completeness and consistency.

·Modify digital models using orthotics and prosthetics CAD software according to clinician specifications and established procedures.

·Apply prescribed buildups, reductions, reliefs, contour changes, and trimlines within your training and assigned responsibilities.

·Check model dimensions, orientation, anatomical landmarks, and requested changes before submitting files for review or production.

·Clarify incomplete scans, conflicting measurements, and unclear modification instructions with the clinical or fabrication team.

·Prepare approved files for the fabrication workflow using required formats and naming conventions.

·Maintain organized records of source files, model changes, revisions, and completed work.

·Coordinate priorities and communicate progress, technical issues, and potential delays to the team.

·Protect patient information and follow company procedures for secure access, file handling, and remote work.

Required Qualifications

  • At least two years of professional experience modifying patient-specific digital models for custom orthotic or prosthetic devices in an O&P clinical practice, fabrication laboratory, or central fabrication facility.
  • Proficiency with O&P-specific CAD software used for digital model modification, including importing scans, applying clinician-directed modifications, and preparing files for fabrication.
  • Production experience applying prescribed buildups, reductions, reliefs, contour changes, and trimlines to orthotic or prosthetic models.
  • Working knowledge of relevant anatomy, anatomical landmarks, and how model modifications affect device fabrication and fit.
  • Ability to review scans, measurements, and work orders; identify incomplete or conflicting information; and obtain clarification before proceeding.
  • Experience preparing and checking digital files for carving, milling, or additive manufacturing.
  • Ability to complete assigned CAD cases independently within clinician specifications, maintain accurate revision histories, and deliver production-ready files within established deadlines.
  • Ability to work remotely with reliable communication and follow company procedures for protecting patient information.
  • High school diploma or GED.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Three or more years of direct experience in O&P digital model modification.
  • Experience modifying models for both orthotic and prosthetic devices.
  • Hands-on O&P fabrication experience, including physical model preparation or modification.
  • Experience supporting multiple clinicians or managing cases within a central fabrication workflow.

What You Can Expect

  • Remote collaboration with clinicians and fabrication staff.
  • Work focused on patient-specific digital models and fabrication requirements.
  • Technical work that supports the production of custom orthotic and prosthetic devices.

Compensation

Base Pay Range: $25.00 to $29.00 per hour

About CPO

Comprehensive Prosthetics & Orthotics provides orthotic and prosthetic services across the Midwest. Our fabrication and clinical teams work together to help patients regain mobility, confidence, and independence through quality devices and personalized care.

Apply

Submit your resume highlighting your orthotics and prosthetics CAD experience, software platforms used, device types supported, and experience preparing modified digital models for fabrication. Do not include patient-identifying information in application materials.

jobs.excerpt: Company OverviewPERSUIT is transforming the way the world's leading legal departments select, engage and manage outside counsel and control legal spend.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

PERSUIT is transforming the way the world's leading legal departments select, engage and manage outside counsel and control legal spend. Our end-to-end platform, powered by AI and a modern user experience, takes legal spend from intake through to invoice and brings transparency, efficiency and intelligence to a market that has long relied on legacy e-billing and fragmented matter management. Legal spend is rising, AI is reshaping legal operations, and we're just getting started.

The Role

As the Director of Solution Consulting, you'll own presales across PERSUIT's full platform and serve as the technical and value heartbeat of our sales process, bridging the gap between what PERSUIT can do and what Fortune 500 legal departments need to see, feel and believe before they buy. This isn't a "demo jockey" role. You'll shape the narrative, build the demos and design solutions that span the entire legal spend workflow, from outside counsel selection and engagement through to billing and invoice review, for audiences ranging from the General Counsel to IT.

You'll be a strategic voice in our biggest deals, working alongside Sales leadership to shape how they're won, and you'll partner with our CEO and Product leadership so that what you learn in the field directly shapes the platform's roadmap. You'll also own and build the function. You'll start as a hands-on player-coach leading a small team, setting the presales motion, standards and best practices, and scaling the team globally as we grow. We're looking for someone who is energized by rolling up their sleeves on live enterprise deals while thinking strategically about how to build a world-class presales practice.

Key Responsibilities

Global Presales Leadership

Own presales strategy and execution across all regions and the full end-to-end platform, not a point solution. Set the technical and value narrative for every enterprise opportunity and manage proof-of-concept engagements from scoping through to decision.

Deal Strategy

Act as a strategic peer to Account Executives and Sales leadership on our most important opportunities. Shape win themes, map multi-stakeholder buying committees, surface technical and commercial risk early, and directly influence how deals are structured and won.

Executive Demonstrations and Storytelling

Design and deliver tailored, high-impact demos and narratives that resonate with GCs, CLOs, legal operations, procurement, finance and IT, going well beyond a standard walkthrough to show prospects what's possible across their entire legal spend workflow.

Business Case and Solution Design

Build bespoke end-to-end solution designs, quantified business cases and prototype workflows that let prospects visualize exactly how PERSUIT transforms their environment before they sign.

Rapid Prototyping and Demo Innovation

Use AI-powered build tools and modern technology to create tailored demo environments, interactive prototypes and data-driven visualizations at the speed of the deal, and set the bar for how PERSUIT shows value.

Technical Discovery

Lead structured discovery with legal operations, procurement, finance and IT stakeholders to surface requirements, integration needs (e-billing, ERP, matter management and data platforms), security considerations and evaluation criteria early in the process.

Presales to Implementation Handoff

Own a seamless transition from presales to implementation so that what is sold is what is delivered. Ensure scope, success criteria and solution design are clearly documented, and that Customer Success and implementation teams start every engagement with full context.

Product and Roadmap Influence

Partner with the CEO and Product leadership to shape strategy and roadmap priorities, bringing enterprise client insight and competitive intelligence to Product and Marketing to sharpen positioning.

Team Building and Management

Hire, develop and lead a growing global Solution Consulting team, establishing the presales motion, repeatable processes, demo standards, playbooks and enablement resources that scale as the team expands.

Requirements

Requirements & Qualifications

  • 12+ years of experience in Sales Engineering, Solution Consulting or a related presales role, with at least 4 years leading presales teams, ideally including building or scaling a function
  • A proven track record supporting complex enterprise SaaS sales into Fortune 500 or global organizations, including large, multi-year deals with multi-stakeholder buying committees
  • Executive presence: you can deliver compelling, consultative demos and narratives to GCs, CLOs and other C-suite stakeholders, as well as legal operations, procurement and IT audiences
  • Experience designing solutions across end-to-end business workflows rather than single products, and translating complex requirements into clear solution narratives and quantified business cases
  • Demonstrated influence on deal strategy and outcomes, working as a peer to Sales leadership rather than a support function
  • Experience partnering with Product leadership to shape roadmap priorities using structured field insight
  • Hands-on fluency with modern AI tools, with the confidence to build prototypes, demo assets and data-driven visualizations yourself
  • Strong operational rigor, including defining presales metrics, coverage and capacity models, and processes while managing multiple active deals simultaneously
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills: you can make technical concepts feel approachable and business value feel concrete
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, resource-efficient scale-up environment where you'll often be building the process as you go, and willingness to travel internationally

Preferred Experience

  • Legal technology, legal operations, e-billing, matter management or legal spend management platforms
  • Selling to, or working within, the in-house legal departments of large global enterprises
  • Building a presales function from an early stage and scaling it across regions (North America, EMEA and APAC)
  • Using AI-native build tools (for example Claude, Cursor, Lovable or v0) to turn a discovery call into a working, prospect-specific prototype or interactive demo in hours rather than weeks
  • Working with APIs, integrations and data: connecting prototypes to sample data, configuring sandboxes and designing integration architectures with e-billing, ERP and finance systems
  • Building data-driven value tools, such as ROI models, spend analytics or benchmark dashboards, that prospects can explore with their own numbers
  • Developing reusable demo environments, sandbox configurations and demo libraries that the wider sales team can use
  • Value-selling methodologies (such as MEDDPICC) and modern revenue tooling (such as HubSpot or Salesforce, Gong and presales platforms)
  • Collaborating closely with Product teams to translate field learnings into roadmap input

Location & Work Authorization

This is a global role with regular international travel. While the position is remote, candidates must have current, valid work authorization in the country where the role is based. Unfortunately, we are not able to provide sponsorship for visas or work permits at this time.

Benefits

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
  • Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
  • Training & Development
  • Wellness Resources

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Container Platform Engineer to design, deploy, and operate enterprise-grade Red Hat OpenShift container platforms running mission-critical workloads across on-premises and cloud environments. In this role you will own the end-to-end platform lifecycle — from cluster provisioning and hardening, through workload onboarding and developer enablement, to ongoing operations and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in OpenShift and Kubernetes internals, strong Linux fundamentals, and a security-first mindset, and will partner with application teams, security engineers, and infrastructure stakeholders to deliver a stable, secure, and developer-friendly container platform.

Key Responsibilities
  • Architect, provision, and operate Red Hat OpenShift clusters across on-premises, virtualized, and major cloud environments, applying best practices for high availability, scalability, and security.
  • Design and implement multi-tenant OpenShift platforms with appropriate project isolation, network policies, quotas, RBAC, and security context constraints.
  • Automate cluster lifecycle operations — installation, upgrades, scaling, and decommissioning — using OpenShift installer, GitOps tooling (Argo CD, OpenShift GitOps), and IaC frameworks.
  • Onboard application development teams to the platform, providing clear self-service patterns, project templates, CI/CD integrations, and supporting documentation.
  • Operate OpenShift networking, including SDN/OVN-Kubernetes, ingress controllers, routes, network policies, and integration with enterprise firewalls and load balancers.
  • Manage OpenShift storage strategies (block, file, object), including dynamic provisioning, OpenShift Data Foundation, and integration with external storage platforms.
  • Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing using the OpenShift observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, EFK, Tempo) and integrate with enterprise SIEM and APM tools.
  • Harden the platform in collaboration with security teams, including image scanning (Quay/Clair), runtime protection, secret management, and continuous compliance with regulatory frameworks.
  • Design and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines on OpenShift using Tekton, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Argo Workflows, enabling safe and frequent application deployments.
  • Develop disaster-recovery and backup strategies for cluster state, etcd, and persistent workloads, validated through regular failover and restore drills.
  • Plan, test, and execute cluster upgrades across minor and major versions with minimal disruption to workloads, including pre-upgrade validation and rollback strategies.
  • Partner with application teams to right-size workloads, manage resource quotas, and tune cluster autoscaling for predictable performance and cost efficiency.
  • Continuously evolve platform tooling and developer experience, capturing feedback from internal users and translating it into roadmap improvements.
  • Mentor junior engineers and act as an OpenShift subject-matter expert across the broader organization.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of experience operating container platforms in production, with at least three years on Red Hat OpenShift.
  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of Kubernetes and OpenShift internals, including operators, CRDs, RBAC, and networking.
  • Strong Linux administration skills, including networking, performance tuning, and troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or Helm.
  • Solid experience implementing CI/CD pipelines on OpenShift or Kubernetes using Tekton, Jenkins, or Argo CD.
  • Strong scripting skills in Bash, Python, or Go.
  • Working knowledge of cluster monitoring, logging, and tracing tools.
  • Familiarity with container image security and supply chain hardening.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration or Architect-level Red Hat certification.
  • Experience operating OpenShift on at least one major public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Exposure to service mesh implementations (OpenShift Service Mesh, Istio, Linkerd).
  • Familiarity with regulated environments such as PCI-DSS, HIPAA, or SOC 2.
  • Experience with GitOps workflows using Argo CD or Flux.

Reading Tutor – OpenLiteracy (POOL)

Talent Pool Application | Remote | Part-time Contract (1099) | $28/hour | 10-20 hours/week

Please note: This is a talent pool posting, not an immediate opening. By applying, you'll be evaluated and added to our pool of qualified tutors. We draw from this pool on a rolling basis as new tutoring positions become available, so timelines vary and applying does not guarantee a placement or a specific start date. Candidates who are accepted into the pool will be contacted directly when a match is identified.

About OpenLiteracy

40% of fourth graders in this country read below grade level. At OpenLiteracy, our mission is to change that, one student at a time. We offer a suite of products and services designed to meet students and educators where they are: a purchasable reading curriculum grounded in the Science of Reading, Tier 2 intervention support for classroom educators, and high-impact, individualized Tier 3 tutoring. We don't just teach reading. We grow readers.

We're looking for passionate, certified educators to join our tutoring team and make a real difference in children's literacy outcomes across the country.

The Role

Once matched from the pool, you'll work 1:1 with students in grades K-6 through our secure online platform, using a curriculum designed by our team. No lesson planning required! Sessions are 25 minutes each, and you'll be matched with the same students over time, giving you the continuity needed to build the trusting relationships that struggling readers need most.

Great OpenLiteracy tutors balance explicit instruction with meaningful engagement with text, weaving comprehension into every step so students can have rich, confident conversations at any reading level.

Why Tutor With Us

Fully Remote All you need is a reliable device, strong Wi-Fi, and a quiet workspace. No commute, no classroom setup, and no lesson planning.

Competitive Pay Tutors begin at a starting rate of $28/hour once placed. You're also paid for student no-shows and late cancellations within 24 hours of the scheduled time. You are paid for any tutoring sessions and meetings you attend. Initial asynchronous orientation is compensated at a flat rate of $100.

Always 1:1 Tutoring All tutoring sessions are 1:1, meaning you can focus on building rapport and maximizing instruction for one student at a time.

Consistent Students Once placed, you're matched with the same students session after session, so your relationship-building skills genuinely matter.

Onboarding & Coaching Support All tutors complete a comprehensive paid onboarding and receive ongoing support from our learning specialist team once placed from the pool.

Breaks Aligned with Typical School-Year Schedules Tutors receive a week off at Thanksgiving, approximately two weeks off during the winter, and summers off. A small number of summer tutoring opportunities are available for interested tutors.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Current or expired K–6 teaching certification (must be able to provide a copy)
  • K-6 classroom teaching experience with a focus on reading
  • Strong grounding in the Science of Reading: phonics, structured literacy, fluency, vocabulary, and comprehension instruction
  • Able to provide at least 3 hours of consistent availability Monday-Thursday during peak hours (10:00 a.m. - 4:30 p.m. ET), minimum 4 days/week
  • Able to commit to at least 10 consistent hours per week
  • U.S. work authorization, U.S. mailing address, and ability to receive U.S. bank deposits
  • Reliable computer with camera and microphone, high-speed internet, and a quiet workspace

Please Note: We are currently unable to hire candidates based in California, Illinois, Massachusetts, New York, or New Jersey.

Preferred:

  • Experience with Tier 3 reading intervention
  • Experience teaching English Learners
  • Experience supporting students with reading disabilities

Note: TOEFL certification and substitute teaching licenses do not fulfill the certification requirement.

You'll Thrive Here If You…

  • Believe every student can learn to read with great instruction and the right support
  • Build warm, trusting relationships with students who have experienced difficulty with reading
  • Are organized, reliable, and manage your schedule with ease
  • Maintain a consistent availability; students depend on seeing the same tutor
  • Are energized by data and motivated by seeing measurable student growth

Application Process

  1. Complete the online application
  2. Respond to teaching-focused questions and submit short video responses
  3. Meet with a member of our hiring team for a short interview
  4. Complete a criminal background check, FBI fingerprinting, and educational verification
  5. If accepted, you'll join our talent pool, and you'll be contacted when a tutoring placement becomes available that matches your availability and experience

OpenLiteracy is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected factor. We encourage talented individuals of all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.excerpt: your missionFires and unplanned downtime cost industrial companies millions.
jobs.description:
your mission

Fires and unplanned downtime cost industrial companies millions. We catch both before they happen.

AVIAN's Swiss-engineered infrared cameras and AI monitoring detect abnormal heat inside industrial facilities at the point of inception. One signal does two jobs: it flags fire risk before a fire starts, and equipment wear before it becomes an unplanned shutdown.

Our system has already prevented thousands of fire events and saved millions of dollars in downtime prevented in live operations across wood processing, recycling and paper. We are also driving in new, exciting verticals like data centers and battery storage facilities with our powerful, adaptable solution.

Customers are coming to us and insurers are partnering with us, but that demand is a fraction of the opportunity. Thousands of facilities have never heard our name. You are joining our founding sales team in the US as one of its first Account Executives, reporting to the SVP of Sales and helping us scale toward $10M+ ARR.

What you'll own:

  • The full cycle. New ARR and expansion deals from first contact to signature: discovery, demo, site visit, ROI case, proposal, negotiation, close. You sell to operations, maintenance and reliability, safety, procurement, and executive buyers, often inside the same account.
  • Your pipeline. You prospect directly into plant managers, maintenance and reliability leaders, safety leaders, and executives at high-risk facilities, consistently, not only when the funnel thins. Marketing, trade shows, partner referrals, and SDR-booked meetings are a bonus on top. The number is yours, and reaching it means working the phones hard every week.
  • The business case. You turn operational pain into an urgent financial argument: unplanned downtime, damaged equipment, lost inventory, rising insurance requirements. Some buyers move over what a fire would cost once, others over what a failing bearing costs every quarter.
  • The account after signature. You do not hand the customer off. You keep the relationship and grow it.
  • The feedback loop. You work closely with marketing, product, and implementation, and what you learn from the market shapes our pitch, pricing, and roadmap.

Land and expand:

  • Land. The first purchase is usually one site, often one high-risk area inside it: a shredder line, a baler, a dryer, a chip pile. You win it by making the risk and the financial case impossible to ignore.
  • Prove. You stay close through installation and the first months of monitoring. Early results earn you the right to ask for more: a heat event caught before it spread, a bearing flagged before it seized, a cleaner insurance conversation.
  • Expand within the site. Coverage grows from that first area to the whole facility as trust builds and the early saves add up.
  • Expand across the account. Most customers run several facilities, some run dozens. One plant that trusts us becomes the reference for the next, and eventually the group standard. You work upward to corporate operations, safety, and risk, and outward to every other site.

This takes patience and emotional intelligence. Plant managers guard their budgets and their independence. Corporate teams want one standard across every site. You need credibility with both, and going to corporate too early can cost you the plant champion who got you in.

The account stays yours as it grows, and every expansion inside it pays you again. Some of your biggest wins in year two will come from accounts you landed in year one.

What success looks like in year one:
  • You close new customers and expansions that put AVIAN on the path to $10M+ ARR.
  • You self-source most of your own pipeline.
  • You turn your first sites into proof points, and at least one into a second site.
  • For your largest accounts, you build plans that map every facility, every stakeholder, and a path to standardizing on AVIAN.
  • You document what works, so the hires after you ramp faster.

your profile

Who you are:

  • You've closed complex B2B deals. Technical products, multiple stakeholders, real negotiation, and you've consistently hit or beaten quota doing it.
  • You build your own pipeline. Startup, scale-up, or a scrappy team inside a larger industrial company, you have sold where nobody handed you leads. Many of your best deals started with you reaching out cold, and you can name them.
  • You grow accounts over years, not quarters. You can point to a customer that started small and got much bigger because of how you managed it, and name the people you won over at each stage.
  • You read operational buyers well. Plant managers, maintenance and reliability leaders, and safety directors can tell within five minutes whether you understand their world. You can also read who is skeptical, who feels threatened, and who quietly decides. Here that is the job, not a soft skill.
  • You're structured. Clean CRM (we run HubSpot), honest forecasts, disciplined next steps, strong follow-up.
  • You're ready to be on the road. You travel to customer sites, trade shows, and team meetings as the deal demands.

You might be coming from fire protection, industrial automation, condition monitoring, predictive maintenance, machine vision, safety tech, or insurance loss control. If you've sold into plants and facilities, we want to hear from you.

Bonus points if you've sold in our core verticals (wood processing, recycling, paper), rolled out a solution across multiple sites of one customer, or built relationships with insurers, brokers, integrators, or OEMs that open doors.

If you don't tick every box but you know you can sell this, apply anyway and tell us why.

why us?

What we offer:

  • Compensation: competitive base plus uncapped variable, where every new site pays as new business and every expansion or upsell inside your sites pays on top
  • Access: you report to the SVP of Sales and work directly with our leadership team and founders, with real influence on pricing, pitch, and go-to-market
  • A product that sells into urgency you do not have to manufacture: fires are an existential risk, downtime costs our customers every month, and insurers increasingly require prevention
  • Flexible, high-trust working model with an international, customer-obsessed team

How we work:

Clarity, ownership, speed. Everyone owns outcomes end-to-end. We fail fast and fix faster. Knowledge is shared, decisions are open, feedback is constant.

Hiring process:

  • Intro call (30 min): mutual fit and your track record
  • Deep-dive interview: how you sell, including a deal you sourced yourself and an account you grew
  • Practical exercise: a discovery and pitch simulation on a real facility scenario (recycling plant or sawmill), then how you would grow that site into the rest of the group
  • Meet the team and a conversation with our founders
  • Offer: we move in weeks, not months

AVIAN is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status. Reasonable accommodations are available upon request.

jobs.title: Area Sales Manager – Global
jobs.excerpt: Expand NOVENCO's international presence: develop new markets, build strategic OEM partnerships, and turn commercial opportunities into sustainable business growth across Europe and the Middle East.
jobs.description:
Expand NOVENCO's international presence: develop new markets, build strategic OEM partnerships, and turn commercial opportunities into sustainable business growth across Europe and the Middle East.

Building a strong international market presence requires more than maintaining existing customer relationships. It requires identifying new opportunities, establishing the right partnerships, and developing commercial relationships that create consistent, long-term business.

As our Area Sales Manager – Rest of World, you will play a key role in expanding NOVENCO's presence across Southern Europe, Eastern Europe and the Middle East. You will take ownership of developing new business, identifying OEM customers and establishing distributor partnerships while strengthening our existing customer relationships.

This is a hands-on commercial role for someone who enjoys opening new doors, building business from the ground up and taking responsibility for turning opportunities into results.

Your Impact

  • Drive international business development across Southern Europe, Eastern Europe and the Middle East, identifying opportunities to establish NOVENCO in new and developing markets.

  • Develop strategic OEM relationships, identifying manufacturers and industrial customers where NOVENCO's ventilation solutions can become part of long-term, recurring business.

  • Identify and establish new distributor partnerships, managing commercial negotiations, partner agreements and the development of sustainable sales channels.

  • Manage and grow existing customer and partner relationships, ensuring strong commercial engagement and identifying opportunities to expand business.

  • Take ownership of the complete sales development process, from market research and prospect identification to negotiations, commercial agreements and long-term account development.

  • Support the onboarding and commercial development of new partners, working with NOVENCO's technical sales support teams to ensure partners have the knowledge, tools and support needed to succeed.

  • Develop and execute regional sales strategies, managing sales pipelines, revenue forecasts, commercial targets and market development initiatives.

  • Build relationships across international markets, understanding different customer needs, business practices and commercial environments.

  • Collaborate closely with internal technical and commercial teams, ensuring customers and partners receive effective support throughout the sales process.

What Drives Success

You are a commercially driven sales professional who enjoys developing new business while understanding the importance of building and maintaining long-term customer relationships.

You combine strong business development capabilities with HVAC industry knowledge and the independence to manage multiple international markets.

You will likely bring:

  • At least 4 years of relevant experience in B2B sales, international business development, area sales or a comparable commercial role.

  • Good knowledge of the HVAC industry, including an understanding of ventilation, air movement or related applications.

  • Demonstrated experience identifying new customers, developing business opportunities and building commercial relationships from the ground up.

  • Experience working with international markets, industrial customers, manufacturers or OEM businesses.

  • Strong commercial capabilities, including sales negotiations, customer development, revenue responsibility and sales forecasting.

  • The ability to work independently, make commercial decisions and take ownership of business development initiatives.

  • Strong relationship-building skills, with the ability to develop trust and collaborate with customers and business partners across different markets and cultures.

  • Clear and effective communication skills, including professional proficiency in English.

  • A proactive, persistent and results-oriented approach, with the patience to develop new markets and partnerships over time.

  • Willingness to travel internationally for approximately 30–60 days per year.

Experience with industrial fans, ventilation solutions, distributor development or an established OEM network would be an advantage. Additional European or regional languages are also beneficial.

Real Impact

Imagine identifying an opportunity in an Eastern European market where NOVENCO currently has limited commercial presence.

Rather than waiting for incoming enquiries, you research the market, identify potential OEM customers and distributors, establish relationships with key decision-makers and demonstrate how NOVENCO's ventilation solutions can support their business.

You negotiate the commercial agreements, establish the partnership and work closely with our technical support team to ensure the new partner is properly introduced to NOVENCO's products, tools and processes.

But your responsibility does not end when the agreement is signed.

You continue developing the relationship, supporting the partner's commercial growth and ensuring the business becomes established and sustainable.

The result is more than a new customer or distributor. It is a stronger market presence, a growing international customer base and a foundation for recurring business that contributes to NOVENCO's long-term growth.

What We Offer

  • A key commercial role in expanding NOVENCO's international business across Southern Europe, Eastern Europe and the Middle East.

  • The opportunity to develop new markets and establish long-term OEM and distributor partnerships.

  • Significant independence and ownership of your assigned markets, commercial activities and business development initiatives.

  • The opportunity to directly influence NOVENCO's international growth strategy and commercial performance.

  • Close collaboration with experienced technical sales support and commercial teams at our headquarters in Denmark.

  • An international working environment combining Danish engineering expertise with global commercial opportunities.

  • A permanent, full-time position with competitive compensation and benefits aligned with the employment location and company policy.

  • Opportunities for professional development and further growth within NOVENCO.

Context

The Area Sales Manager – Rest of World will be part of NOVENCO Building & Industry's Global Sales organisation and report to the Regional Sales Manager responsible for the Nordics and Rest of World markets.

The role covers Southern Europe, Eastern Europe and the Middle East, with an initial focus on developing business opportunities and expanding NOVENCO's OEM and distributor network.

This is an independent commercial position supported by NOVENCO's technical sales support organisation in Denmark.

The position combines new business development, international sales, strategic partner development and account management, with a stronger emphasis on identifying and developing new business opportunities.

Location: We are open to considering candidates based in different European markets, with Poland, Hungary, Italy and Denmark of particular interest. The final employment location and working arrangement will be agreed based on business requirements and local employment possibilities.

International travel of approximately 30–60 days per year is expected.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV via our careers site. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and interviews will be scheduled as suitable candidates are identified.

NOVENCO Building & Industry is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

Through Voice of Customer (VOC), market analysis, industry knowledge, and cross-functional collaboration, this role identifies growth opportunities, develops business cases, defines product requirements, and supports portfolio decisions that deliver customer value, profitable growth, and market leadership. Serving as the primary link between customer needs, market requirements, and business objectives, the Product Manager partners with Engineering, Project Management, Operations, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, and other stakeholders to successfully develop, commercialize, and manage products throughout their lifecycle. This role establishes product priorities, evaluates new product investment opportunities, and optimizes portfolio performance while leveraging knowledge of industrial fluid handling applications and experience within chemical, mining, oil & gas, food & pharma, or related industrial markets. Every large company now runs critical parts of its business on Salesforce: sales, service, financial data, patient records, citizen services. You will own a book of enterprise accounts and one number: retained revenue. You decide which accounts need you most this week, and you go there. This is a commercial role. You will spend your time with executives, not running support tickets.

Requirements

  • You have carried a significant book of business (ideally $5M+ in annual recurring revenue) with individual accounts above $250K.

Our Technology Practice partners with organizations to design, build, and scale innovative digital solutions that drive measurable business impact. What We're Looking For

Michael Baker International is seeking a Senior Oracle HCM Fusion Solution Architect to join our Technology Practice within the Business Applications team. In this role, you will lead the Oracle HCM functional and solution design effort, partnering with HR and technology stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable, well-configured Oracle HCM solutions. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role for someone who understands Oracle HCM deeply, can guide solution direction, and can step in to execute configuration or development work when project volume requires it. No sponsorship is provided for this role; all candidates must be eligible to work for any employer in the United States without restrictions indefinitely.

What You'll Do

  • Lead Oracle HCM solution design across the Business Systems & Analytics team, ensuring solutions are practical, scalable, and aligned with business priorities.

  • Serve as the functional and solution lead for the HCM group, providing direction on configuration, design decisions, and delivery approach.

At ICF Next, we are fearless in finding new ways to solve problems, relentless in making sure it pays off for our clients and committed to making a positive change in the world. Join our community of mission-driven creatives, communicators, strategists, and technologists to challenge the status quo.


The Team

You'll serve as the senior engineering leader for a cross-functional program that includes engineering team leads, software engineers, solution and cloud architects, database administrators, DevSecOps engineers, quality assurance specialists, user experience professionals, business analysts, product managers, data analysts, accessibility and security specialists, and behavioral health subject matter experts. We partner with federal stakeholders to operate and modernize a mission-critical data collection and performance reporting platform used by grantees and program staff.


The Work

In this program-level role, you will serve as the overall technical authority for platform operations and maintenance and for development, modernization, and enhancement. You will connect architecture, delivery, operations, and modernization into a coherent plan; guide multiple engineering workstreams and team leads; make and document consequential technical decisions; establish shared standards; and ensure releases are secure, testable, supportable, and aligned with program priorities.


You will remain close enough to the technology to evaluate designs, challenge assumptions, troubleshoot difficult issues, and advise the client on options and tradeoffs. A key part of the work is balancing reliable operation of the current .NET platform with incremental modernization, improved cloud and deployment practices, stronger data quality, better observability, and a sustainable path for reducing technical debt.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Define and maintain the program engineering strategy, technical roadmap, architecture guardrails, and incremental modernization approach.
  • Lead engineering team leads and multiple development workstreams by aligning priorities, capacity, dependencies, standards, and delivery expectations.
  • Provide technical direction across application architectures (including .NET-based systems), APIs, data models and SQL Server solutions, system integrations, analytics/reporting platforms, and cloud-hosted services.
  • Establish program-wide practices for secure development, automated testing, code review, CI/CD, release readiness, documentation, and production support.
  • Evaluate technical options and communicate recommendations, costs, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs to program leadership and federal stakeholders.
  • Partner with product and delivery leaders to shape release plans, estimates, staffing needs, and acceptance criteria that are technically achievable.
  • Coordinate architecture and delivery across cloud, DevSecOps, database, security, quality assurance, accessibility, data, user experience, and operations teams.
  • Identify and manage technical debt, performance constraints, reliability risks, integration dependencies, and modernization sequencing.
  • Oversee response to complex production issues, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and improvements to monitoring and operational readiness.
  • Mentor engineering leads and senior engineers, strengthen technical decision-making, and build consistent engineering practices across the program.
  • Maintain technical roadmaps, decision records, interface documentation, standards, and executive-ready status reporting.

  • 5+ years architecting APIs, enterprise integrations, or distributed application services across modern application stacks; ability to evaluate .NET design decisions and guide hands-on engineering leads.
  • 3+ years leading engineering teams, technical leads, or multiple engineering workstreams, including Agile delivery, estimation, dependency management, and technical risk management.
  • 3+ years making and documenting architecture decisions across applications, data, integrations, cloud infrastructure, security, and operations, and communicating tradeoffs to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • 3+ years establishing or improving engineering practices for automated testing, code quality, source control, CI/CD, release management, and production support.
  • 3+ years guiding the design or implementation of authentication, authorization, role-based access, privacy protections, and secure handling of sensitive data.
  • Authorization to work in the United States, ability to perform all work within the United States, and ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust determination and complete required background screening.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience leading incremental modernization of a large legacy .NET platform, including sequencing technical debt reduction while maintaining reliable production service.
  • Experience guiding AWS or AWS GovCloud architecture and operations, including cost optimization, capacity planning, observability, and service reliability.
  • Experience establishing deployment and security automation using CI/CD platforms, containers, infrastructure as code, and repeatable environment configuration.
  • Experience supporting federal authorization efforts, including NIST Moderate controls, FedRAMP, ATO processes, and preparation of technical evidence.

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising. ✨ Наші бізнес-цінності:

Відкритість—ми цінуємо вміння говорити прямо, чути інших і шукати нові підходи.

Надійність — для нас важливо, щоб на кожного члена команди можна було покластися, і ми створюємо умови для відповідальної роботи.

Безперервний розвиток—ми не чекаємо досконалості, але очікуємо бажання вчитися та вдосконалюватися.

Націленість на результат — ми працюємо, щоб досягати реальних результатів, а не для виконання формальних планів.

Твої майбутні обов’язки:

✔ Здійснювати дзвінки .

✔ Виявляти потреби клієнтів, презентувати товари та працювати з запереченнями.

✔ Продавати продукцію компанії за скриптами.

✔ Фіксувати замовлення в CRM-системі.

Що потрібно, щоб до нас приєднатись:

✔ Знання італійської мови: від рівня В2+і вище (важливо розмовний рівень)

✔ ПК/ноутбук, дротова гарнітура та стабільний інтернет.

✔ Вільне володіння ПК і офісними програмами.

✔ Уміння продавати або бажання навчитися це робити.

✔Бажано володіння техніками продажу та роботою з запереченнями.

Про нас:

🛠 Наші Core-ніші та експертиза:

Ми працюємо на перетині технологій та комунікацій. Кожен наш співробітник стає мультифункціональним експертом, опановуючи ключові напрямки сучасного бізнесу:
E-commerce & Retail: Повний супровід клієнтів інтернет-магазинів (від оформлення замовлень до координації міжнародної логістики та повернень).
Активні Продажі: Робота з теплими лідами, телемаркетинг, cross-sell/up-sell та повернення клієнтів до покинутих кошиків.
Омніканальний Саппорт (Customer Care): Клієнтська та технічна підтримка користувачів у режимі 24/7/365.
Цифрові чати: Спілкування з клієнтами без голосу через Live-чати на сайтах, Email та популярні месенджери (Viber, Telegram, WhatsApp).
Інтелектуальна Телефонія: Робота з найсучаснішим софтом, професійними CRM-системами та AI-інструментами автоматизації.
🌟 Чому кандидати обирають Agentify?
Стабільність з 2013 року: Прозорі виплати та впевненість у завтрашньому дні.
Власна Академія: Безкоштовне навчання з нуля (ділова комунікація, техніки продажів, робота з софтом). Ми платимо, поки ти вчишся!
Дохід без обмежень: Стабільна погодинна ставка + % від викупу. У продажах твій заробіток залежить тільки від твоїх результатів.
Реальний кар'єрний ліфт: 99% наших тімлідів, супервайзерів та QA-менеджерів виросли всередині компанії за лічені місяці.
Абсолютна інклюзивність: Ми вільні від стереотипів. Для нас важливі лише твої навички, енергія та бажання розвиватись.

Що для нас важливо?

Щоб ви бачили сенс у тому, що робите, були чесними з собою та колегами й не боялися вийти за межі звичного, коли це потрібно.

Якщо ви шукаєте місце, де ваші дії справді впливають на результат, ми будемо раді познайомитися!
