About the Client & Role

Our client is an established mental health practice supporting approximately 400 clients and managing around 350 therapy sessions per week. They are seeking a reliable, organized, and proactive Medical Virtual Assistant — Patient Intake, Admin & Billing to support patient intake, appointment scheduling, medical billing, email management, and daily practice operations. The role's primary focus is patient intake coordination, followed by medical billing support and general administrative responsibilities, with billing responsibilities expected to increase over time under the guidance of the practice's Billing Supervisor.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in patient intake, medical billing, healthcare administration, phone support, and EHR/EMR systems, along with strong technical skills, excellent communication, and the ability to manage multiple responsibilities. The client highly values a positive attitude, coachability, adaptability, and willingness to learn new workflows while building a long-term working relationship with the practice.

Scope of Work / Responsibilities

Patient Intake, Scheduling & Communication

  • Coordinate new patient inquiries, registration, intake documentation, and appointment scheduling.
  • Manage appointment confirmations, rescheduling, cancellations, and patient follow-ups.
  • Handle patient calls and receptionist duties using the practice's phone system.
  • Maintain accurate patient records and intake documentation in SimplePractice.
  • Monitor outstanding intake requirements and follow up to ensure completion.

Medical Billing & Payment Support

  • Assist with medical billing workflows, payment-related tasks, and billing follow-ups under the guidance of the Billing Supervisor.
  • Review billing records for accuracy, identify discrepancies or missing information, and coordinate resolution with the billing team.
  • Maintain accurate billing documentation and update relevant information in the practice management system.
  • Take on additional billing responsibilities as training and proficiency progress.

Email & Practice Administration

  • Manage the practice's administrative email inbox, respond to routine inquiries, and follow up on important communications.
  • Support the practice owner with executive assistant responsibilities, daily operations, and administrative coordination.
  • Maintain organized records, task lists, and documentation while identifying opportunities to improve workflows and efficiency.

Payroll & Administrative Coordination

  • Assist with payroll-related administrative tasks according to established practice procedures.
  • Support accurate tracking and organization of payroll information.
  • Coordinate with the appropriate team members regarding outstanding administrative requirements.

Patient Reactivation & Marketing Support

  • Contact inactive patients to encourage appointment scheduling and re-engagement with the practice.
  • Assist with social media posting, engagement, and basic marketing activities.
  • Support simple content creation or Canva-related tasks when needed.
  • Handle additional marketing activities as workload permits, while prioritizing patient intake, billing, and administrative operations.

Tools You'll Use

  • SimplePractice — EHR/Practice Management
  • Telzio — VoIP Phone System
  • Email and messaging platforms
  • Billing and payment management tools
  • Payroll and administrative systems
  • Canva and social media platforms, as needed

Requirements

Experience Requirements

  • Patient Intake Experience: Required. Candidates must have hands-on experience coordinating patient intake, registration, appointment scheduling, and related healthcare administrative workflows.
  • Medical Billing Experience: Required. Candidates must have previous experience supporting medical billing workflows, billing follow-ups, payment-related tasks, or healthcare billing administration. Full-cycle revenue cycle management experience is not required.
  • Healthcare Administrative Experience: Required. Candidates must have previous experience supporting U.S.-based medical practices, including patient coordination, scheduling, medical records management, or general healthcare administrative operations. Experience in mental health, behavioral health, or therapy practices is an advantage.
  • EHR / Practice Management Experience: Required. Candidates must have previous experience using EHR/EMR systems to manage patient information, scheduling, intake documentation, and administrative workflows. SimplePractice experience is a plus but not required, as training will be provided.
  • Phone Support Experience: Required. Candidates must have experience handling patient calls, receptionist duties, or healthcare-related phone support. Experience with VoIP systems is an advantage, and training on Telzio will be provided.
  • Email & Administrative Management Experience: Required. Candidates must be comfortable managing inboxes, maintaining organized records, coordinating follow-ups, and completing recurring administrative tasks.
  • Credentialing Experience: Plus. Experience assisting with provider credentialing, maintaining credentialing documentation, or coordinating credentialing-related administrative requirements is an advantage.
  • Payroll & Office Administration Experience: Preferred. Experience with payroll tracking, general office management, or executive administrative support is helpful.
  • Social Media & Marketing Experience: Plus. Familiarity with Canva, social media posting, engagement, or basic content creation is beneficial but not a primary requirement.

Performance Expectations

The ideal candidate should help support:

  • Timely and accurate patient intake, registration, and scheduling.
  • Consistent completion of medical billing support tasks and follow-ups.
  • Organized email communication and administrative workflows.
  • Accurate patient, billing, and operational documentation.
  • Reliable payroll and practice administration assistance.
  • Successful cross-training into expanded billing responsibilities.
  • Reduced administrative workload for the practice owner.

Basic Requirements

  • Must speak and write English clearly and professionally.
  • Must have relevant work experience.
  • Must be able to provide an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory).
  • Must be available to attend video meetings with camera on when required.

Technical Requirements

  • Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.
  • Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
  • Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
  • Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.
  • Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.

Benefits

  • Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
  • Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
  • HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
  • Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
  • Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client’s needs and schedule.
  • Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
  • Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
  • Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.

Software Development

  • Communicate progress, risks, dependencies, and blockers effectively.
  • Collaborate with engineers, QA, product managers, data scientists, and external partners.

  • Familiarity with CI/CD, Docker, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, GCP, or DigitalOcean.
  • Experience with RabbitMQ, Kafka, Redis, or similar messaging systems.
  • Familiarity with Grafana, Sentry, logging, and observability tools.
  • Experience integrating AI/ML models into production applications.

Education

A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field is preferred. Equivalent practical experience, relevant projects, or a strong technical portfolio will also be considered.

What We Value

  • A strong testing mindset and sense of ownership.
  • Curiosity and willingness to work across the full application lifecycle.

  • The ability to turn product requirements into reliable, production-ready software.

jobs.excerpt: Skylight is a technology startup building the OS of the family.
jobs.description:
Skylight is a technology startup building the OS of the family. We make Skylight Calendar, the smart calendar loved by millions of families (plus Wired and Wirecutter). Calendar 2 launched earlier this year to rave reviews, and our newest product, Skylight Buddy, was just named one of TIME’s Best Inventions of 2026.

Our mission is to connect loved ones by creating the world’s simplest products and services that improve family life. Our founders are former venture capitalists and serial entrepreneurs who have scaled this business to $300M+ in annual revenue while being completely bootstrapped and profitable. We get to grow a happy, healthy company focused on making products our customers love without investors breathing down our necks.

Smart, hardworking people who care about making actually meaningful products love working here. People like you. We’re busy inventing new ways to simplify family life and help parents raise great kids – and we need your help! Come invent something new with us.

About the Role:

The Senior Manager Retail Operations will lead our retail operations team and own the long-term plan for how we ship to retailers. You will manage two Retail Operations Managers, who run the day to day for our retail accounts, and you will be the escalation point for retailer operations leaders when something goes wrong. You will also be the thought partner to our Senior Director of Global Fulfillment on the larger questions: which retailers to add, whether to go direct or through a distributor, how our systems and 3PL network should look in two years, and where our retail margin is leaking.

This is a player-coach role. About half your time is your team and the accounts; the other half is strategy and projects that need one owner. The ideal candidate has run retail operations for several national retailers, has coached managers, writes clearly, and can tell us when we are wrong.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead and develop two Retail Operations Managers: set expectations, coach weekly, review their accounts, and build the standards they work to. Hire for the team as we grow.
  • Own the retail operations strategy and 12-24 month roadmap: new retailers, new channels, international expansion, and the systems, 3PL capacity, and headcount needed to support them.
  • Be the escalation point for retailer operations and vendor-compliance leaders. Run the quarterly reviews with our largest accounts alongside Sales.
  • Own the cross-account scorecard: OTIF, fill rate, lead time, chargeback % of sales, freight cost per unit, and dispute win rate. Report it to leadership monthly with clear actions.
  • Lead the chargeback and deduction prevention program: find recurring causes across retailers, fix them at the source with the 3PL and carriers, and quantify the savings.
  • Own the retail order-to-cash process end to end with Sales, Accounting, and Planning: EDI (850 / 856 / 810), NetSuite, retailer portals, and where manual work should be automated.
  • Work with Sales, Planning, and Purchasing on forecast-to-ship: how retailer forecasts turn into container loads, allocation rules, and inventory commitments.
  • Work with the 3PL Manager on network design, site capacity, and retailer requirements at each warehouse.
  • Evaluate build vs. buy and direct vs. distributor decisions with a clear business case, and present the recommendation to the executive team.
  • Lead new retailer onboarding and large product launches as the single accountable owner.
  • Own freight strategy for retail: broker and carrier mix, prepaid vs. collect, rates, and service.
  • Build the operating rhythm: weekly team review, monthly business review, annual retailer compliance calendar.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or related field
  • 8+ years of experience in retail fulfillment operations or supply chain management, including 3+ years leading retail logistics for national retailers
  • 2+ years managing people, including coaching and performance management of managers or senior individual contributors
  • Proven experience managing fulfillment for multiple national retailers (Costco, Walmart, Sam’s Club, Target, Best Buy)
  • Track record of designing and delivering a multi-quarter operational initiative with measurable results
  • Strong financial skills: landed cost, freight cost, chargeback ROI, and building a business case
  • Experience with EDI, ERP (NetSuite or similar), and retailer portals
  • Excellent written communication and the ability to present to executives

Bonus Points for:

  • Experience leading a team through rapid growth in number of retailers or volume
  • Experience onboarding new retailers or running a distributor program
  • Experience with international retail and ocean freight
  • Experience with 3PL network design or a 3PL transition
  • MBA or MS in Supply Chain Management, International Business, or related field
  • Experience with consumer electronics or subscription hardware businesses
  • Track record of successful change management in complex organizations
  • Experience building dashboards or automation (SQL, Google Sheets, BI tools) yourself

Our Commitment:

We value diverse experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives—and we hire kind, thoughtful people who care deeply about their work. If you're reading this and think, “I don’t check every box,” but still feel excited about the role: Apply. We want to hear from you.

Benefits

Our competitive compensation package includes:

  • Competitive Salary + Equity Package
  • 401K matching

  • Health, Dental & Vision Medical Plans
  • Tremendous autonomy to set the direction of your work
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Company holidays on the first Friday of every month (Excluding November, December, and January)

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $150k-$180k per year. This range reflects the compensation Skylight reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for the position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors, which may include experience, qualifications, skills, education, geographic location, and internal equity. Skylight also offers benefits, including medical, dental, vision, and paid time off.

The Financial Analyst — Investment Analysis is responsible for evaluating investment opportunities, analyzing financial performance, conducting market and industry research, and supporting investment decision-making. This position analyzes financial statements, valuation models, market trends, and investment risks to provide accurate and timely insights to investment professionals and senior management.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct financial and investment analysis of companies, securities, funds, and potential investment opportunities.

  • Analyze financial statements, earnings reports, cash flows, balance sheets, and income statements.

  • Develop and maintain financial models to evaluate company performance and investment potential.

  • Perform valuation analysis using methodologies such as discounted cash flow (DCF), comparable company analysis, and precedent transactions.

  • Research industries, companies, markets, economic trends, and competitive environments.

  • Evaluate investment opportunities based on financial performance, valuation, growth prospects, risk, and expected returns.

  • Monitor existing investments and analyze financial and operational performance.

  • Track market developments, economic indicators, interest rates, industry trends, and other factors that may affect investment performance.

  • Prepare investment reports, research summaries, financial models, presentations, and recommendations for senior investment professionals.

  • Conduct sensitivity and scenario analysis to assess potential investment outcomes and risks.

  • Analyze historical and projected financial performance to identify trends and investment drivers.

  • Support due diligence activities for prospective investments.

  • Review company filings, investor presentations, earnings releases, and other financial disclosures.

  • Compare companies and investments using relevant financial and operating metrics.

  • Monitor portfolio performance and prepare periodic investment performance reports.

  • Assist with risk analysis and identify factors that could negatively affect investment value or returns.

  • Maintain accurate financial models, research documentation, assumptions, and investment databases.

  • Collaborate with portfolio managers, investment managers, accounting teams, and other financial professionals.

  • Present analytical findings and investment research to management and investment committees when required.

  • Support ad-hoc investment research and financial analysis projects.

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • 2–5 years of experience in investment analysis, financial analysis, equity research, corporate finance, asset management, or a related field.

  • Strong understanding of financial statements and corporate finance principles.

  • Strong financial modeling and valuation skills.

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

  • Ability to analyze financial statements and evaluate company performance.

  • Strong research, analytical, and quantitative skills.

  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to work with complex financial information.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects and meet analytical deadlines.

  • CFA designation or progress toward CFA certification.

  • Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field.

  • Experience with investment research, equity research, portfolio analysis, or asset management.

  • Knowledge of valuation methodologies, capital markets, and investment strategies.

  • Experience with financial databases such as Bloomberg, FactSet, Capital IQ, or Refinitiv.

  • Experience with Python, SQL, or other analytical tools.

  • Knowledge of fixed income, equities, alternative investments, or other asset classes.

  • Experience preparing investment committee materials and presentations.

  • Financial Statement Analysis

  • Equity Research

  • Market & Industry Research

  • Portfolio Analysis

  • Risk Analysis

  • Comparable Company Analysis

  • Scenario & Sensitivity Analysis

  • Excel

  • Financial Forecasting

  • Data Analysis

  • Investment Reporting

  • Due Diligence

  • Capital Markets

  • Business Analysis

  • Research & Presentation

  • Investment Analysis: Ability to evaluate investment opportunities using financial, market, industry, and company-specific information.

  • Research: Ability to gather, evaluate, and synthesize financial and market information from multiple sources.

  • Risk Assessment: Ability to identify and analyze financial, market, operational, and investment risks.

  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to interpret complex financial information and develop meaningful investment insights.

  • Attention to Detail: Ability to ensure financial models, calculations, and research are accurate and well documented.

jobs.title: Penetration Tester - Hardware (Texas/Florida)
jobs.excerpt: Packetlabs is a cybersecurity consulting firm specializing in advanced Penetration Testing.
jobs.description:
Packetlabs is a cybersecurity consulting firm specializing in advanced Penetration Testing. We exist to eliminate the false sense of security that comes from shallow testing and checkbox-driven assessments. Our slogan, "Ready for more than a VA scan?", reflects a simple standard: real security work should be rigorous, manual, and built to uncover what automated approaches miss. Our clients span government, technology, law enforcement, retail, healthcare, and financial services, and they rely on us because credibility matters when the stakes are high.

Packetlabs is looking for an Penetration Tester - Hardware to lead security assessments of embedded and IoT devices, the physical products where a vulnerability lives in silicon, firmware, and board layout, rather than in a web request. The Ethical Hacker - Hardware is a specialized technical role focused on assessing embedded systems across all industries, from consumer IoT to industrial and connected devices. This role involves getting hands-on with a device, opening it up, and proving what an attacker with physical or local access can really do.

This role requires the rare combination of offensive security instinct and genuine hardware fundamentals. You will work directly with clients to understand their devices and deliver findings that improve security posture.

Who we are looking for

  • No egos, ever. Egos don't belong at Packetlabs. The more you learn, the less you know. You stay humble, ask questions, and work to help clients improve their security.
  • Customer-first mentality. You are an excellent communicator with clients, project managers, and teammates. You are responsive, reliable, and professional throughout every engagement.
  • You deliver work that you take pride in. Your work is an autograph of your excellence. You hold yourself to a high standard, and it shows in what you produce.
  • Digs deeper into every finding. You don't stop until impact is proven, while understanding that restraint is the right call in sensitive OT environments where high-risk activity is not appropriate.
  • Comfortable being uncomfortable. You move toward obstacles, not away from them. Consulting is not a typical job and requires adapting to rapidly changing environments.
  • Always learning. Cybersecurity changes every day, and you keep up because you want to. You are deeply aware of your skillset and committed to improving it.
  • Self-motivated and dependable. You take ownership of your work and your outcomes without needing to be managed into them.
  • You must be located in Texas or Florida

What you’ll be doing

  • Hardware Penetration Testing
    • Plan and execute end-to-end hardware penetration tests on embedded and IoT devices, against a defined scope and rules of engagement
    • Identify, access, and exploit on-board debug interfaces: JTAG, SWD, UART, and similar, to gain code execution or memory access
    • Extract firmware via debug ports, in-circuit flash reads (SPI / I2C / NAND), or chip-off when required, and analyze it for vulnerabilities
    • Intercept and analyze data on common embedded buses (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, USB) using logic analyzers and protocol decoders
    • Where in scope, perform side-channel analysis and fault injection (power analysis, voltage/clock glitching) to bypass secure boot, readout protection, or authentication
  • Firmware Analysis & Reverse Engineering
    • Reverse engineer firmware and embedded binaries (Ghidra, IDA, Binwalk, etc.) to find logic flaws, hardcoded secrets, and exploitable conditions
    • Assess physical attack surface, tamper resistance, and key/secret storage
    • Distinguish between theoretical and operationally relevant risk to keep findings actionable
  • Client Advisory & Remediation
    • Write high-quality technical reports and present findings to client stakeholders, both technical and non-technical
    • Advise on practical, prioritized remediation that clients can act on
    • Build client confidence through credibility, clear communication, and proven impact
  • Methodology, Research & Continuous Improvement
    • Build and maintain lab tooling, test rigs, and internal methodology
    • Contribute to research, responsible disclosure, and internal knowledge-sharing
    • Stay current on hardware attack techniques, embedded architectures, and defensive controls
    • Help raise the standard of hardware security work across the firm

What success looks like

  • Clients gain a clear, accurate understanding of their hardware risk, backed by proven, reproducible impact
  • Findings are credible, actionable, and land for both technical and leadership audiences
  • Engagements are delivered to a consistently high standard with strong client confidence
  • Scope and rules of engagement are managed well as engagements evolve, with risk surfaced early and clearly
  • Packetlabs' hardware testing methodology and lab capability continue to mature through your contribution
  • Clients trust Packetlabs as the partner that can break their hardware before someone else does

Education and Experience

  • A graduate of an Information Security, Computer Science, or Computer/Electrical Engineering degree program (or equivalent hands-on experience)
  • Strong electronics fundamentals. Able to read schematics and datasheets and reason about a board from them
  • Hands-on soldering ability, including surface-mount (SMD) rework and basic chip removal
  • Demonstrated experience accessing debug interfaces (JTAG, SWD, UART) and extracting firmware from real devices
  • Comfort with core bench instruments: logic analyzer, oscilloscope, and multimeter
  • Firmware reverse-engineering skills and scripting proficiency in Python, plus enough C to read embedded code
  • Familiarity with common embedded architectures (ARM/Cortex-M, MIPS, AVR, RISC-V) and RTOS/bare-metal concepts
  • Clear written and verbal communication.
  • Nice to have (one or more would be an asset):
    • Side-channel / fault-injection experience (e.g., ChipWhisperer)
    • RF and wireless work: SDR, BLE, sub-GHz, Wi-Fi
    • Knowledge of secure boot chains, TEEs, secure elements, and HSMs
    • PCB design familiarity (KiCad / Altium) for understanding target boards
    • Published CVEs, conference talks, CTF placements, or open-source tooling
    • Relevant certifications (e.g., OSCP for breadth, or hardware-focused training)

Why us?

  • The opportunity to work on high-stakes hardware engagements where your judgment and bench skills genuinely matter
  • Receive immediate and ongoing offensive security training, mentorship, and professional development to advance your technical capabilities
  • Play a key role in shaping the growth, direction, and methodology of Packetlabs' expanding hardware practice
  • A leadership team that values substance, quality, and disciplined execution
  • Collaboration with a highly skilled team of security professionals who are passionate about technical excellence and raising the bar
  • Competitive compensation and growth opportunity
  • Paid education and professional development reimbursement to support continued learning, certifications and technical growth
  • Flexible work environment that empowers employees to do their best work
  • Paid volunteer day each year to give back to your community
  • Paid Birthday day off
  • Paid U.S. public holidays
  • Fully remote within Texas or Florida

We are seeking an experienced Windchill Integration Developer to design, build, and operate integrations connecting PTC Windchill with ERP, MES, CAD, and other engineering and manufacturing systems. In this role you will own the technical integration layer between Windchill and the broader enterprise systems landscape. The ideal candidate will bring deep hands-on Windchill integration experience and a strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns, middleware platforms, and PLM-to-ERP data flows. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

  • Design and develop integrations between Windchill and ERP systems (SAP, Oracle EBS, Oracle Cloud) using Info*Engine, web services, and middleware platforms.
  • Build CAD integrations for Creo, SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Catia, and NX with Windchill, including check-in/check-out workflows and metadata mapping.
  • Develop integrations between Windchill and MES, MOM, and quality systems.
  • Build REST and SOAP services for Windchill data using OData, Info*Engine, or custom Java services.
  • Implement message-based and event-driven integrations using middleware (MuleSoft, Boomi, OIC, SAP CPI).
  • Design and operate robust error-handling, alerting, and resubmission patterns, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Profile and optimize performance of high-volume integrations, applying systematic measurement, targeted improvements, and data-driven validation to deliver quantifiable gains in throughput, latency, or resource efficiency.
  • Lead migration efforts to retire legacy point-to-point integrations and replace them with modern, middleware-mediated patterns, planning phased cutovers, building backward-compatibility shims where needed, and ensuring each migration step is reversible and well-monitored.

  • Develop integration documentation, message specifications, and runbooks, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Provide hands-on post-go-live and hypercare support, working closely with operations teams to triage incidents quickly, identify root causes, and drive durable fixes that improve long-term system stability.
  • Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging integration tools and patterns, assessing maturity, fit for purpose, and total cost of ownership, and make grounded recommendations on which to adopt, pilot, or defer based on real engineering needs.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Ten or more years of PLM integration experience with a strong focus on Windchill.
  • Hands-on experience with Info*Engine and Windchill Java API.
  • Experience designing PLM-to-ERP integrations (SAP, Oracle).
  • Working knowledge of CAD integration patterns.

jobs.description:
About ICL Academy

A new model of private online education: Connecting academics, student passions, and industry experts. ICL Academy is an online private school for grades 5-12 that aims to solve many problems facing in-person and online schools by focusing on student engagement through a personalized, blended approach that combines academics with personal passions. Its founder, Kirk Spahn, is a fourth-generation educator with over 20 years of experience specializing in digital education and youth civic engagement. ICL Academy is powered by 150 years of academic excellence. It builds on the track record of success of the Institute for Civic Leadership, a nonprofit founded in 2001 that has inspired, educated, and supported a new generation of youth civic leaders to take positive action in their local and global communities.

ICL Academy also partners with industry experts who serve as master teachers and Champion Mentors. ICL Academy is grateful to have amazing Champions such as Novak Djokovic, Steve Nash, Bode Miller, Monica Seles, Vincent Zhou, and so many more supporting its community of students and families. ICL Academy has quickly become the #1 online school for kids pursuing their passion.

Position Summary:

We seek a highly motivated, experienced professional to join the ICL Academy team as an Academic Advisor & Student Support Specialist. Reporting to the Dean of Counseling & Advising, this position plays an important role in supporting students and families throughout the admissions, academic planning, and enrollment process while maintaining a small caseload of ICL students.

The Academic Advisor & Student Support Specialist will partner closely with the Admissions, Academic Advising, Records, and instructional teams to review student transcripts and prior coursework, evaluate transferable credits, develop individualized four-year academic plans, and identify appropriate academic supports. This position will also oversee the review and documentation of 504 Plans, IEPs, and other accommodation-related documentation provided during enrollment and will collaborate with the Head of School, ICL Teachers, and Academic Advisors to support the implementation of appropriate accommodations within ICL’s flexible learning model.

As a member of the Academic Advising team, this position will develop meaningful relationships with students and families within their caseload and provide individualized academic planning, student support, and guidance throughout the student’s enrollment at ICL. The Academic Advisor & Student Support Specialist will also serve as a resource to the broader Academic Advising team on matters related to accommodations and other complex student support needs.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Admissions Academic Review & Course Planning:

  • Partner with the Admissions and Records teams to conduct academic reviews for prospective ICL Students in grades 5-12.
  • Review and evaluate student transcripts, academic records, and prior coursework to determine appropriate credit transfer and remaining graduation requirements.
  • Develop individualized four-year academic plans for incoming high school students that reflect transferred credits, current-year course placement, graduation requirements, and projected course planning through senior year.
  • Identify potential academic gaps, credit deficiencies, course sequencing considerations, or other academic factors that may impact a student’s pathway toward graduation. Work in collaboration with the Head of Admissions, Head of School, and Registrar on more complex individual transcript reviews and course planning.
  • Communicate academic findings and recommendations to the Admissions team to support informed enrollment and course placement decisions.
  • Partner with the Academic Advising team to ensure a smooth transition from the admissions process into ongoing academic advising.
  • Maintain accurate academic review documentation and four-year plans within the appropriate student information systems.

504, IEP, Psych-Ed Evaluations & Accommodation Support:

  • Review 504 Plans, IEPs, Psych-Ed Evaluations, and other educational support documentation provided during the admissions and enrollment process, or after enrollment.
  • Identify documented accommodations and determine their applicability within ICL Academy’s flexible instructional model.
  • Document relevant student support information and create and maintain ICL Accommodation Plan when applicable.
  • Maintain accurate and confidential records related to student accommodations and educational support needs.
  • Partner with Head of School, Academic Advisors and ICL Teachers to communicate and clarify student accommodations and support their appropriate implementation.
  • Collaborate with the Head of School and the Dean of Counseling & Advising when requested accommodations fall outside the scope of ICL’s flexible program and require additional consideration or support.
  • Partner with the Academic Advising team when students or families request testing accommodations for the ACT, SAT, or other standardized assessments.
  • Assist with the review and coordination of documentation required for standardized testing accommodations, as appropriate.

jobs.description:
About the role

Enterprise companies with $100 million to $2 billion or more in revenue are where we have the most room to grow, and you'll turn that opportunity into new customers. As Business Development Director, you'll lead new business in this band: you'll own a territory, protect and grow a book of named customers, win new logos, and turn inbound and partner-sourced pipeline into revenue. You'll report to our VP, Sales, work with a Junior AE, a Presales Engineer, an Inside Sales SDR, and our Partnerships team, and spend much of your time with prospects and customers. You'll do well here if an empty territory energizes you, you measure yourself on logos won rather than accounts inherited, and you're a resourceful, direct, consultative seller who's comfortable working independently in a small team at a company that's changing how it sells.

What you'll do

  • Own a territory of enterprise accounts across your region and the full sales cycle, from first conversation to close. Requests from these accounts come straight to you, and Inside Sales passes you inbound leads once they're qualified.
  • Identify, prospect, and close new logos in the enterprise band, running a disciplined outbound motion through Apollo for new contacts and HubSpot sequences for known contacts and nurture.
  • Sell our platform offerings alongside our existing services, and sell the outcome, not the word count.
  • Work with your Junior AE on pre- and post-sales support, your Presales Engineer on demos and technical scoping, and the Inside Sales SDR on inbound qualification and appointment setting.
  • Work with our Partnerships team and technology partners on co-selling and referral opportunities in your territory.
  • Keep HubSpot accurate: create opportunities after qualified meetings, maintain your pipeline and forecast, and share feedback that helps improve lead quality and our ideal customer profile.
  • Bring market insight back to the business, including what competitors are doing, where buyers are moving, and what's resonating.

What you'll bring

  • Typically 7+ years of progressive experience in enterprise B2B sales, including new-logo selling, with a track record of consistently meeting and exceeding quota, or equivalent experience
  • Experience in the localization or language services industry
  • Current or recent experience selling and carrying quota on language technology software, SaaS, or AI-driven translation, beyond per-project services statements of work (SOWs)
  • Experience owning the full commercial motion, from outbound prospecting and multi-threaded outreach to pipeline management and forecasting, beyond closing warm leads or waiting for marketing to fill the funnel
  • Working knowledge of TMS and language technology platforms such as Phrase, Lokalise, Smartling, XTM, and memoQ, and how AI-driven translation workflows are changing what buyers expect

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience of a services-to-platform or services-to-SaaS transition at a previous employer, including the change management that comes with it
  • Experience selling to technology, software, and similar enterprise companies in your territory
  • Experience structuring multi-year enterprise deals, such as subscription, bundled, or outcome-based commercial models
  • Working knowledge of HubSpot and Apollo, or the ability to pick them up quickly

If you have some of these, great. If you don't, we'd still like to hear from you.

Who we are

At Acclaro, we're more than a localization company — we're a content intelligence solutions company, and a global team of language enthusiasts, cultural connectors, and technology innovators. Our mission is to help brands speak the world's languages and resonate deeply across cultures by blending human expertise with cutting-edge technology, delivered through a follow-the-sun model that keeps our teams moving around the clock and around the globe.

With over two decades of experience, we support some of the world's most recognizable brands in expanding their global reach. And we're scaling: we've been making material investments in our own AI-native platform, one that's already reshaping how our business — and the localization industry more broadly — works. Join us on our journey to be the model localization company of the next decade, one that's loved by clients, colleagues, and communities alike.

How we work

Our values shape how we work with customers, colleagues, and partners. Here's what you can expect from us, and what we'll look for in you.

  • Be Accountable. We own our work, learn from our mistakes, and come with solutions.
  • Be Proud. We care about the work, hold a high standard, and celebrate each other's wins.
  • Be Resilient. When things get hard, we stay calm, adapt, and ask for help when we need it.
  • Be Curious. We ask why, keep learning, share what we know, and explore new ways of working, including AI.
  • Be Kind. We assume good intent, give honest feedback with care, and look out for each other.

Inclusion and equal opportunity

Acclaro is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

Are you ready to be a big part of something big?

At Trader Interactive, we make buying and selling a great experience. We’re a group of go-getters who decided they didn’t want to settle for the status quo. We come together as one team to build value and drive innovation across our industries - but we have fun while we do it and make sure our people are always our #1 priority.

When it comes to your career, we want to provide big opportunities to help you make a big impact. But for this to be possible, we strive to feel small. Small enough to quickly change tack, small enough to learn from different teams and small enough to connect authentically with leadership.

  • The opportunity to be a part of a global group of digital marketplace businesses (CAR Group) located across Australia, Brazil, Chile and South Korea - collectively we have around 2,500 team members worldwide, and our CAR Group Tour means you might just find yourself working in one of those businesses sometime soon.

This is a full-cycle sales role; from prospecting and pipeline generation through discovery, demonstration, negotiation and close — selling digital solutions to dealership groups and operators.

Working in concert with SDR support, channel and referral partnerships and self-sourced outbound activity, the Product Specialist owns revenue growth in their assigned territory. This is a high-impact, individual contributor role modeled after best-in-class SaaS acquisition motions seen at large enterprise SaaS companies — structured for reps who thrive in complex, consultative sales environments and are energized by building new customer relationships.

Pipeline Generation & Prospecting

  • Execute a balanced prospecting motion across self-sourced outbound, SDR qualified inbound, and channel/referral-sourced leads.

  • Build and maintain a minimum 3x pipeline coverage ratio against quota at all times.

  • Develop territory and account-level prospecting plans targeting Commercial (powersports, RV, marine, construction equipment) and Recreational verticals.

  • Leverage referral networks within the broader Trader Interactive ecosystem to identify cross-sell and co-sell opportunities.

  • Partner closely with SDR team to refine messaging, qualify inbound interest and convert MQLs to SQLs efficiently.

Sales Execution & Deal Management

  • Own the full sales cycle from initial discovery call through signed contract, typically 60-120 days depending on deal complexity.

  • Conduct compelling discovery sessions to understand dealership workflow, technology gaps and performance objectives.

  • Deliver tailored product demonstrations of iMotor Website tools to dealership operators, GMs, and ownership groups.

  • Build multi-threaded relationships with economic buyers, champions and end users within prospect accounts.

  • Develop and deliver ROI-based business cases and proposals aligned to each prospect's operational metrics and KPIs.

  • Manage deal progression in CRM with accurate forecasting, stage discipline and pipeline hygiene at all times.

Channel & Partner Collaboration

  • Develop and nurture relationships with referral partners, OEM contacts and adjacent Trader Interactive business units to drive inbound deal flow.

  • Coordinate with channel partners on joint pipeline reviews, co-selling motions and shared account strategies.

  • Act as a iMotor Website brand ambassador at industry events, dealer associations and trade shows within target verticals.

Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Collaborate with the Customer Success teams to ensure smooth post-sale handoff and maximize early customer engagement.

  • Feed competitive intelligence, objection patterns and prospect feedback to Product, Marketing, Marketplace Sales and Leadership teams on a structured basis.

  • Support go-to-market initiatives including beta launches, product releases and vertical-specific marketing campaigns.

  • Partner with Marketing to refine ICP targeting, messaging and campaign effectiveness based on field insights.

What We’re Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years of quota-carrying SaaS sales experience in a full-cycle Product Specialist or equivalent role.

  • Demonstrated track record of consistent quota attainment at or above 100%.

  • Experience selling operational or vertical SaaS solutions to SMB and mid-market customers ($15K–$75K ACV).

  • Strong command of consultative selling methodologies (Challenger or equivalent).

  • Proven ability to self-source pipeline through outbound prospecting in addition to working inbound and partner-referred leads.

  • Excellent discovery, presentation, and negotiation skills with comfort presenting to C-suite and ownership-level buyers.

  • Data-literate and CRM-disciplined — experience maintaining accurate pipeline in Salesforce, HubSpot or equivalent.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling into automotive, powersports, RV, marine, or equipment dealership verticals.

  • Experience working in a channel-assisted or partner co-sell sales environment.

  • Comfort with product-led growth motions and shorter, transactional deal cycles alongside complex enterprise sales.

So come and join our team - because every role is a big role in our plans to go big.

Job Requisition ID #

26WD101116

L'affichage de poste en français suivra / The French job posting follows.

26WD101116, AI Research Scientist


Position Overview

As a Senior Research Scientist in the AI Lab at Autodesk Research, you will conduct fundamental and applied research on Motion Foundation Models: general-purpose models that can represent, generate, edit, understand, and reason about motion. The work will initially focus on human and object motion and will extend toward multimodal and interactive settings involving text, trajectories, images, video, geometry, robot observations/actions, and other signals.


You will work with scientists, researchers, developers, and designers across generative AI, computer vision, graphics, robotics, simulation, manufacturing, architecture, and construction to develop new model architectures, representations, training methods, datasets, and evaluations for motion intelligence.


Autodesk's AI Lab is active in the wider research community, targeting publications at CVPR, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, SIGGRAPH, and other top-tier conferences. We collaborate with leading academic and industry labs, combining the best of an academic research environment with product-guided research. This role will report to a Manager of Research Science in the AI Lab.


Responsibilities

  • Develop new foundation-model approaches for motion generation, editing, understanding, reasoning, and representation
  • Drive research end-to-end: identify high-value questions, formulate hypotheses, implement ideas, run experiments, analyze failures, iterate, and communicate conclusions
  • Investigate motion representations and tokenization, generative modeling, multimodal conditioning and alignment, scalable training, post-training, and model refinement
  • Design rigorous evaluations, benchmarks, ablations, and diagnostics that reveal genuine model progress and failure modes
  • Build and modify research code, training pipelines, and data pipelines, using modern AI coding agents where useful while maintaining ownership of correctness, reproducibility, and scientific quality
  • Work toward ambitious long-term goals while defining concrete milestones and maintaining a high pace of empirical iteration
  • Collaborate across a global research team and with academic and industry partners; publish at top-tier conferences and help transfer successful ideas into Autodesk technologies

Minimum Qualifications

  • A Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Computer Graphics, Robotics, Mathematics, or a related technical field
  • A consistent track record of research publications demonstrating experience in applied or fundamental research
  • Deep knowledge of modern generative or foundation-model methods, such as Transformers, diffusion/flow models, latent-variable models, or related architectures
  • Strong hands-on ability with PyTorch, JAX, or similar frameworks, including building, modifying, debugging, and scaling research training pipelines; effective use of modern AI-assisted development and coding agents
  • Excellent experimental judgment: ability to turn ambiguous research questions into testable hypotheses, controlled experiments, useful metrics, and clear conclusions
  • Demonstrated research ownership, persistence, and execution: a track record of pushing difficult technical problems through repeated experimentation to meaningful results

Preferred Qualifications

  • Research experience in human motion, character animation, motion capture, embodied agents, robotics, or other spatiotemporal modeling problems
  • Experience with multimodal or foundation models combining motion with text, images, video, geometry, trajectories, actions, or other modalities
  • Experience with learned motion representations or tokenization (for example VQ/VAE-style methods) and generative methods such as diffusion, flow matching, or autoregressive modeling
  • Research experience with large-scale video foundation models, including video generation, spatiotemporal representations, multimodal conditioning, and scalable training
  • Experience with reinforcement learning, post-training, large-scale/distributed training, dataset construction, or evaluation infrastructure
  • Knowledge of 3D geometry, computer graphics, geometric deep learning, physically grounded modeling, or Autodesk-relevant domains

26WD101116, Chercheur en intelligence artificielle


Aperçu du poste

En tant que chercheur senior au sein du laboratoire d’IA d’Autodesk Research, vous mènerez des recherches fondamentales et appliquées sur les modèles de base du mouvement (Motion Foundation Models) : des modèles polyvalents capables de représenter, générer, modifier, comprendre et raisonner sur le mouvement. Dans un premier temps, vos travaux porteront principalement sur le mouvement des personnes et des objets, puis s’étendront à des contextes multimodaux et interactifs impliquant du texte, des trajectoires, des images, des vidéos, de la géométrie, des observations et actions de robots, ainsi que d’autres signaux.


Vous travaillerez avec des scientifiques, des chercheurs, des développeurs et des concepteurs issus des domaines de l’IA générative, de la vision par ordinateur, du graphisme, de la robotique, de la simulation, de la fabrication, de l’architecture et de la construction afin de développer de nouvelles architectures de modèles, représentations, méthodes d’entraînement, ensembles de données et évaluations pour l’intelligence du mouvement.


Le laboratoire d’IA d’Autodesk est très actif au sein de la communauté scientifique au sens large et vise des publications lors de conférences de premier plan telles que CVPR, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, SIGGRAPH et d’autres. Nous collaborons avec des laboratoires universitaires et industriels de premier plan, alliant le meilleur d’un environnement de recherche universitaire à une recherche orientée produit. Ce poste sera rattaché à un responsable de la recherche scientifique au sein du laboratoire d’IA.


Responsabilités

  • Développer de nouvelles approches de modèles de base pour la génération, l’édition, la compréhension, le raisonnement et la représentation du mouvement
  • Mener la recherche de bout en bout : identifier des questions à forte valeur ajoutée, formuler des hypothèses, mettre en œuvre des idées, mener des expériences, analyser les échecs, itérer et communiquer les conclusions
  • Étudier les représentations et la tokenisation du mouvement, la modélisation générative, le conditionnement et l’alignement multimodaux, l’entraînement évolutif, le post-entraînement et le raffinement des modèles
  • Concevoir des évaluations, des tests comparatifs, des analyses d’ablation et des diagnostics rigoureux qui révèlent les progrès réels des modèles et leurs modes de défaillance
  • Développer et modifier le code de recherche, les pipelines d’entraînement et les pipelines de données, en utilisant des agents de codage IA modernes lorsque cela s’avère utile, tout en garantissant l’exactitude, la reproductibilité et la qualité scientifique
  • Travailler à la réalisation d’objectifs ambitieux à long terme tout en définissant des jalons concrets et en maintenant un rythme soutenu d’itération empirique
  • Collaborer au sein d’une équipe de recherche internationale et avec des partenaires universitaires et industriels ; publier lors de conférences de premier plan et contribuer à transposer les idées fructueuses dans les technologies d’Autodesk

Qualifications minimales

  • Un master ou un doctorat en informatique, apprentissage automatique, vision par ordinateur, infographie, robotique, mathématiques ou dans un domaine technique connexe
  • Un parcours solide de publications de recherche démontrant une expérience en recherche appliquée ou fondamentale
  • Une connaissance approfondie des méthodes modernes de modèles génératifs ou de base, telles que les Transformers, les modèles de diffusion/flux, les modèles à variables latentes ou les architectures connexes
  • Solides compétences pratiques avec PyTorch, JAX ou des frameworks similaires, notamment pour la création, la modification, le débogage et la mise à l’échelle de pipelines d’entraînement de recherche ; utilisation efficace des outils modernes de développement et de codage assistés par l’IA
  • Excellent jugement expérimental : capacité à transformer des questions de recherche ambiguës en hypothèses vérifiables, en expériences contrôlées, en métriques utiles et en conclusions claires
  • Capacité avérée à prendre en main la recherche, à faire preuve de persévérance et à mener à bien les projets : expérience avérée dans la résolution de problèmes techniques complexes par des expérimentations répétées menant à des résultats significatifs

Qualifications souhaitées

  • Expérience de recherche dans le domaine du mouvement humain, de l’animation de personnages, de la capture de mouvement, des agents incarnés, de la robotique ou d’autres problèmes de modélisation spatio-temporelle
  • Expérience avec des modèles multimodaux ou fondamentaux combinant le mouvement avec du texte, des images, de la vidéo, de la géométrie, des trajectoires, des actions ou d’autres modalités
  • Expérience avec les représentations de mouvement apprises ou la tokenisation (par exemple, les méthodes de type VQ/VAE) et les méthodes génératives telles que la diffusion, l’appariement de flux ou la modélisation autorégressive
  • Expérience de recherche sur les modèles de base vidéo à grande échelle, notamment la génération vidéo, les représentations spatio-temporelles, le conditionnement multimodal et l’entraînement évolutif
  • Expérience en apprentissage par renforcement, en post-entraînement, en entraînement à grande échelle/distribué, en construction de jeux de données ou en infrastructure d’évaluation
  • Connaissances en géométrie 3D, en infographie, en apprentissage profond géométrique, en modélisation fondée sur la physique ou dans des domaines liés à Autodesk

One Team. One Purpose. One Global Impact. Every relocation begins with people. Every move creates opportunity. At Sirva, we're united by one shared purpose: helping people and organisations move forward. Join us and you'll build a career where your work makes a difference every day.

MOVE WITH PURPOSE

Your Impact Starts Here As an Executive VIP Consultant, you will play a key role in supporting Sirva’s continued success by serving as the primary point of contact for EVIP customers throughout their mobility journey. This high-touch, service-led role requires strong organizational capability, sound judgement and the ability to support, guide and advise customers across a varied client portfolio. The Executive VIP Consultant is accountable for the day-to-day delivery of designated EVIP relocation programmes, ensuring a highly coordinated, responsive and premium customer experience. Working as part of a global EVIP team, the consultant may be required to support urgent customer needs outside standard working hours and across regions. The role provides close oversight of each customer’s move or assignment and is accountable for maintaining consistently high levels of customer satisfaction. The consultant must communicate with clarity, confidence and proactivity, acting as an ambassador for Sirva and ensuring that customer issues are resolved promptly, effectively and with appropriate sensitivity. The successful candidate will bring extensive international mobility service delivery experience, ideally supported by prior exposure to VIP or executive-level program management. Given the high-touch nature of the service, the Executive VIP Consultant will manage a reduced caseload to enable a more personalized, proactive and elevated level of support.

In this role, you will:

Direct Customer Interaction

  • Oversee the full spectrum of relocation management services, including policy counselling, home sale and purchase support, destination services, household goods shipment, intercultural services, visa and immigration support, language training, ongoing assignment support and repatriation.
  • Interpret designated client relocation policies and procedures, evaluate available options and provide tailored consultation to relocating employees based on their individual circumstances and needs.
  • Anticipate, manage and resolve issues quickly, creatively and with appropriate escalation discipline.

  • Partners with internal support teams and external providers to ensure customer needs are met promptly, with all parties operating as one coordinated support team.
  • Respond to relocating employees on the same business day, ideally within four business hours.
  • Provide ongoing consultation and proactive guidance throughout the duration of the international assignment or relocation.
  • Identify and recommend process improvements that enhance efficiency, consistency and overall customer experience.
  • Demonstrate flexibility in working hours where calls or urgent support are required outside core hours to accommodate EVIP employee schedules.
  • Operate within a global EVIP support model designed to provide 24/7/365 customer coverage, supported by issued mobile devices to enable timely and responsive assistance when required.

Client Support and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Consult with clients on authorized services and potential policy exceptions in advance of customer briefing calls.
  • Provide ongoing updates to key client and Sirva stakeholders.

  • Deliver clear status updates, keep clients informed of emerging issues and provide practical solutions as matters arise.
  • Complete client projects and reports as required, while developing subject matter expertise in client policy and operating procedures.

  • Able to exercise sound judgement and own complex processes through completion and resolution.
  • Able to anticipate potential issues and develop effective solutions without immediate direction or supervision.
  • Able to think creatively, navigate ambiguity and resolve problems quickly and efficiently.
  • Demonstrates strong accountability for the customer experience and the successful delivery of each move.
  • Demonstrates curiosity and a commitment to continuous learning within a transforming organization.

  • Adapts communication style to support different VIP personas and family needs with confidence and discretion.
  • Operates effectively in a team environment with shared goals and responsibilities in support of a positive customer experience.
  • Maintains a calm, confident and composed approach, particularly in difficult, sensitive or high-pressure situations.
  • Demonstrates strong collaboration, cultural awareness and excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills.

Hybrid working Core Flex Hours Health & wellbeing programmes Learning & career development Financial rewards Global career opportunities

The Advanced Placement team supports College Board in serving more than seven million students a year as they prepare for a successful transition to college through programs and services in college readiness and college success — speciﬁcally through the Advanced Placement (AP) Program. With more than 40 courses in a variety of subject areas, we are committed to promoting innovation, equity, and excellence for generations of students.

The AP Web Content team is responsible for defining and executing content strategy across a large, interconnected set of AP digital properties. We work closely with stakeholders across the AP Program and College Board to translate program goals into clear, user-friendly web content that supports students and educators. Our team balances big-picture content strategy with day-to-day execution—organizing information, creating content, and ensuring it’s easy to find and use. In a fast-paced, high-volume environment, we help bring consistency and clarity to the AP web experience.

About the Opportunity:

Under the direction of the AP Web Content Manager, the AP Web Editorial and Content Strategist is a senior individual contributor responsible for shaping and executing content strategy across AP and Pre-AP web properties. This role ensures that content is user-centered, cohesive, scalable, and aligned with AP program goals.

This position plays a critical role in supporting the launch of new AP course content, as well as ongoing course and exam revisions, within a large and complex web ecosystem. The strategist will partner closely with stakeholders across the AP Program and College Board to transform complex, interdependent inputs into clear, effective digital experiences.

This role requires a balance of strategic thinking and hands-on execution, with a strong emphasis on content structure, findability, and long-term sustainability.

In this role, you will:

Content Strategy and Structure (25%)

  • Own and drive editorial and content strategy for key areas of AP web properties, ensuring content is organized, scalable, and aligned with user needs and business goals.

  • Define where and how new content should live within an increasingly large and complex site, balancing user needs, SEO/findability, and maintainability.

  • Guide information architecture, content models, taxonomy, and metadata decisions in collaboration with cross-functional partners.

  • Structure and shape page-level experiences (hierarchy, flow, messaging) to improve usability and engagement.

  • Identify content gaps, redundancies, and opportunities for consolidation or improvement across AP web properties.

Content Creation and Execution (60%)

  • Translate complex, ambiguous, or inconsistently developed stakeholder inputs into clear, structured, and effective web content.

  • Lead content planning across the full lifecycle—from early concept and planning through launch—including defining content requirements, conducting content audits, drafting and editing content, determiningoptimal content strategy/placement, performing quality control and maintaining ongoing optimization.

  • Create and edit high-quality web content, ensuring clarity, consistency, and adherence to brand and editorial standards.

  • Work within the CMS to publish and maintain content, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.

Stakeholder Partnership & Content Operations (15%)

  • Partner with stakeholders to clarify goals, resolve ambiguity, and drive alignment on content direction.

  • Contribute to and help evolve content governance, standards, and workflows to support a growing content ecosystem.

  • Balance multiple competing priorities and deadlines across projects with varying levels of complexity and ambiguity.

About You:

  • Exceptional writing and editing skills, with the ability to simplify complex and highly nuanced inputs into clear, user-friendly content.

  • 7-10 years of experience in content strategy, editorial, or digital content roles, ideally within large, complex web environments.

  • Demonstrated experience leading content strategy for large-scale websites, platforms, or ecosystems. Strong experience working with information architecture, taxonomy, and content organization at scale.

  • Proven ability to operate in ambiguous environments and bring clarity, structure, and direction to content initiatives.

  • Experience partnering with diverse stakeholders and influencing decisions without direct authority.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities while maintaining high quality and attention to detail.

  • Familiarity with CMS platforms and digital publishing workflows.

  • Experience working within structured editorial standards, workflows, and governance models.

  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to articulate content decisions and strategy to non-content stakeholders.

  • Familiarity with education, curriculum, or mission-driven organizations is a plus.

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work

  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.

  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal

  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.

  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.

  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success

  • Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled.This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.

  • While thehiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck- we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $80,000–$115,000.

  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.

  • We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.

  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out ourcareers page for more.

jobs.description:
CloudLinux is a global remote-first company. We are driven by our principles: do the right thing, employees first, we are remote first, and we deliver high-volume, low-cost Linux infrastructure and security products that help companies to increase the efficiency of their operations. Every person on our team supports each other and does what we can to ensure we all are successful.

Check out our website for more information:

CloudLinux Inc. develops the Imunify family of security products, designed to protect hosting environments from a wide range of cyber threats. One of these solutions is Imunify Email, an email security product that protects hosting servers against spam, phishing, and other email-based threats.

Imunify Email filters mail on about 5,000 hosting servers. Today the filter is rspamd with rules and a scoring model we train in-house. We are replacing it with a transformer we trained ourselves that runs on the customer's own CPU in under 100 MB and already beats rspamd at every operating point we measured. We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our team and work alongside the engineer currently responsible for both the existing spam-filtering pipeline and the new ML model. Together, you will drive the development, improvement, and production rollout of our email security technology.

What you will do:

  • Train, evaluate, and release spam-detection models: build the corpus, pick the threshold, read the precision/recall report, decide ship or retrain.
  • Build the production side of the new engine in Go: the inference service, the mail-filter integration, the tokenizer, the streaming message parser.
  • Fix detection quality end to end, from a customer's "this phishing got through" to a rule, a corpus fix, or a retrain, with the false-positive cost weighed against the catch.
  • Keep the corpus tooling and training infrastructure running.
  • Review and approve classifier, rule, and model changes, so no release waits on one person.
  • Answer partner engineers who ask why a message scored the way it did.
  • Write specs, handbooks, and post-mortems. That is how this team transfers knowledge.

Your first six months:

  • Month 1: you ship a rule-model release on your own.
  • Month 3: your first piece of the new engine is merged and running on staging.
  • Month 6: a model release goes out while the principal engineer is away.

Requirements

What you bring:

  • 5+ years of shipping detection or classification systems where false positives have a cost you had to defend: anti-spam, anti-phishing, anti-malware, fraud, abuse.
  • You have taken at least one ML classifier to production yourself: corpus construction, threshold selection, error analysis.
  • Hands-on transformer training in PyTorch: tokenizers, masked-language pre-training, fine-tuning, ONNX export, CPU inference measurement.
  • Linux, shell, and Python on shared servers and a shared GPU.
  • Daily usage of AI coding agents and tools.
  • English at upper-Intermediate (B2) level or higher, with particularly strong written communication skills for technical documentation, specifications, and code reviews. Your specs and merge-request descriptions count as much as your code.

It is a strong plus if you have:

  • Email internals: SMTP, MIME, transfer encodings, SPF / DKIM / DMARC, how Exim, Postfix, and Dovecot handle mail to a filter.
  • Experience in creating embedded models
  • Go or Rustfor systems code: parsers, streaming, memory budgets, concurrency.
  • rspamd or SpamAssassin internals: rules, composites, Lua plugins, mass-check scoring.
  • Multi-million-sample corpora, labelling pipelines, annotator tooling.
  • Small models for constrained hardware: quantization, distillation, latency budgets.
  • LLM-based labelers or validators for scaling annotation.
  • Hosting panels: cPanel, Plesk, DirectAdmin.

  • Compensation for private medical insurance.
  • Co-working and gym/sports reimbursement.
  • Budget for education.
