jobs.description:
Skylight is a technology startup building the OS of the family. We make Skylight Calendar, the smart calendar loved by millions of families (plus Wired and Wirecutter). Calendar 2 launched earlier this year to rave reviews, and our newest product, Skylight Buddy, was just named one of TIME’s Best Inventions of 2026.

Our mission is to connect loved ones by creating the world’s simplest products and services that improve family life. Our founders are former venture capitalists and serial entrepreneurs who have scaled this business to $300M+ in annual revenue while being completely bootstrapped and profitable. We get to grow a happy, healthy company focused on making products our customers love without investors breathing down our necks.

Smart, hardworking people who care about making actually meaningful products love working here. People like you. We’re busy inventing new ways to simplify family life and help parents raise great kids – and we need your help! Come invent something new with us.

What You’ll Own:

In this role you’ll build, own, and improve the demand forecast for Skylight’s ecommerce business: Amazon and DTC, in the US and internationally. You’ll turn performance signals (traffic, conversion, in-stock levels, pricing, promotions) and consumer signals (macro trends and our own customer behavior) into SKU- and channel-level demand plans for Skylight Calendar, Frame, and Buddy. You’ll sit between Commercial, Finance, and Supply Planning so forecasts reflect our pricing and promotional strategy and give Supply Planning what it needs to buy and replenish. You’ll also help shape how we plan as we build out our Demand Planning tool in Pigment.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain the bottom-up forecast model for DTC and Amazon globally, covering both US and INTL.
  • Own SKU- and channel-level demand forecasts for Calendar, Frame, and Buddy, translating market and operational indicators into SKU-level demand and revenue projections.
    • Amazon: account for Buy Box performance, deal events, advertising, and inventory availability.
    • DTC: account for traffic, conversion, marketing plans, and the promotional calendar.
  • Work with Commercial counterparts to understand promotional and pricing strategy, and reflect that strategy in the demand forecast by quantifying the impact of each promotion and price change on demand.
  • Forecast new product and variant launches for ecommerce, including ramps and phase-outs, working with Commercial on launch plans and timing.
  • Align with Commercial and Finance on the revenue plan, and provide the demand forecast that informs the marketing spend budget.
  • Partner with the Retail Demand Planner and take the retail forecast and performance into account in the ecommerce forecast, factoring in its potential impact on ecommerce demand.
  • Work with Supply Planning on inventory challenges and opportunities. You own the demand signal, and Supply Planning owns purchasing and replenishment.
  • Support the monthly S&OP forecast cadence: prepare and present forecast accuracy, forecast vs. actual analyses, identify risks and upside opportunities, and document assumptions and scenarios.
  • Keep a log of demand assumptions and of adjustments to historical actuals (stock-outs, Buy Box issues, price changes), separating baseline from promotional demand.
  • Build scenario plans when inputs change, such as pricing or assortment.
  • Support the build and adoption of Pigment for demand planning, and keep improving our models, dashboards, and process.

What Sets You Apart:

This role is not for everyone. You will thrive here if you:

  • Can find the 1-2 things that actually drive outcomes or that will really make a difference for any given goal.
  • Feel comfortable in ambiguity. You don’t need a roadmap handed to you—you’ll make one.
  • Can both execute while designing repeatable processes that work in practice.
  • Care deeply. You show up with curiosity, vulnerability, and good intent.

Requirements

Must-Haves:

  • 4-7 years of experience in demand planning, revenue forecasting, analytics or similar for physical products, ideally in an omnichannel company.
  • Hands-on experience forecasting Amazon and DTC, and how stock-outs, Buy Box loss, and price changes distort history.
  • Strong forecasting fundamentals (seasonality, time-series methods, promotional lift) and advanced Excel or Google Sheets.
  • Comfort working with data in BI tools (Omni, Looker, Tableau, or similar) to analyze performance and build reports.
  • A track record of partnering with Commercial, Marketing, Finance, and Supply Chain, and communicating the story behind the numbers.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Economics, Analytics, or similar.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, ownership, and continuous improvement.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience with Pigment or a similar planning platform (Anaplan, o9, Kinaxis).
  • Experience with international or multi-region ecommerce forecasting.
  • Experience forecasting new product launches, ideally consumer hardware with strong holiday seasonality.
  • Experience with S&OP or monthly demand review processes, and with an ERP such as NetSuite.

Our Commitment:

We value diverse experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives—and we hire kind, thoughtful people who care deeply about their work. If you're reading this and think, “I don’t check every box,” but still feel excited about the role: Apply. We want to hear from you.

Benefits

Our competitive compensation package includes:

  • Competitive Salary + Equity Package
  • 401K matching
  • Wellness, learning, and home-office budgets
  • Health, Dental & Vision Medical Plans
  • Tremendous autonomy to set the direction of your work
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Company holidays on the first Friday of every month (Excluding November, December, and January)

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $130k-$160k per year. This range reflects the compensation Skylight reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for the position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors, which may include experience, qualifications, skills, education, geographic location, and internal equity. Skylight also offers benefits, including medical, dental, vision, and paid time off.

Equal Employment Opportunity

All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We are looking for a hands-on Revenue Operations Manager to build and optimize the systems, data, and processes that power our revenue engine.

In this highly cross-functional role, you will partner with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Finance to create a connected, data-driven approach to revenue growth across the entire customer lifecycle.

You will serve as the primary owner of HubSpot, establish reliable revenue reporting, improve operational efficiency, and develop scalable processes that support customer acquisition, retention, and expansion

We are looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with commercial judgment. A builder who can simplify complexity, identify opportunities for improvement, and translate data into meaningful business outcomes.

This role has three priorities:

  1. Build a scalable revenue operations foundation. Establish HubSpot as a reliable source of truth through strong data governance, integrated systems, consistent metrics, and efficient workflows from first touch through billing.
  2. Drive new revenue. Improve revenue visibility and performance, and build the signal-driven engine that surfaces our best opportunities. Partner with GTM leadership to strengthen forecasting, pipeline management, marketing attribution, and revenue reporting, enabling better decisions and more predictable growth.
  3. Increase customer retention and expansion. Work closely with Customer Success and Finance to improve customer lifecycle visibility, streamline renewal and expansion processes, and provide actionable insights into recurring revenue performance.

What You’ll Do

Go-to-market and sales operations

  • Own the sales process in HubSpot: pipeline stages, exit criteria, deal desk, and approval workflows
  • Run forecasting in partnership with Finance and give leadership a weekly view of pipeline health and risk
  • Find and fix funnel leaks across conversion, win rate, sales cycle length, and deal size
  • Design lead routing, territories, and Marketing-to-Sales SLAs, including leads from OEM and partner programs
  • Support annual planning, quota and capacity models, and commission administration with Finance

Post-sales and Customer Success operations

  • Partner with Customer Success leadership to operationalize onboarding, adoption, renewal, and expansion
  • Build customer health scoring that combines product usage, engagement, and customer feedback signals, with triggers and playbooks that help CSMs act on churn risk and upsell opportunity
  • Optimize the sales-to-CS handoff and renewal and expansion workflows in HubSpot
  • Own MRR, GRR, and NRR reporting, including movement by cause (new, expansion, contraction, churn)

Systems, data, and quote-to-cash

  • Own HubSpot administration across all hubs, including user permissions and integrations with product, GTM, and finance systems
  • Partner with Finance to configure quoting, products and pricing, contracts, billing, and payments in Revenue Hub
  • Own data governance: field definitions, deduplication, account hierarchies, and a single source of truth for accounts, contacts, deals, and revenue
  • Evaluate, implement, and rationalize GTM tools and vendors
  • Maintain a RevOps roadmap and run intake and prioritization for system, workflow, and reporting requests, pushing back on changes that add complexity without clear business value

Reporting and analytics

  • Set the definitions and calculation logic for core revenue metrics, including MRR, GRR, NRR, CAC, LTV, and pipeline coverage, so every team reports the same numbers
  • Build full-funnel leadership dashboards and turn them into regular business reviews with clear recommendations

Enablement and change management

  • Lead change management for new processes and systems: build buy-in with leaders, roll changes out, and make sure they stick
  • Train teams on HubSpot, AI tools, and process changes, and track usage and data quality by team to close adoption gaps
  • Maintain process documentation and playbooks for the full customer lifecycle

AI-augmented operations

  • Use AI tools (such as HubSpot Breeze agents and general-purpose AI assistants) to speed up analysis, reporting, forecasting, campaign builds, and documentation
  • Find and automate repetitive manual work across Marketing, Sales, and CS
  • Apply and help shape AI usage standards with Security, consistent with our compliance commitments
  • Design, build, and run our the technical components of Widewail’s signal-driven GTM engine: unify first-party data (customer feedback and reputation data, product usage, HubSpot engagement) with third-party enrichment and intent signals
  • Maintain and improve enrichment and routing workflows across Widewail’s technology stack, from signal detection to scoring, routing, and outreach, with HubSpot as the system of record

Marketing campaign operations

  • Partner with Marketing to design each campaign's operational setup before launch: audience logic, workflows, lead scoring, attribution, UTM and naming conventions, and success metrics
  • Partner with Marketing to establish scalable campaign infrastructure, automation, attribution, and reporting standards in HubSpot, enabling the Marketing team to execute campaigns effectively.
  • Own campaign tracking, attribution, and ROI reporting so each campaign ties to MQLs, pipeline, revenue, and expansion, and recommend where to invest or cut
  • Maintain lifecycle stage definitions and lead scoring models, and keep MQL-to-SQL handoffs clean

What Success Looks Like

  • First 30 days: HubSpot audit complete; current-state map of the customer lifecycle, data gaps, and quick wins shared with leadership.
  • First 90 days: Agreed definitions for MQL, SQL, pipeline, MRR, GRR, and NRR; first leadership revenue dashboard live; RevOps roadmap approved; every new campaign launches with standard tracking and attribution.
  • 6 months: Forecast accuracy improving against baseline; customer health scoring live with Customer Success; renewal and expansion workflows running in HubSpot.
  • 12 months: Measurable gains in win rate, campaign-sourced pipeline, MRR, and NRR against baseline; manual reporting time cut through documented, AI-assisted processes.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Marketing Operations at a B2B SaaS company with recurring revenue
  • Experience supporting a high-volume subscription customer base, with frequent renewals and expansion across hundreds of accounts or more
  • Expert-level HubSpot skills, including 3+ years as the primary admin or owner of a multi-hub HubSpot instance (Marketing, Sales, Service, and Revenue at minimum)
  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot Revenue Hub, or with HubSpot's quoting, billing, and payments tools and a clear plan to master Revenue Hub fast
  • Proven results improving GTM performance, with specific examples of better forecast accuracy, conversion and close rates, lead generation, and revenue growth
  • Proven success partnering with Customer Success leaders on retention and upsell, with clear, quantified impact on MRR, GRR, and NRR
  • A track record of leading change across teams without direct authority, getting leaders to adopt new processes and shared definitions
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI and automation to improve operational efficiency, data analysis, reporting, and workflow execution, with sound judgment around data security, accuracy, and business value
  • Strong analyst and communicator who turns data into clear recommendations and aligns Marketing, Sales, CS, and Finance on shared definitions
  • A hands-on builder with the judgment to prioritize competing requests and say no when a change doesn't serve the business
  • Deep experience running marketing campaign operations: building, tracking, attributing, and measuring campaigns tied to pipeline and revenue

Preferred

  • HubSpot certifications (such as Revenue Operations, Marketing Hub, or Sales Hub Implementation)
  • Experience selling to automotive dealerships or other multi-location businesses, including modeling account hierarchies (location, group, OEM program)
  • Experience operationalizing OEM, channel, or partner-sourced revenue programs
  • Experience working in a SOC 2 or similarly controlled data environment
  • Familiarity with SQL or a BI tool for analysis beyond HubSpot reporting
  • Experience at a company growing from early to mid-stage, building RevOps from the ground up

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, HSA, FSA, DCA
  • Company funded Lifestyle Spending Account
  • Remote Monthly Stipened
  • Employer match 401K
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Sick Time Off
  • Paid Time Off & Paid Holidays

Physical Demands & Work Environment

This position requires the ability to sit and stand for extended periods in an office environment. The in office work environment may include moderate noise levels, such as from office equipment, conversations, or foot traffic.

Equal opportunity

Widewail is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, contact [alias] and we will work with you.

Mettez votre expertise du médico-social au cœur de solutions logicielles qui ont du sens.

Rejoignez Orisha Health & Safety, notre Business Unit qui accompagne les acteurs de la santé et du secteur médico-social dans leur quotidien grâce à des solutions logicielles innovantes.

En tant que Product Owner, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec le Responsable Produit, au sein de l'entité SociaNova.

Votre mission ? Être le pont essentiel entre la réalité du terrain médico-social et nos équipes techniques pour maximiser la valeur de nos logiciels (notamment le Dossier Usager Informatisé - DUI Ogiris) et répondre concrètement aux besoins des professionnels accompagnants.

Vos missions

  • Comprendre et porter la voix du terrain : vous allez à la rencontre de nos utilisateurs (directeurs d’établissements, chefs de service, équipes soignantes et éducatives) lors de visites terrain ou d’ateliers d’expression de besoins (Design Thinking) pour cerner leurs contextes d’usage et leurs attentes.

  • Traduire le métier en fonctionnalités : vous transformez les besoins des utilisateurs et les retours clients en spécifications et documentations fonctionnelles claires, prêtes à être développées par l'équipe technique.

  • Prioriser et faire vivre le Backlog : en lien avec la stratégie Produit et nos exigences de qualité, vous alimentez, ordonnez et maintenez le Product Backlog au quotidien.

  • Participer aux rituels Agiles & à la qualité : vous participez activement aux cérémonies Scrum, rédigez et validez les tests fonctionnels et de non-régression pour garantir la fiabilité de nos livrables.

  • Accompagner les enjeux réglementaires et de déploiement : vous contribuez activement aux projets structurants du secteur (notamment la certification réglementaire DSR Vague 2 / Ségur du numérique) et soutenez les équipes Relation Clients et Commerce sur les sujets fonctionnels clés.

Qui êtes-vous ?

  • Vous venez du secteur médico-social (handicap, protection de l'enfance, accueil hébergement insertion, addictologie...) ou de la e-santé, avec une expérience terrain confirmée et une utilisation avancée d'un Dossier Usager Informatisé (DUI).

  • Vous avez une forte curiosité pour les outils informatiques, le logiciel et l'envie de basculer vers le Product Management (ou vous disposez déjà d'une première expérience en tant que Product Owner / gestion de projets digitaux).

  • Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre excellent relationnel, votre écoute et votre capacité à dialoguer facilement tant avec des professionnels du médico-social qu'avec des développeurs.

  • Vous faites preuve de rigueur, d'autonomie et de réactivité dans l'organisation de vos priorités.

  • Vous êtes ouvert(e) à l'usage de l'anglais professionnel pour communiquer au sein d'un groupe international.

  • (Atouts appréciés mais non obligatoires : certification PSPO, appétence technique ou connaissance des démarches qualité).

Chez Orisha, l’IA est un allié au quotidien : nous encourageons et formons chaque collaborateur à l'usage de Gemini pour booster sa créativité et sa productivité.

➡️ Ce poste est disponible en CDI, et ouvert en full télétravail (le siège social est basé à Paris).

➡️ Rémunération : 45 000 € - 55 000 € fixe brut annuel selon profil et expérience.

➡️ Des déplacements ponctuels sur le terrain sont à prévoir (environ une fois par trimestre).

A propos d’Orisha

Fondé en 2003, Orisha est un éditeur européen de logiciels dédiés principalement aux entreprises du commerce, de l’immobilier, de la santé, de la construction et de l'agrifood.

Depuis sa création, Orisha guide les entreprises vers le succès en leur proposant des solutions spécifiques à leur métier et indispensables à leur activité. Orisha réalise plus de 350M€ de chiffre d’affaires et compte plus de 2200 collaborateurs.

Orisha, c'est un groupe qui accompagne plus de 50.000 clients dans +100 pays dans leurs besoins technologiques pour faire tourner l'activité au quotidien.

Si vous vous reconnaissez dans ce projet, dites-le nous ! Nous avons hâte de vous rencontrer.

Software Engineer 1 (New Grad)

College Board – Technology

Location: This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Type: This is a full-time position

 

About Technology at College Board

We are a mission-driven engineering team building and evolving the technology that powers and protects the future of learning. Our systems support highly trusted education programs used by millions of students each year, operating at significant scale and public responsibility. Today, we are focused on designing and delivering a critical new initiative that extends our platform in meaningful ways: blending foundational system work with thoughtful experimentation as we adapt to emerging technologies and new learner needs. We combine modern, cloud-native engineering practices with years of platform modernization, security hardening, and large-scale digital delivery, operating as an experiment factory that tests assumptions and iterates based on evidence rather than tradition. What makes this team distinct is the rare combination of meaningful public impact, platform-scale technical challenges, and the freedom to shape how mission-critical systems are built and evolved.

About the Team

The Core Assessment Platform is a group of cross-functional teams responsible for building and evolving shared platform capabilities that support assessment-related systems used by institutions at scale. The work spans a range of assessment contexts, from routine evaluation to more complex, high-stakes environments, where accuracy, consistency, and trust are essential. Teams collaborate across engineering, product, design, data, and operations to build reliable capabilities that can be reused and adapted over time. What makes this group special is its focus on continuous learning, experimentation, and steady improvement, with success driven by thoughtful collaboration, iteration, and careful decision-making in environments where reliability and quality matter.

 

About the Opportunity  

In this role, you’ll contribute to production systems used at significant scale while learning how large, secure platforms are designed, built, and evolved responsibly. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers to ship code, test ideas, and improve shared capabilities that support assessment-related systems used by institutions. The focus is on learning by doing, while gaining exposure to real-world engineering challenges while building a strong foundation in modern development practices. This role emphasizes growth, feedback, and continuous learning. You’ll be encouraged to ask questions, experiment thoughtfully, and develop an understanding of system, not just features, while contributing meaningful work in an environment where reliability and quality matter.

 

In this role, you will:

Design & Implementation (65%)

  • Contribute to the design and implementation of high-quality software using modern technologies, focusing on building component-based, cost-effective, scalable, and secure solutions. You’ll learn and apply established design patterns to support integration with other services and applications, promote code reuse, and improve collaboration across teams.

  • Contribute to the development of application logic and responsive user interfaces using ReactJS, JavaScript (ES2015+), TypeScript, and Node.js.

  • Assist in building, maintaining, and scaling, cost-effective serverless solutions using Amazon Web Services (AWS).

  • Follow and uphold engineering standards in collaboration with product owners, architects, and stakeholders, in support of our systems and services.

  • Learn to understand new product capabilities and decompose the implementation into specific functional changes for verification.

  • Apply and continue to develop skills best practices in Agile development, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps to deliver reliable, high-quality software.

Team Operations & Analysis (20%)

  • Participate in Agile SCRUM ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Grooming, Daily SCRUM, Demo) and contribute to team commitments.

  • Review requirements and provide input, asking questions and learning how design decisions are made.

  • Participate in peer reviews of code, designs, and other software engineering artifacts, giving and receiving constructive feedback.

  • Practice continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) by implementing, testing, and delivering code in line with the team’s DevOps model.

  • Actively develop skills needed to work effectively in a poly-skilled Agile team, including collaboration, communication, and continuous learning.

Software Solutioning & Support (15%)

  • Develop an understanding of the customer’s business processes and operational needs, learning how systems are used in real-world contexts.

  • Work closely with Solutions Architects, Senior/Lead Engineers and Data Leads to evaluate requests, help assess level-of-effort and contribute to sprint planning activities.

  • Participate in peer code and design reviews.

  • Assist in troubleshooting and resolving application issues, including access, communications, and feature behavior, with support from the team.

About you, you have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, MIS, or equivalent professional experience.

  • 0-3 years of production-level software development experience or exposure using the College Board technology stack, including JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Node.js, and AWS.

  • Hands-on experience developing, debugging, and supporting web-based software applications in professional environments.

  • Proficiency in reviewing and improving code structure and architecture for testability, maintainability, scalability, and security.

  • Experience participating in software design discussions for new features and bug fixes.

  • Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify issues, ask the right questions, and develop effective solutions.

  • Clear communicator with practical decision-making skills and a strong belief in clean code, meaningful comments, and thorough documentation.

  • Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning and growth, including learning from setbacks and seeking expertise from others.

  • Ability to travel 3–5 times per year to the NYC or Reston, VA office.

  • Authorization to work in the United States.

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work

  • Authorization to work in the United States for any employer

  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and a comfort learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively. 

  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal

  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.

  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.

  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success.

About Our Process 

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.

  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, coding assessment prescreen, and a panel interview.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than just a paycheck, we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation, grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $106,000 – 125,000

  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.

  • We aim to make our best offer upfront—rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.

  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

jobs.description:
Overview

Pacific Clinics is the largest Mental and Behavioral Health care non-profit in the state of California. Join us and let your expertise and leadership in this critically important space help us realize our vision of providing innovative and transformational approaches to care while ensuring access and health equity for the communities we serve.


Pay Range

$220,000 - $240,000 (DOE, Part Time)

Job Summary

Reporting to, and working in collaboration with, the Chief Clinical Officer, the Medical Director serves as the clinical and administrative leader of psychiatric and medical services for the organization. The Medical Director is part of the agency ELT (Executive Leadership Team), and participates in associated projects and activities. This key executive role ensures the delivery of high-quality, ethical, and evidence-based behavioral healthcare in alignment with the organization's nonprofit mission, as well as all relevant state, federal, and accreditation standards across the organization. The Medical Director supervises the Director of Nursing, and provides oversight and consultation to agency physicians, nurse practitioners, and nurses, assuring standardized performance expectations and adherence to work processes. The Medical Director will integrate medical and psychiatric components into a holistic service delivery model.

Given the history and size of Pacific Clinics, there are two Medical Director positions. One positioned for NCIE (Northern California and Inland Empire) and the other for LASC (Los Angeles South Coast) Regions, with coordination between the Medical Directors playing a pivotal role in the position.

Compensation We Offer
Initial compensation for this Part-Time position ranges from $220,000 to $240,000 annually; depending on experience, location, and internal equity considerations.

Benefits We Offer

  • Benefits Eligibility starts on day ONE*
  • We provide a robust benefits package which includes medical, dental, vision. Check out our Benefits Page.
  • 401K Employer Match up to 4%
  • Competitive Time Off Plans
    (* Must meet eligibility requirements based on employment status)

Responsibilities

I Clinical Leadership & Oversight:

  • Executive Strategic Planning: Provide consultation to the Executive Leadership Team regarding current best practice in psychiatry, as well as input regarding pertinent opportunities and innovations in clinical treatment delivery, including integrated care models.
  • Clinical Program Direction: Provide comprehensive oversight and clinical guidance for all psychiatric and medical health services, including outpatient, crisis, Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS), and Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT) programs.
  • Staff Consultation: Serve as the final medical authority and clinical consultant for complex patient cases, risk management issues, and emergency evaluations.
  • Policy & Procedure: Develop, implement, and routinely review clinical protocols, policies, and procedures related to patient care, medication prescribing, psychopharmacology, medical triage, nursing and professional conduct.

II Administrative & Management:

  • Staff Supervision & Mentorship: Recruit, hire, supervise, and mentor the organization’s team of psychiatrists, nurse practitioners, nurses, psychiatric technicians, and medical support staff. Establish a structure for regular clinical supervision and/or peer review.
  • Quality & Compliance: Support continuous Quality Improvement (QI) and Utilization Review (UR) activities for medical services. Ensure full compliance with federal, state, and local regulatory bodies, as well as relevant accreditation standards.
  • Budget & Resources: Collaborate with the COO, CCO, and CFO on budget planning for the medical department, ensuring efficient resource utilization and productivity targets are met without compromising quality of care.
  • Strategic Planning: Advise the CCO on current medical trends, service gaps, and opportunities for program expansion and evidence-based practice adoption.

III Stakeholder Engagement & Advocacy:

  • Community Liaison: In conjunction with Communications Department, represent the organization's medical perspective to external stakeholders, including community partners, governmental agencies, and professional medical societies.
  • Interdisciplinary Collaboration: Foster a cohesive, collaborative environment among the medical team, clinicians, case managers, and administrative staff to ensure truly integrated, person-centered care.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Education: Doctor of Medicine (M.D.) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (D.O.) degree from an accredited medical school.
  • Residency: Successful completion of an accredited Psychiatry Residency Program.
  • Licensure: Current, unrestricted license to practice medicine and prescribe controlled substances in the State of California
  • Board Certification: Board Certified or Board Eligible in Psychiatry by the American Board of Psychiatry and Neurology (ABPN).
  • Experience: Minimum of five (5) years of progressively responsible clinical leadership and management experience, preferably within a community behavioral health or human services setting.

Job Competencies

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Expert knowledge of federal and state laws governing behavioral health and substance use disorder treatment.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead a diverse, multidisciplinary team and foster a positive, high-performance clinical culture.
  • Strong understanding of public behavioral health systems, managed care, and performance-based contracting.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, presentation, and analytical skills.
  • Commitment to the mission and values of a nonprofit organization serving vulnerable populations.
  • Experience with managed care, as provider and manager of care, preferred.
  • Experience in telepsychiatry preferred.
  • Must possess a valid California driver's license and maintain an insurable driving record under the Pacific Clinics' liability policy.

Physical Requirements

  • Will not have unsupervised contact with children.

jobs.description:
Build and run the GHL systems that turn leads into members and keep members coming back — and be the go-to support for the gym team using them.

About the Role

Seamless Assist places AI-fluent virtual assistants with growing businesses and builds the automation systems they run. We are hiring a GoHighLevel Specialist on behalf of our client, a US-based gym business. This is a fully remote role open to candidates based in Brazil.

The gym runs its lead follow-up, trial bookings, member communication, and retention campaigns through GoHighLevel. This hire owns that platform end to end — building the automations that drive memberships and supporting the owner and front-desk team who use it every day.

Culture: owner-led, fast-moving fitness business. Clear ownership, proactive communication, and steady improvement over perfection.

Role Details

  • Industry: Health & Fitness — Gym
  • Reports to: Gym Owner
  • Type: Full-time · 40 hours/week
  • Hours: US Eastern Time (EST) business hours
  • Rate: TBD
  • Location: Remote — Brazil
  • Tools: GoHighLevel (GHL), Zapier / Make / n8n, gym management software (e.g., Mindbody, ABC Glofox, PushPress, Zen Planner), Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Google Workspace

Role Overview

Every lead, trial, and member touchpoint at the gym runs through GoHighLevel. The GHL Specialist will design and maintain those systems — from the first ad inquiry to the membership renewal — and provide responsive, first-line support to the gym owner and staff.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can move between building and supporting in the same day: fixing a broken trial-booking workflow in the morning, walking the front desk through the pipeline after lunch, and documenting both so it doesn't happen twice. The right person treats every support request as a signal of what to systematize next.

Key Responsibilities

GHL Automation & Build

  • Build and maintain lead nurture workflows — speed-to-lead SMS/email, trial class and intro session booking, and follow-up for leads who don't book
  • Automate the member journey — class and appointment reminders, no-show follow-up, new-member onboarding, and milestone check-ins
  • Run retention and reactivation campaigns — lapsed and frozen members, expiring memberships, failed payments, and win-back offers
  • Set up and manage pipelines, calendars, forms, surveys, landing pages/funnels, custom fields, and tags
  • Build and send email and SMS campaigns — promotions, challenges, events, and monthly member newsletters
  • Automate review requests and referral campaigns to grow the gym's reputation
  • Integrate GHL with the gym's management software, payment tools, and ad lead sources (Facebook/Instagram lead forms) via native integrations, Zapier, Make, n8n, or webhooks

Customer Support

  • Serve as first-line GHL support for the gym owner and front-desk/sales staff
  • Manage and respond to member and lead inquiries in the GHL Conversations inbox (SMS, email, social DMs) within agreed response times
  • Troubleshoot issues: broken workflows, failed sends, calendar sync errors, A2P/10DLC and email deliverability problems, integration failures
  • Train gym staff on using GHL — pipelines, conversations, booking, and reporting — through live walkthroughs and short recorded videos
  • Escalate billing, platform-level bugs, or out-of-scope requests to the gym owner with a clear summary

Reporting, Documentation & Improvement

  • Build dashboards that track leads, trial bookings, show rates, conversions to membership, and retention
  • Write SOPs and how-to guides for every recurring build and support issue
  • Audit the account for broken, duplicate, or unused workflows and recommend clean-up
  • Track recurring issues and propose automations or fixes that remove them at the source
  • Use AI tools to speed up campaign copy, troubleshooting, and documentation

Who Will Succeed

"Builds it right, explains it simply, and fixes the root cause — not just the ticket."

  • Has built real GHL automations for live businesses — ideally gyms, studios, or other membership businesses
  • Understands how a gym makes money: leads, trials, memberships, retention
  • Patient and clear with busy, non-technical owners and staff — explains a workflow without jargon
  • Systems thinker who documents as they go and hates fixing the same problem twice
  • Takes initiative — spots what is broken or missing and raises it before the owner does

Experience & Skills

Required

  • GHL expertise: 2+ years of hands-on GoHighLevel experience building workflows, pipelines, funnels, and campaigns for live businesses
  • Customer support: 1+ year providing customer or technical support (tickets, live chat, calls, or client success)
  • Integrations: Working knowledge of Zapier, Make, n8n, or webhooks to connect GHL with other tools
  • AI fluency: Actively uses AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to build, write, and troubleshoot faster — specific tools and use cases confirmed at screening
  • Time zone compatibility: Able to work US Eastern Time (EST) business hours from Brazil
  • Strong communication: Exceptional written and spoken English — clear, friendly, and concise with owners, staff, and members; assessed at screening
  • Deliverability: Understanding of email and SMS deliverability, including A2P 10DLC registration
  • Remote setup: Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated workspace

Preferred

  • Experience with gyms, fitness studios, or other membership-based businesses
  • Experience with gym management software (Mindbody, ABC Glofox, PushPress, Zen Planner, or similar)
  • GHL Admin certification
  • Familiarity with GHL Conversation AI / AI Employee features
  • Experience running Facebook/Instagram lead-gen campaigns into GHL

jobs.excerpt: Position SummaryThe US Accountant is responsible for maintaining accurate and complete financial records in accordance with US Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (US GAAP), supporting timely financial close and reporting, and administering US payroll processes.
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The US Accountant is responsible for maintaining accurate and complete financial records in accordance with US Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (US GAAP), supporting timely financial close and reporting, and administering US payroll processes. The role combines general ledger accounting, financial analysis, account reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable, payroll processing, tax-accrual support, and audit coordination. The successful candidate must have practical experience in US accounting and US payroll, a strong understanding of US GAAP, and the ability to work collaboratively with internal teams and external advisors.

Job Details

  • Workarrangement: Work from home.
  • Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, subject to adjustment during peak periods, including month-end close and reporting.
  • Holidayschedule: Follows Philippine holidays, subject to operational requirements and peak-period needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • GeneralLedgerandFinancialRecordkeeping: Maintain accurate and complete accounting records; prepare and post journal entries; and ensure transactions are properly supported, classified, and recorded in the correct accounting period.
  • USGAAPFinancialReporting: Prepare and support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and related schedules in accordance with US GAAP. Apply relevant accounting principles consistently and escalate complex accounting matters as needed.
  • Month-EndandYear-EndClose: Coordinate and execute close activities, including recurring and adjusting journal entries, account reviews, accruals, and cut-off procedures, to deliver accurate and timely financial results.
  • AccountReconciliations: Prepare and review balance sheet reconciliations, including bank accounts, accounts receivable aging, prepaid expenses and amortization, deferred revenue, and other general ledger accounts. Investigate and resolve reconciling items promptly.
  • FinancialandVarianceAnalysis: Analyze monthly revenue and expense movements, identify significant variances and trends, validate results against expectations, and prepare clear explanations for management.
  • USPayrollAdministration: Process and administer US payroll using Gusto or other applicable payroll systems. Review employee wages, overtime, bonuses, benefits, deductions, and other payroll adjustments for accuracy and timely processing.
  • USPayrollTaxandCompliance: Support compliance with applicable federal, state, and local payroll tax and reporting requirements, including reviewing payroll tax calculations, filings, and payments as applicable. Maintain accurate, confidential payroll records and supporting documentation.
  • EmployeePayrollSupport: Respond to payroll inquiries, investigate discrepancies, coordinate corrections with relevant stakeholders, and help ensure payroll issues are resolved accurately and on time.
  • AccountsPayableandReceivable: Process and record vendor and customer transactions, verify invoices and supporting documents, support payment processing and collections, and record the transaction on a daily basis, and investigate discrepancies.
  • ClientInvoiceRecording: Record client invoices accurately and promptly in the accounting system; validate client details, dates, amounts, and supporting documentation; maintain organized records; and support invoicing-related close activities.
  • TaxAccrualsandExternalTaxCoordination: Prepare and record monthly accruals for US federal corporate income taxes and, where applicable, state and local income taxes. Coordinate with external tax advisors on tax schedules, supporting documentation, and required tax filings.
  • IntercompanyandTransferPricingEntries: Record and support intercompany transactions and transfer-pricing-related cost recognition across applicable entities and locations, ensuring transactions are supported and recorded in the appropriate period.
  • AccrualsandExpenseRecognition: Calculate and post accruals for recurring expenses where invoices have not yet been received, ensuring expenses are recognized in the appropriate reporting period.
  • AuditandComplianceSupport: Support internal and external audits by preparing reconciliations, schedules, and documentation; respond to information requests; and maintain well-organized audit trails.
  • CorporateCreditCardReporting: Prepare or assist with monthly corporate credit card liquidation and expense reports, ensuring transactions are supported and properly classified.
  • ManagementReportingandCollaboration: Work with accounting, FP&A, operations, and other business teams to gather and validate financial data, explain results to stakeholders, improve reporting quality, and support process improvements and automation.
  • ProcessImprovement: Identify opportunities to strengthen accounting controls, standardize workflows, improve data quality, and increase the efficiency and reliability of accounting and payroll processes.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • At least 5 years of professional accounting experience, including a minimum of 3 years of hands-on US accounting experience.
  • Practical, hands-on experience processing US payroll, including familiarity with payroll calculations, deductions, payroll taxes, and applicable federal, state, and local requirements.
  • Strong working knowledge of US GAAP and its application to general ledger accounting, reconciliations, accruals, and financial reporting.
  • Experience using US accounting and payroll systems; QuickBooks and Gusto experience is an advantage.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including the ability to organize, reconcile, and analyze financial data.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Ability to handle confidential financial and employee payroll information with integrity and discretion.
  • Demonstrates consistent commitment to assigned duties and responsibilities, maintains focus and engagement during agreed working hours, and ensures that outside activities or other professional commitments do not interfere with work performance, availability, productivity, or deliverable quality.
  • Demonstrates a high standard of honesty, integrity, ethical conduct, and sound professional judgment in all work-related activities, particularly when handling financial records, payroll information, confidential data, and sensitive business matters.
  • Provides accurate and timely updates on work progress, communicates delays and potential issues promptly, and ensures that reported progress reflects actual work completed. Demonstrates dependability in meeting commitments and maintaining consistent work quality.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CPA or equivalent professional accounting certification.
  • Experience supporting US payroll tax filings and year-end payroll reporting.
  • Experience coordinating with US-based tax advisors, auditors, and other external service providers.
  • Experience with multi-entity accounting, intercompany transactions, transfer pricing, and month-end close.
  • Experience improving accounting workflows, internal controls, and reporting automation.

Success Measures

  • Accurate and timely recording and processing of client invoices, vendor payables, expense accruals, payroll, related-party transactions, deferred revenue, and other accounting entries. Investigate discrepancies promptly, implement appropriate corrections, and ensure all transactions are properly supported, reconciled, and recorded in the correct accounting period.
  • Reliable financial records, reconciliations, and US GAAP-compliant reporting delivered within agreed deadlines.
  • Timely completion of month-end close activities and clear explanations of material revenue and expense variances.
  • Complete, well-organized supporting documentation for audits, tax coordination, and management reporting.

jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD101374

Position Overview

As a Research intern at Autodesk Research, you will explore and apply novel technologies and techniques to empower our customers in designing and building a better, safer, and more sustainable world. We are a team of researchers, engineers, and industry domain experts working on projects that range from learning-based design systems, computer vision, graphics, robotics, human-computer interaction, sustainability, simulation, manufacturing, architectural design and construction.


Working with a multidisciplinary research team across AI, spatial computing, AEC, and human perception, you’ll develop and evaluate methods that interconnect different representations of the built environment within immersive, editable world models. Possible research directions may include exploring editing non-traditional 3d geometries such as gaussian splats, building multi-layered spatial representations of architectural spaces (simulations, physics, rendering, reality capture), and controlling 3d modeling and design environments and processes with agentic workflows.


You’ll build research prototypes and explore how this work could inform future Autodesk design workflows.


Responsibilities


  • Research multimodal AI approaches for the generation and editing of novel 3d representations of built environments.
  • Develop methods using foundation models, AI agents, and/or world models.
  • Work with multimodal datasets, including visual, spatial, behavioral, and physics simulations data.
  • Design experiments and benchmarks to evaluate AI predictions against human responses.
  • Build and evaluate research prototypes for real and simulated environments.
  • Document and communicate findings through papers, presentations, and demonstrations.

Minimum Qualifications


  • Currently pursuing a PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Graphics, Computational Design, or a related field - with a completion date in 2028 or later.
  • Research experience in AI/ML, computer vision, reality capture and 3d reconstruction, 3d modeling or geometry generation, or a related computational field.
  • Strong programming skills, ideally with Python and modern ML frameworks.
  • Experience designing computational experiments and working with complex datasets.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills.
  • Track record of contributions to the field, demonstrated through related projects, open-source work, or publications.

Preferred Qualifications


Experience in one or more of the following: multimodal AI or vision-language models; world models, AI agents, or spatial intelligence; 3D, simulation, or virtual environments; human perception or human-centered AI; modern 3D modeling and reconstruction methods; AEC or computational design; Solid understanding of 3D modeling systems and data pipelines

Financial Solutions Advisor

Office of Financial Solutions

Full-Time, Contingent II, Exempt, Pay Grade 1.1

University of Maryland Global Campus (UMGC) seeks a Financial Solutions Advisor. Within the Office of Financial Solutions, the Financial Solutions Advisor (FSA) actively partners with learners and develops long term funding plans for their education, helping to remove financial obstacles to academic success. Leveraging in-depth knowledge of federal student aid, military benefits, employer benefits and self-pay options, the FSA consultatively reviews all funding options available based on a learner’s unique circumstance. With a goal of increasing access and affordability, the FSA also surfaces financial literacy resources and approaches solutions aimed at providing learners with an educational investment aligned with their goals. The Financial Solutions department is a high energy, fast-paced environment that relies heavily on data and technology to provide a superior learner experience. While interacting with learners and taking steps to find solutions, the FSA will regularly partner with colleagues in the Admissions, Success Coach, Financial Aid and Student Accounts departments. The FSA engages with learners in a variety of communication channels including email, SMS (text messaging), live chat, inbound calls, and outbound calls. A successful FSA is enthusiastic to financially guide learners from the earliest stages of admission through graduation. A skilled FSA employs a curiosity-based mindset to build rapport with learners and explores solutions to move learners forward in their educational journey.

When partnering with financial aid applicants and users, accountabilities include:

  • A thorough understanding of eligibility requirements and available grant and loan types available through the Title IV program

  • Partnership with learners through each step of the application process, including the provision of documentation needed to satisfy verification and C-flag requirements

  • Actively partner with learners through decisions related to changes in enrollment that may impact financial aid eligibility

You will lead success planning and day-to-day engagement for key accounts, using data and best practices to increase RFP volume, drive feature adoption (e.g., RFP Showcase), and grow the community of sourcing users across our customers’ organizations.

  • Partner closely with Sales, Account Management, and cross-functional teams, working in tandem with the primary success resource to deliver a unified customer experience, support renewals, and uncover expansion opportunities.

As an Inside Sales Representative, you'll be a key point of contact for our dealer network across the U.S. and Canada, supporting incoming inquiries, processing orders, coordinating custom projects, and helping deliver a seamless experience from quote to completion. You'll partner closely with dealers, regional sales managers, production planning, accounting, and technical support teams to ensure customers receive accurate information, timely updates, and solutions that meet their needs.


This is not a traditional outbound sales role. Rather than cold calling or prospecting, you'll primarily support inbound dealer communications through phone and email, helping answer product questions, provide project guidance, create custom quotes, and manage orders.


Success in this role comes from taking ownership, staying organized, and paying close attention to detail. We're looking for someone who can manage multiple priorities independently, review requests for accuracy, align customer expectations with our capabilities, and help ensure the final product meets the customer's needs. Whether you bring several years of experience or are earlier in your career with the right attitude and aptitude to learn, we'll provide the training and support to help you succeed.

  • Do you enjoy helping customers find the right solution? Support dealers by answering questions, providing product information, availability updates, and lead-time estimates while delivering a positive customer experience.
  • Can you turn customer needs into actionable solutions? Assist with custom room design projects, prepare custom quotes, and help qualify new projects from inquiry through completion.
  • Are you energized by managing details and keeping work moving? Process and manage incoming dealer orders while ensuring requests are accurate, complete, and aligned with internal processes.
  • Do you communicate confidently through both phone and email? Handle inbound dealer communications, respond to inquiries, and provide professional written and verbal support throughout the sales process.
  • Do you take ownership of customer requests from start to finish? Review project details, help ensure customer expectations align with company capabilities, and support quality assurance throughout the order and quoting process.
  • Are you skilled at connecting people and information? Act as a liaison between dealers and internal teams including sales, accounting, production planning, and technical support to keep projects moving forward.
  • Do you enjoy solving problems and finding answers? Investigate concerns, coordinate with internal departments, and help identify solutions that support both customer satisfaction and operational success.
  • Can you stay organized while managing multiple priorities? Balance a steady flow of emails, phone calls, quotes, custom projects, and order activity while maintaining responsiveness and accuracy.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Associate degree or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience preferred.3-5 years of customer service, administrative, inside sales support, or related experience preferred, though candidates with less experience and a strong aptitude for learning are encouraged to apply.Strong written communication skills, including the ability to professionally communicate through email and proofread work for accuracy.
  • Strong verbal communication and customer service skills.
  • Experience working directly with customers, dealers, distributors, or business partners.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and OneNote.
  • ERP system experience is helpful. Salesforce experience or the ability to learn new systems quickly is a plus.Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.

  • Ability to multitask, solve problems, exercise sound judgment, and collaborate effectively in a fast-paced environment.Adaptability and a willingness to learn new processes, products, and systems.

Teladoc Health is the global virtual care leader, offering comprehensive virtual care solutions spanning virtual care including primary, mental health, expert medical, devices and licensed platform services. Teladoc Health serves the world's leading insurers, employers, and health systems and helps millions of people around the world resolve their healthcare needs with confidence. Serving over 9 million Canadians, Teladoc Health has been in Canada for more than 20 years and operates in 175 countries world-wide.

The Case Manager ensures the well-being of members/patients and guides them through their healthcare journey. As part of a specialized team, including Case Coordinators, physicians and nurses, the Case Manager optimizes clinical quality and ensures high member satisfaction across various Teladoc service lines. They follow members and patients through all stages, including but not limited to triage/intake to report delivery, including provider selection and case matching. Assignments may focus on Health Navigation, Mental Health, or other areas based on expertise with the expectation that the case manager will be flexible and cross-trained in all applicable areas. This allows flexibility and professional growth.

  • Serve as the initial clinical contact for members/patients.

  • Collect comprehensive health histories and document relevant medical data.
  • Provide ongoing clinical support and navigate the healthcare system for members.
  • Communicate clearly with members about service progress, ensuring high customer service levels.
  • Collaborate closely with Case Coordinators and the clinical team to support case progression.
  • Use technology to ensure case coordination and information integrity.
  • Review complex medical issues and ensure the accuracy of clinical summaries/reports.
  • Provide clinical expertise to support members in understanding their diagnoses and treatment recommendations.
  • Meet service standards for case progression, quality, and member satisfaction.
  • Ensure compliance with privacy legislation
  • Help select appropriate specialists using Teladoc’s database.
  • Follow up directly with providers on overdue reports.
  • Support providers with case consultation and referral to appropriate resources.
  • Document casework clearly and timely for transparency across departments.
  • Maintain accurate provider information in the system.
  • Conduct quality reviews to ensure thorough documentation.
  • Escalate case-related questions/concerns to Operations Leaders and the Medical Director(s).

  • Liaise between the clinical team and providers to address questions and concerns.

Flosum is a leading Salesforce-native DevOps platform that enables enterprises to manage and accelerate their Salesforce development lifecycle with security, compliance, and efficiency at scale. Built entirely on Salesforce, Flosum empowers teams to streamline releases, improve governance, and drive faster innovation.

We're looking for a driven, relationship-first Account Manager to own and grow a portfolio of enterprise accounts. You'll be the primary point of contact for a set of high-value customers — responsible for renewal, expansion, and long-term success. You'll partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, and Product to ensure our customers see measurable impact from our platform and grow with us over time.

Own a portfolio of accounts, managing the post-sale lifecycle including QBRs, renewals, and expansions.

  • Build and maintain multi-threaded relationships across economic buyers, executives, and champions within each account.

  • Strong understanding of Salesforce (Admin, DevOps, or development lifecycle concepts preferred)

  • Experience with Salesforce DevOps tools or release management processes

Salesforce certifications (Admin, Platform App Builder, etc.)

President & Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
Aviation Information Sharing and Analysis Center (Aviation ISAC)
Reports To: Board of Directors
Location: Remote / Global

Position Summary
The President & Chief Executive Officer (CEO) serves as the senior executive leader of the Aviation Information Sharing and Analysis Center (Aviation ISAC), a global nonprofit organization dedicated to reducing cyber risk and strengthening resilience across the aviation sector. The organization’s membership comprises 155 members across 41 countries, spanning five continents, demonstrating its extensive global reach and international representation.
The CEO establishes the culture and provides strategic leadership and operational oversight to advance the organization's mission, vision, and long-term sustainability. The CEO serves as the primary liaison to the Board of Directors, member organizations, government agencies, industry associations, regulators, and strategic partners. The CEO is responsible for fostering a trusted global community that enables information sharing, knowledge development, stewardship, and partnership across the aviation ecosystem.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Aviation ISAC Core Values
The President & CEO is expected to model and champion Aviation ISAC's five core values in all activities and decisions:
  • Trusted Community
  • Information Sharing
  • Knowledge Development
  • Stewardship
  • Partnership
The CEO is responsible for ensuring these values remain embedded within Aviation ISAC's culture, strategy, operations and execution.


Strategic Leadership
  • Lead the development and execution of Aviation ISAC's strategic plan.
  • Identify and manage emerging opportunities, risks, and trends affecting aviation cybersecurity.
  • Ensure the organization remains the leading trusted authority for global collaboration on aviation cybersecurity.
  • Drive innovation in information sharing, threat intelligence, automation, community engagement, and member services.
  • Seek advice and guidance on strategic priorities and organizational direction from the Board of Directors.
Governance and Board Relations
  • Serve as the principal advisor to the Board of Directors.
  • Support the Board, Executive Committee, and standing committees through effective communication and reporting.
  • Implement Board-approved policies, strategies, and resolutions.
  • Ensure adherence to corporate governance requirements, bylaws, and fiduciary responsibilities.
  • Maintain organizational compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and nonprofit requirements.
Mission and Industry Leadership
  • Act as the public face and chief spokesperson for Aviation ISAC.
  • Represent the organization before industry groups, conferences, government agencies, regulators, and international bodies.
  • Strengthen Aviation ISAC's role as a trusted voice on aviation cybersecurity and resilience.
  • Promote collaboration among airlines, airports, OEMs, manufacturers, government agencies, and service providers.
  • Advance Aviation ISAC's influence within the global aviation ecosystem.
Membership Growth and Community Engagement
  • Maintain and strengthen Aviation ISAC's trusted community.
  • Establish membership growth and retention strategies.
  • Ensure members receive exceptional value through intelligence products, communities of interest, training, events, and engagement opportunities.
  • Foster collaboration among diverse member segments across the global aviation ecosystem.
Financial Management and Stewardship
  • Ability to oversee and manage an annual operating budget of approximately $6 million.
  • Develop and oversee organizational budgets, forecasts, cash and investments, and financial planning.
  • Must have financial and business acumen, with demonstrated ability to manage budgets, ensure organizational sustainability, prioritize investments, and align resources to strategic outcomes.
  • Ensure responsible stewardship of organizational assets and resources.
  • Monitor financial performance and organizational sustainability.
  • Work with the Treasurer, Audit & Risk Committee, and Board to ensure sound financial governance.
  • Identify and develop sponsorship, partnership, grant, and revenue opportunities consistent with the mission.
Organizational Leadership
  • Provide direct oversight and strategic direction for five key leadership roles: VP Member Success/CISO, VP Global Intelligence, VP Marketing/Event/Sponsors, Office Manager, and Business Development Manager, supporting a organizational workforce of 20 employees.
  • Lead, develop, and inspire a high-performing remote workforce.
  • Establish annual goals and performance expectations for senior leaders.
  • Foster a culture of trust, accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure organizational practices align with Aviation ISAC's Core Values and Vision.
  • Promote employee development, succession planning, and organizational resilience.
Information Security and Risk Management
  • Ensure effective governance of information security, privacy, and risk management programs.
  • Oversee implementation and maintenance of the Information Security Management System (ISMS).
  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of member information and trusted sharing environments.
  • Champion organizational resilience and business continuity planning.
Partnerships and External Relations
  • Develop and maintain strategic relationships with:
    • Aviation industry stakeholders
    • Government agencies
    • Regulators
    • Sector coordinating councils
    • Research institutions
    • Strategic technology and cybersecurity partners
  • Pursue opportunities that enhance value to members and advance Aviation ISAC's mission.
  • Facilitate collaboration on aviation cybersecurity issues of global significance.

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic Vision
  • Executive Leadership
  • Board Governance
  • Cybersecurity and Risk Awareness
  • Member and Stakeholder Engagement
  • Financial Acumen
  • Relationship Building
  • Public Speaking and Advocacy
  • Organizational Development
  • Change Leadership
  • Consensus Building
  • Ethical Decision-Making
Preferred Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred.
  • Minimum 15 years of progressive leadership experience.
  • U.S.-based residency required.
  • Ability to obtain a U.S. government national security clearance highly desirable.
  • Experience leading nonprofit, association, membership-based, aviation, cybersecurity, intelligence, or critical infrastructure organizations preferred.
  • Familiarity with aviation industry stakeholders, cybersecurity risk management, information sharing communities, and regulatory environments.
  • Demonstrated success working with Boards of Directors and senior executives.
  • Proven ability to build partnerships and influence diverse stakeholders globally.
  • Strong financial management and strategic planning experience.
  • Exceptional communication and public speaking skills.

You are the operational spine of Skylight's logistics function. Where our Director of Logistics owns strategy carrier contracts, compliance posture, SLA frameworks, and systems design you own execution: making sure that every shipment moves as planned, every forwarder and drayage partner is held to their commitments, and exceptions are caught and resolved before they become problems. You'll be the connective tissue between our freight forwarders, 3PL partners, and internal teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with our freight forwarders on day-to-day bookings, exception escalations, and performance follow-ups. You are the primary operational point of contact.
  • Own the forwarder to drayage handoff: ensure cargo moves cleanly from vessel discharge to our FC’s (Reno NV and Indianapolis IN) with no gaps in ownership or communication.
  • Coordinate FC facility transfers, including inbound routing decisions, cross-dock timing, and delivery sequencing.
  • Audit forwarder rates, accessorials, and SLA performance on a recurring basis — flag variances and drive them to resolution.
  • Operate cargo tracking systems (TMS, Forwarder Systems, Internal trackers): maintain shipment visibility across all active lanes, escalate delays proactively, and keep stakeholders informed.
  • Own data and documentation workflows: ensure all shipping documents (commercial invoices, packing lists, BOLs, ISF filings) are captured, filed, and accessible and build the habits and systems that make this reliable at scale.
  • Lead exception and incident management: serve as the point person when things go wrong, a delayed vessel, a drayage no show, a CBP hold, a cargo claim and drive resolution to closure.
  • Provide compliance ops support to the Director of Logistics: assist with ISF filing coordination, CBP exam response, customs document collection, and UFLPA documentation workflows.
  • Continuously improve the processes, tools, and documentation that underpin operational consistency across all lanes and partners.

Requirements

This role is not for everyone. You will thrive here if you:

  • Can find the 1-2 things that actually drive outcomes or that will really make a difference for any given goal.
  • Feel comfortable in ambiguity. You don’t need a roadmap handed to you—you’ll make one.
  • Can both execute while designing repeatable processes that work in practice.
  • Care deeply. You show up with curiosity, vulnerability, and good intent.
  • Own the problem, fix the system. You don't patch the same issue twice — you find root cause and build a process that prevents recurrence.
  • Bridge ops and tech. You can look at a workflow, articulate what a system needs to do, and work with engineers or no-code tools to make it repeatable and scalable.
  • Own the problem, fix the system. Identify the root cause, prevent the recurrence
  • Bridge Ops and Tech - translate workflow needs into buildable requirements

Must-Haves:

  • 4–7 years of experience in freight forwarding, 3PL, or shipper-side logistics operations with hands-on carrier and forwarder management.
  • Strong working knowledge of international freight: ocean FCL/LCL, air freight, and domestic drayage operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to own exceptions, incidents, and escalations in a fast-moving environment you finish what you start.
  • Comfortable with data: you can work in Google Sheets or Excel, build trackers, and produce reporting without needing someone to set it up for you.
  • Baseline familiarity with customs and trade compliance workflows ISF, CBP entry process basics, document collection even if compliance is not your primary background.
  • Clear written communicator: you correspond professionally with carriers, forwarders, and 3PLs, and draft internal updates that are crisp and complete.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset: comfortable in fast-moving environments, able to deal with ambiguity, take ownership, and continuously improve.
  • Process design and systems thinking: spots what’s broken, designs something better, and sees it through to adoption — has translated an operational need into a tool, tracker, or automation, and can work alongside engineers or analysts to build it right.


Nice to Haves:

  • Experience working with major freight forwarders (Expeditors, Flexport, Crane Worldwide, or similar).
  • Familiarity with drayage and 3PL coordination in transpacific lanes to LA/LGB, or the Midwest
  • Experience with TMS or shipment visibility platforms (OSCA, Setlog, project44, FourKites, or similar).
  • Customs brokerage coordination experience (CBP holds, ISF corrections, entry review, standard customs documentation).
  • Experience in a consumer goods or eCommerce company with an omnichannel distribution model.
  • Prior experience managing or mentoring junior logistics staff.

Our Commitment:

We value diverse experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives—and we hire kind, thoughtful people who care deeply about their work. If you're reading this and think, “I don’t check every box,” but still feel excited about the role: Apply. We want to hear from you.

Benefits

Our competitive compensation package includes:

  • Competitive Salary + Equity Package

  • Health, Dental & Vision Medical Plans
  • Tremendous autonomy to set the direction of your work
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Company holidays on the first Friday of every month (Excluding November, December, and January)

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $110k-$130k per year. This range reflects the compensation Skylight reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for the position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors, which may include experience, qualifications, skills, education, geographic location, and internal equity. Skylight also offers benefits, including medical, dental, vision, and paid time off.
