The base salary may vary within the anticipated base pay range based on factors such as the ultimate location of the position and the selected candidate’s knowledge, skills, and abilities. Position may be eligible for additional compensation that may include an incentive program.

Job Description

*This position is remote/work from home. You need to reside within the Eastern or Central Time Zones. If near our Atlanta office, the role will be hybrid.


The Senior Specialist, Digital Marketing / Communications – Email, SMS & Organic Social conducts day-to-day channel operations for email marketing, SMS communications, and organic social media across Cox Automotive’s enterprise B2B portfolio. This role independently executes campaigns for a broad range of brands and products, handling end-to-end campaign development including audience strategy, content optimization, journey design, testing, and performance analysis. The Senior Specialist identifies opportunities to improve engagement and deliverability, proactively recommends new strategies and content approaches, and contributes to the innovation roadmap for channel technologies and platforms.

The ideal candidate brings demonstrated expertise in email marketing, SMS, and organic social execution, with the ability to independently run complex, multi-brand campaigns and proactively recommend improvements. This individual partners closely with 82 auction locations and Key Account Marketing teams, creative teams, marketing automation specialists, analytics, agency partners, and fellow digital marketing professionals to translate business objectives into high-performing channel campaigns, and identifies new industry trends and technologies that can strengthen Cox Automotive’s owned channel presence.

What You’ll Do

  • Email Campaign Execution & Optimization
  • Conduct end-to-end email campaign execution for a broad range of brands and products, including audience segmentation, journey design, template development, content optimization, QA, deployment, and post-send analysis.
  • Design nurture programs for different audience segments and lifecycle stages, building progressive engagement sequences that drive conversion and retention.
  • Implement progressive profiling strategies to enrich contact data over time and improve personalization capabilities across email campaigns.
  • Execute re-engagement campaigns for inactive subscribers, testing content approaches, subject lines, and send timing to recover audience attention.
  • Proactively recommend new email strategies, content formats, and automation approaches to amplify engagement and drive toward business objectives.
  • Implement deliverability monitoring practices including sender reputation tracking, domain health checks, and ISP feedback loop analysis.
  • SMS Campaign Execution & Optimization
  • Execute SMS campaigns across a broad range of brands, handling message creation, audience targeting, compliance management, and delivery optimization.
  • Coordinate SMS and email orchestration to optimize cross-channel messaging sequences, managing timing and frequency to prevent audience fatigue.
  • Design trigger-based SMS programs for time-sensitive updates, alerts, and event-driven communications across the customer lifecycle.
  • Monitor carrier-level delivery performance, identifying and resolving issues by carrier to maintain high deliverability rates.
  • Identify new SMS capabilities and emerging messaging technologies, translating them into actionable test proposals and implementation plans.
  • Organic Social Media Execution & Optimization
  • Execute organic social media campaigns across platforms such as LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and other relevant channels for a broad range of brands and products.
  • Develop platform-specific content approaches recognizing different audience behaviors, content formats, and algorithmic requirements across LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and emerging platforms.
  • Conduct social listening to monitor brand mentions, sentiment trends, and trending topics, surfacing insights that inform content strategy and messaging.
  • Coordinate organic social content calendars with campaign timelines, product launches, and cultural moments, ensuring consistent publishing cadence.
  • Proactively report on organic social performance by platform and brand, providing data-driven improvement recommendations on content mix, posting cadence, and engagement tactics.
  • Performance Analytics & Cross-Channel Optimization
  • Conduct performance monitoring across email, SMS, and organic social channels, tracking deliverability, engagement, conversion, and audience growth metrics.
  • Develop and maintain cross-channel performance dashboards offering visibility into trends, audience responsiveness, and campaign effectiveness.
  • Execute A/B and multivariate tests across all three channels, documenting results and socializing learnings with the broader team.
  • Identify new industry trends and technologies impacting email, SMS, and social channels, and translate them into actionable plans for improving campaign performance.
  • Contribute to the innovation roadmap for channel technologies, automation capabilities, and platform features, evaluating new tools for potential adoption.

What’s in It for You?

Here’s a sneak peek at the benefits you could experience as a Cox employee:

  • A competitive salary and top-notch bonus/incentive plans.
  • Exceptional work-life balance, flexible time-off policies and accommodating work schedules.
  • Comprehensive healthcare, with multiple options for individuals and families.
  • Generous 401(k) retirement plans with company match.
  • Professional development and continuing education opportunities.
  • Inclusive parental leave policies, plus comprehensive fertility coverage and adoption assistance.
  • Extra perks like pet insurance, employee discounts and much more.

Who You Are

Minimum:

  • Bachelor’s degree in related discipline and 4 years’ experience in a related field. The right candidate could also have a different combination, such as a master’s degree and 2 years’ experience; a Ph.D. and up to 1 year of experience; or 8 years’ experience in a related field.
  • Experience in digital marketing with a demonstrated focus on email marketing, SMS, and/or social media execution across multiple brands or platforms.
  • Proven track record of independently executing complex, multi-brand campaigns with measurable engagement and performance improvements.
  • Strong proficiency with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, including campaign setup, journey building, audience segmentation, automation, and deliverability management.
  • Demonstrated expertise with social media management tools and platforms (LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram) including content scheduling, community monitoring, and social listening.
  • Working knowledge of SMS campaign execution including compliance frameworks (TCPA, carrier guidelines), opt-in management, and delivery optimization.
  • Proficiency with HTML and CSS for email template development and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with analytics and reporting tools for measuring email, SMS, and social performance; ability to build dashboards and generate actionable insights.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint) and project management tools such as Monday.com.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret cross-channel performance data, identify trends, and formulate optimization strategies.
  • Excellent written communication skills, including the ability to craft and refine channel content and present performance findings to stakeholders.
  • Proven project management skills with close attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities under minimal guidance.
  • Proactive, self-directed approach with the ability to identify opportunities and recommend new strategies without being prompted.
  • Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams, agencies, and brand stakeholders.
  • Travel: 5%

Join the Cox family of businesses and make your mark today!

Drug Testing

To be employed in this role, you’ll need to clear a pre-employment drug test. Cox Automotive does not currently administer a pre-employment drug test for marijuana for this position. However, we are a drug-free workplace, so the possession, use or being under the influence of drugs illegal under federal or state law during work hours, on company property and/or in company vehicles is prohibited.

Benefits

The Company offers eligible employees the flexibility to take as much vacation with pay as they deem consistent with their duties, the company’s needs, and its obligations; seven paid holidays throughout the calendar year; and up to 160 hours of paid wellness annually for their own wellness or that of family members. Employees are also eligible for additional paid time off in the form of bereavement leave, time off to vote, jury duty leave, volunteer time off, military leave, and parental leave.

About Us

Through groundbreaking technology and a commitment to stellar experiences for drivers and dealers alike, Cox Automotive employees are transforming the way the world buys, owns, sells – or simply uses – cars. Cox Automotive employees get to work on iconic consumer brands like Autotrader and Kelley Blue Book and industry-leading dealer-facing companies like vAuto and Manheim, all while enjoying the people-centered atmosphere that is central to our life at Cox. Benefits of working at Cox may include health care insurance (medical, dental, vision), retirement planning (401(k)), and paid days off (sick leave, parental leave, flexible vacation/wellness days, and/or PTO). For more details on what benefits you may be offered, visit our benefits page. Cox is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer – All qualified applicants/employees will receive consideration for employment without regard to that individual’s age, race, color, religion or creed, national origin or ancestry, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, physical or mental disability, veteran status, genetic information, ethnicity, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law.   • Engineer, implement, and administer enterprise PAM and PSM solutions

  • Support investigations involving privileged credentials and elevated access
  • Partner with Security, Risk, and Compliance teams to satisfy audit and regulatory requirements

  • Minimum of 5+ years of professional experience with Identity and Access Management solutions (PAM, ILM, IGM, etc.)
  • Minimum of 5+ years of professional experience with Microsoft Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID
  • Minimum of 5+ years of fundamental experience in DDI, networking, firewall, server, and cloud technologies
  • Minimum of 5+ years of hands-on experience in Windows PowerShell, with ability to develop scripts as need
  • Experience in complex enterprises with a diverse array of unique authentication / authorization requirements

Tool & Technology Skills

  • IAM solutions such as Active Directory, VDS, SSO, SAML, oAuth, OpenID, MFA, and PAM
  • Identity Lifecycle Management and Governance tools (MIM, SailPoint, Saviynt, ForgeRock)
  • Cloud Identity technologies, including Microsoft Azure, Amazon AWS, and Google Cloud
  • Microsoft Mail Services (Exchange Server, as well as Microsoft O365)
  • SharePoint for O365, Microsoft Teams, and OneDrive administration
  • Automation, such as PowerShell, Perl, Python, or .NET development languages
  • AuthX Support for Windows Server, as well as Linux Server
  • Mergers & Acquisitions involving Active Directory and Azure
  • Working in GxP or other regulated environments
  • Documentation for systems management and compliance purposes

Preferred PAM / PSM Skills

  • Experience implementing and administering CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Delinea, ARCON, or similar PAM platforms
  • Experience with Privileged Session Management including session monitoring, recording, and audit controls
  • Credential vaulting and privileged account lifecycle management
  • Just-in-Time access and least-privilege administration models
  • Zero Trust security principles and privileged access governance

Benefits

These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full-time or part-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $81,000 - $110,000 annually, and will be based on a number of additional factors including skills, experience, and education.

The Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Managing Director — Motor Gear Trader (MGT)

Company overview

Motor Gear Trader (MGT) is building a modern marketplace and trading platform for the motor gear ecosystem—helping recreational enthusiasts buy and sell pre-owned vehicles and gear with ease. MGT supports key categories including ATVs, Dirt Bikes, Go-Karts, Personal Watercraft (PWC), Racing Bikes, and Snowmobiles, with a simple flow to browse listings, post listings, connect with buyers/sellers, and leave reviews.

MGT operates within Estoras Group and aligns to Estoras’ operating standards: performance, accountability, and disciplined execution.

Role summary

The Managing Director owns the end-to-end business: launch readiness, revenue, operations, product execution, and (where applicable) investor outcomes. This is a builder/operator role—someone who can take MGT from beta → launch → scale, while recruiting and leading a high-performing team and ensuring the platform and go-to-market motion match real customer demand.

This role reports into Estoras Group leadership.

6–12 month outcomes (what success looks like)

Within the first 6–12 months, the Managing Director will:

  • Launch a stable, market-ready platform (post-beta) with clear adoption and retention signals
  • Establish repeatable acquisition channels across buyers/sellers/dealers/partners (based on MGT’s operating model)
  • Build a lean, high-output team (contractor-first where possible) with clear scorecards and accountability
  • Implement operating cadence: weekly KPIs, monthly reporting, and forecast discipline
  • Create investor-ready reporting and a credible scaling plan (fundraising optional depending on strategy)

Core responsibilities

1) Strategic leadership & growth

  • Own and execute the company operating plan: positioning, pricing, GTM, partnerships, and growth targets
  • Translate Estoras Group objectives into measurable quarterly priorities (OKRs / EOS-style rocks)
  • Drive launch readiness across product, operations, marketing, and support
  • Build a roadmap toward scale and (if applicable) future capital events (fund raise / strategic sale)

2) Platform & product execution (beta → launch → scale)

  • Oversee the design, development, and deployment of the MGT platform (beta improvements, launch version, iteration cycles)
  • Ensure product decisions are grounded in customer feedback and marketplace liquidity dynamics
  • Establish lightweight but effective delivery systems:

o Roadmap management and prioritization

o Sprint cadence and delivery rituals

o QA/release process and incident management

o Uptime/support workflows and vendor SLAs

  • Partner with technical leads and vendors to deliver outcomes on time and within constraints

3) Operational management & performance

  • Run day-to-day operations with a focus on speed, quality, and profitability
  • Build and maintain core operating infrastructure:

o KPI dashboards and weekly reporting

o Budgeting, forecasting, and cost controls

o Vendor management and contract oversight

o Risk management and compliance awareness relevant to marketplace operations

  • Own P&L accountability (or build toward it as revenue ramps)

4) Team leadership & talent development

  • Recruit, onboard, and lead a high-performing team across:

o Product / engineering (internal or vendor-managed)

o Sales / partnerships

o Customer success / support

o Ops / admin (as needed)

  • Make key personnel decisions (hiring, compensation, performance management) aligned with Estoras Group policies
  • Build a performance culture: clear expectations, scorecards, feedback loops, and accountability

5) Customer, partner, and stakeholder relationships

  • Build strong relationships with customers and key supply-side stakeholders (dealers, distributors, partners)
  • Own customer satisfaction, retention, and escalation management
  • Develop strategic partnerships that accelerate liquidity and trust in the platform
  • Manage investor communications (where applicable): updates, transparency, metrics, and narrative

6) Project & change management

  • Deliver cross-functional initiatives on time, within budget, and to spec

· Maintain clear documentation:

o Project plans and milestones

o Status reports and risk logs

o Change requests and decision records

  • Resolve conflicts quickly and professionally—internally and externally

Requirements

Required skills (top 10)

  • Marketplace operations & liquidity management (balancing supply/demand, category focus, activation loops)
  • Go-to-market execution (channel testing, acquisition funnels, conversion optimization)
  • Product leadership (roadmap prioritization, translating customer feedback into shipped outcomes)
  • Technical fluency (working effectively with engineers/vendors; understanding modern platform constraints)
  • Operational cadence & KPI management (weekly dashboards, metric definitions, accountability rhythms)
  • Financial management (budgeting, forecasting, unit economics, cost control)
  • Vendor and contract management (SOWs, SLAs, delivery governance, performance enforcement)
  • Team leadership and performance management (scorecards, coaching, hiring/firing decisions)
  • Customer success and escalation management (retention, support workflows, trust-building)
  • Executive stakeholder communication (board/investor-ready reporting, narrative, decision memos)

Requirements

Qualifications (must-have)

  • Proven Managing Director/operator experience in a startup, marketplace, platform, or high-growth environment
  • Strong execution track record across operations + product delivery + revenue growth
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams and vendors with clear accountability
  • Strong business fundamentals: budgeting, forecasting, KPI management, cost control
  • Excellent communication skills with customers, partners, and senior stakeholders
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity; bias toward action and measurable outcomes

Preferred / strong assets

  • Fundraising experience (seed/Series A or strategic capital) and investor communications
  • Experience with trading platforms, marketplaces, or multi-sided networks (liquidity, trust, supply/demand dynamics)
  • Familiarity with compliance, risk, and governance expectations in regulated or high-trust industries
  • Experience building contractor-heavy teams and performance-based compensation structures

Benefits

Compensation & ownership structure

This role is structured as a long-term ownership opportunity for an operator who is willing to invest effort to take an existing platform to the next level.

  • Co-ownership / equity participation: The Managing Director will have the opportunity to become a co-owner of the company. The specific ownership structure (e.g., equity, options, profit share, or equivalent) will be discussed and documented during the selection process.
  • Performance-based compensation only: Compensation is strictly performance-based and is triggered only once the business generates profit, per an agreed definition and reporting cadence.
  • No guaranteed salary at start: There is no initial pay and no guaranteed monthly salary until growth and profitability milestones are achieved.
  • Founder investment already made: The founders have already invested in the technology and platform. This role is best suited to candidates focused on long-term ownership and value creation rather than a traditional employee mindset.

The video and audio interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The interpreters translate verbally.

  • High-trust, high-ownership personal support role with direct access to the founder and real room to expand as trust grows

  • Use Claude Cowork and other AI tools as a core part of how tasks are planned and executed

Social Events and Community

jobs.description:
The opportunity

F2 Finance is looking for a proven loan originator who knows the private lending market, have an established network, and can consistently close loans.

We offer a highly competitive base salary and an aggressive, uncapped commission structure designed to reward top performers.

This is not an entry-level position. To be considered, you must have:

  • At least two years of experience as a loan officer
  • Direct experience at a private lender, hard money lender, or bridge lending company
  • A verifiable track record of originating at least $1 million per month

If you do not meet these requirements, please do not apply.

About F2 Finance

F2 Finance is a fast-growing, real estate lender focused on short-term residential bridge loans, fix and flip financing, and other business-purpose real estate loans.

We are a true balance-sheet lender. We control our capital, make credit decisions in-house, and can move quickly when a transaction makes sense. We have substantial capital available for growth and are building a national lending platform for real estate entrepreneurs and investors who value speed, certainty, and direct access to their lender.

This is an opportunity to join an ambitious lender with the capital and appetite to close loans, without the bureaucracy or funding uncertainty found at many other platforms.

The role

You will be responsible for generating new business, developing relationships with borrowers and brokers, and managing opportunities from initial inquiry through closing.

Our preference is for this role to be based in our Santa Monica office. However, we are open to a remote arrangement for an exceptional candidate with a strong production history and the discipline to perform without day-to-day supervision.

Responsibilities

  • Originate short-term bridge, fix and flip, and other business-purpose real estate loans
  • Develop relationships with borrowers, brokers, real estate investors, and referral partners
  • Build and manage a substantial pipeline of prospective loans
  • Work company-generated leads while conducting consistent outbound business development
  • Qualify opportunities against F2 Finance’s credit appetite
  • Structure and present transactions clearly to the credit team
  • Maintain oversight of loans through processing, underwriting, and closing
  • Deliver clear, proactive communication to customers and internal teams
  • Maintain accurate pipeline and relationship information in HubSpot
  • Represent F2 Finance at relevant conferences and industry events

Requirements

You must have:

  • At least two years of experience as a loan officer
  • Direct experience in private lending, hard money, residential bridge lending, or fix and flip finance
  • A verifiable track record of originating at least $1 million per month
  • An established network of relevant borrowers, brokers, investors, or referral sources
  • Strong knowledge of private lending transactions and credit considerations
  • The ability to build, manage, and convert a large pipeline
  • Strong sales, relationship management, and communication skills
  • A disciplined approach to prospecting, follow-up, and CRM management
  • The ability to work autonomously in a fast-moving environment
  • A customer-focused, commercially minded approach
  • Strong work ethic, sound judgment, and a genuine drive to produce results

Experience with HubSpot, Notion, Slack, and Google Workspace would be an advantage.

Remote candidates must also demonstrate a history of high performance in an autonomous environment, with excellent responsiveness and reporting discipline.

What success looks like

A successful originator will:

  • Consistently originate at least $1 million per month, with the expectation of growing beyond that level
  • Build a repeatable pipeline of borrowers and brokers
  • Convert opportunities efficiently while protecting credit quality
  • Take ownership of transactions from initial contact through closing
  • Generate repeat business and become a trusted financing partner to active real estate investors

Benefits

Compensation and benefits

  • Generous base salary
  • Aggressive, uncapped commission and bonus structure
  • Significant earning potential for high performers
  • Medical insurance
  • 401(k) with employer contribution
  • Paid time off
  • Direct access to decision-makers
  • Parking, endless snacks, quality coffee, and regular team lunches for office-based employees

The strongest candidates will receive a package reflecting their production history, relationships, and expected contribution.

We are looking for a Senior Director of Corporate FP&A to join Grafana Labs and help build and scale our Corporate FP&A function as the company enters its next phase of growth.

This is a pivotal leadership role responsible for building the financial infrastructure and operating cadence that power company-wide planning, forecasting, reporting, and decision-making. You will serve as a key partner to Finance, business leaders, and the executive leadership team, translating operating performance into clear financial insights and helping drive fast, informed decisions.   • Own the company-wide Corporate FP&A model and planning processes, including long-range planning, annual planning, monthly forecasting, and consolidated P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow forecasting.

  • Lead the modernization of Finance processes, forecasting methodologies, and planning frameworks through systems, workflow automation, structured data, and AI to improve accuracy, scalability, and the quality of forward-looking insights as the business evolves.
  • Build strong cross-functional relationships with business and functional leaders, serving as a trusted partner on financial performance, resource allocation, and strategic decision-making.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Corporate FP&A leadership experience, ideally in a public-company, newly public, or public-company-readiness environment, with exposure to quarterly close, executive reporting, Board reporting, and other rigorous financial operating cadences.
  • Meaningful experience owning a consolidated P&L, company-wide forecast, and Balance Sheet and Cash Flow forecasting processes.

Compensation & Rewards:

jobs.description:
Foundation and Grants Manager

Position Summary

The Foundation and Grants Manager is responsible for identifying, cultivating, and securing funding opportunities from private and family foundations in support of the Epilepsy Foundation’s mission and strategic priorities.

This position manages the full grant lifecycle, including prospect research, opportunity qualification, proposal development, submission, grant tracking, reporting, stewardship, and renewal. The Foundation and Grants Manager develops compelling and competitive proposals that effectively communicate the Foundation’s impact, programs, priorities, and unique role within the epilepsy and patient advocacy community.

Working collaboratively across the organization, the Foundation and Grants Manager partners with program teams, subject matter experts, Finance, Development, and senior leadership to gather and synthesize information required for complex proposals, reports, and other funder communications.

The Foundation and Grants Manager conducts research and analyzes prospective funders, including historical giving, funding priorities, grantmaking patterns, and trends, to identify high-potential opportunities and determine the strongest approach for engagement. This position also maintains the Foundation’s grant calendar and establishes effective project management and quality review processes to ensure proposals and reports are accurate, compelling, compliant, and submitted on time.

As a key member of the Development team, the Foundation and Grants Manager serves as an internal subject matter expert on foundation fundraising and grant development and contributes to strategies designed to achieve annual fundraising and revenue goals.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Foundation Prospecting & Research – 25%

  • Conduct comprehensive prospect research to identify private and family foundations whose funding priorities align with the Epilepsy Foundation’s mission, programs, and strategic initiatives.

  • Analyze prospective funders’ historical giving, grantmaking priorities, funding patterns, eligibility requirements, and trends to assess fit and likelihood of success.

  • Identify, qualify, and prioritize high-potential grant opportunities.

  • Provide recommendations to Development leadership and internal partners regarding prospective funding opportunities and engagement strategies.

  • Research and recommend tools, resources, and platforms that strengthen foundation prospecting and grant research capabilities.

Grant Development & Proposal Management – 45%

  • Lead the planning, development, writing, editing, and submission of compelling grant proposals, letters of inquiry, applications, and other funding requests to private and family foundations.

  • Partner with program teams, subject matter experts, Finance, Development, and senior leadership to gather programmatic, financial, and organizational information required for grant submissions.

  • Translate complex programmatic and organizational information into clear and persuasive narratives tailored to funder interests and requirements.

  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive grants calendar to manage proposal deadlines, reporting requirements, renewals, and other key milestones.

  • Establish and maintain quality-control processes to ensure proposals are accurate, complete, compelling, and compliant with funder requirements.

  • Take ownership of the final submission process, ensuring all required materials are completed accurately and submitted on time.

Grant Management, Reporting & Stewardship – 15%

  • Manage post-award requirements for secured grants, including deliverables, reporting deadlines, program outcomes, and stewardship activities.

  • Partner with Finance and program teams to monitor grant budgets, expenditures, and compliance with funding requirements.

  • Prepare timely and accurate interim and final reports, stewardship communications, and other funder updates.

  • Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with foundation representatives and other grantmaking decision-makers.

  • Identify renewal and continued funding opportunities and develop strategies to strengthen long-term funder relationships.

CRM, Tracking & Operations – 15%

  • Maintain accurate and timely foundation and grant records within Salesforce CRM.

  • Track prospect activity, proposals, awards, reporting requirements, deadlines, funder communications, and other relevant grant activity.

  • Develop and continuously improve grant tracking, project management, and reporting processes.

  • Maintain accurate documentation to support institutional knowledge, grant compliance, and fundraising strategy.

  • Utilize data and performance metrics to evaluate grant activity, pipeline health, and progress toward fundraising goals.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree required.

Experience

  • Minimum of 2–3 years of professional grant writing and grant management experience, preferably within a nonprofit, human health, healthcare, or patient advocacy organization.

  • Minimum of two years of demonstrated experience identifying, researching, and qualifying foundation funding opportunities.

  • Demonstrated experience developing and submitting competitive proposals to private and/or family foundations.

  • Experience managing multiple grants through the full grant lifecycle, including proposal development, award management, reporting, stewardship, and renewal.

  • Experience with grant prospecting, research, and tracking tools.

  • Experience using Salesforce or a comparable CRM/donor management platform preferred.

  • Experience collaborating with programmatic and finance teams on grant budgets, outcomes, and reporting.

  • Demonstrated understanding of nonprofit fundraising principles, grantmaking practices, and foundation relations.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Exceptional grant writing, editing, research, and storytelling skills.

  • Strong ability to translate complex programmatic information, data, and outcomes into clear and compelling funder communications.

  • High level of attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and quality.

  • Strong research and analytical skills, including the ability to assess funder alignment and funding potential.

  • Excellent organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple proposals, deadlines, and competing priorities simultaneously.

  • Ability to independently manage projects from initial research through final submission and reporting.

  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.

  • Excellent written, verbal, and cross-functional communication skills.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues, subject matter experts, senior leadership, and external partners.

  • Strong time management, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

  • Demonstrated initiative, accountability, and ownership of assigned responsibilities.

  • Ability to exercise sound judgment and maintain strict confidentiality.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and the ability to quickly learn new technology platforms.

  • Knowledge of basic nonprofit budgeting and financial principles related to grant management.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities.

Travel & Work Environment

  • This is a full-time position working 35 hours per week.

  • Occasional evening or weekend work may be required based on organizational needs, meetings, events, or grant deadlines.

  • This position is expected to participate in Foundation meetings, trainings, and other organizational activities as required.

  • This position requires travel to mandatory Foundation events and meetings, as well as additional travel as needed to support business and organizational priorities

Other Duties

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications associated with the position. Responsibilities may be modified or assigned based on the needs of the organization.

jobs.description:
About our Client:

Alterity Therapeutics is a dual-listed, late-stage clinical biotechnology company focused on developing disease-modifying treatments for rare and debilitating neurodegenerative disorders

About the Role:

The Scientific Documentation Specialist provides cross-functional scientific documentation support to help ensure the accuracy, completeness, consistency, traceability, and accessibility of Alterity’s scientific and regulated documentation.

The role combines scientific document quality control and source verification with document and information management activities. Based within Regulatory Affairs and Quality Assurance, the role works across Clinical, Nonclinical and Chemistry, Manufacturing and Controls (CMC) to organize and maintain documentation, verify information against designated source materials, and support regulatory submissions, audits, inspections and due diligence.

Priorities will be agreed with the line manager in consultation with functional leads. The breadth and focus of responsibilities will evolve based on program priorities, organizational needs, and demonstrated capabilities. Position reports to VP, Regulatory Affairs and Quality Assurance.

Key Responsibilities

Scientific Documentation and Quality Control

  • Perform documented QC of clinical, nonclinical, CMC and regulatory documents using established procedures and checklists.
  • Verify numerical values, units, tables, figures, references and factual statements against designated source reports, datasets, approved outputs or supporting records.
  • Review related documents for consistency of study information, terminology, data, document identifiers and scientific content.
  • Check formatting, numbering, terminology, cross-references, references and document versions.
  • Record discrepancies and queries, coordinate resolution with authors and subject-matter experts, and track corrections to closure.
  • Support source verification of information incorporated into regulatory submission documents and other key development records.

Document Management and Systems

  • Organize, classify and maintain scientific, regulatory and quality documentation in SharePoint, Veeva and other designated document repositories.
  • Coordinate implementation and improvement of document filing structures, naming conventions, metadata and workflows with Regulatory/QA, functional leads, IT and system providers.
  • Support document-management and filing-system implementation activities, including requirements gathering, document organization, migration, reconciliation and user guidance.
  • Coordinate receipt and migration of records from CROs, manufacturers, consultants and legacy repositories.
  • Reconcile document inventories and verify completeness, appropriate classification and successful transfer.
  • Maintain document registers and trackers and identify missing, duplicate, superseded or incorrectly filed records for resolution with document owners.
  • Support appropriate version control, review, approval, retrieval and archiving practices.

Cross-Functional Coordination and Readiness

  • Work with Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Clinical, Nonclinical and CMC teams to support documentation needs and agreed program priorities.
  • Coordinate document review and approval cycles and follow up on outstanding inputs and deliverables.
  • Prepare and retrieve document packages for regulatory submissions, audits, inspections and due diligence, maintaining traceability to approved source records.
  • Maintain practical QC checklists, filing guides, templates and work instructions.
  • Support user onboarding and consistent document-management practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve document quality, traceability, accessibility and efficiency.

Education and Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, biomedical sciences, chemistry, pharmacology or a related scientific discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience working accurately with scientific reports, technical documents or research data through industry, research, internships or substantial academic work.
  • Ability to understand scientific terminology and concepts and to compare information across multiple sources.
  • Ability to identify inconsistencies, discrepancies and potential errors and recognize when review by a functional subject-matter expert is required.
  • Understanding of document control, version management, confidentiality and accurate recordkeeping.
  • Strong written communication, organization, analytical ability and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively across functions.

Preferred

  • One to three years of relevant experience in biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, a CRO or another regulated scientific environment.
  • Experience with scientific document QC, regulatory documentation, controlled records, document management or document migration.
  • Familiarity with clinical, nonclinical, CMC or regulatory submissions.
  • Working knowledge of GCP, GLP and/or GMP and associated documentation and data-integrity principles.

Technical / Software Knowledge

  • Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint
  • Adobe Acrobat
  • SharePoint
  • Veeva Vault or equivalent electronic document management systems
  • Egnyte
  • Smartsheet
  • R - asset
  • SAS - asset

Working Relationships and Accountability

  • The Scientific Documentation Specialist works closely with Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Clinical, Nonclinical, CMC, medical writers and external service providers.
  • The role performs scientific document QC, source verification and document-management activities within an agreed scope and with appropriate training and subject-matter support.
  • Scientific interpretation, technical decisions and final content approval remain the responsibility of the appropriate functional experts.
  • System ownership, access administration, configuration and validation remain with designated system owners; the Scientific Documentation Specialist supports and coordinates document organization, implementation and operational activities.

Expected Outcomes

  • Scientific and regulated documents are consistently organized, readily retrievable and identifiable by current status and version.
  • Data, references and factual information are appropriately verified against designated source materials.
  • QC findings and source discrepancies are documented, traceable and resolved before document finalization.
  • Cross-functional teams receive reliable scientific documentation support within agreed timelines.
  • Document repositories and filing practices support regulatory, quality, development and business-readiness needs.

Location: Remote- US-based candidates

Pay Range (based on National Average): $45.00-50.00 per hour.

Benefits include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance

jobs.excerpt: Join a team that’s transforming mental healthcare.
jobs.description:
Join a team that’s transforming mental healthcare. Founded by psychiatrists, Headlight is more than a company: it’s a movement. A movement that exists on the front lines of the mental health crisis, transforming the way people access care and the way clinicians deliver it. In order to help people in their time of need and ensure that every person who comes to us has options, we are transparent about our capabilities, treatments, and coverage, we champion innovation, and we leverage our rich data to continuously implement better ways of delivering care. Our mission is simple but powerful: Improving lives, one session at a time.
Our highly skilled and principled clinical team enjoys autonomy and institutional support so they can put their focus where it should be: on improving patient outcomes. Our clinicians want to do more than help individual clients, so they work to affect the system as a whole, elevating standards of care so that their efforts reverberate far beyond what they could do in private practice.
As the most trusted behavioral health partner in the Western U.S., we’ve established deep relationships that give us unparalleled access, interoperability, and first-priority referrals. This exclusivity, combined with our best-in-class coordinated care and feedback loops, results in superior outcomes and cost savings.
Our services are convenient, accessible, and expert, combining personalized client engagement with advanced technology to enhance, not replace, human connection. Indeed, we hold that human-to-human relationships are indispensable, so from the match to the session to the time between sessions, we provide whole person care so nobody falls through the cracks and there is a brighter path forward for all.
The Care Access Specialist II serves in a critical role as the first person a patient connects with when seeking care at Headlight Health. In this role, the Specialist helps patients feel welcomed, heard, and supported as they begin their care journey.
Care Access Specialists are a non-clinical role. Care Access Specialist facilitate access to care, provide peer informed support within the scope of their training, and follow established escalation protocols. Care Access Specialist do not diagnose, independently assess clinical acuity, provide treatment recommendations, deliver psychotherapy, or replace the judgment of licensed clinical professionals.
The Care Access Specialist II provides clear, compassionate guidance about Headlight Health’s services, responds to patient questions, confirms service eligibility, and coordinates appropriate clinician matching. Through empathy, patience, and persistence, the Specialist supports patients through scheduling, onboarding documentation, and related administrative steps to promote a smooth, reassuring transition into care.

Our Pillars

  • Make things easier.
  • Forge genuine connections.
  • Elevate the standard.

Responsibilities

    Own the Outcome

  • Take accountability for connecting each person to care. Success is a kept first appointment, not simply a scheduled appointment
  • Close the loop on every opportunity by proactively following up and re-engaging people who have not yet started care
  • Respond to new opportunities quickly, with a standard of first outreach within five minutes

    • Engage and Guide

  • Meet people where they are in their care journey and provide the right combination of information, reassurance, guidance, and encouragement to help them move forward
  • Build supportive, engaging relationships with people who reach out directly or are referred by a healthcare provider, introducing them to Headlight Health’s mental healthcare services
  • Create a positive and reassuring experience for people taking the step of seeking mental health support
  • Facilitate access to client care with the appropriate Headlight clinician based on client specific needs; schedule appointment needs, gather accurate information, and determine the appropriate next steps.
  • Keep people informed and comfortable throughout the process, addressing questions, concerns, and barriers as they arise

    • Facilitate the Client Lifecycle

  • Own the onboarding process from first contact through the first kept clinical appointment, including scheduling and collection of required intake paperwork, insurance information, and payment method
  • Follow Headlight’s Service Offer Standard and all applicable guidelines when discussing or introducing additional services
  • Oversee the management of new clinicians’ clients who are following them to Headlight including waitlist management and scheduling of services as the Clinician onboarding occurs
  • Coordinate transfers of care when a client needs a new clinician, communicating changes to the client and facilitating the transition to an appropriate provider
  • Connect existing clients with additional Headlight services when recommended by their clinician, coordinating the internal referral and next steps

    • Keep the System Clean

jobs.title: The Health Initiative Senior Director, Health Plans
jobs.excerpt: THE HEALTH INITIATIVESENIOR DIRECTOR, HEALTH PLANSThe ContextIt is well-established that 80% of a person’s health is determined by factors outside the doctor’s office — healthy food, safe housing and a decent income.
jobs.description:
THE HEALTH INITIATIVE

SENIOR DIRECTOR, HEALTH PLANS

The Context

It is well-established that 80% of a person’s health is determined by factors outside the doctor’s office — healthy food, safe housing and a decent income. Yet our healthcare system is built backwards, with more than 99% of US healthcare dollars spent on medical care alone. The amount of money going toward healthcare is huge — with public and private payers spending over $11B on healthcare every day. This is projected to grow 6% annually through the next decade.

But what exactly do we get for all this healthcare spending? Right now, the US has some of the worst health outcomes across all high-income countries, including for preventable heart disease and obesity, which cost the system nearly $500B each year.  This is inefficient and leaves people behind, especially low-income children and families.

Imagine a system designed to pay for health, not simply healthcare. What if it invested dollars more efficiently and effectively to pay for access to nutritious food or safe housing as key levers to prevent and manage disease and lower healthcare costs?

The result would be a win-win-win: Children and adults would have better access to healthy food and safe housing and, as a result, have better health outcomes. When healthier patients use less care, the government saves money – and insurance companies’ revenues increase – incentivizing both to pay for these basics.

The Health Initiative Approach & Impact to Date

The Health Initiative (THI) is a national organization that crosses political divides, taps market forces and activates stakeholders to shift dollars toward health.

By providing strategic guidance and technical assistance, we activate healthcare institutions to redesign their policies and invest preventatively in nutritious food and safe housing— to improve health outcomes for those most at risk and reduce overall healthcare costs. To date, these institutions have spent nearly $1B in healthcare dollars on food, housing and other basics.

For example, THI supported North Carolina to use Medicaid dollars to provide patients with groceries, rental assistance and other basics, keeping them out of the hospital and saving the state a net $1,020 per person per year. CMS incorporated aspects of NC’s approach into its approval process for states to use Medicaid dollars for food and housing benefits and 22 states have enacted key elements of it.

Likewise, THI worked with CMS leadership to lay the foundation for its enacting the first-ever billing codes to pay healthcare providers to screen patients for food, housing, and other basics, and to pay community health workers to navigate patients to these resources.

Finally, with THI’s guidance, three major insurance companies invested over $300M in buying health for their patients and/or their low-wage employees. For example, THI advised a Fortune 50 insurance company on how to increase healthy food and housing benefits by $80M for high-risk patients and to design an evaluation which found that those receiving higher benefits have lower healthcare costs.

Job Purpose

The Senior Director - Health Plans is a key member of the THI Leadership Team and is responsible for engaging health plans with Medicare, Medicaid, Marketplace, and/or commercial members, with the goal of unlocking existing healthcare dollars to invest in healthy food, safe housing, and other drivers of health. This role will be both creative in envisioning how plans can achieve this goal as not just the right, but also the economic thing to do, and persuasive in communicating this approach to others.

The Senior Director - Health Plans may or may not have direct reports but will be responsible for leading a cross-functional team of both THI’s program staff and cross-cutting functions (including research and analytics, communications, and mobilization) to achieve these goals.

This role will also collaborate closely with their peers leading THI’s work to spur federal and state healthcare institutions to invest in drivers of health and to engage philanthropic partners who invest in and champion THI’s work. The position reports to the Chief Operating Officer on an interim basis, and works closely with the Co-Founders and Co-CEOs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead THI’s work to activate health plans to invest in the drivers of health as a core part of the business, by engaging plan leaders to implement this approach, build the business case, and go on the record to build sector momentum.

  • Engage directly – and support other THI leaders to engage – the health plans’ executive, product, actuarial, analytic, communications, government affairs, and drivers of health teams to achieve these goals.

  • Identify key stakeholders and the messages/content/analyses that will compel them to act, including overseeing the development and execution of high-quality deliverables.

  • Define annual and multi-year goals for THI’s work with health plans; create and execute plans to achieve those goals; set and evolve priorities; and manage tradeoffs among them.

  • Direct and develop a high-performing, collaborative team to execute on these goals, including effectively using cross-cutting capabilities such as communications, mobilization, and research and analytics.

  • Support identification and recruitment of potential health plan partners for THI and, as appropriate, secure contractual agreements to enable THI to conduct its work most effectively.

  • Actively participate in the THI Leadership Team to strengthen organization-wide operations and culture.

Key Competencies

  • Deep, first-hand understanding of health plans’ business model, operating context, priorities, culture, and approach to engaging policymakers, members, investors, and other stakeholders.

  • Prior employment at a health plan or in a federal policymaking role with direct engagement of senior health plan leadership.

  • Fluency in Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payment policy required; involvement with bid development for the Medicare Advantage and/or Medicaid markets preferred.

  • Track record of excellence in strategic planning, resource prioritization, and making tradeoffs in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment.

  • Best-in-class at understanding and effectively engaging with others’ motivations, including the ability to know when and how to inspire, challenge, and collaborate, including at the executive level.

  • Ability to understand current constraints; think creatively about how to achieve THI’s objectives within these or to alter them; and persuade others to take action consistent with this approach.

  • Ability and experience influencing outcomes through establishing credibility, building trusting relationships, and persuasive written and oral communication, rather than through formal authority.

  • Experience supporting senior executives/leaders; leading change management efforts in complex environments; and facilitating multi-stakeholder engagements.

  • Experience leading a division or team, ideally with cross-functional team members.

CORE THI ATTRIBUTES AND BEHAVIORS:

  • Commitment to THI’s mission, vision, and values.

  • Continuous improvement mindset; curiosity and eagerness for learning and feedback.

  • Confident in leading with a point of view and recommendations while being open to changing position when necessary.

  • Takes full accountability for functional team goals, deliverables, and team performance amidst change.

  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, work independently and collaboratively, and know when to seek input.

  • Ability and willingness to learn and adapt to THI’s approach to building transformative relationships based on humility, reliability, openness, humor, and confidence.

  • Clear, concise, and compelling communication.

  • Strong prioritization skills and ability to manage multiple projects concurrently with short, medium, and long-term deadlines.

  • Ability to manage up, down, and with peers.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

In addition to a competitive salary, THI also offers a generous, comprehensive benefits package including:

  • Full coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance.

  • Generous 401K matching and parental leave.

  • Unlimited sustainable vacation and sick time.

This is a full-time, exempt role and is fully remote within the US. THI expects staff to work eastern time zone hours. Travel and flexible evening and weekend work expected.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT:

THI is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and encourage all qualified applicants to apply.

Description

Rankings.iois looking for a highly organized, proactive, and client-focused Video Account Manager to join our growing Video Department.

In this role, you'll serve as a key point of contact for clients, ensuring a seamless experience from onboarding through content production, approvals, publishing, and ongoing account management. You'll work closely with our internal video production, creative, and advertising teams to keep projects moving, deadlines on track, and clients informed every step of the way.

We're looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates with confidence, and doesn't wait to be told what needs to happen next. You should be comfortable managing multiple client accounts, juggling competing priorities, and following through until the job is done.

Responsibilities

Client Onboarding & Account Setup

  • Own the client onboarding process, ensuring a smooth and professional experience from day one.

  • Coordinate welcome calls, account connection meetings, and onboarding follow-ups.

  • Communicate onboarding requirements, next steps, and outstanding action items to clients.

  • Set up and maintain client accounts, project boards, and communication channels in ClickUp and Slack.

  • Coordinate account connections, securely manage client-provided credentials, and prepare standardized AI prompt documents.

  • Ensure all onboarding requirements are completed before video content is ready for publication.

Video Content Coordination & Approvals

  • Serve as the primary liaison between clients and internal teams throughout the video content review and approval process.

  • Notify clients when videos are ready for review and ensure they have access to the appropriate platforms.

  • Proactively follow up on outstanding feedback, revisions, and approvals to prevent production delays.

  • Coordinate with internal teams to initiate content publishing once approvals are received.

  • Keep clients informed of publishing timelines and confirm when their content goes live.

Paid Advertising Coordination

  • Facilitate client review and approval of video advertisements and lead generation forms.

  • Track outstanding approvals and follow up to keep advertising campaigns on schedule.

  • Communicate campaign launch updates and coordinate post-launch check-in calls.

  • Partner with internal advertising teams to ensure client requests, feedback, and next steps are clearly communicated.

Ongoing Client Account Management

  • Manage day-to-day client communications through Slack, email, and scheduled meetings.

  • Build strong client relationships through responsiveness, professionalism, and consistent follow-through.

  • Prepare client meeting notes, document action items, and communicate important updates to internal stakeholders.

  • Maintain accurate project timelines, client deliverables, upcoming shoot dates, and account information in ClickUp.

  • Proactively identify potential delays, outstanding client needs, and opportunities to improve the client experience.

  • Coordinate across departments to ensure client expectations are understood and deliverables remain on track.

Account Status & Offboarding

  • Maintain accurate client account statuses, including onboarding, active, offboarding, and inactive accounts.

  • Coordinate client offboarding requests and communicate necessary next steps to internal teams.

  • Track offboarding deliverables and ensure all outstanding requirements are completed.

Requirements

  • Experience in account management, client success, project coordination, or a similar client-facing role.

  • Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple client accounts and deadlines simultaneously.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with confidence communicating directly with clients.

  • A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

  • Ability to follow up consistently, manage competing priorities, and keep projects moving without constant oversight.

  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate client records and project documentation.

  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with multiple internal stakeholders.

  • Experience with project management platforms such as Monday, Asana, ClickUp, or similar tools.

  • Proficiency with Slack, email, and virtual meeting platforms.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working at a digital marketing agency, video production company, or creative agency.

  • Familiarity with video production workflows, content approval processes, and social media publishing.

  • Exposure to paid digital advertising campaigns and lead generation.

  • Experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously.

  • Familiarity with the legal marketing industry.

Benefits

  • Salary Range of $60k - $70k

  • Fully Remote

  • Unlimited PTO

  • $100 Wellness Reimbursement Program

  • Quarterly training stipend for Professional Development

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer match (Safe Harbor)

  • 100% Employer-Paid Health Insurance (For Employee)

What to Expect in the Interview Process

  1. Resume Review: Applications and resumes are reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team.

  2. One Way Interview: Selected candidates will receive a link to answer a short set of questions by video. Please plan to record your responses in your typical work-from-home environment, ensuring it is well-lit and free of distractions.

  3. Live Zoom Interview:Candidates who move forward will meet with Talent Acquisition and the Hiring Manager for a live Zoom interview to discuss experience, role expectations, and team fit.

jobs.description:
NOTE: This is a FULLY remote role, but the candidate must be within LOCATION to collaborate with their team, peers, and internal customers. You do not have to be in the specific country or city shown in this listing, but please only apply if you are physically based within LOCATION.

Trusted by 20,000+ property managers worldwide, Hostaway is an industry leading, AI-powered vacation rental management platform designed for professional short-term rental operators. Hostaway brings everything together for greater efficiency and faster growth.

Profitable, high-growth, and the first short-term rental PMS unicorn 🦄. Join us at our most exciting stage yet! Learn more about our recent valuation and story here.

About the role

Hostaway is looking for its first Product Analytics leader, someone to own how we choose what to build, and to prove what it delivered. This role is about setting the standards and building the tools that help teams move faster with confidence. You'll define what good looks like, set the standards for how we measure, and bring the whole product organization along with you.

You'll work alongside our product leaders, who decide which bets we make, helping make sure the evidence behind them is solid. In a company leaning hard into AI, you'll also work out what measurement even means when the AI, not the human, is doing the work. It's a rare chance to be first: to shape the processes, metrics and KPIs, in a fast-growing, profitable, AI-first company with low bureaucracy and little hierarchy. Your work will make the impact of everyone around you visible.

Reporting directly to the Chief Product Officer, this is a hands-on role where you will write SQL, build analyses, and mentor others rather than purely manage. While Data Engineering oversees the data pipelines, warehouse, and central architecture, you will own the product measurement layer on top, maintaining a dotted-line partnership with the CTO.

Your Mission

  • Set the product measurement standard: what counts as an active, adopting customer, and how every analysis gets segmented.

  • Bring measurement into planning early, so every product requirements document includes sizing, an expected metric impact and a measurement plan.

  • Design measurement where clean A/B tests aren't available, and redefine it for an AI-native product where activity metrics no longer tell the full story.

  • Bring numbers to investment decisions, and grow metrics fluency so product managers can bring their own numbers to reviews.

  • Set the technical standards and build the function: tracking plans, instrumentation specs, data quality, starting with an experienced product analyst.

  • Stay close to the work. You'll remain hands-on day to day, writing queries and building analyses yourself rather than only directing others.

Requirements

  • 8+ years in product analytics, ideally in B2B SaaS at a scaling stage. We're open to strong candidates from other product backgrounds too.

  • Strong data foundations. You know how to design clean, reliable data models together with Data Engineering, and how to set up event tracking that stays consistent across features and domains. Experience with SQLMesh is a plus. You use AI tools heavily in your own work and understand where they help and where they mislead.

  • Influence beyond your title. You've disagreed with a senior leader about a number, backed it up with evidence, and your definition was still in use six months later. You've helped a company move from gut feel to data-led decisions, and you work patiently with product managers to find what fits a company of our size.

  • You build the function, not just run it. You've set up analytics operating models rather than inherited them. You can build business models that hold up to a finance leader's scrutiny, and you can show what actually worked: designing fair comparisons in a complex B2B product and being honest about what a number does and does not prove.

Nice to have

  • Measuring AI features, automated workflows or API usage; product-led growth; churn modeling; platform businesses with more than one user type (ours are property managers and their guests); travel, hospitality or property technology.

This role probably isn't for you if...

  • You see analytics as a service desk, waiting for tickets to come in.

  • You're a dashboard specialist. Dashboards are an output; the real work is changing how decisions get made.

  • You've only worked in large, mature data organizations, where the frameworks and teams were already established.

  • You need a formal title to have influence.

What we offer

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive pay based on market rates in the country of the applicant.

  • 100% Remote: Enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere within your country of residence—be it a co-working space, your home office, or even your dining room table. The choice is yours. Just don’t ask to work in our office (we don’t have one).

  • Equity: Every role in our company comes with valuable stock options in a fast-growing and profitable company. This ensures we all share in the company’s success.

  • Values-Driven Leadership: Our Core Values are not just words we’ve written to make us feel good. We leverage them daily when making strategic and tactical decisions.

  • Professional Growth: Our rapid growth offers unparalleled learning and development opportunities, along with a multitude of career advancement opportunities.

  • Annual Paid Leave: The specific amounts vary by country and are aligned with country and/or contract-specific norms.

  • Geographic Specific Benefits: As an international employer, we offer different country-specific benefits such as Health Insurance and Pensions in countries where these perks are customary. The specifics depend on the country of the applicant.

  • Dynamic Team Culture: As a global company with team members in over 40 countries, our diverse and international culture fuels our innovation and creativity, providing a key pillar to our success (and making it a lot of fun to work here).

Thank you for your interest. If you apply for this role, you will receive an email from our Talent Acquisition team after your application has been reviewed alongside the qualifications for this role and the qualifications of others who have applied.

jobs.excerpt: Marcus Evans is a global leader in business intelligence, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities.
jobs.description:
Marcus Evans is a global leader in business intelligence, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities. With over four decades of experience and teams of highly experienced professionals across 50+ office locations, we deliver impactful strategic insight and business development guidance across all sectors through high-level summits, conferences, online platforms, performance coaching, and curated corporate event programmes. Based in 30+ countries, we create services that connect decision-makers, spark innovation, and drive real business growth.

ME Perform is the performance improvement consultancy of the Marcus Evans Group. We work differently from most of the training market: we diagnose what is actually holding an organisation's people back, design a programme specifically for them, deliver it over months rather than days, and measure whether behaviour genuinely changed, then hand the client written evidence of what improved. Because the design work is done in-house by our Programme Scientists, our trainers get something rare: a fully built, properly researched session, briefed to them in advance, delivered to a cohort who have already been diagnosed and who are expecting to work rather than watch.

Job Summary

You will deliver live sessions, typically 90 to 150 minutes, mostly online, working from a session design and a written brief prepared for you by the Programme Scientist.

This is a delivery role, and deliberately so. You are not asked to write content, find clients, or sell anything. You are asked to be outstanding in the room. Based on the seniority and ability of the applicant there will also be an opportunity extend this role to a follow-up coach with the same group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver live sessions to our designed structure, to a consistently high standard.

  • Prepare from the written brief you receive at least five working days before each session — preparation time is paid within the session fee.

  • Run structured practice: our sessions are built around participants doing the thing, not listening to it explained. Expect to spend much of each session facilitating small-group work, giving feedback, and coaching in the moment.

  • Manage the room — including the sceptical senior participant, the quiet group, and the one who wants to debate rather than practise.

  • Submit brief written session notes within 48 hours of every session, so the Programme Scientist can adjust what comes next.

  • Take part in accreditation before your first client session, and stay open to observation and feedback afterwards.

Qualifications

Essential

  • 5-10 years of substantial experience in facilitating live learning or development sessions for professional or managerial audiences in a corporate setting.

  • Genuinely strong online delivery — confident running breakout groups, keeping cameras on and energy up, and handling the mechanics without it disrupting the session.

  • Comfortable delivering material you did not write, to a structure you are asked to keep to. This is the single most important requirement of the role.

  • Skilled at running practice and giving direct, useful feedback to adults — rather than presenting.

  • Reliable on the administrative side: punctual, responsive, and consistent with session notes.

  • Fluent, credible professional English, and comfortable with senior audiences.

Desirable

  • Experience in one or more of: leadership and management development, communication and influence, collaboration, resilience and change, or working across cultures.

  • A coaching qualification, or experience delivering one-to-one as well as group work.

  • Additional languages, or experience delivering to international cohorts working in a second language.

  • Familiarity with evidence-based learning design — you do not need to be a researcher, but you should be interested in why a session is built the way it is.

How the engagement works

  • Paid accreditation first: a methodology induction, then you deliver a full session for our Programme Scientist to observe, paid at half the standard session fee. Accreditation is completed before any client-facing work.

  • You are then briefed and booked per session. Fees are paid per session with preparation included, invoiced on delivery, on 30-day terms.

  • Standard contract terms apply, including confidentiality, intellectual property assignment for anything created in connection with the work, and non-solicitation of our clients. These are shared in full before accreditation.

  • If a client cancels at short notice, you are protected: cancellations inside five working days are paid in full.

Marcus Evans is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

Who You'll Work With
Operating right where hardware meets software, the Platform team builds the foundation for our networking ASICs and supporting infrastructure. PCIe software engineers write the code that manages high speed communication between hardware components in our switches. We work with hardware, diagnostics, and software engineers to maximize bandwidth and improve reliability on the PCIe links.

As part of this team, you’ll work on projects like:

  • Bringing up pcie links on new hardware designs
  • Tuning pcie parameters on root ports, bridges, and end points
  • Modifying the linux pci drivers and virtual memory allocation
  • Using AER and DPC to improve error visibility and resiliency
  • Developing userspace software that mediate between networking ASICs, FPGAs, and PCIe bridges.
  • Measuring hardware read and write performance
  • Develop automated tests using C, C++ and Python to validate your features.
  • Strong engineering and Computer Science fundamentals.
  • 8+ years fluency in C or C++. Python experience an added bonus.
  • Solid understanding of PCIe hardware and software drivers
