jobs.description:
Position Summary:


Zoetis is seeking a CIAM & IDAM Services & Enablement Lead to join our Tech & Digital organization within Information Security.

The global Identity, Directory & Access Management (IDAM) team is responsible for ensuring the right individuals have the right access to the right information across Zoetis’ digital ecosystem.


In this role, you will lead the Customer Identity & Access Management (CIAM) function while serving as a trusted advisor and advocate for Identity & Access Management best practices across the organization. Leveraging SAP Customer Data Cloud (CDC/Gigya), you will oversee B2B and B2C identity services including registration, consent management, authentication, sign-on, and password management across global web properties and mobile applications.


This is a leadership-focused role that combines CIAM platform ownership, identity strategy, technical solution design, stakeholder enablement, and team/vendor leadership. The ideal candidate brings broad knowledge across the IDAM landscape, including CIAM, Identity Governance & Administration (IGA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), PKI, and directory services, along with the ability to translate complex identity concepts into practical solutions for both technical and business audiences.


Key Responsibilities:

CIAM Platform Leadership & Operations

  • Lead the Customer Identity function and oversee the availability, reliability, and ongoing operation of the SAP Customer Data Cloud (CDC/Gigya) platform.
  • Manage the roadmap and strategic direction for B2C and B2B external Identity & Access Management solutions.
  • Partner with business stakeholders, technologists, application owners, and external partners to translate business requirements into scalable identity solutions.
  • Support the onboarding and integration of applications leveraging the CIAM platform.
  • Lead platform enhancements, including advanced logging and reporting, form standardization, security improvements, and user experience enhancements.
  • Oversee global platform rollouts, ensuring solutions meet scalability, performance, security, and business requirements.
  • Lead QA, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and deployment validation activities.
  • Manage Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and ensure operational expectations are consistently met.
  • Lead incident response for platform disruptions, including stakeholder communications, root cause analysis, remediation, and preventive actions.
  • Ensure CIAM services align with applicable corporate policies and privacy requirements, including GDPR and CCPA.

IDAM Consulting & Enablement:

  • Serve as a trusted advisor on Identity & Access Management, establishing and promoting standards for security, data governance, and user experience.
  • Consult with business units, project teams, and technology partners to assess identity and access requirements and recommend appropriate IDAM solutions.
  • Drive adoption of enterprise identity standards and help teams integrate security-first and identity-aware principles into solution design.
  • Develop and deliver best-practice guides, reference architectures, training materials, and other enablement resources.
  • Present identity strategies, solutions, and recommendations to a broad range of stakeholders, including executive leadership.
  • Build strong relationships across business and technology teams while fostering a collaborative, flexible, and client-focused culture.

Technical Design & Engineering:

  • Design and implement IAM solutions that meet business and security requirements, including architectures for application and data integration.
  • Troubleshoot issues and reengineer identity processes and interfaces to improve reliability and efficiency.
  • Develop and maintain tools, scripts, workflows, and automation that support identity processes and anomaly detection.
  • Lead large-scale technical initiatives from solution design and planning through implementation and post-launch support.
  • Drive continuous improvement based on operational data, platform performance, security requirements, and business needs.

People & Vendor Leadership:

  • Lead a growing team of direct reports and oversee approximately 10 Managed Service Provider (MSP) consultants.
  • Coordinate projects involving Zoetis India Capability Center (ZICC) colleagues, onshore teams, and MSP resources.
  • Manage relationships with technology vendors and partners, including SAP/Gigya and SailPoint, to support platform performance and issue resolution.
  • Oversee project and contract resources to ensure deliverables meet quality, budget, and timeline expectations.
  • Provide strategic direction to cross-functional teams including cloud operations, cybersecurity, web development, data analytics, and marketing.

Education & Experience:

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

Preferred

  • Advanced degree or relevant industry certifications, such as: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP) Comparable security, identity, or cloud certifications

Technical & Leadership Qualifications:

This is primarily a leadership and enablement role. Hands-on technical experience is valuable, but the primary focus is on platform leadership, solution strategy, stakeholder influence, and delivery.


The ideal candidate will bring:

  • Deep expertise in Customer Identity & Access Management (CIAM), ideally with SAP Customer Data Cloud (CDC/Gigya).
  • Strong knowledge of authentication and authorization protocols, including OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, and LDAP, as well as risk-based authentication.
  • Experience integrating CIAM platforms with enterprise applications such as CRM, e-commerce, billing, and learning management systems.
  • Strong understanding of IAM capabilities and technologies, including Identity Governance, federated sign-on, privileged access, PKI, and directory services.
  • Familiarity with IAM platforms such as SailPoint IIQ and Oracle Identity Manager.
  • Experience managing platform scalability, availability, performance, upgrades, and feature rollouts.
  • Knowledge of privacy and compliance requirements, including GDPR and CCPA.
  • Strong incident management and remediation experience, including root cause analysis, impact assessment, workaround identification, and data remediation.
  • Experience working with REST APIs, ETL processes, and other integration technologies.
  • Familiarity with web and infrastructure technologies including CMS, DNS, JavaScript, CSS, HTML, and HTTPS.
  • Understanding of data governance and data quality principles.
  • Familiarity with analytical tools such as SQL, Power BI, Alteryx, Tableau, Microsoft Excel, and Access.
  • Experience working within Agile/Scrum development environments.
  • Familiarity with collaboration and information-sharing platforms such as SharePoint, Jira, and Confluence.
  • PowerShell and Secret Server experience is preferred.
  • Strong vendor management experience, including oversight of MSPs and third-party technology partners.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and lead effectively within a global, matrixed organization.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English.

Position Requirements:

  • Office-based or remote leadership role with standard working conditions.
  • Ability to work during core business hours, with flexibility to support global time zones and occasional off-hours needs related to critical incidents or executive meetings.
  • Ability to travel up to 20% for global meetings, conferences, or vendor engagements.

26WD101063,Director, Product Management, Platform Trust

Position Overview

This role is accountable for defining what trusted capabilities Autodesk customers need and why they matter, partnering with product and platform organizations that determine how those capabilities are delivered. We are seeking an experienced Director of Product Management to lead the product strategy for Trusted experiences across Autodesk's platform ecosystem. Trust is foundational to every customer experience and every AI-powered workflow we deliver. This role will define the vision, strategy, and priorities for the trust capabilities customers expect and partner with product and platform teams to ensure these capabilities are delivered consistently across Autodesk products. Reporting to the Chief Trust Officer you will partner across Autodesk to influence platform investments and product strategy. You will translate evolving customer expectations, regulatory requirements, and competitive trends into platform investments that strengthen Autodesk's differentiation. This is a highly collaborative, cross-functional leadership role requiring exceptional influence, strategic thinking, and execution across a global organization.


We are open to remote candidates based in the United States and Canada.


Responsibilities

26WD101063,Directeur de la gestion des produits, Confiance dans la plateforme


Aperçu du poste

Le titulaire de ce poste est chargé de définir les fonctionnalités fiables dont les clients d'Autodesk ont besoin et d'expliquer leur importance, en collaboration avec les équipes chargées des produits et des plateformes qui déterminent la manière dont ces fonctionnalités sont mises en œuvre. Nous recherchons un directeur de la gestion des produits expérimenté pour diriger la stratégie produit relative aux expériences de confiance au sein de l’écosystème de plateformes d’Autodesk. La confiance est le fondement de chaque expérience client et de chaque flux de travail basé sur l’IA que nous proposons. Le titulaire de ce poste définira la vision, la stratégie et les priorités concernant les fonctionnalités de confiance attendues par les clients et travaillera en partenariat avec les équipes chargées des produits et des plateformes afin de garantir que ces fonctionnalités soient mises en œuvre de manière cohérente dans l’ensemble des produits Autodesk. Sous la responsabilité du directeur de la confiance (Chief Trust Officer), vous travaillerez en collaboration avec l’ensemble d’Autodesk pour orienter les investissements dans les plateformes et la stratégie produit. Vous traduirez l’évolution des attentes des clients, des exigences réglementaires et des tendances concurrentielles en investissements dans les plateformes qui renforceront la différenciation d’Autodesk. Il s’agit d’un poste de direction hautement collaboratif et transversal, exigeant une influence exceptionnelle, une réflexion stratégique et une capacité d’exécution au sein d’une organisation mondiale.


Nous sommes ouverts aux candidatures à distance provenant des États-Unis et du Canada.


Responsabilités

  • Définir la vision et la stratégie produit à long terme pour les fonctionnalités de confiance et d’IA de confiance au sein de l’écosystème de plateformes d’Autodesk

  • Élaborer des analyses de rentabilité et des stratégies produit fondées sur les études clients, les tendances du marché, l’analyse de la concurrence, l’innovation technologique et l’évolution des exigences réglementaires
  • Assurer la coordination entre les équipes Produit, Ingénierie, Sécurité, Confidentialité, Juridique, Conformité, Réussite client et la direction générale concernant les priorités en matière de confiance et les investissements dans la feuille de route
  • Évaluer en permanence l’évolution du paysage de la sécurité, de la confidentialité, de la résilience et de l’IA afin d’identifier les opportunités stratégiques et les besoins émergents des clients
  • Représenter la stratégie de confiance d’Autodesk auprès des clients professionnels, des partenaires stratégiques et des forums sectoriels

Qualifications minimales

  • Plus de 10 ans d’expérience en gestion de produit ou en gestion de produit de plateforme, y compris la définition d’une stratégie de plateforme couvrant plusieurs produits
  • Expérience dans l’orientation de la stratégie produit au sein de grandes organisations matricielles sans responsabilité directe sur les équipes d’ingénierie

  • Capacité avérée à influencer les parties prenantes de la direction et à favoriser l’alignement entre les organisations techniques et commerciales
  • Grande capacité à concilier les besoins des clients, les priorités commerciales, la complexité technique et les considérations réglementaires
  • Expérience dans l’élaboration de stratégies produit fondées sur les insights clients, l’analyse concurrentielle et les données

  • Expérience dans la présentation de stratégies à la direction et dans l’interaction directe avec les clients professionnels
  • Expérience de travail efficace au sein d’équipes réparties à l’échelle mondiale

Qualifications souhaitées

  • Connaissance des architectures de sécurité modernes, des infrastructures cloud, des systèmes d’identité, de l’ingénierie de la confidentialité ou des cadres de gouvernance de l’IA

At SCA Health, we believe health care is about people – the patients we serve, the physicians we support and the teammates who push us forward. Behind every successful facility, procedure or innovation is a team of 15,000+ professionals working together, learning from each other and living out the mission, vision and values that define our organization.

As part of Optum, SCA Health is redefining specialty care by developing more accessible, patient-centered practice solutions for a network of more than 370 ambulatory surgical centers, over 400 specialty physician practice clinics and numerous labs and surgical hospitals. Our work spans a broad spectrum of services, all designed to support physicians, health systems and employers in delivering efficient, value-based care to patients without compromising quality or autonomy.

What sets SCA Health apart isn’t just what we do, it’s how we do it. Each decision we make is rooted in seven core values:

  • Clinical quality
  • Integrity
  • Service excellence
  • Teamwork
  • Accountability
  • Continuous improvement
  • Inclusion

Our values aren’t empty words – they inform our attitudes, actions and culture. At SCA Health, your work directly impacts patients, physicians and communities. Here, you’ll find opportunities to build your career alongside a team that values your expertise, invests in your success, and shares a common mission to care for patients, serve physicians and improve health care in America.

At SCA Health, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to support your health, well-being, and financial future. Our offerings include medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401k plan with company match, paid time off, life and disability insurance, and more. Please visit, to learn more about our benefits.

Your ideas should inspire change. If you join our team, they will.


Responsibilities

The Senior Director of HRIS provides enterprise functional leadership for the HRIS organization and is accountable for performance, results, and service outcomes through multiple layers of managers, senior professional staff, vendor partners, and cross-functional delivery teams. This role owns the strategy, operating model, governance, roadmap, and execution discipline for a major HR functional area that supports multiple HR disciplines, business stakeholder groups, and markets/sites. The Senior Director translates business and HR strategy into scalable technology priorities, stabilizes and optimizes the current HR technology ecosystem, strengthens data integrity and controls, and builds the capabilities required to support future transformation and platform modernization. This leader directs others to resolve highly complex, cross-functional business problems; aligns HR, IT, People Analytics, HR Operations, HRBPs, COEs, Finance, Operations, and vendor partners around shared priorities; and drives programs that improve platform reliability, reduce manual work, strengthen decision-making, and improve teammate and leader experience across the organization.

Responsibilities:

Core Responsibilities

  • Provide leadership, direction, and accountability for the HRIS function through multiple layers of managers, senior professional staff, offshore resources, and vendor partners, ensuring clear ownership, disciplined execution, measurable outcomes, and mature service delivery across HR platforms and business functions.
  • Develop, translate, and execute the HR Technology strategy and multi-year roadmap across HR functional areas, aligning stabilization, AI enablement, platform optimization, operating model maturity, governance, data integrity, continuous improvement, and future transformation readiness with business priorities.
  • Play a critical role in HR Transformation by leading HR through technology-enabled optimization and its AI journey, developing an HR AI strategy, prioritized roadmap, and governance aligned with enterprise standards to identify, evaluate, and safely deploy high-value use cases and solutions across the organization in partnership with HR leaders, IT, Legal, Compliance, and Information Security.
  • Direct leaders and cross-functional partners to resolve highly complex or unusual business problems that affect multiple HR functions, platforms, stakeholder groups, markets/sites, and operational disciplines.
  • Drive programs that impact broad internal customer and teammate experiences by improving system reliability, configuration discipline, testing, release management, integration controls, documentation, service performance, and overall platform effectiveness.
  • Establish functional governance, intake, prioritization, decision rights, KPIs, dashboards, portfolio routines, and operating cadences that provide visibility into demand, backlog health, cycle time, SLA performance, release readiness, resource capacity, risks, and business outcomes.
  • Own vendor strategy, performance management, delivery accountability, contract standards, renewals, negotiations, SOWs, augmented staffing, and financial stewardship for HR Technology partnerships.
  • Ensure HR technology requirements, configuration, integrations, access, reporting, testing, deployment, controls, audit readiness, security, data governance, and stabilization activities are sustainable across mergers, acquisitions, compliance needs, and enterprise change.

HR Technology Stabilization, Transformation & Capability Building

  • Lead the assessment and redesign of the HRIS organization, including structure, roles, processes, decision rights, leadership layers, partner interfaces, and service expectations, to build a scalable operating model across HRIS, IT, People Analytics, and vendor partners.
  • Translate the future-state vision into short-, medium-, and long-term execution plans with defined objectives, milestones, owners, dependencies, capacity needs, risks, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Build a product-oriented, service-minded HRIS function with clear platform ownership, managed backlogs, release practices, quality standards, support models, and accountability for business and operational results.
  • Direct the development and maturity of core HRIS capabilities, including product ownership, configuration, integrations, QA, data governance, vendor management, production support, portfolio management, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Strengthen offshore and partner delivery models by defining scope, service levels, handoffs, escalation paths, quality controls, documentation standards, and performance expectations for L2/L3 support, QA, reporting, and execution work.
  • Partner as the senior HRIS leader with IT to strengthen architecture, environments, integration patterns, security, controls, release governance, and support models across the existing HR platform ecosystem.
  • Co-lead practical HR data governance with People Analytics by clarifying data definitions, source systems, ownership, lineage, access controls, reporting standards, stewardship routines, and decision-making forums.
  • Ensure HRIS solutions enable reliable executive dashboards, self-service analytics, operational reporting, and future predictive insights by improving upstream data quality, integration design, process consistency, and governance discipline.

Technology Optimizations & Re-Design

  • Create and govern digital transformation readiness plans across multiple markets/sites, including process standardization, data cleanup, integration dependencies, access and security models, documentation, change management, and business engagement ahead of formal implementation activity.
  • Provide senior leadership oversight for integrations across iCIMS, ServiceNow HR Service Delivery, UKG Workforce Management, UKG Payroll/CoreHR, and related platforms, reducing risk, improving data flow, and increasing visibility into issues and dependencies.
  • Identify and sponsor HR platform enhancements that reduce manual work, improve accuracy, strengthen controls, increase scalability, and improve teammate, leader, and HR stakeholder experiences.
  • Translate the HR AI roadmap into governed pilots and scalable solutions by partnering with HR process owners and enterprise stakeholder to prioritize use cases based on business value, feasibility, and risk; establish appropriate data protection, human oversight, testing, and approval checkpoints with enterprise partners; and measure adoption, outcomes, and ongoing performance before expanding deployment.
  • Represent HR Technology in senior cross-functional optimization efforts across HR, IT, Finance, Operations, vendors, and business stakeholders, ensuring HR strategy, dependencies, risks, decisions, funding needs, and change impacts are clearly understood and addressed.

Intake, Staffing Ratios, & Capacity Management

  • Establish and govern demand management and prioritization across the HRIS function through clear intake channels, prioritization criteria, product-line backlogs, quarterly planning routines, and transparent decision-making processes.
  • Define sustainable staffing, capacity, and sourcing models across onshore/offshore resources, build/run work, product ownership, configuration, integrations, QA, reporting, production support, and strategic initiatives.
  • Implement standard tools, templates, documentation practices, dashboards, operating routines, and delivery metrics that improve consistency, visibility, governance, and performance across HR Technology work.
  • Ensure the HRIS roadmap is maintained, governed, socialized, and used as a functional planning mechanism to align resources, sequencing, risks, dependencies, and execution across major HR priorities.

Qualifications

Required

  • 12+ years of progressive HR Technology or enterprise systems leadership experience, including accountability for enterprise HR platforms, integrations, data quality, governance, production support, and technology-enabled process improvement.
  • Demonstrated experience leading managers, senior professional staff, matrixed partners, offshore resources, and vendors through multiple layers of delivery accountability.

  • Strong experience partnering with IT, People Analytics, HR Operations, HRBPs, COEs, Finance, Operations, vendors, and business leaders through clear governance, influence, communication, and disciplined follow-through.

Position Summary

At managed.com, we're a remote-first, global team. We're also AI-first, so finding practical ways to use AI is part of every role here.

As the Senior Talent Acquisition Partner, you will manage recruitment from role intake through offer acceptance and handover to the People Operations team. You will also help improve how we recruit as the company grows. This role reports to the Director of People & Culture.

What you’ll do

  • Partner with hiring managers to clarify the business need, role scope, required skills, compensation range, and interview plan before launching an approved search.
  • Manage multiple searches across technical and non-technical roles, set clear timelines, and keep hiring managers accountable for feedback and decisions.
  • Build candidate pipelines through direct sourcing, referrals, job postings, and relevant professional networks. Adapt your approach to the role and local talent market.
  • Conduct screening interviews, assess candidates against agreed criteria, and help managers use structured interviews and practical assessments.
  • Keep candidates informed, coordinate interviews across time zones, and provide timely follow-up from first contact through the hiring decision.

jobs.title: GZ-Psycholoog / Regiebehandelaar
jobs.excerpt: Wij zoeken een GZ-Psycholoog / Regiebehandelaar binnen een startup GGZ instelling (minimaal 24 uur per week).
jobs.description:
Wij zoeken een GZ-Psycholoog / Regiebehandelaar binnen een startup GGZ instelling (minimaal 24 uur per week).

Wij zijn net even anders en wij werken anders!

Wij bieden jou als GZ-Psycholoog / Regiebehandelaar de vrijheid van een zelfstandige en tegelijkertijd de zekerheid van een vast dienstverband. Werken waar en wanneer je maar wilt en het zelf kunnen bepalen van het behandelschema. Wij doen alles online! Dat betekent dat je locatie onafhankelijk kunt werken. Je zou zelfs voor een periode vanuit je vakantiebestemming kunnen werken.

Als GZ-Psycholoog / Regiebehandelaarbinnen Mindler behandel je voornamelijk volwassenen. Daarnaast vervul je ook de rol van regiebehandelaar voor een of enkele basispsychologen. Je begeleidt hen in het behandelproces van intake en indicatiestelling tot het geven van richting aan de behandeling en de afsluiting.

Wie is Mindler?

Mindler is in 2018 in Zweden opgericht. In 2020 zijn wij in Nederland gestart. Mindler focust zich op het verlenen van kortdurende generalistische GGZ behandelingen. Wij vinden dat niets in de weg mag staan tussen mensen en een betere geestelijke gezondheid. Of de belemmeringen nu geografisch, fysiek of emotioneel zijn - iedereen moet dezelfde toegang hebben tot de meest efficiënte geestelijke gezondheidszorg. Een bezoek aan een psycholoog moet net zo natuurlijk aanvoelen als een bezoek aan de huisarts. We willen door de wijze waarop wij zorg verlenen deze zorg voor iedereen bereikbaar maken, zonder wachtlijsten.

In Europa zijn inmiddels 250 psychologen aangesloten, die met elkaar meer dan 1000 therapiesessies geven. Onze 30 Nederlandse psychologen werken zelfstandig en online en garanderen snelle hulp en geen wachtlijsten. Het online werken betekent tevens dat er geen reistijden zijn of een ongemakkelijk gevoel in de wachtkamer.

Het team van psychologen bestaat uit collega's die allemaal volledig online behandelen. Op ons hoofdkantoor hebben wij een team van collega’s die de noodzakelijke ondersteuning bieden van Customer Service tot en met de Algemeen Directeur om jou en Minder tot een succes te maken.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Het houden online van intakes en het geven van online behandelingen aan cliënten met matige tot ernstige problemen in de kortdurende generalistische basis GGZ, waarbij je werkt volgens de actuele richtlijnen;

  • Ter ondersteuning van de behandeling maak je gebruik van onze eigen e-health modules, die beschikbaar zijn in onze zelf ontwikkelde app, waarbij je werkt volgens het blended-care principe;

  • Als regiebehandelaar ben je verantwoordelijk voor de juiste indicatiestelling en uitvoering van de behandeling van cliënten van een of enkele basispsychologen;

  • Je biedt supervisie en deelt je kennis in individuele werkbegeleiding sessies;

  • Tot je taken en verantwoordelijkheden behoort uiteraard de noodzakelijke verslaglegging; en

  • Je levert een bijdrage aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze organisatie, van een jong volwassen startup instelling tot een gevestigde speler in de Nederlandse GGZ. Je kan hierbij denken aan het opzetten van trainingen voor onze Mindler academy of het meedenken in hoe wij deze groei kunnen realiseren.

Wat bieden we?

Het best laten wij dat omschrijven door onze kernwaarden. Deze worden gebruikt om onze bedrijfscultuur te koesteren en ons te begeleiden in onze manier van werken om te zorgen dat wij op een duurzame manier groeien. Wij zijn er voor elkaar en voor de ander aan wie wij zorg bieden. Wij zijn een informele organisatie, waar iedereen zichzelf kan zijn. Wederzijds respect en waardering voor elkaar zijn belangrijke waarden voor ons. Er wordt hard gewerkt met elkaar om Mindler een succes te maken en daarnaast is er veel ruimte voor plezier met elkaar. Wij geven je uiteraard ook de mogelijkheid om je verder te ontwikkelen in je vakgebied en binnen de organisatie.

Wat bieden wij nog meer?

Zelfstandigheid, vrijheid van locatie, zelf bepalen wanneer jij je cliënten behandelt, naar wat past bij jouw persoonlijke situatie in een rustige werkomgeving met een beveiligde en goede internetverbinding, waarin jij de privacy van je cliënten kunt garanderen.

Als GZ-Psycholoog kun je niet alleen je functie goed combineren met je privéleven, maar ook kun je je eigen agenda afwisselend houden, door je eigen caseload af te wisselen met de begeleiding van de basispsychologen.

Wij zijn gebonden aan de CAO voor de GGZ, die voor ons de meest aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden al heeft geformuleerd. Daarbij verdien je een goed salaris, afhankelijk van je werkervaring, conform de FWG salarisschaal 65.

Wat verwachten we?

  • Een postdoctorale opleiding tot GZ-Psycholoog;

  • Een geldige BIG-registratie en een AGB-code;

  • Een positieve Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG);

  • Minimaal 3 jaar ambulante ervaring, bij voorkeur in de GB GGZ;

  • Geschoold in CGT, waarbij aanvullende scholing in bv EMDR en/of ACT gewenst is;

  • Ervaring met ADHD & ASS diagnostiek en behandeling is een pré;

  • Ervaring met het online behandelen en blended werken met e-health;

  • Een grote mate van zelfstandigheid en in staat zijn tot het plannen van je eigen caseload en agenda.

  • Goed ontwikkelde digitale vaardigheden;

  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal (minimaal C1 level); en

  • Bereidheid tot een contract in loondienst of een overeenkomst van opdracht als zzp'er van minimaal 24 uur per week.

Sollicitatieproces

  1. 👋 Videobel afspraak oriënterend gesprek met GZ-Psychologe-Regiebehandelaar

  2. ✨ Bij voorkeur F2F (indien niet mogelijk wederom videobel afspraak) met Country Manager NL en People & Culture Business Partner NL

  3. 🤝 Indien iedereen positief een mooi aanbod!

Mindler biedt gelijke kansen. Alle sollicitanten die in aanmerking komen voor deze baan worden in overweging genomen, ongeacht hun geslacht, genderidentiteit of -expressie, afkomst, religie of andere overtuiging, handicap, seksuele geaardheid en leeftijd.

  • Participate in HR special projects such as policy rollouts or engagement campaigns

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer
  • Frequent meetings via video or phone; occasional in-person site visits

WORKING CONDITIONS:

  • Remote
  • Fast-paced, deadline-driven environment with collaborative teams

COMPETENCIES AND SKILLS:

  • Knowledge of full-cycle recruiting processes
  • Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational and time management abilities
  • Cultural competency and inclusive recruitment practices
  • Familiarity with applicant tracking systems and HRIS platforms
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize in a dynamic environment

LEVEL OF EDUCATION / TRAINING / QUALIFICATIONS:

  • SHRM certification
  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field preferred
  • Minimum 2 years of recruiting or talent acquisition experience required
  • Experience recruiting in healthcare, human services, or nonprofit settings strongly preferred
  • Familiarity with labor laws and EEO/AA regulations a plus
  • Ability to pass background and reference checks

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience recruiting for behavioral health, psychiatric rehabilitation, outpatient mental health, assisted living, skilled nursing, or other healthcare settings. Experience recruiting for roles in Maryland is a plus.
  • Solid experience in full-cycle recruiting, preferably within behavioral health, psychiatric rehabilitation, outpatient mental health, assisted living facilities, skilled nursing facilities, or other healthcare-related settings, with specific experience recruiting in the Maryland healthcare and behavioral health market strongly preferred.Familiarity with behavioral health and mental health job functions, including roles such as therapists, counselors, case managers, psychiatric rehabilitation staff, direct support professionals, medication technicians, caregivers, and other care team members.
  • Strong understanding of Maryland healthcare recruitment challenges, including high-volume hiring, credential-sensitive roles, shift-based staffing needs, licensing requirements, compliance standards, and candidate availability in competitive healthcare labor markets.
  • Demonstrated ability to source, screen, interview, and support hiring for clinical, direct care, administrative, and program-level roles in behavioral health or healthcare environments.

jobs.title: Accounts Receivable (A/R) & Insurance Follow-Up Specialist
jobs.excerpt: About AdvantixxRCM AdvantixxRCM provides comprehensive revenue cycle management services to healthcare providers, including medical billing, insurance follow-up, denial management, payment posting, credentialing, and revenue optimization.
jobs.description:
About AdvantixxRCM
AdvantixxRCM provides comprehensive revenue cycle management services to healthcare providers, including medical billing, insurance follow-up, denial management, payment posting, credentialing, and revenue optimization.

We are seeking an experienced Accounts Receivable (A/R) & Insurance Follow-Up Specialist who understands that submitting a claim is only the beginning—the ultimate objective is obtaining accurate and timely reimbursement for our clients.

Position Summary

The A/R & Insurance Follow-Up Specialist is responsible for managing outstanding insurance accounts and aggressively pursuing appropriate reimbursement from Medicare, Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid Managed Care, and commercial insurance payers.

This individual will investigate unpaid, delayed, denied, rejected, and underpaid claims and take appropriate action until each assigned account reaches resolution.

We are looking for someone who can work an A/R aging report independently and take ownership of accounts from follow-up through resolution.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Insurance A/R Follow-Up

  • Work assigned insurance A/R aging reports daily.
  • Follow up on unpaid and outstanding insurance claims.
  • Research claim status through payer portals, clearinghouses, telephone calls, and other available resources.
  • Determine why claims remain unpaid.
  • Contact insurance companies regarding delayed or incorrectly processed claims.
  • Document every follow-up action accurately.
  • Establish appropriate follow-up dates and continue working accounts until resolution.
  • Prioritize high-dollar and aging accounts.
  • Identify claims approaching timely-filing or appeal deadlines.
  • Escalate significant reimbursement issues to management.

Denials & Rejections

  • Investigate rejected and denied claims.
  • Review CARC/RARC codes and payer explanations.
  • Determine appropriate corrective action.
  • Correct and resubmit claims when appropriate.
  • Submit reconsiderations and appeals.
  • Obtain supporting documentation when required.
  • Track appeals through final determination.
  • Identify recurring denial patterns and communicate them to management.
  • Work with billing, coding, credentialing, eligibility, and authorization teams to resolve root causes.

Underpayment & Reimbursement Review

  • Review EOBs and ERAs.
  • Identify potential underpayments.
  • Compare reimbursement against expected or contracted reimbursement when information is available.
  • Research incorrectly processed claims.
  • Request claim reprocessing when appropriate.
  • Identify coordination-of-benefits issues.
  • Research primary and secondary payer issues.
  • Escalate suspected payer reimbursement problems.

A/R Management

  • Work accounts across aging categories, including:

0–30 Days | 31–60 Days | 61–90 Days | 91–120 Days | 120+ Days

Special attention should be given to aging balances, high-dollar accounts, filing deadlines, and claims requiring immediate intervention.

Documentation

Every account worked must contain clear documentation describing:

  • Date of follow-up
  • Payer contacted
  • Claim status
  • Representative/reference information when applicable
  • Reason payment remains outstanding
  • Action taken
  • Documentation requested or submitted
  • Expected resolution
  • Required next action
  • Follow-up date

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 2 years of medical billing, insurance follow-up, or healthcare A/R experience preferred.
  • Experience working insurance aging reports.
  • Experience communicating directly with insurance companies.
  • Knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid Managed Care, and commercial insurance.
  • Understanding of CMS-1500 professional claims.
  • Experience with EOBs and ERAs.
  • Knowledge of claim denials, rejections, reconsiderations, and appeals.
  • Familiarity with CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10-CM, modifiers, and CARC/RARC codes.
  • Experience using payer portals and clearinghouses.
  • Strong research and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience with an RCM or medical billing company.
  • Experience handling multiple healthcare practices or clients.
  • CPC, CPB, CRCR, or related certification.
  • Medicare and Medicaid billing experience.
  • Experience with behavioral health, primary care, specialty medicine, or other outpatient services.
  • Experience with Availity, Office Ally, Waystar, Change Healthcare/Optum, or similar systems.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus.

Performance Expectations

Performance will be measured using appropriate departmental KPIs, including:

  • Number and quality of accounts worked
  • A/R resolution
  • Reduction of aging balances
  • A/R over 90 days
  • Recovery of outstanding reimbursement
  • Follow-up turnaround time
  • Appeal/reconsideration completion
  • Documentation quality
  • Accuracy
  • Timely-filing protection
  • Compliance with company and client procedures

Quality and actual account resolution are more important than simply documenting a high number of touches.

Preferred

About iClosed

Do you love helping people and solving problems? Do you want every customer to walk away with a great experience? Then we'd like to meet you.

iClosed is a profit maximizer for high-ticket sales teams, helping them capture more leads, book more calls, and close more deals. We work with customers like Hyros.com, Iman Gadzhi, Whop, Instantly.ai, and thousands of users.

As a Customer Support Representative, you'll be the friendly voice of the company. You'll help our users with their questions, fix what's blocking them, and keep their experience smooth. Most of our support happens over chat. Premium customers also get video support, so you'll jump on calls from time to time.

What You'll Own

Customer Support

  • Support customers over chat, email, and occasional video calls.
  • Stay quick, friendly, patient, and professional in every conversation.
  • Escalate issues to the right internal team and follow them through to resolution.

Technical Troubleshooting

  • Troubleshoot technical issues and walk users through the fix.
  • Help users connect iClosed with automation tools like Zapier, Make, n8n, webhooks or API.

Feedback & Improvement

  • Suggest improvements to our support processes and to the product itself.
  • Help improve our product by providing feedback and suggestions.

Who We're Looking For

Required

  • 1+ year of experience in customer support or a similar role.
  • English: B2 spoken and C1 written.
  • Basic knowledge of web apps and SaaS products (Intercom, ClickUp, Slack, email, Zapier/Make/n8n, scheduling tools).
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex things simply.
  • A problem-solving mindset and eagerness to learn.
  • Dedicated and hardworking, and happy when you've helped someone.
  • Available to work shifts within 8am to 10pm CET.

Nice to Have

  • French language skills.

Success in This Role

  • Customers get quick, friendly, and accurate answers.
  • Technical blockers are fixed, or escalated with clear context and followed through to resolution.
  • Users get their iClosed integrations and automations working.
  • Customer feedback reaches the team and helps improve the product and our support processes.

What We Offer

  • 🌍 Remote-friendly – work from anywhere.
  • 📈 Growth opportunities – expand your skills and career.
  • 💡 A supportive team – people who help each other out.
  • 🎯 Impactful work – help customers and make a difference every day, internally and publicly.
  • 🎉 A positive, energetic culture – we take our work seriously, but that doesn’t mean we can’t have fun while doing it.

Why is this one different?

You're the first person our customers talk to when something gets in their way. Every conversation is a chance to turn a blocked user into a happy one.

Nail it, and you’ll keep growing your skills and your career with us.

How to Apply

Our hiring process has three steps:

  1. Intro video + Resume: Send us a Loom video (up to 5 minutes) introducing yourself. Tell us who you are, your support experience, and why you want this role. Applications without a Loom won't be reviewed.
  2. Skills test: If we think you're a good fit, we'll send you a short practical test.
  3. Interview: Candidates who do well on the test are invited to an interview with our team.

If you're excited to join a team that cares about customer happiness, teamwork, and growth, we'd love to hear from you!

Salary: $1,200-$1,700 per month DOE

Job Title: Senior Manager, Practice Operations
Location: remote (work from home eligible)

Salary: $160,000-$180,000 DOE

Company Overview: Celerity is a consulting firm specializing in utilities and energy sectors. We empower organizations by converting complex data into actionable intelligence to mitigate risk, optimize assets, and maximize project outcomes. Our background and expertise enable us to drive and deliver transformation and operational excellence for our clients.
Practice Overview: The Business Integration Services (BIS) practice is a high-growth technology consulting practice delivering enterprise-scale integration, digital transformation, and solution design engagements for complex, multi-stakeholder clients. The practice is in its third year of a structured build and scale phase, expanding from a founding team to a full-capability organization spanning four pillars: Project Management (PMO), Business/Technical Analysis, Solution Architecture, and Engineering.
The practice operates at the intersection of business strategy and technology execution, working closely with technology partners and vendors to deliver outcomes that are both architecturally sound and commercially meaningful. It is entering a pivotal phase of maturity, transitioning from practice-leads delivery to a structured operating model with defined build paths, methodology standards, and delivery governance.
Position Overview: The Senior Manager role is newly created role designed to build and run the operational backbone of the BIS practice. This person is also a people manager while owning the internal operating infrastructure that allows the practice to scale without losing delivery quality or team cohesion. The Senior Manager is an experienced professional including consulting background with over 10 years of hands-on experience driving and building delivery excellence, can build and sustain a high-performing team culture, and has the operational discipline to manage experienced professionals through a period of rapid growth.
This role demands strong operational leadership, industry knowledge, and technical fluency to drive results in complex client environments.
Key Responsibilities:
Practice Operations & Delivery Coordination:

  • Own the weekly resource coordination sync and alignment across multiple projects — aligning deployment to project demand, managing capacity constraints, and ensuring no engagement is under-resourced
  • Maintain a real-time view of utilization across all active engagements; proactively identify over-allocation, burnout risk, or skill mismatches and resolve before they affect delivery.
  • Build and maintain the practice's operational cadences: team meetings, delivery check-ins, onboarding sequences, and inter-pillar coordination mechanisms.
  • Escalate delivery risks that require leadership action; translate ground-level team intelligence into clear, actionable executive signals without filtering out critical information
  • Ensure the project teams have the tools, templates, methodologies, and standards they need to deliver consistently across different engagement types and client environments
Capability Building:
  • Partner with the project teams to define and maintain the practice's methodology: discovery frameworks, requirements standards, stakeholder engagement approaches, and deliverable quality benchmarks
  • Build a learning and development calendar for the team that reflects real engagement needs — not generic training — including cross-pillar exposure across all pillars.
  • Create and maintain a competency framework that provides clear, credible criteria for performance evaluation and career progression, recognizing that most team members are already highly experienced
  • Drive/support the development of BIS delivery playbooks, templates, and standards for discovery, change management, testing, cutover, and post-implementation support.
  • Identify patterns across engagements where capability gaps surface and systematically address them through targeted development rather than reactive support
  • Use insights from the quarterly coach roundtable to shape new hire onboarding for incoming cohorts, ensuring lessons from active delivery are embedded into how new team members learn the practice
People Leadership & Team Development
  • Lead structured onboarding for incoming new hires, ensuring they integrate into the practice culture and reach delivery readiness within 60-90 days.
  • Serve as a direct people manager for the reporting team that includes senior business analysis professionals with process, data, business/technical requirements and systems/product implementation skillsets.
  • Hold a quarterly coaching roundtable with cross-pillar coaches to aggregate team development signals and translate them into management action
  • Retain and support a team of experienced senior practitioners— understanding the difference between craft recognition and career progression for high-expertise individual contributors
Practice Strategy & Governance
  • Contribute to capacity planning working with leadership to project capacity needs against pipeline and growth targets
  • Partner with leadership on the design of the coaching model, cross-pillar development programs, and any structural adjustments as the practice scales
  • Maintain the operating model documentation: org structure, role definitions, operating norms, and governance processes that align with the team structure on implementation projects.
Continuous Improvement & Quality Assurance
  • Promote continuous improvement through lessons learned, feedback loops, and project retrospectives.
  • Ensure project deliverables meet established quality standards, conduct quality audits and reviews, and implement quality improvement processes.
Educational Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Management, or a related field or equivalent experience.
  • Advanced degree (MBA or Master’s) is preferred.
Required Skills and Experience:
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in technology consulting, professional services, or a related discipline, with demonstrated experience leading or managing teams of senior practitioners.
  • Proven track record as a people manager — comfortable owning performance reviews, difficult conversations, retention risk, and career development for experienced individual contributors
  • Experience working with Agile and Waterfall methodologies in SaaS companies or with system integrators.
  • Strong working knowledge of the four pillars as a discipline: what excellent discovery looks like and how requirements mature through an engagement
  • Experience managing resource deployment and capacity planning in a project-based or consulting environment
  • Demonstrated ability to build trust with experienced peers and direct reports who have strong professional identities and do not require or respond well to directive management styles
  • Comfort operating in a high-growth, structurally evolving environment where processes are being built while delivery is ongoing
  • Strong understanding of utility operations, asset management, and regulatory compliance.
  • Demonstrated experience in team building and leadership, with the ability to inspire and develop talent.
  • Excellent project management skills, including proficiency in project planning, execution, and risk management.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage clients and stakeholders at all levels.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage with clients effectively, collaborate with internal teams, and interact with management.
  • Ability to travel domestically and(or) internationally if required.
Preferred Skills:
  • Prior experience in practice operations, delivery management, or capability development role within a consulting firm or technology services organization
  • Familiarity with the cross-functional dynamics between PMO, BA, solution architecture, and engineering in integrated delivery engagements
  • Experience with coaching models, structured mentoring programs, or formal learning and development initiatives in a consulting context
  • Exposure to Big 4 or top-tier consulting operating models — particularly how those firms separate craft leadership from people management at scale
  • Experience hiring and onboarding senior practitioners in a compressed timeline.
  • Certifications: PMP/PMI-ACP, Prosci/Change Management, ITIL, SAFe/Agile or relevant certifications.

jobs.excerpt: Position SummaryAdvantixxRCM is seeking an experienced Payment Posting Specialist responsible for accurately posting and reconciling insurance and patient payments for our healthcare clients.
jobs.description:
Position Summary

AdvantixxRCM is seeking an experienced Payment Posting Specialist responsible for accurately posting and reconciling insurance and patient payments for our healthcare clients.

This position manages ERAs, EOBs, EFTs, insurance payments, patient payments, contractual adjustments, unapplied payments, credit balances, and payment discrepancies while ensuring financial activity is accurately reflected in each client's practice management system.

The ideal candidate is highly accurate, organized, comfortable working with high transaction volumes, and able to identify reimbursement discrepancies that require additional investigation.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Post insurance payments from ERAs and EOBs.
  • Post EFT, check, and other payer payments.
  • Post patient payments when assigned.
  • Review electronic remittance files for accuracy.
  • Apply contractual adjustments according to payer requirements and established procedures.
  • Accurately allocate payments to the appropriate patient, encounter, claim, and service line.
  • Identify and research unmatched or unapplied payments.
  • Research missing payments and posting discrepancies.
  • Review zero-payment remittances.
  • Identify denials and route them to the appropriate billing or denial team.
  • Identify potential insurance underpayments.
  • Identify overpayments and credit balances.
  • Assist with refund research and processing according to company procedures.
  • Correct payment posting errors.
  • Review secondary insurance balances following primary payer processing.
  • Ensure patient responsibility is transferred accurately based on payer adjudication.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of posting and reconciliation activity.

Payment Reconciliation

The Payment Posting Specialist will also be responsible for helping ensure that money received matches money posted.

Responsibilities include:

  • Reconcile EFTs against ERAs.
  • Reconcile checks against EOBs.
  • Compare bank/payment information with system posting records when authorized.
  • Identify missing ERAs or EOBs.
  • Research unidentified deposits.
  • Research duplicate payments.
  • Identify incorrect adjustments.
  • Identify payments posted to incorrect accounts.
  • Maintain reconciliation reports.
  • Escalate unresolved discrepancies to the Operations Manager.

EOB & ERA Review

The successful candidate must understand:

  • Allowed amounts
  • Paid amounts
  • Contractual adjustments
  • Deductibles
  • Copayments
  • Coinsurance
  • Non-covered charges
  • Patient responsibility
  • Denial codes
  • CARC/RARC codes
  • Primary and secondary payer processing
  • Coordination of benefits

A/R & Denial Coordination

Payment posting is an important part of the overall revenue cycle.

The Payment Posting Specialist will communicate identified issues to the appropriate team, including:

A/R Specialist — unpaid or incorrectly processed claims

Denial Management Specialist — denied claims requiring investigation or appeal

Medical Billing Specialist — claims requiring corrections

Credentialing Specialist — enrollment-related payment issues

Operations Manager — significant payment, reconciliation, or payer discrepancies

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 1–2 years of medical payment posting, medical billing, or healthcare revenue cycle experience preferred.
  • Experience posting insurance ERAs/EOBs.
  • Understanding of healthcare reimbursement.
  • Ability to interpret EOBs and ERAs.
  • Understanding of deductibles, copayments, coinsurance, contractual adjustments, and patient responsibility.
  • Familiarity with Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance.
  • Strong numerical and reconciliation skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Strong computer and data-entry skills.
  • Ability to maintain accuracy while processing high transaction volumes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience with an RCM or medical billing company.
  • Experience handling multiple practices or clients.
  • Medicare and Medicaid payment posting experience.
  • Experience with electronic remittance and EFT reconciliation.
  • Experience researching credit balances and unapplied payments.
  • Familiarity with multiple EHR/Practice Management systems.
  • Experience with clearinghouses and payer portals.
  • CPB or similar billing certification is a plus.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus.

Performance Expectations

Performance will be evaluated based on:

  • Payment posting accuracy
  • Payment posting turnaround time
  • ERA/EOB processing
  • Reconciliation accuracy
  • Unapplied payment resolution
  • Adjustment accuracy
  • Identification of payment discrepancies
  • Documentation quality
  • Productivity
  • Compliance with client and company procedures

Accuracy is critical. AdvantixxRCM does not prioritize posting volume at the expense of financial accuracy.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who understands that payment posting is more than entering numbers.

The successful candidate should recognize when an EOB doesn't look right, identify discrepancies, determine whether the issue involves a denial, underpayment, adjustment, patient responsibility, or posting error, and route or resolve the issue appropriately.

We want someone who takes ownership of ensuring payments are posted accurately, reconciled properly, and accounted for completely.

Why Join AdvantixxRCM?

AdvantixxRCM is building a high-performance revenue cycle organization where accuracy, accountability, productivity, and financial integrity are essential.

This position provides exposure to multiple healthcare organizations, payers, specialties, and revenue cycle processes while providing opportunities for professional growth.

Performance Analysis & Measurement

Data Integrity & Media Operations

Audience Insights & Best Practices

Agency & Cross-Functional Partnership

jobs.excerpt: Build and run the GHL systems that turn leads into members and keep members coming back — and be the go-to support for the gym team using them.
jobs.description:
Build and run the GHL systems that turn leads into members and keep members coming back — and be the go-to support for the gym team using them.

About the Role

Seamless Assist places AI-fluent virtual assistants with growing businesses and builds the automation systems they run. We are hiring a GoHighLevel Specialist on behalf of our client, a US-based gym business. This is a fully remote role open to candidates based in the Philippines.

The gym runs its lead follow-up, trial bookings, member communication, and retention campaigns through GoHighLevel. This hire owns that platform end to end — building the automations that drive memberships and supporting the owner and front-desk team who use it every day.

Culture: owner-led, fast-moving fitness business. Clear ownership, proactive communication, and steady improvement over perfection.

Role Details

  • Industry: Health & Fitness — Gym
  • Reports to: Gym Owner
  • Type: Full-time · 40 hours/week
  • Hours: US Eastern Time (EST) business hours
  • Rate: TBD
  • Location: Remote — Philippines
  • Tools: GoHighLevel (GHL), Zapier / Make / n8n, gym management software (e.g., Mindbody, ABC Glofox, PushPress, Zen Planner), Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Google Workspace

Role Overview

Every lead, trial, and member touchpoint at the gym runs through GoHighLevel. The GHL Specialist will design and maintain those systems — from the first ad inquiry to the membership renewal — and provide responsive, first-line support to the gym owner and staff.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can move between building and supporting in the same day: fixing a broken trial-booking workflow in the morning, walking the front desk through the pipeline after lunch, and documenting both so it doesn't happen twice. The right person treats every support request as a signal of what to systematize next.

Key Responsibilities

GHL Automation & Build

  • Build and maintain lead nurture workflows — speed-to-lead SMS/email, trial class and intro session booking, and follow-up for leads who don't book
  • Automate the member journey — class and appointment reminders, no-show follow-up, new-member onboarding, and milestone check-ins
  • Run retention and reactivation campaigns — lapsed and frozen members, expiring memberships, failed payments, and win-back offers
  • Set up and manage pipelines, calendars, forms, surveys, landing pages/funnels, custom fields, and tags
  • Build and send email and SMS campaigns — promotions, challenges, events, and monthly member newsletters
  • Automate review requests and referral campaigns to grow the gym's reputation
  • Integrate GHL with the gym's management software, payment tools, and ad lead sources (Facebook/Instagram lead forms) via native integrations, Zapier, Make, n8n, or webhooks

Customer Support

  • Serve as first-line GHL support for the gym owner and front-desk/sales staff
  • Manage and respond to member and lead inquiries in the GHL Conversations inbox (SMS, email, social DMs) within agreed response times
  • Troubleshoot issues: broken workflows, failed sends, calendar sync errors, A2P/10DLC and email deliverability problems, integration failures
  • Train gym staff on using GHL — pipelines, conversations, booking, and reporting — through live walkthroughs and short recorded videos
  • Escalate billing, platform-level bugs, or out-of-scope requests to the gym owner with a clear summary

Reporting, Documentation & Improvement

  • Build dashboards that track leads, trial bookings, show rates, conversions to membership, and retention
  • Write SOPs and how-to guides for every recurring build and support issue
  • Audit the account for broken, duplicate, or unused workflows and recommend clean-up
  • Track recurring issues and propose automations or fixes that remove them at the source
  • Use AI tools to speed up campaign copy, troubleshooting, and documentation

Who Will Succeed

"Builds it right, explains it simply, and fixes the root cause — not just the ticket."

  • Has built real GHL automations for live businesses — ideally gyms, studios, or other membership businesses
  • Understands how a gym makes money: leads, trials, memberships, retention
  • Patient and clear with busy, non-technical owners and staff — explains a workflow without jargon
  • Systems thinker who documents as they go and hates fixing the same problem twice
  • Takes initiative — spots what is broken or missing and raises it before the owner does

Experience & Skills

Required

  • GHL expertise: 2+ years of hands-on GoHighLevel experience building workflows, pipelines, funnels, and campaigns for live businesses
  • Customer support: 1+ year providing customer or technical support (tickets, live chat, calls, or client success)
  • Integrations: Working knowledge of Zapier, Make, n8n, or webhooks to connect GHL with other tools
  • AI fluency: Actively uses AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to build, write, and troubleshoot faster — specific tools and use cases confirmed at screening
  • Time zone compatibility: Able to work US Eastern Time (EST) business hours from the Philippines
  • Strong communication: Exceptional written and spoken English — clear, friendly, and concise with owners, staff, and members; assessed at screening
  • Deliverability: Understanding of email and SMS deliverability, including A2P 10DLC registration
  • Remote setup: Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated workspace

Preferred

  • Experience with gyms, fitness studios, or other membership-based businesses
  • Experience with gym management software (Mindbody, ABC Glofox, PushPress, Zen Planner, or similar)
  • GHL Admin certification
  • Familiarity with GHL Conversation AI / AI Employee features
  • Experience running Facebook/Instagram lead-gen campaigns into GHL

jobs.title: Security Operations Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Revizto enables the people behind the world’s most important structures to do their best work.
jobs.description:
Revizto enables the people behind the world’s most important structures to do their best work. We connect architects, engineers, contractors, and owners in one shared 2D/3D environment to help deliver complex projects on time and on budget. From airports and hospitals to data centers and large-scale infrastructure, Revizto supports industry leaders in reducing risk, improving collaboration, and delivering better project outcomes.

Built on a gaming engine, Revizto is designed to handle the scale and complexity of modern construction projects while remaining fast, reliable, and accessible across devices and environments — whether teams are in the office or on site.

Key Responsibilities & Requirements

  • Security Monitoring & Investigation: Monitor, triage, and investigate security alerts and incidents across cloud, endpoint, and SaaS environments, ensuring timely identification and assessment of potential threats.
  • Incident Response Management: Lead and coordinate security incident response activities, including containment, eradication, recovery, root-cause analysis, and preparation of comprehensive post-incident reports.
  • Threat Detection Engineering: Develop, test, and continuously refine security detection rules to improve accuracy, reduce false positives, and maintain detection coverage aligned with the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
  • Proactive Threat Hunting: Conduct proactive threat-hunting activities across cloud, endpoint, and identity telemetry to identify suspicious behavior, emerging threats, and potential security compromises.
  • Security Log Analysis: Analyze and correlate security logs and telemetry from AWS, Microsoft Azure/Entra ID, Kubernetes, endpoints, and SaaS applications to detect and investigate potential security incidents.
  • Cloud Security & Vulnerability Management: Investigate cloud security findings and vulnerability alerts, collaborate with relevant system owners, and support timely remediation of identified security risks.
  • Security Logging & Visibility: Maintain the health, completeness, and reliability of existing security log sources while identifying and onboarding additional sources to improve monitoring and detection coverage.
  • Incident Response Documentation: Develop, maintain, and continuously improve incident response runbooks and escalation procedures to ensure consistent and effective handling of security events.
Requirements
  • Professional Experience: At least 3 years of hands-on experience in a Security Operations Center (SOC), incident response, or security detection role.
  • SIEM & EDR Technologies: Practical experience working with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) solutions, preferably Microsoft Sentinel, and Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) platforms, preferably CrowdStrike Falcon.
  • Detection Engineering & Query Languages: Ability to write, analyze, optimize, and tune security detection queries using Kusto Query Language (KQL) or similar query languages.
  • Cybersecurity Fundamentals: Solid understanding of common cyberattack techniques, threat behaviors, and the MITRE ATT&CK framework, combined with a strong foundation in AWS and Azure cloud security principles.
  • End-to-End Incident Response: Proven experience managing security incidents throughout their entire lifecycle, from initial alert investigation and triage through containment, eradication, recovery, root-cause analysis, and post-incident reporting.
  • Security Frameworks & Standards: Knowledge of established information security frameworks and standards, including ISO 27001, NIST, CIS, and SOC 2.
  • English Proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or higher proficiency in English, both written and spoken.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Hands-on experience conducting proactive threat-hunting activities to identify and investigate potential security threats.
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes and container security principles, including common risks and security considerations in containerized environments.
  • Basic scripting skills in Python, PowerShell, or Bash to support security investigations, analysis, and operational tasks.
  • One or more relevant professional certifications, such as GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, GCTI, Microsoft SC-200, or CrowdStrike CCFA/CCFH.
Personal & Professional Competencies
  • Composure Under Pressure: Ability to remain calm, structured, and focused when managing security incidents and working under time-sensitive conditions.
  • Communication & Reporting: Strong written communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain security incidents, technical findings, and their impact to both engineering teams and executive stakeholders.
  • Collaboration & Ownership: A proactive team player who can work effectively both independently and collaboratively, take ownership of responsibilities, and continuously identify opportunities to improve security processes.
  • Relationship Building: Ability to establish and maintain strong, productive working relationships with colleagues across teams and at all organizational levels.

Position Overview

We are looking for a Security Operations Engineer to join our Information Security team and play a key role in protecting Revizto's cloud infrastructure, endpoints, and SaaS environments.

In this role, you will be at the forefront of identifying, investigating, and responding to security threats, ensuring that potential risks are detected and addressed effectively. You will take ownership of security incidents throughout their lifecycle, continuously improve threat detection capabilities, and proactively identify vulnerabilities and emerging threats.

Working closely with Engineering, DevOps, and IT teams, you will contribute to strengthening our overall security posture, enhancing detection coverage, and reducing incident detection and response times. This is an opportunity to take ownership of meaningful security challenges and directly contribute to the protection and resilience of Revizto's technology environment.

Why Join Us

  • Recognised as one of Switzerland’s Best Managed Companies by Deloitte for three consecutive years from 2024 through
  • Company-wide trips, including Armenia in 2023 and Switzerland in 2025, with more to come
  • A flexible, employee-focused culture
  • An innovative and collaborative team environment
  • Great working conditions designed to support your best work

We can only accept applications from candidates based in Germany, Armenia, France or the UK.

Corporate Travel Consultant (Sandia Team)

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend four weeks (paid) training. This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Other duties and tasks as assigned
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of recent, prior experience in corporate travel management, understanding the unique needs and challenges of business travelers.
  • In-depth familiarity with current Sabre GDS (Global Distribution System) for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance.
  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings.
  • Proficiency in ticketing procedures and scripting, along with the ability to handle complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both international and domestic travel.
  • Proven ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to meet client requirements.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully
  • Reliable, high-speed internet connectivity required to support core job responsibilities, including but not limited to video conferencing, access to company systems, and secure handling of company data.

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Have fun:At the heart of everything we do at Flight Centre is a desire to have fun.
  • Reward & Recognition: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  • Use your smarts:Our people use their quick thinking, expertise, and tenacity to always figure things out.
  • Love for travel:We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  • Personal connections:We are a big business founded on personal relationships.
  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through initiatives like Diversity Day (paid leave to observe a holiday or cultural celebration of your choice) Employee Resource Groups (Racial Equity, Gender Equity, LGBTQ2IA+, Accessibility, Environmental Justice), DEI education initiatives, and equitable practices, including regular equity assessments and inclusive recruitment protocols.
  • A career, not a job:We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve
  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Benefits Include:

  • Paid Time Off: A comprehensive time off package, including up to 15 vacation days (prorated upon hire and increasing to 20 days after 2 years of employment), 5 sick days, 3 personal days, 1 Diversity Day, 1 Volunteer Day, and 9 recognized holidays annually.
  • Travel perks/discounts

  • National/International Award Nights and Conferences
  • Health benefits including, medical, dental, vision, gender affirming care, and fertility care
  • Insurance including hospital indemnity, AD&D, critical illness, long-term and short-term disability
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 401k program with partial match
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Employee Share Plan – Ability to purchase company stock on Australian Stock Exchange with partial company match, subject to terms and conditions
  • Global career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses

*Vacation, Personal, and Sick time accrual rates will vary based on full-time or part-time employee status. Recognized Holidays are either paid time off or, if required to work due to job requirements, holiday pay rate, and may vary depending on state.

Location – Remote, USA
