jobs.excerpt: RESPONSABLE DE L’IMPLÉMENTATION CLIENTFCM adopte une approche globale des voyages d’affaires et se spécialise dans la gestion de programmes de voyages nationaux et internationaux pour les entreprises de moyenne et grande envergure.
jobs.description:
RESPONSABLE DE L’IMPLÉMENTATION CLIENT

FCM adopte une approche globale des voyages d’affaires et se spécialise dans la gestion de programmes de voyages nationaux et internationaux pour les entreprises de moyenne et grande envergure.
Classée parmi les cinq plus grandes sociétés de gestion de voyages au monde, FCM dispose d’un réseau d’affaires présent dans plus de 97 pays, avec des sièges sociaux mondiaux à Londres, Brisbane, Singapour et New York. Appuyée par la force mondiale de Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combine une expertise locale et une portée internationale afin d’offrir à ses clients une expérience véritablement personnalisée.
Fondée en juin 2004, FCM a été nommée Meilleure société de gestion de voyages au monde pendant huit années consécutives aux World Travel Awards.

Pour en savoir plus sur FCM, veuillez cliquer ICI


À propos du poste

Joignez-vous à FCM à titre de Responsable de l’implémentation client et jouez un rôle clé dans la prestation d’une expérience d’intégration fluide auprès de clients nationaux et multinationaux. Ce poste est au cœur de la réussite client, veillant à ce que les nouveaux clients soient implantés avec succès, soutenus efficacement et positionnés en vue d’un partenariat à long terme. Vous collaborerez avec les parties prenantes internes et les équipes clientes, gérerez plusieurs projets d’implémentation simultanément et contribuerez à l’atteinte de résultats exceptionnels pour la clientèle. Si vous aimez évoluer dans un environnement dynamique, coordonner des projets et offrir une expérience client remarquable, cette occasion vous permettra d’avoir un impact concret.

Responsabilités principales

  • Gérer l’implémentation et l’intégration de clients nationaux et multinationaux conformément aux processus d’implémentation établis.
  • Offrir une expérience client d'une qualité supérieure tout au long du cycle de vie de chaque projet.
  • Coordonner et animer les réunions d’implémentation avec les parties prenantes internes et externes.
  • Assurer le suivi des échéanciers et veiller au respect des jalons convenus pour chaque implémentation.
  • Identifier, communiquer et escalader les risques liés aux projets en appliquant les méthodologies de gestion des risques en place.
  • Maintenir à jour et avec exactitude la documentation d’implémentation, les énoncés de travaux (SOW) et les dossiers de projet.
  • Recueillir et valider de manière proactive les informations nécessaires à la bonne réalisation du projet.
  • Soutenir les projets d’implémentation régionaux pour les clients multinationaux ainsi que l’adoption continue des outils en ligne.
  • Assurer le suivi de l’avancement des projets et des échéanciers au moyen des outils internes de gestion de projet.
  • Veiller au respect des normes, systèmes, processus et meilleures pratiques liés à l’implémentation.
  • Collaborer efficacement avec les collègues, les gestionnaires et les parties prenantes afin d’atteindre les objectifs d’implémentation.
  • Appuyer les activités de tests d’acceptation par les utilisateurs (UAT) et veiller à l’exactitude des implémentations.
  • Contribuer à l’amélioration continue grâce aux revues de projet et aux commentaires des clients.
  • Favoriser un environnement de travail sécuritaire, inclusif et accessible où tous les Flighties se sentent accueillis, respectés et soutenus dans leur réussite.
  • Effectuer toute autre tâche ou responsabilité connexe assignée.
  • Autres tâches et responsabilités assignées
  • Contribuer à un environnement de travail sécuritaire, inclusif et accessible où tous les Flighties se sentent accueillis, respectés et soutenus afin de s’épanouir

Expérience et compétences

  • Au moins 2 ans d’expérience au sein de Flight Centre ou 2 ans d’expérience à titre de Gestionnaire de l’implémentation ou dans un poste similaire.
  • Excellente compréhension des processus d’implémentation.
  • Feuille de route démontrée en matière de réussite dans des fonctions antérieures.
  • Solides compétences en coordination de projets et en gestion du temps.
  • Capacité à gérer plusieurs projets simultanément.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit.
  • Fort sens des affaires et excellentes capacités de résolution de problèmes.
  • Expérience de collaboration avec des clients et des parties prenantes à divers niveaux organisationnels.
  • Connaissance des outils de réservation en ligne, un atout.
  • Approche souple et grande capacité d’adaptation dans un environnement d’affaires en constante évolution.
  • Disponibilité pour effectuer des déplacements occasionnels, au besoin.
  • Bilinguisme (français et anglais) requis
  • Une connexion Internet fiable et à haut débit est requise pour assurer les responsabilités essentielles du poste, y compris, sans s’y limiter, la vidéoconférence, l’accès aux systèmes de l’entreprise et le traitement sécurisé des données de l’entreprise.
  • Le bilinguisme français/anglais est requis, en raison de la nature du poste qui consiste à traiter avec des clients et des fournisseurs français et anglais.

Des conditions de travail qui ont de quoi séduire!

FCTG est reconnu dans le monde entier pour ses magnifiques conditions de travail et sa culture entrepreneuriale encore plus exceptionnelle. Nous savons que notre personnel est notre atout le plus précieux. C’est la passion et le dévouement de nos équipes qui maintiennent notre entreprise au sommet de son industrie. C’est également la raison pour laquelle nous offrons des avantages sociaux et des primes hors du commun à notre personnel.

  • Amusez-vous: l’importance d’avoir du plaisir au travail imprègne chacun de nos gestes.
  • Obtenez des récompenses et une reconnaissance: voyez vos succès et ceux des autres être applaudis lors des fameuses soirées Buzz que nous organisons régulièrement, ainsi qu’au rassemblement mondial annuel. Il faut le vivre pour le croire !
  • Puisez dans votre génie : nos collaborateurs se servent de leur vivacité d’esprit, de leur savoir-faire et de leur persévérance pour trouver en tout temps une solution.
  • L’amour du voyage : notre société a été fondée par des personnes qui voulaient voyager et qui souhaitaient que d’autres en fassent autant. Cette passion marque immanquablement tout notre personnel et l’ensemble de nos services.
  • Des liens personnels : le fondement de notre grande entreprise repose sur les relations personnelles.
  • Diversité, équité et inclusion : engagement envers la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion à travers des initiatives telles que la Journée de la diversité (congé payé pour observer un jour férié ou une célébration culturelle de votre choix) Groupes de ressources pour les employés (équité raciale, équité des genres, LGBTQ2IA+, accessibilité, justice environnementale ), les initiatives éducatives du DEI et les pratiques équitables, y compris des évaluations régulières de l'équité et des protocoles de recrutement inclusifs.
  • Une carrière, et non un boulot: nous offrons à tous de véritables possibilités de croissance et d’évolution personnelle.
  • Nous offrons notre soutien tout temps à nos employés : nous nous engageons fermement à soutenir chaque employé dans son développement professionnel et personnel.
  • Redonner en retour : nous nous engageons à faire une différence grâce à notre programme de responsabilité sociale d'entreprise, qui soutient les organismes de bienfaisance désignés via le bénévolat et la collecte de fonds, notre programme environnemental de bureau, des espaces de bureau certifiés LEED® Gold et une journée de bénévolat rémunérée par année civile.

Voici un aperçu des avantages offerts :
Avantages

  • Politique généreuse de congés payés
  • Avantages et rabais liés aux voyages
  • Programmes de santé et de bien-être et services de bien-être financier pour les employés
  • Soirées de reconnaissance et conférences nationales et internationals
  • Avantages sociaux collectifs, incluant l’assurance maladie complémentaire, les soins dentaires et de la vue, les soins d’affirmation de genre et les soins de fertilité
  • Assurances, incluant l’assurance vie, l’assurance décès et mutilation accidentels, l’assurance maladies graves et l’assurance invalidité de longue durée
  • Programme d’aide aux employés
  • REER/RPA avec contribution de l’employeur
  • Programme de remboursement des frais de scolarité
  • Régime d’actionnariat des employés – possibilité d’acheter des actions de la société à la Bourse australienne, avec une contribution partielle de l’employeur, sous réserve des modalités et conditions applicables
  • Possibilités de carrière à l’échelle mondiale au sein d’un réseau de marques et d’entreprises

Emplacement – TÉLÉTRAVAIL, Canada

Si vous pensez que c’est là le poste que vous cherchiez et que vous souhaitez adhérer à notre culture entrepreneuriale primée, POSTULEZ SANS TARDER.

Cette offre d'emploi correspond à un poste vacant que nous cherchons actuellement à pourvoir.

Dans le cadre de notre processus de recrutement, nous pouvons utiliser des outils d’intelligence artificielle (IA) pour soutenir différentes étapes, notamment la présélection et l’évaluation des candidatures. Ces outils nous aident à évaluer les candidats en fonction des qualifications, des compétences et de l’expérience pertinentes pour le poste. Avant de postuler à un poste interne, vous devez être dans l'entreprise ou dans votre poste actuel depuis au moins 6 à 12 mois et en informer votre responsable avant de postuler.

Vous avez des questions sur cette opportunité? Communiquez avec notre équipe de recrutement à l'adresse

Pour ce poste, nous prévoyons offrir un salaire annuel compris entre 88 000 $ et 90 000 $. Le salaire de base sera établi en fonction de divers facteurs pertinents, notamment l’expérience, l’emplacement géographique et les exigences du poste.

Notre philosophie numéro un? Nos employés. La promesse de Flight Centre Travel Group est de fournir un environnement où prônent le respect, la dignité et des opportunités pour tous nos employés. Nous valorisons un lieu de travail inclusif et solidaire qui reflète véritablement la diversité de notre société.

Nous nous engageons à procurer un environnement où règne l’égalité en matière de respect, de dignité et de possibilités pour tous les membres de notre personnel. jobs.description:
At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Bartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform.

If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!

 

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Artificial Intelligence to be part of making that happen.  

 

About The Role

In this role, you advance that mission by planning and directing the AI development that turns massive volumes of security signal into faster detection and response. This work spans the full range of machine learning and AI solutions, from classical models to fine-tuned language models and agentic systems. You ensure AI initiatives, processes, and deliverables conform to the organization’s established policies, quality standards, and objectives. You also work closely with R&D Leadership, Product Management, and the Security Services (S2) organization to build scalable, production-grade AI that customers and analysts need, delivered on time.

Senior Managers carry a large scope of leadership and may have multiple managers and/or technical leads reporting to them. The right leader brings specialized subject-matter expertise in the AI domain along with a can-do attitude. They are comfortable working across functional boundaries, partnering with data scientists, platform engineers, threat researchers, and security operations analysts to push complex, ambiguous initiatives over the line.

Responsibilities

Generates and manages the day-to-day work for their team and is accountable for its outcomes. Partners with the Product team to define and deliver the 6-month AI roadmap and contributes to longer-term planning and strategy with R&D Leadership. Provides direction and clarity, removes obstacles, and leads teams that deliver high-quality, innovative AI solutions alongside architects, developers, data scientists, product managers, CSEs, and support people.

  • Set the direction for applying the right approach to each problem, from classical ML (e.g., clustering, random forests) to deep learning, fine-tuned language models, and agentic systems, in partnership with your technical peers and team members, translating complex security use cases into production-ready initiatives.

  • Partner with Architects and other leadership on the company’s technical roadmap, championing secure, observable, and scalable AI systems in cloud-native environments.

  • Oversee the design, training, deployment, and ongoing quality measurement of models and agentic experiences.

  • Drive continuous improvement in engineering and MLOps processes. Uphold secure coding and acceptable-use standards across the full development life cycle.

  • Drive cross-functional initiatives with platform, product, and security operations teams to integrate AI into production, and see that work through to completion.

  • Mentor each team member and help them grow their technical and leadership skills, establishing career development plans and achievable goals. Build collaborative relationships across teams and stakeholders.

  • Lead recruitment for their team and be a key contributor to hiring and recruitment strategy for both full-time and co-op roles.

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Four years of experience in software, AI/ML, or data science roles (or a Master’s degree plus two years), including experience leading technical teams or projects.

  • Demonstrated experience leading technical teams and delivering AI/ML or Generative AI systems to production at scale.

  • Strong expertise in the production delivery of Generative AI or machine learning systems, including training, tuning, and ongoing quality measurement and evaluation (e.g., LLM-as-judge).

  • Experience with agentic frameworks (e.g., AgentCore, LangChain, LangGraph) and LLM integration.

  • Experience architecting MLOps processes and tooling for moving models from training to production, including drift monitoring and continuous learning in high-volume pipelines.

  • Familiarity with cloud-native data services (AWS preferred) and data engineering tools (e.g., Spark, Flink, Kafka, Databricks), and with infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, and DevSecOps principles.

  • Exposure to cybersecurity concepts such as threat detection, MITRE ATT&CK, telemetry, and adversarial behavior modeling.

  • A can-do attitude, tenacity, and proven ability to work across cross-functional boundaries to drive ambiguous, high-impact initiatives to completion.

On-Camera Policy
To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

About Arctic Wolf

At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021-2024), Best Places to Work – USA (2021-2024), Great Place to Work – Canada (2021-2024), Great Place to Work – UK (2024), and Kununu Top Company – Germany (2024). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 7,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry.

Our Values 

Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that—by protecting people’s and organizations’ sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk— we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good. 

We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance. See more about our Pack Unity here.  

We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities. 

All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including: 

  • Equity for all employees

  • Flexible time off and paid volunteer days

  • RRSP and 401k match

  • Training and career development programs

  • Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical, mental health, dental, disability, life and AD&D, and value-added services

Arctic Wolf is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. Arctic Wolf is committed to fostering a welcoming, accessible, respectful, and inclusive environment ensuring equal access and participation for people with disabilities. As such, we strive to make our entire employee experience as accessible as possible and provide accommodations as required for candidates and employees with disabilities and/or other specific needs where possible. Please let us know if you require any accommodations by emailing . 

Security Requirements

About Us

Let’s go on an adventure together!

Hey there, we’re G Adventures. We’re one of the world’s leading small group travel companies, and we’ve always believed that travel isn’t just about where you go — it’s about how it changes you.

For the last 35 years, we’ve set out to do things differently. No cookie-cutter tours. No giant buses or cruise ships. And not to mention, as few selfie sticks as possible. Just real humans, travelling your heart out across the world with open minds and a non-stop desire to make our planet better, simply by exploring it.

At G Adventures, our DNA (or GNA, if you will) is built on belonging — where bringing your authentic self to work every day isn’t just accepted, it’s downright celebrated. For our office crew — you wanna rock a t-shirt with your dog’s face on it? We say go for it. For our Chief Experience Officers — you wanna hit the road and call some of the most epic places on Earth your home office? We love that — and we’ve got you. Wanna spend your days with people you genuinely like? Us too — and we’re pretty sure you’ll fit right in, wherever that is.

Now about that career of yours — this is the kind of place where you can spread your wings and truly grow into your role. The best part? You get to do it all alongside a passionate, freakishly talented, one-of-a-kind bunch excited to produce top-notch work and spread a ridiculous amount of goodness at the same time.

Feel like this could be the right fit? We think so too, and we’re already way too excited to meet you.

The Tour Staff Administrator provides administrative and operational support to the Tour Operations team, ensuring that systems, documentation, travel logistics, communications, and operational processes are maintained accurately and efficiently. The role is responsible for supporting Tour Staff (CEOs) and the wider Operations team through effective coordination, record management, routine reporting, and logistical administration, contributing to the smooth delivery of tours across the region.

  • Maintain and audit physical and digital filing systems, transaction records, receipts, and payment documentation.

Systems Administration

  • Maintain and update the internal Tour Staff (CEO) website and resource portals with current itineraries, trip planners, and operational documentation.

  • Upload approved Tour Staff schedules into internal systems (e.g. Polaris).

Travel Logistics & Financial Administration

  • Coordinate routine travel arrangements for Tour Staff (CEO) relocations, including flights, accommodation, and ground transfers.

Communication & Operational Support

jobs.excerpt: Company DescriptionZayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society.
jobs.description:
Company Description

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.

We are seeking an experienced Director, Enterprise Quality Engineering and Agentic Evaluation to build and lead a modern enterprise quality capability across Zayo’s technology organization. This role will be accountable for improving the reliability, predictability, and speed of technology delivery while providing independent assurance for critical business platforms, transformational programs, and AI-enabled solutions.

The successful candidate will combine deep quality engineering expertise with strong enterprise leadership, bringing a risk-based, automation-first approach to how quality is embedded across the software delivery lifecycle. The role will also shape how Zayo evaluates and governs emerging agentic AI capabilities, ensuring they are reliable, controlled, and ready for enterprise-scale adoption.


This is a highly collaborative and transformational leadership role, partnering across Engineering, Product, Architecture, Data and AI, Operations, and business teams to strengthen quality outcomes, reduce production risk, and establish a culture of measurable engineering excellence.


Key Responsibilities

  • Define and lead Zayo’s enterprise quality engineering strategy, operating model, roadmap, service catalog, standards, and governance.
  • Own the enterprise quality engineering platform, including Tosca, qTest, automation assets, integrations, test execution infrastructure, quality reporting, and AI-evaluation capabilities.
  • Establish risk-based quality models, release-readiness criteria, quality gates, certification standards, and evidence requirements for critical platforms, business processes, integrations, data products, and AI agents.
  • Lead a centralized quality engineering service that plans, automates, executes, and governs testing across enterprise products, platforms, programs, and high-risk releases.
  • Develop reusable automation frameworks, model-based testing patterns, API and integration testing capabilities, regression suites, and continuous testing practices aligned to business risk and production impact.
  • Establish enterprise capabilities for AI-agent evaluation, including scenario design, evaluation datasets, regression testing, tool-use validation, policy and permission checks, human escalation criteria, and production quality monitoring.
  • Own the enterprise approach to test data, test environments, service virtualization, production validation, and quality analytics to reduce release risk and delivery delays.
  • Provide independent quality intelligence and release-risk assessments to engineering, product, program, and executive stakeholders.
  • Manage vendor-outsourced quality engineering resources, Tricentis partners, systems integrators, and specialist testing providers to deliver sustained enterprise quality outcomes.
  • Build a quality engineering culture focused on automation, objective assurance, reuse, engineering discipline, measurable outcomes, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • Minimum of twelve (12) years of experience in quality engineering, software testing, test automation, platform engineering, enterprise technology delivery, or related technology disciplines, including 5+ years leading quality engineering, test automation, enterprise testing, or platform-oriented teams.
  • Demonstrated experience building or leading modern quality engineering capabilities beyond manual test execution, including automation strategy, risk-based testing, continuous testing, quality gates, and release assurance.
  • Strong experience with enterprise test automation and test management platforms, preferably Tricentis Tosca and qTest.
  • Experience leading testing or quality engineering across multiple products, platforms, business processes, programs, or business units.
  • Strong understanding of API, integration, data, workflow, cloud, event-driven, distributed-system, performance, resilience, and production validation testing.
  • Practical knowledge of generative AI, large language models, retrieval, AI agents, tool calling, evaluation methods, and responsible AI testing practices.
  • Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, vendor management, financial management, organizational leadership, and decision-making skills.

Estimated base salary range: $126,600 - $194,700 USD/annually.

Work Authorization Requirement: This position is not eligible for employment-based visa sponsorship. Zayo will not provide, transfer, or assume sponsorship for any employment visa or work authorization for this position now or in the future.

  • Excellent Health, Dental & Vision Insurance

Job Description

A bit about this role:

Devoted Health is redefining healthcare. We are seeking a Primary Care Physician (PCP) to lead an innovative clinical model that treats members like family. In this role, you will be a clinician-leader and a builder of the highest-quality virtual primary care model in the nation. Your role will involve deep clinical work managing a shared panel of primary patients, supervising a team of Advanced Practice Providers, developing a suite of industry leading embedded AI-technology, and building out our core clinical model.

You will practice as part of a collaborative interprofessional team while supervising an Advanced Practice Provider pod caring for a panel of patients. You will be supported by industry-leading AI-enabled technology and will be able to refer your patients to a robust suite of internal Devoted Medical specialty clinics.

This position offers the opportunity to impact patient outcomes at scale in a modern, tech-supported care environment and to deeply influence the build of our primary care operation.

Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • Clinical Care: Deliver primary care within an interdisciplinary team, ensuring effective, patient-centered care. You will be a clinician leader on the Active Care team, responsible for managing diagnostic dilemmas, complex workups, and patients with multiple ongoing chronic disease management needs.

  • Team Management: Provide supervision, teaching and quality oversight to a team of Advanced Practice Providers. You will foster a collaborative and supportive clinical environment that will help your team thrive.Lead weekly interdisciplinary rounds and readmission conferences to review high-risk patients.

  • Innovation: Drive innovation and process improvement to enhance the delivery of primary care services. You will be given the tools to rapidly solve problems and develop new ways of delivering primary care with AI and digital engagement as a foundation. The builder work you do will have a lasting and demonstrable impact on our delivery system.

  • Quality Measurement and Oversight: Our objective is to deliver the highest quality primary care in the nation. You will have the opportunity to build new quality measures, manage quality oversight for your pod, and help us iterate on our balanced scorecard for primary care. Additionally, you will hold collaborative practice agreements with APPs across multiple states.

Attributes to success:

  • Clinical Excellence: A passion for delivering high-quality patient care and demonstrated commitment to primary care. New graduates are encouraged to apply.

  • Servant Leadership: Recognize that everyone's success is your success. Enable your team to be empowered to do their best work possible and trust your guidance and assistance.

  • Passion for Improvement: Passionate about making healthcare better, solving complex problems, and supporting the delivery of healthcare that we would want for our own family members.

  • Adaptability & Agility: Wired for learning and change, comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-energy environment.

Required skills and experience:

  • A board-certified Internal Medicine or Family Medicine physician with demonstrated commitment to primary care

  • Experience serving diverse patient populations, with a focus on delivering care that aligns with our mission to treat every member like family.

  • You believe deeply in measuring and improving the quality of primary care delivery across a population.

Desired skills and experience:

  • Experience supervising Advanced Practice Providers or other healthcare professionals is highly desired, though recent graduates are welcome to apply.

  • Proven ability to manage change and drive innovation in a dynamic healthcare environment and/or run a clinical program is desired.

  • Experience with virtual primary care is a plus but not required.

Salary Range: $265,000 - $320,000/ year

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.


Devoted is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a safe and supportive work environment in which all employees have the opportunity to participate and contribute to the success of the business. Grid Compliance Manager is to ensure that the grid connection/ compliance deliverables and test documentation required to be submitted to the DNOs and NESO by e-Storage and its’s partners or subcontractors, are provided in a timely, and high-quality manner to guarantee on time energization and smooth commissioning.

As the Engineering Lead for the CCM platform, you will set the technical direction and engineering standards across a set of interconnected applications – spanning greenfield development, enterprise scaling of existing applications, and integration with vendor and internal systems. You will serve as a Solution Lead, starting with a newly formed discovery team and continuing as the platform expands into dedicated delivery teams.

This role combines technical leadership with hands-on engineering (approximately 40–50% coding). The ideal candidate is an experienced solution or engineering lead who enjoys building new platforms, keeps teams honest on engineering practices, and is energized by shaping a multi-year transformation of how Mutual of Omaha communicates with its customers.

jobs.excerpt: über juni JUNI ist ein gemeinnütziges Ökosystem für Wissenschaft und Ausgründungen in Berlin.
jobs.description:
über juni

JUNI ist ein gemeinnütziges Ökosystem für Wissenschaft und Ausgründungen in Berlin. Wir betreiben unsere Programme über sieben SaaS-Tools hinweg — Newsletter, Events, Community, CRM, Formulare, Bewerbungen, Coworking — und darunter eine Postgres-Datenbank, die der eine Ort sein soll, an dem eine Person existiert.

Auf die Datenbank kommt es an. Ein aufgelöster Datensatz pro Person und pro Organisation, eine append-only-Zeile pro Interaktion, und ein deterministischer Weg zu entscheiden, zu welcher Person ein eingehender Payload gehört. Ziel ist, den Weg vom ersten Kontaktpunkt bis zum Meilenstein messbar zu machen. Die Verbindungsschicht zwischen den Tools und dieser Datenbank ist die Aufgabe.

deine aufgaben

Die Schicht bauen, die unsere Systeme mit einer Datenbank verbindet — in beide Richtungen — und uns dabei helfen, das Datenmodell richtig hinzubekommen.

Die Form der Daten steht weitgehend, und jedes neue System stellt sie auf die Probe. Quellen sind sich nicht einig, was als eine Person zählt, wann etwas passiert ist, und ob sie es zweimal melden. Das zu klären — und zu erkennen, wann das Modell angepasst werden muss, statt es um eine Quelle herumzubiegen — ist der Kern der Arbeit.

Wir suchen jemanden, der das mit uns durchdenkt und für einen bestimmten Entwurf argumentiert, nicht nur umsetzt, was spezifiziert ist.

dein profil

Umfang

InboundJedes System in die Datenbank. Mehrere Pipelines pro System — Quellen melden sehr unterschiedliche Dinge. Identitätsauflösung über Systeme hinweg.OutboundManche Zustände entstehen bei uns, nicht im Tool. Die Datenbank entscheidet und schiebt an die Plattform, die es ausführt.Beide Richtungen sauber haltenPlattformen melden zurück und widersprechen uns manchmal. Wer sich abgemeldet hat, darf nicht wieder hinzugefügt werden.ReportingKPI-Daten müssen in einem BI-Tool ankommen. Sie dorthin zu bringen gehört dazu, Dashboards bauen nicht.SucheDen Datenbestand in natürlicher Sprache durchsuchbar machen.DokumentationEntscheidungen schriftlich, Pipelines in GitHub.

Nicht Teil der Rolle

  • Frontend. Es gibt keins und es ist keins geplant.

Voraussetzungen

  • Integration gegen Third-Party-APIs und Webhooks, in der Tiefe: Pagination, Retries, Signaturprüfung, Rate Limits, undokumentierte Payload-Strukturen, verspätete und vertauschte Events, Quellen, die bei jeder Änderung feuern und nicht sagen, was sich geändert hat.
  • Bidirektionale Synchronisation zwischen Systemen, die beide dasselbe Feld für ihres halten — Loop-Vermeidung, Echo-Unterdrückung, eine klare Antwort darauf, wer bei Konflikten gewinnt.
  • Postgres als Anwendungsdatenbank, nicht nur als Ziel. plpgsql-Funktionen, Trigger, Constraints und RLS, um Regeln beim Schreiben durchzusetzen. Wenn sich deine SQL-Erfahrung auf Transformationen nach dem Load beschränkt, passt die Rolle nicht.
  • Idempotenz als Gewohnheit, nicht als Nachgedanke. Eine Pipeline, die erneut läuft und nichts verändert, ist der Abnahmetest.
  • Sauberes Arbeiten mit Git — Migrationen, PRs, Review.
  • Arbeit mit personenbezogenen Daten unter der DSGVO, und ein Verständnis dafür, warum das einschränkt, was überhaupt eingelesen wird.
  • Englisch in Schrift. Die Arbeit läuft überwiegend asynchron, und was du baust, muss für jemanden lesbar sein, der nicht dabei war.

Hilfreich, nicht erforderlich

n8n oder ein anderer Orchestrator · Supabase · Relevanzarbeit an einem Suchindex — Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Meilisearch oder vergleichbar; Cluster-Betrieb ist nicht der Teil, den wir brauchen · Erfahrung als einzige Person auf einem System · Deutsch.

Whether you find your edge in data-driven, lead-responsive execution or in nurturing a local professional network, both paths offer a high-impact career within the Zillow ecosystem.

You’ll guide borrowers from first contact through funding while delivering a best-in-class customer experience. Based on your background and strengths, you may operate in either a high-volume, digitally driven environment or a relationship-based, market-focused model. Success in this role comes from responsiveness, execution, and performance in a structured, metrics-driven organization—supported by Zillow’s brand, platform, and operational scale.

Position Title: Senior Developer, APIs

Department: Technology - Engineering - Digital Experience (DEx)

Reports to (Title): Head of Engineering

Level/Sub-Level:Operations Level / Professional​

☒Exempt ☐ Non-Exempt

POSITION PURPOSE

The Sr. Developer, APIs is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the API platform that supports YPO's member ecosystem, chapter operations, and agentic AI platform.

This role owns the technical implementation of APIs that sit at the core of the digital experience and works closely with Product, Data Architecture, IT, and Security to deliver scalable, secure, and well-governed API solutions.

The role requires strong backend engineering expertise, a high standard for API quality, and the ability to translate complex integration requirements into maintainable, production-grade systems within an event-driven, domain-aligned, serverless-first architecture.

Your API Portfolio: You will own the engineering implementation of three core API domains:

Members API

Stable, semantic endpoints exposing member profile, identity, peer discovery, and graph relationships. The foundation of member experience.

Chapters API

APIs powering chapter management, forum operations, event discovery, and role-based data access across YPO's global regional structure.

Agentic Ecosystem APIs

Governed API contracts for AI agents (Peer Discovery, Event Discovery) built on OpenAI + RAG and Google Gemini. Agents consume only approved APIs. Agent reasoning must always be surfaceable.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. API Design & Implementation

  • Design and implement production-grade RESTful and GraphQL APIs deployed via AWS API Gateway that are stable, semantic, and decoupled from vendor-specific backend schemas.

  • Ensure all APIs conform to YPO's canonical ontology and global member graph. No endpoint may directly expose Salesforce object structures. APIs must map to govern entity definitions maintained in the enterprise data dictionary.

  • Design APIs to operate within an event-driven architecture leveraging CDC, pub/sub messaging (Kafka and AWS EventBridge), and idempotent patterns.

  • Apply Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles bounded contexts, ubiquitous language, and domain events to ensure API boundaries reflect business domains, not implementation details.

  • Adopt a serverless-first approach using AWS Lambda, Step Functions, and EventBridge where appropriate, selecting stateful services only when serverless patterns are genuinely insufficient.

  • Write clean, well-tested, and well-documented code across the Members, Chapters, and Agentic Ecosystem API domains.

  • Define and enforce data models, versioning standards, authentication flows (Auth0 / Okta / OAuth 2.0), and integration patterns from first principles.

  • Apply performance-aware design intentional pagination, caching strategies, query constraints, and rate-limiting so APIs scale safely under real-world load.

  • Every API decision must reinforce member trust through privacy-first architecture, consent enforcement, and transparent data usage.

  • Ensure every API response includes provenance and explanation metadata, so agent reasoning is always surfaceable to the member.

2. Agentic Ecosystem Engineering

  • Implement the API governance layer that controls how YPO's AI agents (Peer Discovery, Event Discovery) interact with member data on OpenAI + custom RAG and Google Gemini.

  • All agent-facing APIs must support structured retrieval, citation-ready provenance fields, consent-aware filtering, and deterministic fallback.

  • Build and maintain kill-switch-capable API boundaries that prevent agents from ever consuming raw member data outside approved contracts.

  • Instrument agent API integrations with feedback loop mechanisms hallucination rates, task success rates, and cost-per-outcome metrics must be observable and attributable to specific API behaviors.

  • Collaborate with data science and ML teams to translate agentic data flow requirements into governed, tested API contracts.

3. API Lifecycle, Versioning & Governance

  • Own the full API lifecycle: development, testing, documentation, versioning, deprecation, and migration planning. Every phase requires an explicit decision, no implied continuation.

  • Establish and maintain engineering standards for API versioning, backward compatibility, and breaking-change policy.

  • Build and maintain sandbox environments, integration test suites, and automated contract tests for every endpoint in the portfolio.

  • Working with Engineering leads to ensuring reliable CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, observability via Datadog, alerting, and uptime SLAs. All infrastructure changes must be deployed via Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or AWS CDK) manual console changes in production are not permitted.

4. Cloud Architecture, IAM & Security

  • Design and enforce IAM boundary design using least-privilege principles, permission boundaries, and Service Control Policies (SCPs) ensuring API-layer identities and Lambda execution roles cannot exceed governed data access boundaries.

  • Operate within and contribute to YPO's multi-account AWS strategy (AWS Organizations, Control Tower) understanding how workload isolation, environment separation, and cross-account roles affect API deployment patterns and security boundaries.

  • All cloud infrastructure must be defined and maintained as code using Terraform or AWS CDK this is a hard requirement, not optional practice.

5. Developer Experience & Enablement

  • Produce and maintain clear API documentation, for example queries, and troubleshooting guides so internal teams can self serve without escalation.

  • Support technical onboarding for new product teams and integration partners, ensuring APIs are discoverable, stable, and easy to consume.

  • Identify and address developer friction proactively issues must never surface only via member complaints or downstream team escalations.

  • Act as a technical resource for Engineering peers consuming the Members, Chapters, and Agentic APIs.

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Data Architecture to ensure APIs maintain stable semantic meaning over evolving backend schemas frontend experience must be decoupled from vendor-specific fields.

  • Partner with IT and Security to enforce role-based access, chapter-scoped data boundaries, and member consent policy (Auth0 / Okta, OneTrust, GDPR, CCPA).

  • Collaborate with Product teams and the Sr. Product Manager, Technical to translate requirements and API specifications into production implementations.

  • Evaluate and integrate third-party technologies (Elasticsearch, Kafka / AWS EventBridge, Search Orchestration Service) that enhance YPO's member ecosystem.

How We Measure Success

  • API Reliability APIs meet defined uptime SLAs; issues detected proactively via Datadog not reported by members.

  • Code Quality New endpoints ship with full test coverage; zero undocumented breaking changes; lifecycle plans in place for every endpoint.

  • Developer Experience Internal teams can serve from documentation; integration timelines reduced; escalations minimized.

  • Delivery Roadmap milestones delivered on time, with acceptance test coverage and passing CI/CD pipelines.

  • Agent Safety Zero agentic API calls bypass the governance layer; kill-switch tested and functional for all agent endpoints.

  • Explainability Every API response includes provenance and explanation metadata; no result feels like a black box.

  • Observability All agent integrations emit hallucination rates, task success, and cost-per-outcome metrics traceable to specific API behaviors.

  • IaC Compliance All infrastructure changes are deployed via Terraform or CDK; no manual console changes in production.

SKILLS

  • Ability to work collaboratively in a multi-cultural organization with international members, helping them achieve excellence in voluntary roles for YPO initiatives. 

  • Excellent interpersonal skills, including strong diplomacy skills with the ability to build meaningful relationships with all levels of associates, members and vendors. Adaptable, insightful, empathetic and reliable. Great sense of humor and humility. 

  • Resourceful and able to work independently with initiative and common sense. Effective time management, organization and prioritization skills with the ability to focus on varied projects simultaneously. 

  • Possesses a distinct global mindset, sensitive to local and international customs and protocols.  

  • Demonstrate empathy through active listening and asking the right questions to find the source of an issue. 

  • Able to identify problems, research alternatives, provide solutions and/or resolve issues in a timely manner. Anticipates member/internal client needs and delivers with clarity. 

  • Analytical thinker with ability influence and guide processes with appropriate approach and execution. Natural curiosity and desire to learn more; proficiency and interest in applying new technologies and tools. 

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including proof reading, with a meticulous attention to detail. Adjust communication style appropriately to the audience.  

  • Professional presence, appearance, and stature to interact easily with YPO members, C-level executives and peers at all levels within the organization.  

  • Strong ability to translate complex security risks into clear business decisions.

  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across product, engineering, and global teams.

  • Analytical thinker with strong architectural judgment and risk-based decision making.

  • High degree of discretion and integrity in handling confidential information.

  • Ability to operate independently in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.

EXPERIENCE/BACKGROUND

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in security engineering, with at least 3 years focused on cloud infrastructure security (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP).

  • Experience integrating security tooling into CI/CD platforms (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, Jenkins, etc.).

  • Experience securing AI/ML infrastructure, including model APIs, data pipelines, vector databases, and inference endpoints.

  • Experience with AI technologies, ability to monitor LLM usage, audit model access controls, etc.

  • API abuse detection across the entire SDLC.

  • Strong experience with IaC tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM).

  • Familiarity with container security and Kubernetes environments.

  • Experience with SAST, DAST, SCA, and dependency scanning tools.

  • Proficiency in Python or equivalent scripting language.

  • Strong knowledge of IAM, encryption, OAuth/OIDC, RBAC, and secure cloud architecture principles.

  • Understanding of compliance & security frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST).

  • Exposure to mobile application security on native iOS and/or Android platforms, including API security, token management, and mobile threat defense.

EDUCATION/TRAINING/CERTIFICATION

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent experience).

  • Security certifications are highly desirable (AWS, Azure, GCP, CISSP, CCSP, GIAC, etc.).

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to work flexible and/or extended hours as needed to accommodate members and team members in multiple time zones.

  • Willingness and ability to travel, domestically and internationally, without restrictions, approximately 5-10% per year.

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. jobs.description:
NOTE: This is a remote-global role. The hiring team is considering candidates wherever CRS is registered to work at. CRS does not sponsor visas for remote employees.

The Pay Range referenced in this job announcement only applies to applicants who perform the job within the US and to applicants classified by CRS as International Assignees. Staff hired on local payroll would follow the respective Country pay range. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your anticipated work location during the candidate selection process.

Pay Range

$95,173 - $117,498 Annually

Job Summary

The Deputy Chief of Party II will work as part of the leadership team for the anticipated Continuity of Integrated Health Services (CIHS) project, a multi-country initiative supporting Guinea, Liberia, Mali, and Togo. The Deputy Chief of Party II will provide strategic oversight and leadership for all project technical programming, ensuring the quality, integration, and effectiveness of interventions across malaria, maternal, newborn and child health (MNCH), health systems strengthening, infectious disease preparedness and response, and transition to country ownership.

The Deputy Chief of Party II will directly oversee the project's core team technical advisors and guide implementation of technical strategies aligned with the project's four objectives: (1) strengthening malaria and MNCH service delivery; (2) strengthening health information systems, laboratories, supply chains, and other health systems; (3) improving readiness to detect and respond to infectious disease threats; and (4) accelerating the transition to country-led health programs.

This position will ensure technical approaches are evidence-based, coordinated across countries, and aligned with host-country priorities and the America First Global Health Strategy. The Deputy Chief of Party II's management and technical knowledge will ensure the delivery of high-quality programming and achievement of project results. As a senior leader, the incumbent will proactively manage and mitigate technical risks and support a culture of learning, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Roles and Key Responsibilities

  • Provide overall technical leadership for the development, implementation and consolidation of the CIHS project across malaria, MNCH, laboratory systems, disease surveillance, health information systems, supply chain strengthening, and other health systems strengthening interventions. Serve as the primary technical point of contact with the Department of State, as well as public, private and non-government stakeholders, when requested.
  • Lead the development and execution of an integrated technical strategy that advances the project's objectives and ensures coordination across technical disciplines, countries, and consortium partners. Ensure technical activities achieve high-quality, timely results and are aligned with donor priorities, country needs, and global best practices. Work closely with programmatic and operational leaders to promote effective implementation and ensure CRS program quality standards, MEAL policies, and procedures are consistently applied.
  • Effectively manage, supervise, mentor a multidisciplinary team of technical advisors. Foster collaboration across technical areas, manage team dynamics, and staff well-being. Strategically tailor individual development plans and complete performance assessments for direct reports.
  • Contribute to the development of staffing plans and the recruitment process of senior technical staff.
  • Manage and mitigate technical risks that may affect achievement of project objectives and milestones. Monitor evolving national health priorities, policy developments, and contextual factors that may affect implementation, and support risk mitigation strategies to maintain program quality and continuity. Ensure all staff understand and adhere to CRS staff safety, security, and safeguarding policies and plans.
  • Promote, uphold and model responsible stewardship of agency and donor resources. Help ensure technical activities are implemented efficiently and in compliance with donor requirements, while collaborating with CIHS leadership team to support sound budget management, reporting, and accountability.
  • Maintain relationships with key staff of consortium partner organizations in areas related to their respective scopes of work. Contribute to coordination of the roles and activities of staff from other consortium member organizations in implementation in line with CRS partnership principles.
  • Foster a culture of learning and continuous improvement across the project. Create and maintain an environment that encourages collaborative problem-solving, the sharing of lessons learned, and adaptive management.

  • Proactive, resourceful, solutions-oriented and results-oriented.

Travel: Must be willing and able to travel up to 30%.

jobs.title: REMOTE Sales Manager
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT USOur client is an established business coaching company that helps successful business owners build stronger, more scalable, owner-independent companies.
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Our client is an established business coaching company that helps successful business owners build stronger, more scalable, owner-independent companies. For more than 20 years, the company has worked with business owners to improve growth, profitability, leadership, systems, and ultimately create businesses that can thrive without depending entirely on the owner.

They are seeking an experienced, hands-on Sales Leader to lead, rebuild, and scale our sales organization.

This is not a role for someone who has only managed sales teams from a distance. They are looking for a true player-coach: someone who has personally been a successful high-ticket salesperson, knows how to coach and develop salespeople, has built outbound-generated pipeline, and has successfully improved an underperforming sales organization.

Why Join US

This is an opportunity to make a visible impact, not simply maintain an existing sales organization.

You'll inherit a company with an established brand, proven coaching programs, existing sales infrastructure, a substantial prospect database, and a history of strong sales performance—but you'll also have the autonomy to rebuild and improve the sales engine.

The right person will have significant influence over how the sales organization evolves and meaningful upside as the company grows.

If you're a proven sales leader who still understands what it takes to personally win business—and you enjoy building teams, fixing problems, and creating predictable revenue—we'd like to talk.

Compensation: $60,000–$100,000 base/guaranteed compensation + uncapped performance compensation
Expected Year-One Earnings:Approximately $150,000–$200,000 based on performance

The Opportunity

The sales organization currently includes:

  • A team of outbound setters responsible for proactively generating qualified sales appointments.

  • An Enrollment Director responsible for conducting consultative sales conversations and enrolling business owners into coaching programs.

  • An Account Management function responsible for client relationships, retention, referrals, and expansion opportunities.

The foundation is already in place, including CRM, dialing technology, sales scripts, an existing database, and a functioning outbound process.

The next Sales Leader will own improving, scaling, and managing the system.

Initially, your biggest priorities will be scaling the outbound setter team and improving closing performance. Over time, you will also develop additional revenue opportunities through referrals, past-client reactivation, previous qualified prospects, events, and other proactive sales strategies.

What You'll Do

Lead and Scale the Sales Team

Manage, coach, train, and develop the company's sales organization, including outbound setters and Enrollment Directors.

Recruit and onboard additional sales talent as the organization grows.

Establish clear expectations, activity standards, KPIs, accountability, and performance management.

Make difficult personnel decisions when necessary and continuously upgrade the strength of the sales organization.

Build a Predictable Outbound Sales Engine

Scale the existing outbound setter organization to consistently generate qualified sales conversations.

Create a sales organization that can generate its own pipeline rather than relying primarily on inbound marketing.

Continuously improve prospecting strategies, scripts, lead management, follow-up, reactivation, and referral generation.

Work closely with leadership and marketing to maximize the company's house database, outbound lists, inbound opportunities, events, referrals, and other lead sources.

Coach High-Ticket Sales

Review sales conversations and identify opportunities to improve discovery, qualification, objection handling, emotional engagement, and closing.

Coach Enrollment Directors through recorded calls, role-playing, scripting, and ongoing feedback.

Initially serve as a backup closer when necessary.

The long-term goal is not for the Sales Leader to compete with the sales team for deals, but this person must be capable of stepping into a sales conversation, successfully closing business, and demonstrating what great selling looks like.

Drive Sales Performance

Analyze activity, appointments, conversion rates, enrollments, pipeline, and revenue.

Use data to identify performance gaps and translate those insights into specific coaching, process, staffing, and sales strategies.

Build a disciplined sales culture focused on accountability and measurable results.

Initial Success Measures

Within approximately the first 2–4 months, we expect the Sales Leader to:

  • Evaluate the existing sales organization.

  • Scale and strengthen the outbound setter team.

  • Build toward approximately 6–8 productive part-time setters.

  • Generate at least 20–30 held qualified sales appointments per month.

  • Evaluate current closing performance and determine the appropriate coaching or personnel strategy.

  • Begin moving qualified close rates toward a minimum 25% target.

After stabilizing the core sales organization, the Sales Leader will expand into referrals, client reactivation, previous qualified opportunities, events, and other self-generated revenue strategies.

What We're Looking For

1. Experience With a Comparable Sales Model

You have meaningful experience with a sales process where appointments are generated and then handed to a closer for a consultative sales conversation.

Ideally, you have sold high-ticket services or programs directly to small and midsized business owners through phone or Zoom conversations.

2. You Have Personally Been a Successful Salesperson

You didn't begin your career managing salespeople—you learned how to sell.

You can discuss your personal sales results, close rates, average deal sizes, quotas, and performance.

You understand how to conduct discovery, uncover business and emotional pain, handle objections, and confidently ask for the business.

3. You Know How to Generate Business Without Depending on Marketing

You have led teams that generated meaningful pipeline through outbound prospecting, cold and warm outreach, database reactivation, referrals, or similar proactive strategies.

You appreciate inbound leads, but don't depend on them to succeed.

4. You've Successfully Rebuilt a Sales Team

You have at least five years of relevant sales leadership experience, ideally 10+.

More importantly, you've inherited an underperforming sales team or sales function and materially improved it.

You can clearly explain:

  • What performance looked like when you arrived.

  • What wasn't working.

  • What you changed.

  • Who you hired, coached, or replaced.

  • How you changed process or accountability.

  • The measurable results that followed.

5. You're a High-Accountability Leader
You're self-directed, organized, and comfortable operating with autonomy.

You communicate clearly, do what you say you're going to do, and take ownership when something isn't working.

You're comfortable making difficult decisions and don't need someone else continually motivating or managing you.

Job Description

At Blue Cross NC, we recognize the dedication, discipline, and leadership that transitioning service members bring to the workforce. Through our DoW SkillBridge Program, we provide a unique opportunity for military personnel in their final months of service to gain hands-on experience in a civilian work environment while exploring meaningful career paths in the healthcare industry.

By joining Blue Cross NC’s SkillBridge Program, service members can deploy their leadership, problem-solving skills, and mission-driven mindset in a civilian setting. This internship provides a bridge between military service and a meaningful career in healthcare, allowing participants to continue their tradition of service—this time, by helping make healthcare better for all.

We are honored to support transitioning military professionals as they navigate this next chapter and invite you to explore how your skills can make a difference at Blue Cross NC.

**This program is open to only active military service members.**


  • Develop and execute strategic military and veteran-focused initiatives that advance Blue Cross NC's brand, business objectives, member outreach, retention efforts, and community impact. Strategies will include improving access to healthcare, behavioral health resources, benefits education, and social determinants of health for active-duty service members, veterans, and military families.

  • Manage military engagement projects, programs, policies, and procedures, ensuring deliverables, strategic objectives, compliance requirements, and performance measures are successfully achieved.
  • Evaluate community needs and partnership opportunities to develop sustainable, long-term initiatives that strengthen trust within the military community while supporting Blue Cross NC's mission and business objectives.

  • Applicants must be active-duty service members within their last 180 days of service at the time of internship start.

  • Note: To be eligible for full-time employment at Blue Cross NC, individuals must reside and work in one of the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maryland, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Wisconsin, or Wyoming.

  • Command and service branch approval documentation (if available).

  • Final selection is contingent upon Blue Cross NC’s internal review and business need alignment.

Program Compliance:

  • The Blue Cross NC SkillBridge Program is conducted in accordance with Department of War (DoW) policies, guidance, and regulations. Participation is subject to DoW approval, and all service members must adhere to applicable program requirements throughout their internship.

Additional Considerations

  • Service members are responsible for their own housing, transportation, and living expenses during the internship.

The Role

As our Cyber Risk and Compliance Specialist, you will occupy a critical role that is 50% technical auditor and 50% security advocate. You will ensure the integrity of our financial systems through IT SOX compliance while simultaneously maturing our global compliance posture (HIPAA/NIS2) and building a high-integrity security culture through a comprehensive Security Awareness program.


Focus A: IT SOX & Financial Integrity (60%)

  • Program Ownership: Lead the IT SOX program and design, implement, and test IT General Controls (ITGCs), IT Application controls (ITACs) and Key Reports (IPE) across our enterprise applications, databases, and infrastructure.

• Audit Management: Serve as the primary "translator" between technical teams and external auditors, ensuring evidence is accurate, timely, and defensible.

• Deficiency Management: Lead the root-cause analysis for any control failures and partner with stakeholders to build long-term, remediation plans.


Focus B: HIPAA, NIS2 & Risk Advisory (30%)

• Healthcare Compliance (HIPAA): Act as the technical SME for the HIPAA Security Rule, ensuring controls protect PHI, including controls monitoring and providing guidance to management for new systems.

• International Resilience (NIS2): Lead the alignment of our security posture with the NIS2 Directive, focusing on key areas in the directive for our European operations.

• Strategic Risk Assessments: Conduct deep-dive risk assessments for new technologies and vendors, ensuring compliance is baked in from the procurement stage.


Focus C: Security Awareness & Training (10%)

• Program Development: Manage the security awareness program that goes beyond "check-the-box" training. You will create engaging content for diverse audiences, from senior leadership to staff.

• Policy Promotion: Translate dense Information Security Policies into digestible, actionable "good practices" for IT administrators and data owners.

• Culture Building: Design targeted communication campaigns to increase internal reporting of security incidents and reinforce the importance of compliance.


Qualifications

• Experience: 5–7 years in IT Audit, IT Compliance, or Cyber Risk.

• Regulatory Knowledge: Expert-level understanding of SOX 404 (ITGCs) and a strong working knowledge of the HIPAA Security Rule and NIS2.

• Frameworks: Proficiency in applying NIST 800-53, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, or COBIT.

• Certifications: CISA is highly preferred; CISSP or CRISC is a major plus.

• Skills: The ability to explain to key stakeholders why a certain control is necessary without sounding like an auditor.

• Technology: Experience with ERP systems, such as SAP (ECC/S4 HANA) etc., cloud environments like Microsoft Azure, AWS etc., GRC systems such as Auditboard, Workiva or other.

jobs.description:
Are you ready to be a big part of something big?

At Trader Interactive, we make buying and selling a great experience. We’re a group of go-getters who decided they didn’t want to settle for the status quo. We come together as one team to build value and drive innovation across our industries - but we have fun while we do it and make sure our people are always our #1 priority.

When it comes to your career, we want to provide big opportunities to help you make a big impact. But for this to be possible, we strive to feel small. Small enough to quickly change tack, small enough to learn from different teams and small enough to connect authentically with leadership.

What We Offer

  • An inclusive and supportive work environment where you can move your career forward and will have the chance to do work that has real, significant impact on the world.

  • The opportunity to be a part of a global group of digital marketplace businesses (CAR Group) located across Australia, Brazil, Chile and South Korea - collectively we have around 1,800 team members worldwide, and our Global Talent Exchange Program means you might just find yourself working in one of those businesses sometime soon.

  • Plenty of flexible leave options and employee benefits including up to 31 days of paid time off in your first year, continuing education with access to LinkedIn Learning, a full benefits package including medical, dental & vision, 401K with company match, and wellness program.

What You’ll Do

As Director of GTM Operations, you’ll own the planning, analytics, and operating rhythm that connect our go-to-market strategy to execution across Sales and Marketing. You’ll lead a small team, including an analyst and a project manager, and use data, AI, and research to shape GTM decisions, keep teams aligned, and drive measurable revenue impact.

GTM Strategy & Planning

  • Partner with Sales leadership and Finance to build and operationalize the annual growth plan: pipeline and bookings targets, capacity, headcount, and budget.

  • Lead GTM strategy for new products and verticals, pricing and packaging changes, and market expansion.

  • Build segmentation and coverage models that focus reps on the highest-value opportunities and improve productivity.

  • Turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations for Sales leadership.

Campaign Operations & Governance

  • Run the campaign operating rhythm: governance, meeting cadences, decision rights, and follow-through.

  • Own campaign dashboards that track milestones, owners, risks, and dependencies, and escalate blockers with a recommended path forward.

  • Build repeatable launch playbooks covering CRM configuration, workflows, reporting, and sales enablement.

Sales & Marketing Alignment

  • Define and enforce the marketing-to-sales handoff (lead routing, follow-up SLAs, and rules of engagement), partnering with CRM, Systems, and Engineering on the process and system design behind it.

  • Align campaigns, lists, and messaging with sales workflows and pipeline priorities.

  • Run feedback loops so Sales and Marketing operate as one team.

AI, Automation & Process Innovation

  • Identify, pilot, and scale AI and automation across prospecting, lead scoring, deal support, and rep workflows.

  • Track emerging AI-native GTM tools and bring what’s proven into the team’s playbook.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and develop a small team, including an analyst and a project manager: set priorities, coach for growth, and hold a high bar on quality and follow-through.

  • Balance the team’s capacity across planning, analytics, and campaign operations work.

What We’re Looking For

  • 6+ years in GTM Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or strategic consulting/finance.

  • Experience leading and developing a team, ideally including analysts and/or project managers.

  • Track record of owning complex, cross-functional initiatives end to end, from problem framing and analysis through stakeholder alignment, execution, and measurement.

  • Strong commercial instincts: you connect operational decisions to revenue outcomes, funnel health, and rep productivity.

  • Deep Salesforce experience plus hands-on work with BI and data warehouse tools (e.g., Looker, Snowflake), with SQL and advanced spreadsheet modeling skills.

  • Executive-level communicator who turns messy operational problems into structured, actionable roadmaps.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in a marketplace environment.

  • Experience working across multiple business segments and/or product lines.

  • Hands-on experience deploying AI or automation tools in a GTM setting.

So come and join our team - because every role is a big role in our plans to go big.

TI proudly supports a diverse workforce, and we encourage candidates from underrepresented groups to apply. Trader Interactive is an equal opportunity employer where hiring is based entirely on business needs, job requirements, and individual merit.
