jobs.excerpt: Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic.
jobs.description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!

Our Values

Best Life

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

Growth Mindset

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

One Team

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.

INTRODUCTION:

ABC Fitness has the product, the client base, and the market position. What's missing is a single owner who can convert the mobile and digital coaching opportunity inside our existing top accounts and across a new class of multi-location prospects into a repeatable, enterprise-grade revenue motion.


This role merges two functions that were operating as separate, sub-scale motions: expansion selling into ABC's most strategic accounts, and net-new enterprise acquisition of mobile-first, multi-location fitness operators. It is built as a player-coach seat; the person in this role carries a personal number, manages one direct report, and owns enablement for every new product ABC brings to the sales floor.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Own Expansion Across the Top 100

Personally manage and grow ABC's relationship with its 100 most strategic gym and studio accounts. Lead full-cycle expansion opportunities, mobile app, digital coaching, CRM, and premium platform add-ons across Ignite and Glofox from discovery through close. Build multi-year account plans that treat these accounts as long-term growth partners, not renewal targets.


Drive Net-New Mobile Enterprise Acquisition

Build and run an enterprise sales motion targeting mobile-first operators with 10+ locations who sit outside the current client base. Sell Trainerize Enterprise and standalone mobile/training services as a wedge into larger, multi-location groups. Own the full cycle: prospecting, discovery, demo, business case, negotiation, and close, supported by dedicated SDR capacity.


Lead a Direct Report

Manage one Cross-Sell/Upsell Account Manager. Set activity and pipeline expectations, run weekly 1:1s and deal reviews, and coach toward quota attainment and long-term skill development. This is the first management rep in what should become a small, high-performing pod as the mobile enterprise motion scales.


Partner with the Enterprise SDR Team

Work directly with SDR leadership to define targeting criteria for the mobile enterprise segment (location count, platform fit, incumbent signals) and to build outbound sequences and qualification standards specific to this motion. This is a working overlay, not a reporting relationship; success depends on pipeline quality, not headcount ownership.


Own Product & Product Line Enablement

Serve as the enablement owner for every new product or product line that ABC introduces to the sales organization, globally across Mid-Market and Enterprise. Build the positioning, objection-handling, and certification materials that the broader sales team uses to sell each new release, starting with mobile and digital coaching capabilities.


Build the Enterprise Mobile GTM Motion

Define the playbook that makes this a repeatable enterprise motion rather than a set of one-off deals: ICP criteria for 10+-location mobile prospects, a standard business case template, a pricing/packaging approach for mobile-only entry deals, and a clear expansion path from a single-service sale to full platform adoption.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Delivered measurable expansion MRR across the Top 100, directly attributable to mobile and digital coaching attach.
  • Closed and onboarded a first cohort of net-new mobile enterprise logos (10+ locations), validating the wedge motion.
  • Built a repeatable enterprise mobile playbook: ICP, business case, pricing- that a second hire could pick up in year two.
  • Coached the Cross-Sell/Upsell Account Manager to full quota attainment and growing account ownership.
  • Shipped enablement for every new product/product line launched in the period, measured by rep certification and time-to-first-sale.
  • Established a defined targeting and qualification standard with the SDR team specific to the mobile enterprise segment.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • 8–12 years in B2B SaaS with direct experience in both enterprise net-new acquisition and expansion/account management — this role requires genuine fluency in both motions, not a hunter forced into a farmer seat or vice versa.
  • Experience selling mobile, digital coaching, or platform/app-based products into multi-location operators.
  • A track record of building playbooks and enablement material that other reps actually use.
  • Direct people management experience, even at small scale (1–3 reports).
  • Comfort operating without a large team around you — this seat is built lean by design in year one.
  • Fitness, wellness, or vertical SaaS experience is a plus; multi-product SaaS environments are highly valued.

Compensation for this role will be determined based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, qualifications, skills, geographic location, and market considerations. The anticipated compensation range for this position is -

$110,000 - $118,000 USD- annually. In addition to base compensation, eligible employees may be offered other forms of compensation, such as bonuses, commissions, equity, or other incentive programs, where applicable. Compensation and benefits may vary by location and are subject to applicable legal, business, and market requirements.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:

  • Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
  • Time Off – with our open PTO policy, we offer flexibility in how and when you take PTO!
  • Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
  • Parental & Pawternity Leave – we offer leave for when your family grows by two feet or four paws!
  • Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
  • Medical/Dental/Vision coverage
  • EAP – we get you help when you need it. Period.
  • Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
  • And more! – so many benefits we couldn’t even fit them all here!

At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.


ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION: 

ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at abcfitness.com


About ABC Fitness

ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.

From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Learn more at abcfitness.com

What You Can Expect

This is a hands-on technical leadership role at the center of how Zoom gets found, understood, and surfaced across both traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered discovery platforms. You will own the technical SEO foundation across a complex, multi-platform web ecosystem spanning Optimizely CMS, WordPress, custom web applications, and modern frontend frameworks, translating search strategy into scalable production solutions. Working closely with SEO and Website Engineering leadership, you will drive high-impact implementations, build reusable SEO capabilities and automation, and establish the engineering standards that keep Zoom's digital presence ahead of the curve. Your work connects directly to organic visibility, pipeline, and revenue, and your fingerprints will be on the architecture decisions that shape how Zoom shows up across Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and the next generation of agentic web experiences.

About the Team


You will be part of Zoom's Website Engineering team within the Online Business organization, a cross-functional group of web engineers, CMS specialists, SEO and AEO experts, and performance engineers who build and scale the technical foundation powering Zoom's global web presence. The team collaborates closely with Marketing, Product, Design, Content, and Localization to deliver fast, accessible, and AI-ready digital experiences. Technical excellence, a bias toward automation, and engineering-by-design are at the core of how we operate.

Responsibilities


  • Lead the technical SEO roadmap and execution across Zoom's global web ecosystem, owning high-priority initiatives driven by SEO analysis, audits, crawl data, search performance data, server logs, technical root-cause analysis, and business priorities.
  • Translate SEO and AEO requirements into technical designs, development specifications, production implementations, and ongoing maintenance across Optimizely CMS, WordPress, custom web applications, APIs, and modern frontend frameworks, ensuring requirements are incorporated throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Own technical solutions for crawlability, indexability, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonicalization, redirects, URL architecture, metadata, structured data, internal linking, hreflang, JavaScript rendering, client-side rendering, server-side rendering, static generation, incremental rendering, and search-friendly application architecture.
  • Build and scale reusable SEO capabilities including centralized metadata services, automated sitemap generation, structured-data components, redirect services, internal-linking systems, and standardized SEO configurations that platforms can inherit without repeated manual intervention.
  • Drive Core Web Vitals and web performance improvements, including LCP, INP, CLS, JavaScript execution, rendering performance, image optimization, font loading, third-party scripts, caching, CDN configuration, API performance, and server response times.
  • Develop automated testing, monitoring, dashboards, CI/CD quality gates, proactive alerting, and validation scripts that detect technical SEO issues and prevent regressions from reaching production across broken links, metadata, canonicalization, structured data, redirects, sitemaps, indexability, robots directives, duplicate URLs, internal linking, accessibility, performance, and rendering.
  • Establish the technical foundation for AEO and AI search by implementing structured data, semantic HTML, machine-readable metadata, entity and product schemas, and machine-readable endpoints; evaluate emerging AI-search and agentic-web standards and translate them into practical engineering requirements.
  • Define and maintain technical SEO standards and governance across Optimizely, WordPress, and custom applications, serving as the technical authority for SEO implementation within Web Engineering through reference architectures, launch-readiness criteria, design reviews, and code reviews.
  • Partner with SEO, Content, Product Marketing, Web Engineering, Product, and senior stakeholders to translate search strategy and business priorities into scalable technical solutions, improve Zoom's discoverability and representation across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms, and connect technical SEO initiatives to measurable organic visibility, acquisition, pipeline, and revenue outcomes.

What We're Looking For


  • 8+ years of experience in technical SEO, web engineering, or a related discipline, with a demonstrated track record leading technical SEO initiatives across large-scale websites and web applications in a B2B SaaS or enterprise technology environment; ability to connect technical SEO work directly to measurable organic visibility, acquisition, pipeline, and revenue outcomes.
  • Deep expertise in technical SEO fundamentals: crawlability, indexation, rendering, canonicalization, redirects, URL architecture, XML sitemaps, robots directives, structured data, internal linking, hreflang, and JavaScript-based web applications; hands-on proficiency with JavaScript, PHP, HTML, and CSS to diagnose and implement technical SEO fixes directly in the codebase and CMS, not only through engineering handoffs.
  • Proven experience improving web performance and Core Web Vitals, including diagnosing issues related to JavaScript execution, rendering, caching, CDN configuration, images, third-party scripts, APIs, and server performance.
  • Experience building scalable SEO capabilities, automation, monitoring, and CI/CD quality gates across enterprise CMS platforms such as Optimizely and WordPress; comfortable going directly into the CMS or codebase to implement configurations, standardize templates, and deploy SEO capabilities across multiple sites and applications without requiring a dedicated engineering sprint for every change.
  • Strong understanding of structured data, Schema.org, JSON-LD, semantic HTML, and the technical foundations required for AEO and AI-powered search, with familiarity with emerging AI search platforms including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews.
  • Strong analytical skills using tools such as Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Semrush, Ahrefs, Sitebulb, analytics platforms, and application observability tools; experienced in analyzing server logs and crawl logs to identify crawl blocks, indexation gaps, rendering failures, and visibility issues across Google, AI search platforms, and LLM crawlers, and translating those findings into prioritized, actionable fixes.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to influence engineering architecture, establish technical standards, and partner effectively with SEO, Web Engineering, Product, Marketing, Content, and senior stakeholders.

The Content Strategist / Information Architect shapes how content is planned, structured, and organized across the program's public-facing websites and applications so that users can find, understand, and act on information efficiently. This role guides content strategy across its full lifecycle, from audience research and planning through development, ongoing management, governance, and publishing, while contributing information-architecture expertise to usability testing, content governance, and search discoverability.

At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our inclusive, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Job Requisition ID #

26WD101268, Senior Software Developer


Position Overview

At Autodesk Informed Design, our mission is to help companies embrace Industrialized Construction through the convergence of Architecture, Engineering, Construction (AEC), and Manufacturing (MFG). We are transforming how buildings are designed and manufactured through scalable digital workflows and connected cloud platforms.


We are looking for a self-motivated and experienced Senior Software Developer to join our team. Our organizational ecosystem comprises cloud services, desktop add-ins, and web application and client components. In this role, you will play a key role in developing components and services across the Informed Design organization. You will solve complex problems of diverse scope by taking a new perspective on existing solutions and applying knowledge of best practices in practical situations. You will also be responsible for the full lifecycle of our products, from writing and evolving code to deploying, monitoring and providing support in production. Success depends not only on technical strengths but also on the ability to collaborate, communicate, and contribute positively to a team that values trust, mutual support and respect for different perspectives and skill sets.


This position can be based anywhere in Canada and is a remote-friendly role.


Responsibilities

  • Involved with all aspects of software development, working to create and maintain the most reliable, secure, performant, and efficient web/ desktop applications and high-throughput services for our customers
  • Partner closely with product managers, product owners, software architects and other stakeholders to iteratively turn high-level requirements into product enhancements that are delivered to customers incrementally and continually
  • Be an integral member of our scrum team and contribute to our codebase and overall team success
  • Contribute to software design and architecture by leveraging software design patterns and injecting your expertise into the entire development lifecycle
  • Contribute to improvements in processes and deliverables that increase the effectiveness and efficiency of the team in responding to customer and business needs
  • Research and prototype innovative ideas, technologies and patterns.
  • Document and present your ideas and solutions accurately and thoroughly
  • Utilize LLMs and AI tools like Claude, Copilot, Cursor or equivalent to improve productivity, efficiency and code quality
  • Leverage modern development tools, including AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to improve productivity, efficiency and code quality
  • Participate in on-call rotations to support production systems

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with application and cloud services development
  • Experience building software projects with Typescript, C# and/or Python
  • Solid understanding of web or desktop application architecture, including data, application and web tiers and how those components behave in production
  • Experience with building secure APIs, Microservices and Desktop applications
  • Experience with Relational database technologies, e.g. Postgres, including schema design, query performance and operational considerations
  • Familiarity with monitoring, logging, alerting and incident response practices
  • Demonstrated ability with using AI-assisted tools and techniques as a productivity multiplier for software development, debugging, testing and operational problem-solving
  • Hands-on experience with unit and automated testing tools such as Cypress, Playwright, etc
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to converse with multiple audiences, not limited to SW Developers, Managers, etc

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AWS services and technologies (e.g. Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS)
  • Experience building or working with CAD applications such as Autodesk Inventor, Autodesk Revit, or other CAD + AEC design software
  • Experience applying AI or automation to improve testing, operational efficiency and developer productivity
  • Strong preference for simple solutions first over complex solutions
  • Exposure to DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code

26WD101268, Développeur logiciel senior


Aperçu du poste

Chez Autodesk Informed Design, notre mission est d’aider les entreprises à adopter la construction industrialisée grâce à la convergence de l’architecture, de l’ingénierie, de la construction (AEC) et de la fabrication (MFG). Nous transformons la manière dont les bâtiments sont conçus et construits grâce à des flux de travail numériques évolutifs et à des plateformes cloud connectées.


Nous recherchons un développeur logiciel senior motivé et expérimenté pour rejoindre notre équipe. Notre écosystème organisationnel comprend des services cloud, des modules complémentaires pour ordinateurs de bureau, ainsi que des applications web et des composants clients. À ce poste, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le développement de composants et de services au sein de l’organisation Informed Design. Vous résoudrez des problèmes complexes de portée variée en adoptant une nouvelle perspective sur les solutions existantes et en appliquant votre connaissance des meilleures pratiques à des situations concrètes. Vous serez également responsable de l’ensemble du cycle de vie de nos produits, de l’écriture et de l’évolution du code jusqu’au déploiement, à la surveillance et au support en production. La réussite dépend non seulement de vos compétences techniques, mais aussi de votre capacité à collaborer, à communiquer et à apporter une contribution positive au sein d’une équipe qui valorise la confiance, le soutien mutuel et le respect des différentes perspectives et compétences.


Ce poste peut être occupé depuis n’importe où au Canada et se prête au télétravail.


Responsabilités

  • Participer à tous les aspects du développement logiciel, en travaillant à la création et à la maintenance d’applications web/de bureau et de services à haut débit les plus fiables, sécurisées, performantes et efficaces pour nos clients
  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les chefs de produit, les propriétaires de produit, les architectes logiciels et les autres parties prenantes afin de transformer de manière itérative les exigences de haut niveau en améliorations de produit livrées aux clients de manière incrémentielle et continue
  • Être un membre à part entière de notre équipe Scrum et contribuer à notre base de code ainsi qu’à la réussite globale de l’équipe
  • Contribuer à la conception et à l’architecture logicielles en tirant parti des modèles de conception logicielle et en apportant votre expertise tout au long du cycle de vie du développement
  • Contribuer à l’amélioration des processus et des livrables afin d’accroître l’efficacité et l’efficience de l’équipe dans la réponse aux besoins des clients et de l’entreprise
  • Rechercher et prototyper des idées, des technologies et des modèles innovants.
  • Documenter et présenter vos idées et solutions de manière précise et exhaustive
  • Utiliser des modèles de langage (LLM) et des outils d’IA tels que Claude, Copilot, Cursor ou leurs équivalents pour améliorer la productivité, l’efficacité et la qualité du code
  • Tirer parti des outils de développement modernes, y compris les outils de codage assistés par l’IA (par exemple, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude) pour améliorer la productivité, l’efficacité et la qualité du code
  • Participer aux rotations de permanence pour assurer le support des systèmes de production

Qualifications minimales

  • Licence (ou diplôme supérieur) en informatique, ingénierie ou dans un domaine technique connexe
  • Au moins 5 ans d’expérience pratique en développement logiciel, notamment dans le développement d’applications et de services cloud
  • Expérience dans la réalisation de projets logiciels avec TypeScript, C# et/ou Python
  • Solide compréhension de l’architecture des applications web ou de bureau, y compris les couches de données, d’application et web, ainsi que le comportement de ces composants en production
  • Expérience dans la création d’API sécurisées, de microservices et d’applications de bureau
  • Expérience des technologies de bases de données relationnelles, par exemple Postgres, y compris la conception de schémas, les performances des requêtes et les considérations opérationnelles
  • Maîtrise des pratiques de surveillance, de journalisation, d’alerte et de réponse aux incidents
  • Capacité avérée à utiliser des outils et techniques assistés par l’IA comme multiplicateur de productivité pour le développement logiciel, le débogage, les tests et la résolution de problèmes opérationnels
  • Expérience pratique des outils de tests unitaires et automatisés tels que Cypress, Playwright, etc.
  • Solides compétences en communication écrite et orale, avec la capacité de dialoguer avec des publics variés, sans se limiter aux développeurs logiciels, aux responsables, etc.
  • Autonomie et sens aigu des responsabilités, avec la capacité de travailler de manière indépendante tout en gérant plusieurs priorités

Qualifications souhaitées

  • Expérience avec les services et technologies AWS (par exemple Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS)
  • Expérience dans le développement ou l’utilisation d’applications de CAO telles qu’Autodesk Inventor, Autodesk Revit ou d’autres logiciels de conception CAO + AEC
  • Expérience dans l’application de l’IA ou de l’automatisation pour améliorer les tests, l’efficacité opérationnelle et la productivité des développeurs
  • Préférence marquée pour les solutions simples plutôt que pour les solutions complexes
  • Connaissance des pratiques DevOps, y compris les pipelines CI/CD et l’infrastructure en tant que code

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Belonging

About the Role

The Data Analyst II works with Client Services staff to process data changes upon request. The Data Analyst II is also responsible for delivering data transfers when needed. The Data Analyst II shows high attention to detail to ensure that data updates they conduct, as well as data transfers they output and deliver to our clients, are of the utmost quality.

Why Signant Health? At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Function currently reports to Sr. VP of Innovation.

Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience building enterprise data platforms at scale (cloud-native, modern data stack: dbt, Spark, Databricks or Snowflake)

  • Data governance tooling: Collibra, Alation, or equivalent enterprise catalog platforms
  • BI and analytics: Tableau, Power BI, or Looker — platform strategy and semantic modeling
  • GenAI patterns: RAG architecture, LLM evaluation frameworks, prompt engineering at enterprise scale

Leadership Profile:

  • Build trust with clinicians and operational leaders; demonstrates clinical context, not just technical empathy
  • Makes decisions with data, not just instinct — models the culture they are trying to build

jobs.excerpt: Fluent German is required for this role.  Our customers are property management companies in Germany and you'll talk to them directly.
jobs.description:
Fluent German is required for this role. Our customers are property management companies in Germany and you'll talk to them directly.

In most companies a developer gets a ticket, builds it and moves on to the next one. Someone else talked to the customer, someone else decided what gets built, and whether it actually helped is someone else's question.

We're looking for developers who want to do the whole job: talk to the people who use the software, decide what to build, build it and stay on it until it works for them. That's what we mean by product engineer. We took the term from PostHog, who describe it well in their Product Engineer Handbook.

About us

is software for property management companies in Germany. Inbox, CRM, documents, telephony, video calls, team chat and AI agents in one platform, so property managers can do their daily work in one place. We're a small team based in Worms, Germany, working fully remote. We're self-funded and profitable.

What a product engineer does here

  • You talk to customers. You read the support requests and feedback for your area, look at how customers use it and talk to them directly, in German. Nobody filters it for you.

  • You decide what to build. For your area you decide what comes next, based on what customers need and what matters for the company. You write down why, so the team can follow and give feedback.

  • You ship early. The first version goes to a few customers as soon as it's useful. Then you improve it based on what they say and do.

  • You build all of it. Data model, backend, frontend and UI. The result has to be clean, simple and intuitive to use, not only working.

  • You do support for your area. When something breaks or a customer is stuck, you fix it and tell them it's fixed.

  • You check whether it worked. Your job isn't done when the feature is live. You look at whether customers use it and whether it solved their problem.

  • You automate what you can. When a customer asks a support question, you add the answer to our knowledge base and update our internal agent, so next time it's handled automatically. A lot already runs on its own here, bug fixes are already processed semi-automatically, and we keep automating more.

Examples of what you could work on

  • A customer wants to bring their old file storage into our document management, with their own folder structure and thousands of documents, and it should be fast and AI-supported. You look at how they've organized their files, build the import as a general feature for all customers, set it up for them and test it with their folder structure. Then you check whether the AI assigned every document to the right building, apartment or contact and fix what doesn't fit.

  • A customer reports that the inbox agent gave a tenant a wrong answer. You look at what the agent did, fix the tool or its instructions and let the customer know.

  • Only a few customers build their own agents in the sandbox. You find out why, by looking at the data and talking to customers, make the setup simpler and check whether more customers use it afterwards.

  • Property managers do the same task fifty times a day and it takes too many clicks. You notice it, talk to them about how they work and make it faster.

Our tech stack

Everything is TypeScript, from the database schema to the frontend.

Backend: Convex (database & serverless functions)

Frontend: Next.js, React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui

Agents: Vercel AI SDK, LiveKit for voice

You'll build with Claude and get as many AI tokens as you need.

Salary

  • $1500 - $3000 per month before taxes with room for growth and promotion in the months & years ahead

  • Permanent employment contract in your country of residence through our partner Deel (EOR)

Benefits

  • 100% remote work

  • Flexible hours

  • Self-funded & profitable, no VC money to burn through

  • Small team, what you build goes live

  • Quick decisions, no pointless meetings and no layers of approval

Our Health Program

  • Private room in hospital, worldwide coverage

  • Free choice of doctors & specialists, no health check, pre-existing conditions don't matter

  • Partner and kids are covered as well

  • Surgery, cancer care, MRI/CT/PET scans and diagnostics fully covered

  • Dental treatment & surgery covered at 90%

  • $675/year for physio, osteopathy, chiropractic and acupuncture

  • $100 per night in-patient cash benefit, up to 20 nights

  • Prescription drugs, vaccinations, glasses/contacts, home nursing and ambulance covered

Our values

  • Get things done, every day matters

  • Transparency and honesty, especially when it's hard

  • High standards for our own work and each other's

Requirements

Requirements

  • Fluent German, spoken and written

  • Fluent English

  • More than a year of experience shipping production code

What we look for

  • You care more about whether customers can get their work done than about the perfect implementation.

  • You have a good eye for aesthetics and UI design. You don't just ship whatever the AI generates. You keep working on the interface until it's clean and as simple and intuitive as possible for the people using it.

  • You finish things. A feature that's 80% done doesn't help anyone, so you stay on it until it works well.

  • You have an opinion on what to build and back it up with what customers say and do. When the feedback says otherwise, you change your mind.

  • You take feedback well and give honest feedback yourself.

  • You write clearly. As a remote team we work a lot in writing: issues, short proposals, PR descriptions.

  • You understand the basics of the business: who our customers are, what they pay for and why they stay.

  • You write almost all of your code with AI and understand architecture well enough to judge what it writes.

  • You'd rather automate a task than do it twice.

  • You're a generalist and learn new things quickly.

Nice to have

  • You've built your own product or side project that real people used, or you've worked directly with customers before.

  • Experience designing databases and optimizing query performance & cost

  • Experience building production agents, queues and long-running workflows

This role is not for you if

  • you want someone else to decide what you build and hand you tickets

  • you'd rather not deal with customers or support

  • you want to polish code for weeks before anyone sees it

  • you like to move on to the next idea before the last one really works

How we hire

  1. Intro call

  2. Interview with our founder about your background and the things you've built

  3. Reference call with a previous manager

  4. Offer

For a closer look at what we're building, check out our YouTube channel (it's in German).

About Viamo

The organizations that serve them lack the technology and capacity to reach them, and many are unaware of the power of mobile technology to meet their organizational goals.

Viamo connects individuals and organizations using digital technology to make better decisions.

Viamo is the #1 Digital Platform connecting these organizations to the Next Billion users who don't have access to the internet, and we are well on our way to meeting our goal of reaching 100 million people annually.

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join our growing, multinational team of engineers. We work passionately to improve the quality of life for people in lower and middle income countries through high quality digital services with human centered design bridging the gaps of commerce, education and health. All our users need is a simple mobile phone and a mobile connection to get access to the information and services they need to succeed and thrive.

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer at Viamo, you and your team will be responsible for multiple exciting projects. You will be building, maintaining, and scaling a large-scale platform that handles millions of voice and SMS interactions every month. You and your team will be innovating on and scaling GenAI and language AI voice technologies for people in low-resource languages.

Use them as much or as little as you like: our workflows aren't set in stone, and there's room to experiment with how agentic engineering fits the way we build.

jobs.excerpt: We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production.
jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

Priorytetem jest dla nas Twój postęp zawodowy i osobisty, dlatego oferujemy bogaty zakres możliwości doskonalenia zawodowego i międzynarodową wymianę wiedzy. Nasze środowisko pracy wyróżnia się elastycznością i troską o równowagę między życiem zawodowym a prywatnym.

Projekt

Dla naszego klienta, dużego skandynawskiego dostawcy telekomunikacyjnego, poszukujemy osób na stanowisko Study Driver.
Projekt dotyczy analizy, projektowania oraz optymalizacji systemów radiowych LTE/5G w ujęciu end-to-end. Będziesz pracować w roli konsultingowej nad architekturą RAN, analizą funkcjonalności oraz wydajności systemu, uwzględniając zależności pomiędzy wszystkimi warstwami aplikacji i sprzętu.
Twoje zadania będą dotyczyć kluczowych aspektów optymalizacji działania systemu (throughput, latency, coverage), analizy problemów oraz wspieraniu decyzji projektowych w kontekście ograniczeń platformowych i sprzętowych.

Zakres zadań projektowych:

  • Analiza end-to-end działania systemów radiowych LTE/5G NR.

  • Wsparcie w projektowaniu i optymalizacji architektury RAN (RU, DU, CU) wraz z kluczowymi aspektami zarządzania warstwą radiową (scheduling, interference management, load balancing).

  • Przekładanie zachowania i wydajności systemu na mierzalne metryki (KPI).

  • Przeprowadzanie symulacji (MATLAB) oraz projektowanie scenariuszy testowych.

  • Analiza i troubleshooting problemów na poziomie systemu.

  • Wsparcie w rozmowach z klientami, tworzenie technicznych rekomendacji, przekładanie decyzji biznesowych na techniczne wymagania.

  • Współpraca z zespołami hardware i software (ASIC, FPGA, DSP).

Oczekiwania

Szukamy inżynierów systemowych z doświadczeniem w obszarze RAN, którzy rozumieją zależności pomiędzy basebandem, sprzętem radiowym oraz protokołami sieciowymi. Osób, które potrafią łączyć głęboką wiedzę techniczną z podejściem konsultingowym i swobodnie poruszają się między analizą szczegółową a dyskusją na poziomie architektury systemu.

Kwalifikacje

  • Kilkuletnie doświadczenie na podobnym stanowisku.

  • Bardzo dobra znajomość LTE oraz 5G NR.

  • Znajomość standardów 3GPP (L1–L3, ze szczególnym uwzględnieniem L1/L2).

  • Dobra znajomość architektury RAN/gNB (RU, DU, CU).

  • Doświadczenie w analizie systemowej i analizie wymagań.

  • Znajomość zagadnień z obszaru Radio Resource Management (scheduling, interference management, load balancing).

  • Doświadczenie w symulacjach systemowych (np. MATLAB).

  • Znajomość fronthaul (CPRI, eCPRI).

  • Rozumienie przetwarzania sygnałów oraz synchronizacji.

  • Komunikatywna znajomość języka angielskiego w mowie i piśmie.

Mile widziane

  • Doświadczenie w projektach 5G Advanced lub 6G.

  • Doświadczenie w pracy konsultingowej (rola client-facing).

  • Doświadczenie w pracy w środowisku operatora sieci telekomunikacyjnych.

  • Praca w środowisku międzynarodowym.

  • Znajomość Python i/lub C++.

Oferujemy:

  • Współpracę w formule B2B opartą na partnerskich zasadach

  • Możliwość realizacji ambitnych projektów dla klientów z różnych branż

  • Udział w projektach technologicznych z obszaru AI, data oraz transformacji cyfrowej

  • Elastyczność w zakresie organizacji i sposobu realizacji zadań projektowych

jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Our client is a small, founder-led consumer brand based in Austin, TX, that makes a regulated nicotine product (tobacco-free pouches) and sells it direct-to-consumer in the UK. Because Meta, Google, and TikTok all prohibit nicotine advertising, there is no ad budget this company can spend to buy growth — every channel that's left (search, owned email and SMS, subscription retention, referral, retail and trade, athlete and podcast partnerships, field sampling) has to be built and wired together by hand. That constraint is the whole shape of this job.

Your Role:

This role exists because the easy version of growth marketing isn't available here — someone has to build the campaign machinery, not just brief it. You'll spend real time each week directing Claude Code to connect APIs, enrich lists, and automate recurring work, and the rest of your time running campaigns alongside the people actually knocking on doors: sales, field, and partnerships. You report directly to the two founders, at manager level, fully hands-on, with no reports of your own (headcount comes later, if at all). Success looks like a trade and partnership outbound engine that runs itself, a field team that's armed and getting better each cycle, owned channels (search, lifecycle, retention, referral) doing the growth work that paid acquisition can't, and numbers everyone can actually trust.

A note on the category: this is a regulated product, and the rules aren't style guidance — they're hard constraints on the job itself. No health, cessation, or performance claims anywhere, ever. Age and territory gating (18+, UK only) stays intact, full stop. No paid social or paid search for the product, no workarounds. Nothing overstated in writing. If that reads as a limitation on the work rather than the actual shape of it, this isn't the right seat.

You'll:

  • Build and run the trade and partnership outbound engine — define the segment, pull and enrich the list, verify and score contacts, write and track the sequence, and know when not to use a sequencer (some outreach has to go out by hand)

  • Arm the field team (sampling, shop visits, trade shows) with target lists, routes, one-pagers, and post-visit follow-up sequences, then work alongside them so the next version is better

  • Own the channels that are actually open here: search and content, lifecycle email and SMS, subscription retention (win-back, dunning recovery, pause-instead-of-cancel), and referral programs, including the reconciliation behind them

  • Produce creative in-house with AI tools against the brand's existing visual system — knowing when to generate, when to composite a real product shot instead, and when to send a piece to a human

  • Automate anything manual and recurring — enrichment scripts, list hygiene, report pulls, campaign QA, content pipelines — instead of adding it to someone's checklist

  • Own first-party measurement (order and subscription data, cohort retention, referral attribution, search visibility), since no ad platform is feeding this business conversion data, and flag a bad number before anyone else finds it

You Bring:

  • Real, hands-on experience directing Claude Code (or an equivalent coding agent) on live work — connected to an API or MCP server, shipping something still in use today. This is the one non-negotiable requirement on this list, and it's tested directly in the interview process; nearly everything else here is trainable

  • 3+ years hands-on in marketing — the profile that fits typically started in a coordinator-type role, got tired of waiting on others to pull data or wire up tools, and taught themselves to do it

  • Cold outbound you've run yourself, start to finish: built the list, wrote the sequence, watched the reply rate, fixed deliverability when it broke, using Apollo or an equivalent plus at least one sequencer

  • Comfortable with data — you read a CSV without flinching, write SQL or get there with help, and know why a bad join can quietly double your numbers

  • Working scripting ability in Python or JavaScript (or a track record of directing AI to write and debug it while keeping it honest), and you use git

  • APIs are ordinary to you: auth, keys, rate limits, webhooks, and reading docs to find the endpoint you need

  • A genuine eye for marketing — you can tell a good offer from a weak one, spot a broken page, and write an email a retail buyer will actually answer — and you write plainly, in specific, filler-free sentences

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with this kind of stack: list/enrichment tools (e.g. Apollo), sequencers, a commerce/subscription backend, Postgres/SQL, transactional email, SEO tooling, workflow automation (e.g. n8n), and AI image tools

  • Background marketing in a regulated or high-constraint category (alcohol, supplements, pharma, gambling, or similar), where claims review and compliance shape every campaign

  • DTC subscription or ecommerce experience, especially retention/win-back programs and referral mechanics

What’s Offered:

  • Based in Austin, TX, or remote with 9–5 CT overlap

  • Direct reporting line to the two founders — high visibility, real ownership, minimal layers

  • A hands-on, builder-first seat: you ship the work yourself rather than briefing someone else to

  • Real autonomy over a growth stack built on search, lifecycle, retention, referral, trade, and field — not ad spend

  • The chance to help build out the company's own agent and automation stack from the ground up

  • Compensation based on experience and location — to confirm with the client before this goes to candidates

Interview Process:

  • 1️⃣ Apply with a short note naming one thing you've built with Claude Code and what it does today (link it if you can)

  • 2️⃣ Screening call (30 minutes) — walking through that build in detail

  • 3️⃣ Paid exercise (about 3 hours) — given a target segment and API access, produce a scored, enriched contact list, a three-touch sequence, and the script or flow that generated it; one touch has to survive a claims review

  • 4️⃣ Working session with a founder — pick the exercise apart together and build one more thing live in Claude Code

Position Overview

Autodesk’s worldwide sales organization depends on its forecast, pipeline, targets and reporting. This role builds the data models behind them. As an Analytics Engineer on the Forecasting & Revenue Intelligence team, you turn sales, subscription and hierarchy data into tested, documented models that analysts and sales leaders can trust, covering what customers bought, who owns which accounts and how the sales organization looked on any given date. You will work in SQL and dbt on Snowflake, and you will work closely with the people who use your models. This is a hands-on role on a new team, and you will own what you ship.

Location: United States (remote). Central or Eastern time zone preferred.

Organization: Revenue Operations

  • Reconcile the data to Salesforce and to Finance, and find the cause when they disagree
  • Build the datasets behind the weekly forecast pack, business reviews and leadership dashboards
  • Add tests and monitoring for freshness, completeness and accuracy, and fix what breaks
  • Explain data issues and trade-offs to sales and finance partners in plain terms, and agree on a fix with them

  • Working knowledge of the Salesforce data model: accounts, opportunities, line items and ownership

Job Summary

The Health Data Analyst is responsible for assessing and improving health data quality, performing advanced statistical and clinical analysis, and designing interactive visualizations and reporting tools. Operating at the intersection of clinical data, claims databases, and business operations, this role extracts complex datasets to support Value-Based Care, Quality Metrics, and executive decision-making. The position supports UHIN’s transition toward a data-driven culture by delivering actionable insights, advancing data governance, and maintaining rigorous compliance with regulatory standards.

Qualifications - Education, Experience and Skills

Required qualifications:

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Informatics, Epidemiology, Data Analytics, Statistics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Minimum 2–4 years of experience extracting, analyzing, interpreting, and reporting on complex healthcare data.
  • Demonstrated experience working with both healthcare claims and clinical data distributions.

Domain & Analytical Expertise:

  • Experience with Risk Stratification models (e.g., CMS HCC), Quality Metrics (e.g., HEDIS, MIPS, CMS Star Ratings), and Utilization/Cost Analytics (e.g., total cost of care, readmission rates, length of stay).
  • Proven track record assessing health data quality, accuracy, completeness, and timeliness across disparate data sources.

Technical & Software Proficiency:

  • Advanced SQL query development for complex data extraction, aggregation, and manipulation.
  • Experience with Python (including data visualization and statistical libraries).
  • Hands-on experience developing interactive dashboards using Business Intelligence tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree with specialized training in research methods and statistical analysis in a healthcare domain (e.g., Informatics, Epidemiology).
  • Experience with machine learning algorithms, predictive analytics, and Natural Language Processing (NLP) for unstructured healthcare data.
  • Familiarity with additional languages/tools: R, JavaScript, Google BigQuery, and healthcare industry data standards.

Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities

  • Technical & Data Mastery: Proficiency in writing optimized SQL queries, utilizing Python/R libraries, building BI dashboards, applying statistical/research methods, and working with both structured and unstructured datasets.
  • Analytical & Critical Thinking: Ability to identify complex problems, weigh pros/cons (cost/benefit), perform quantitative and qualitative analyses, and draw logical, data-backed conclusions.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Engagement: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills to articulate complex technical insights and non-technical actionable recommendations for medical directors, clinicians, and executive leadership teams.
  • Data Governance & Security: In-depth knowledge of HIPAA, CMS regulations, and internal data governance policies, maintaining absolute confidentiality and security standards.
  • Organization & Collaboration: Strong time management, self-initiative, and prioritization skills, with a demonstrated ability to lead meetings, manage projects, and collaborate cross-functionally across teams.

Coordinate with data contributors to resolve anomalies.
  • Dashboarding & Visualizations: Design, develop, and maintain interactive business intelligence tools and dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) to track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as patient readmission rates, length of stay, and operational costs.

Description

About Coralogix

Coralogix is a full-stack observability and security platform built for modern engineering teams that need real-time visibility at scale.

Our platform brings together logs, metrics, traces, security events, infrastructure, Kubernetes, applications, and user experience in one place. With a no-index architecture and in-stream analytics, Coralogix helps customers reduce cost, retain more data, and troubleshoot faster without compromising scale or performance.

We are looking for technical sellers who can help customers understand the value of a different approach and prove it in real-world environments.

﻿The Role

We are hiring a Solutions Engineer to join our East Coast pre-sales team, focused on LATAM customers and involving frequent travel across the region.

This is a senior, hands-on technical sales role. You will partner with Account Executives to run technical discovery, lead product evaluations, design solutions, and help customers validate Coralogix in their own environments.

During evaluations, you will be expected to do more than present the platform. You will act as the technical owner, helping customers deploy, configure, integrate, troubleshoot, and validate Coralogix across their environments. You need to be credible with engineers, confident with executives, and capable of moving between architecture, code, configuration, and business value.

This role is for someone who can earn trust in technical conversations, build strong relationships with LATAM customers, and help drive deals to a strong technical close. Frequent travel across LATAM is an important part of the role.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the technical strategy for sales opportunities in partnership with Account Executives.
  • Lead discovery across customer architecture, telemetry sources, operational pain, business drivers, and success criteria.
  • Design and deliver tailored demonstrations that connect Coralogix to real customer use cases.
  • Manage technical evaluations and POCs from scope through validation.
  • Support hands-on deployment, configuration, integration, and troubleshooting during evaluations.
  • Work with customers across logs, metrics, traces, Kubernetes, cloud environments, applications, and security use cases.
  • Explain Coralogix’s architecture, differentiation, and value clearly to both technical and executive audiences.
  • Identify technical risks, remove blockers, and guide customers toward a successful technical decision.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Support to represent field feedback and improve how we win.

Requirements

  • 3+ years in a customer-facing technical role such as Solutions Engineering, Pre-Sales, Solution Architecture, Technical Consulting, DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, or Security Engineering .
  • Native level Spanish and fluent English are required. Portuguese or additional languages - strong advantage.
  • ﻿Experience leading technical evaluations, product demonstrations, and proof-of-concept processes.
  • Willingness to travel frequently across LATAM.
  • Strong hands-on technical ability across deployment, configuration, troubleshooting, and integration work.
  • strong understanding of observability, including logs, metrics, traces, APM, dashboards, alerting, and infrastructure monitoring.
  • Ability to speak credibly with engineers, DevOps, SRE, platform, and security teams.
  • Confidence engaging executives and translating technical value into business impact.
  • Practical experience with cloud-native environments, distributed systems, containers, and modern infrastructure.
  • Coding or scripting experience in languages such as Python, Go, Java, JavaScript, Bash, or similar.
  • Strong communication, ownership, follow-through, and commercial judgment.

Technical Experience

Relevant experience may include:

  • Kubernetes and containerized environments
  • AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • OpenTelemetry
  • Prometheus
  • Docker
  • APM and distributed tracing
  • Log analytics and telemetry pipelines
  • SIEM or security monitoring
  • Infrastructure monitoring
  • RUM
  • Terraform, Helm, or deployment automation
  • CI/CD workflows
  • Application instrumentation and debugging

What Success Looks Like

The best Solutions Engineers at Coralogix are not just strong presenters. They are technical owners.

They can uncover pain, define success, build a validation plan, and prove value in the customer’s environment. They are hands-on enough to earn credibility with practitioners and commercially aware enough to help move opportunities forward.

They know when to go deep, when to simplify, when to challenge, and when to escalate.

Why Join Coralogix

Observability is changing fast. Data volumes are growing, budgets are under pressure, and teams are rethinking the platforms they rely on.

Coralogix gives customers a different path: real-time analytics, open standards, strong security and observability use cases, and an architecture designed for scale.

As a Solutions Engineer, you will play a central role in strategic evaluations, competitive opportunities, and the technical decisions that help customers choose Coralogix.

﻿Compensation and Benefits

The on-target earnings range for this role is $220,000 to $250,000. Final compensation will be based on experience, skills, education, and work location.

Our total rewards package includes healthcare, dental, mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan with company match, paid sick time, and paid time off.

Coralogix is an equal-opportunity employer. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

Cultural Fit

We’re seeking candidates who are hungry, humble, and smart.

Coralogix fosters a culture of innovation and continuous learning, where team members are encouraged to challenge the status quo and contribute to our shared mission. If you thrive in dynamic environments and are eager to shape the future of observability solutions, we’d love to hear from you.

Coralogix is an equal-opportunity employer and encourages applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.description:
About RAB2B

  • RAB2B is a global B2B marketing agency that partners with ambitious brands to drive measurable growth. We combine strategic thinking, media excellence, and operational rigor to deliver integrated solutions across markets. Our culture is built on accountability, clarity, and performance — empowering our teams to lead with ownership while collaborating across disciplines.

About the role

RAB2B is growing its data practice into a service clients buy in its own right. The Data Director sets its direction and leads the team that delivers it.

The role owns how data creates commercial value across the agency: the strategy, the capability roadmap, the offerings taken to market, and the narrative that persuades a client to invest. The Data Director partners with media, account and performance leadership as the person accountable for what data makes possible, and sits with client marketing leaders as the person who explains what their investment produced and what it should fund next.

The practice serves enterprise B2B clients across technology, manufacturing and healthcare, delivering measurement, reporting and dashboarding on a modern cloud data stack. Its next phase centers on advanced attribution and incrementality, marketing mix modeling, AI-assisted measurement and a portfolio of commercial data offerings.

This is a builder’s mandate. The Data Director carries end-to-end authority over the data discipline — strategy, capability, commercial offerings and team design — with the latitude to set the practice’s direction and the accountability that comes with it.

What you'll do

1. Commercial leadership of data

  • Define the commercial strategy for data at RAB2B: what we sell, to whom, at what price and with what proof.
  • Develop monetizable data products and services that grow client accounts and create agency revenue. Shape and price them jointly with media, account and finance leadership, against a shared target for what they produce.
  • Partner with business and client leads to identify high-value data use cases across existing accounts and new logos, then deliver them.
  • Present investment recommendations (data sources, partners, platforms, licenses) to the executive team, with the business case behind each one.

2. Data strategy and capability

  • Build the capability roadmap and align the organization behind it: the methods, the stack, the sequence and the investment each stage requires.
  • Lead the move past campaign reporting into multi-touch attribution, incrementality testing and marketing mix modeling, including a clear view of where each method holds and where it breaks.
  • Build on the team’s early adoption of AI-assisted measurement: decide where AI belongs across the practice, scale what already works and set the standard for the discipline.
  • Identify the data sources and partners worth acquiring, and negotiate the terms.

3. Client-facing leadership

  • Embed data across the commercial cycle: pitches, RFP responses, strategic planning, media activation and effectiveness measurement.
  • Translate complex data into actionable insight and a commercial narrative that moves a CMO to act.
  • Own the measurement conversation in the room: model the path from media investment to pipeline, qualified opportunity and closed revenue, and defend that model under scrutiny.
  • Raise client ambition through insight, storytelling and thought leadership.

4. Standards, team and organization

  • Own the standards by which the practice operates — measurement frameworks, taxonomy, data governance and reporting quality — and hold the discipline to them.
  • Build and lead a cross-functional team of data strategists, analysts and technologists, and define the shape that team takes as the practice scales.
  • Partner with the MarTech and Digital Experience teams, who own tagging, consent, CRM and marketing automation, so the data the practice reads and sells is trustworthy.
  • Make the case for data internally and build agency-wide fluency in what the practice offers.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years in data strategy, analytics or data-driven marketing, with progressive leadership responsibility across teams and client relationships.
  • A track record of building or scaling a data capability inside an agency, holding company or consultancy.
  • Commercial fluency: experience shaping offerings, defending pricing and contributing to revenue, not only to delivery.

jobs.description:
Role Overview

We are looking for an AI Engineer specializing in Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to design, develop, and deploy production-grade AI solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong experience with LLM/VLM architectures, prompt engineering, RAG, fine-tuning, multimodal AI, and model serving.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and deploy AI applications using LLMs and VLMs.
  • Build RAG pipelines involving document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval, reranking, and generation.
  • Work with models such as GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, Qwen, and multimodal/VLM models.
  • Develop multimodal solutions involving text, images, PDFs, charts, tables, and documents.
  • Perform prompt engineering, supervised fine-tuning, LoRA/QLoRA, and model evaluation.
  • Build AI agents and tool-calling workflows where appropriate.
  • Optimize inference for latency, throughput, memory, and cost.
  • Develop APIs and production services using Python, FastAPI, Docker, and cloud platforms.
  • Implement evaluation frameworks to measure accuracy, hallucination, relevance, latency, and safety.
  • Collaborate with ML engineers, software engineers, and product teams to take prototypes into production.

Required Skills

  • Strong Python programming and software-engineering fundamentals.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs and/or VLMs.
  • Strong understanding of Transformers, attention mechanisms, tokenization, embeddings, and inference.
  • Experience with PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Experience building RAG systems and vector-search solutions.
  • Knowledge of prompt engineering and LLM evaluation.
  • Experience with APIs, REST services, Git, Docker, and CI/CD.
  • Familiarity with vector databases such as FAISS, Milvus, Pinecone, Weaviate, or pgvector.
  • Understanding of cloud AI infrastructure, preferably AWS/Azure/GCP.

VLM / Computer Vision Skills

  • Experience with multimodal models such as Qwen-VL, LLaVA, Gemini, GPT vision models, or similar.
  • Understanding of image preprocessing and document/image understanding.
  • Experience with OCR, document intelligence, image classification, object detection, or visual question answering is a plus.
  • Ability to build pipelines combining vision + language + retrieval.
